coinbase-new-user-bonus.title: [US] Coinbase: random BTC reward on your first buy
coinbase-new-user-bonus.highlight: Buy $50+ of crypto after signing up and get a random $3–$2,000 BTC reward, about $25 on average
coinbase-new-user-bonus.regions: [US] United States and other countries where Coinbase opens accounts (check the sign-up page)
coinbase-new-user-bonus.content: New users who sign up for Coinbase and make one crypto purchase of $50 or more in their account get a random BTC reward between $3 and $2,000; Coinbase states the average is about $25. The reward pool is limited and the offer ends when it runs out or Coinbase ends it.
coinbase-new-user-bonus.conditions: New users only; the first purchase must be $50 or more; limited reward pool, first come first served; some regions and identity checks are restricted.
steps: Sign up for Coinbase through the offer page and complete identity verification (KYC)
Buy any crypto in your account, at least $50 in one order
Check your portfolio for the randomly issued BTC reward
coinbase-new-user-bonus.risk: Coinbase labels this "up to $2,000" and most people get the small end; crypto price risk after buying is yours, and the reward is not investment advice.
coinbase-new-user-bonus.source: Coinbase official offer page (the terms state an average reward of about $25)

usbank-business-checking-1500.title: [US] U.S. Bank business checking: up to $1,500 bonus + $250 Bill Pay
usbank-business-checking-1500.highlight: Platinum Business Checking: deposit $25k of new money, hold it to day 60 and make 6 qualifying transactions — $1,200 on the official page, $1,500 with code Q4BUS26; another $250 on top with Bill Pay for Business
usbank-business-checking-1500.regions: [US] United States; needs a business entity (SSN/EIN) and a state where U.S. Bank has branches, or an existing relationship with the bank
usbank-business-checking-1500.content: U.S. Bank business checking bonus (offer runs 2026-09-28 to 2027-01-13): open online with at least $25, choose Platinum Business Checking, deposit $25,000 of new money within 30 days, keep the daily balance until day 60 and make 6 qualifying transactions within 60 days. The official page lists Platinum $1,200 / Essentials $400 (code Q4DIG26); community reports and Doctor of Credit found code Q4BUS26 pays Platinum $1,500, Gold $900 (with $10k) and Essentials $500 (with $5k). Bill Pay for Business adds $250: enrol between 2026-09-28 and 2027-01-13 and make 5 qualifying bill payments within 60 days of enrolling. Bonuses are paid within 30 days after the end of the qualifying month and reported on 1099-INT.
usbank-business-checking-1500.conditions: Must be a US business (SSN/EIN); enrol in Business Online Banking within 30 days of opening (separate from personal online banking); new money must arrive within 30 days, stay until day 60 and come with 6 qualifying transactions; one per business; no U.S. Bank business checking account in the past 12 months or recently closed; Platinum charges $30 a month, waived with a $25k average balance.
steps: Open Platinum Business Checking online at the U.S. Bank business page with code Q4BUS26 (or the default code), depositing at least $25
Move $25,000 of new money in from outside the bank within 30 days (internal transfers don't count)
Keep the daily balance until day 60 and make 6 qualifying transactions (ACH/Zelle/debit card/cheques)
Enrol in Business Online Banking within 30 days; for the extra $250, enrol in Bill Pay for Business and make 5 bill payments
usbank-business-checking-1500.risk: Ties up $25,000 for about 60 days and requires a US business entity; the $1,500 tier comes from invite code Q4BUS26 (the official page shows $1,200 and the code changes the amount); the $30 monthly fee needs a balance waiver; bonuses are taxable interest.
usbank-business-checking-1500.source: U.S. Bank official Business Checking and Online Banking Bonus page (terms to 2027-01-13) + Doctor of Credit, updated 2026-09-29 + US card forum data point, 2026-11-18

binance-lite-vouchers.title: [Global] Binance new-user tasks: up to $1,100 in fee vouchers
binance-lite-vouchers.highlight: A first $50 fiat/card/P2P buy plus $100 of spot volume unlock two fee-rebate vouchers
binance-lite-vouchers.regions: [Global] Countries served by Binance Global (entity terms differ by region)
binance-lite-vouchers.content: After signing up through a referral link (Lite mode), new users can get two fee-rebate vouchers: a first fiat/credit-card/P2P purchase of $50 or more earns up to $100, and $100 of cumulative spot or Convert volume earns up to $1,000. Binance decides the voucher value when it is issued.
binance-lite-vouchers.conditions: New accounts signed up through a referral only; only fiat/card/P2P buys count for the first task, on-chain deposits don't; vouchers must be activated within 7 days and used within 14 days of activation.
steps: Sign up with the referral link and complete KYC
Buy $50 or more of crypto with a credit/debit card or P2P
Complete $100 of spot or Convert volume
Activate the fee vouchers under Rewards and use them within 14 days
binance-lite-vouchers.risk: The vouchers only offset spot trading fees, so they are worth $0 if you don't trade; the "up to" amounts aren't guaranteed — what the issued voucher says is all you get.
binance-lite-vouchers.source: Binance official referral programme page + third-party terms check (2026-09)

jetbrains-student-pack.title: [Global] JetBrains student pack: every IDE free
jetbrains-student-pack.highlight: All desktop IDEs and Ultimate subscriptions free, renewed yearly, then 40% off for two years after graduating
jetbrains-student-pack.content: Students and teachers can apply for a JetBrains educational licence and use IntelliJ IDEA Ultimate, PyCharm, WebStorm, CLion, GoLand and every other desktop IDE plus Ultimate subscriptions for free while enrolled, renewed each year; after graduating you keep 40% off for two years.
jetbrains-student-pack.conditions: Must be enrolled at an accredited school (university/college); verify with a school email, an ISIC/ITIC student card or the GitHub Student Pack; renew once a year.
steps: Open the JetBrains student application page and verify with your school email or the GitHub Student Pack
Click the confirmation link in the email
Download the IDEs and sign in with your JetBrains Account
jetbrains-student-pack.risk: The licence runs for a year: forget to renew and it lapses; commercial use must follow the educational licence terms.
jetbrains-student-pack.source: JetBrains official student pack page + support docs (2026-10-29)

hostinger-black-friday.title: [Global] Hostinger Black Friday: hosting from $1.99/mo
hostinger-black-friday.highlight: 48-month plans 85% off, with a free domain, SSL and double AI credits
hostinger-black-friday.regions: [Global] Prices vary slightly by country and currency
hostinger-black-friday.content: Hostinger's Black Friday runs to 12/14: the Premium plan is $1.99/mo on a 48-month term (normally $12.99/mo, about 85% off, $95.52 paid up front) and Unlimited is $2.79/mo, both with a free domain for a year, SSL, weekly or daily backups and double AI credits; domains are up to 99% off.
hostinger-black-friday.conditions: Pay for 48 months up front; renewals return to list price (Premium $10.99/mo); the discount applies automatically, no code needed; 30-day money-back guarantee.
steps: Open the Black Friday page and choose a plan on the 48-month term
Check whether the free domain is included and add it to the cart
Check the total and the renewal price before checkout
hostinger-black-friday.risk: You pay for four years up front and renewals cost several times more; if you're unsure you'll keep the site, start monthly rather than locking in four years for the discount.
hostinger-black-friday.source: Hostinger official Black Friday page (offer dates and prices as published)

bybit-referral-tasks.title: [Global] Bybit referral tasks: up to 250 USDT for each side
bybit-referral-tasks.highlight: From a first $50 trade, tiers at $500 and $10,000 of volume pay 50+100+100 USDT
bybit-referral-tasks.regions: [Global] Countries served by Bybit Global (some regions restricted)
bybit-referral-tasks.content: Sign up for Bybit through an invite link and both the new user and the inviter can complete three tasks: a first trade of $50 or more within 14 days pays 50 USDT each; $500 of cumulative volume within 30 days of the first trade pays 100 USDT each; $10,000 pays another 100 USDT each. That is up to 500 USDT across both sides, and the new user also gets a tiered Welcome Gift worth about $100.
bybit-referral-tasks.conditions: Must register with an invite link/code; deposit $100 or more; volume excludes zero-fee pairs; rewards are released after a 3-day risk review and must be claimed within 10 days.
steps: Sign up for Bybit with the invite link and complete KYC
Deposit $100 or more within 7 days
Make a first trade of $50 or more within 14 days, then reach the volume tiers
Claim the rewards in the Rewards Hub
bybit-referral-tasks.risk: Rewards arrive as Bonus / Fee Saver / Position Airdrop, which can't be withdrawn directly and only offset fees or margin; the monthly pool is 500,000 USDT, first come first served.

okx-new-user-bonus.title: [EEA] OKX new-user pack (tiered tasks)
okx-new-user-bonus.highlight: Verify, deposit €100 and trade through the tiers; vouchers by task, and the amounts vary a lot by region
okx-new-user-bonus.regions: [EEA] The European Economic Area example totals €400; other regions have different tiers, shown in the app's Welcome Rewards
okx-new-user-bonus.content: After signing up through a designated promo channel, OKX shows a personal task card under Rewards → Welcome Rewards: the European example pays €50 for identity verification, €50 for a €100 deposit and X-Perps vouchers at €1, €1,000, €10,000 and €50,000 of trading volume, up to €400 in total. Tasks and amounts change by region, campaign period and user tier.
okx-new-user-bonus.conditions: Must sign up through the designated invite link or official offer page — accounts opened on the normal sign-up page can't be added later; deposits are counted net; trading tasks must be completed within 14 days of signing up.
steps: Sign up with the campaign link and complete KYC
Deposit what the task card asks (e.g. €100 or more)
Complete the matching trading volume
Claim in Rewards → My Rewards and watch the lock-up period
okx-new-user-bonus.risk: Crypto rewards can be locked for up to 45 days and can't be withdrawn; rewards are futures/perpetual vouchers, not cash; sign-ups outside the designated channel are void.

citizens-bank-400-checking.title: [US] Citizens Bank first checking account: $400 for a single $1,000 direct deposit (to 12/20)
citizens-bank-400-checking.highlight: Open your first personal checking account online and take one qualifying direct deposit of $1,000+ within 60 days to get $400; only in CT, DC, DE, FL, MA, MD, MI, NH, NJ, NY, OH, PA, RI, VA, VT
citizens-bank-400-checking.regions: [US] Only 15 north-eastern states and DC (CT, DC, DE, FL, MA, MD, MI, NH, NJ, NY, OH, PA, RI, VA, VT); needs a US address and SSN/ITIN
citizens-bank-400-checking.content: Citizens Bank's Q4 account offer: between 2026-10-05 and 2026-12-20, open your first Citizens personal checking account online through the offer page link and take one single direct deposit of $1,000 or more into it within 60 days to get a $400 promo bonus. Eligible accounts include One Deposit Checking ($9.99 monthly fee, waived with one deposit per statement), Citizens Quest Checking and Student Checking. Bonuses are paid by account-opening month: October accounts by 2027-02-28, November by 2027-03-31, December by 2027-04-30.
citizens-bank-400-checking.conditions: The primary owner must not have held any Citizens personal checking or savings account in the previous 6 months; you must start the online application from the offer page's "Open Account" link — opening from the homepage doesn't count; P2P deposits such as Zelle, Cash App, Venmo and PayPal and irregular credits don't qualify, only recurring income such as salary or pension does; the new account must stay funded and active until the payout date; one bonus per person, not combinable with other Citizens checking offers; bonuses are taxed under IRS rules.
steps: Check your state is covered and have a US address, SSN/ITIN and photo ID ready
From https://www.citizensbank.com/promo/checking/26-q4-bau-gm.aspx click Open Account for the account you want
Complete the application online and save or print the terms page as proof
Get one direct deposit of $1,000 or more (salary or pension) into the new account within 60 days
Track progress in the app's Promo Tracker and check the account at the end of the payout month
citizens-bank-400-checking.risk: Only some states can open online, so non-residents can't apply; One Deposit Checking charges $9.99 a month (waived with a deposit) and EverValue's $5 fee can't be waived; the bonus takes 2–4 months and closing the account in between forfeits it; the bank can withdraw the offer at any time.
citizens-bank-400-checking.source: Citizens Bank official offer page (footnote 1, read 2026-11-19)

sofi-checking-400-direct-deposit.title: [US] SoFi checking direct-deposit bonus: $5,000 in 25 days for $400 (to 12/31)
sofi-checking-400-direct-deposit.highlight: Take $1,000–$4,999.99 in qualifying direct deposits within 25 days of your first one for $50, or $5,000+ for $400; no monthly fee, no minimum balance
sofi-checking-400-direct-deposit.regions: [US] Nationwide (SoFi Bank, N.A., FDIC member); needs US identity and address
sofi-checking-400-direct-deposit.content: SoFi Checking and Savings direct-deposit bonus: between 2026-05-15 and 2026-12-31, once your first qualifying direct deposit of $1 or more lands, SoFi adds up qualifying direct deposits over the following 25 calendar days — $1,000–$4,999.99 pays $50 and $5,000 or more pays $400, paid within 7 business days of qualifying. The account has no monthly fee and no minimum balance, and pays two days early.
sofi-checking-400-direct-deposit.conditions: New and existing SoFi members qualify as long as they haven't set up a direct deposit with SoFi before; one per person; a qualifying direct deposit must be recurring ACH from an employer, payroll provider or government agency (salary, pension, Social Security); cheque deposits, P2P such as Zelle/PayPal/Venmo/Wise, merchant transfers, ACH transfers from other banks, wires and tax refunds don't count; the account must be in good standing at payout.
steps: Open SoFi Checking and Savings through the invite link or the website
Switch your direct deposit to SoFi in your employer's payroll system (or set up a government benefit deposit)
Confirm the first direct deposit of $1 or more has landed, then accumulate $5,000 within 25 days
Check the bonus in the checking account within 7 business days
sofi-checking-400-direct-deposit.risk: Reaching the $400 tier means moving $5,000 in within 25 days, which really means relocating your salary; SoFi decides what counts as a direct deposit and some payroll providers need a manual appeal; the bonus is taxable.
sofi-checking-400-direct-deposit.source: SoFi official Checking Offer page terms (read 2026-11-19)

chase-total-checking-400.title: [US only] Chase Total Checking $400 sign-up bonus
chase-total-checking-400.highlight: Open a new account and take $1,000 in direct deposits within 90 days; the bonus lands within 15 days
chase-total-checking-400.regions: [US only] Online applications exclude Alaska, Hawaii and Puerto Rico
chase-total-checking-400.content: New customers who open Chase Total Checking with the coupon code and complete $1,000 or more of salary/government direct deposits within 90 days qualify. The account has a $15 monthly fee, waived with $1,000 of monthly direct deposits or another condition.
chase-total-checking-400.conditions: New Chase checking customers only (not if you closed an account in the last 90 days or were closed for a negative balance within 3 years); one bonus per two years; direct deposits exclude Zelle, transfers and cheque deposits.
steps: Enter your email on the offer page to get the coupon code
Open Total Checking online or in a branch with that code
Complete $1,000 of direct deposits within 90 days
Keep the account in good standing until the bonus arrives
chase-total-checking-400.risk: The $15 monthly fee eats the bonus if you don't get it waived; closing early can claw it back; needs a US address and SSN/ITIN, and non-residents face extra restrictions.
chase-total-checking-400.source: Chase official offer page + Bankrate / BankDealGuy (updated 2026-11-11)

santander-everyday-switch-240.title: [UK] Santander Everyday switch bonus £240: switch + 2 household Direct Debits + deposit £1,500 (from 10/27)
santander-everyday-switch-240.highlight: Full CASS switch into Santander Everyday: complete the switch, two household direct debits, a £1,500 deposit and £200 into the Regular Saver within 60 days to get £240 about 90 days later. Apply through the MSE link before 15:00 on 2026-11-25 and add a £25 Amazon gift card.
santander-everyday-switch-240.regions: [UK] UK residents switching in full from another UK bank or building society (Santander, cahoot and Cater Allen accounts don't count)
santander-everyday-switch-240.content:
Santander's official £240 Switch & Save: apply from 27 October 2026 (the bank can withdraw the offer at any time). Within 60 days you must complete a full CASS switch (old account closed), have at least 2 "household" Direct Debits on the account (council tax, mobile/home phone/broadband/pay TV, utilities and other specified billers), deposit a total of at least £1,500 into the Everyday Current Account and put at least £200 into your own Santander Regular Saver. Eligibility is checked on day 60 after the switch, and £240 is paid into the account within the next 30 days, so about 90 days in; you must still hold both accounts and the 2 active household Direct Debits on the payout day.

Addition (MSE round-up 2026-11-19): applying for the Everyday account through the designated MoneySavingExpert link and meeting the same £240 conditions also earns a £25 Amazon.co.uk gift card, £265 in total. Applications must be submitted by 15:00 on 2026-11-25; the claim instructions arrive by email within 120 days and must be used within 30 days.
santander-everyday-switch-240.conditions: UK resident; held no Santander current account on 2026-01-01 and neither you nor any joint holder has ever had a Santander switch bonus; the switch must be a full CASS switch that closes the old account; within 60 days: 2 specified household Direct Debits, a £1,500 deposit and £200 into a Regular Saver; one payout per joint account. The extra £25 gift card requires applying through the MSE promotional link before 15:00 on 2026-11-25.
steps: Open an Everyday Current Account at santander.co.uk (or use the one you have)
Choose a full switch through the Current Account Switch Service and enter the old account details correctly
Move at least 2 household Direct Debits (mobile, broadband, utilities, council tax) across within 60 days
Deposit a total of £1,500 into the new account and £200 into your Regular Saver within 60 days
Check the £240 around 90 days later; if it's missing call 0330 9123123
santander-everyday-switch-240.risk: The headline £240 needs the switch, 2 household Direct Debits, £1,500 of deposits and £200 into a Regular Saver — miss one and there's nothing; the £1,500 and £200 are your own money (you can take them back out, but they must still be there on payout day); the switch closes your old account, so check salary and subscriptions can move; the bank can withdraw the offer at any time (applications already submitted are still paid if eligible).
santander-everyday-switch-240.source: Santander UK official switch page "Switch. Save. Get £240." + official £240 Switcher T&Cs (2026-10 edition, offer from 2026-10-27) + official press release (2026-09-01)

ally-spending-300.title: [US] Ally checking $300: $1,000 of direct deposits for 6 months (code ALLY300, to 11/30)
ally-spending-300.highlight: Open your first Spending Account with code ALLY300 and get $50 for every month with $1,000 of direct deposits, up to 6 months and $300 in total; no monthly fee, no minimum balance
ally-spending-300.regions: [US] Online nationwide (Ally Bank, FDIC member); needs US identity and address
ally-spending-300.content: Ally Bank's Spending Account bonus: open your first Ally Spending Account with promo code ALLY300 by 2026-11-30, fund it within 30 days (otherwise it closes automatically) and set up a qualifying direct deposit of at least $1,000 a month; each of 6 consecutive qualifying months pays $50, up to $300. The first month's deposit must land within 60 days of opening, and missing the first month loses the rest.
ally-spending-300.conditions: New customers who have never had an Ally Spending Account, one per person; the account must be opened with code ALLY300 through the offer link; transfers between your own accounts don't count; the account must stay in good standing to receive each monthly bonus; unfreeze ChexSystems or credit freezes first.
steps: Open your first Spending Account from the Ally offer page with code ALLY300
Fund the account within 30 days so it doesn't close automatically
Move $1,000 or more of monthly salary direct deposit to the account
Keep it up for 6 consecutive months and check the $50 each month
ally-spending-300.risk: You need $1,000 a month for 6 straight months, and a missed month costs the remaining bonuses; the offer ends 11/30 and funding must happen within 30 days of opening; the terms page couldn't be reached from here, so confirm the code and end date on ally.com before applying.
ally-spending-300.source: Ally official ALLY300 terms (checked line by line by Perkful 2026-11-17, cited by CNBC Select 2026-11-18; the official page returned 500 from this environment)

surfshark-black-friday.title: [Global] Surfshark Black Friday: 2 years at $2.49/mo + 3 months
surfshark-black-friday.highlight: One plan 88% off, with VPN + antivirus + breach monitoring
surfshark-black-friday.regions: [Global] Some countries are limited by payment or compliance rules
surfshark-black-friday.content: Surfshark's Black Friday runs to 12/1: the Starter / One two-year plans are $2.49/mo ($67.23 in total including 3 free months, about 88% off), One+ is $3.99/mo and yearly starts at $2.99/mo. Includes a 30-day money-back guarantee, and One adds antivirus, ad blocking and breach monitoring.
surfshark-black-friday.conditions: Pay 24 months up front; renewals at list price; the 7-day free trial is only on some platforms; refunds must be requested within 30 days.
steps: Open the Black Friday page and pick the Starter / One two-year plan
Check the total, the free months and the renewal price
After paying, download the app — unlimited devices can connect at once
surfshark-black-friday.risk: VPN prices are "Black Friday" all year round, so don't stock up on four years for the discount; auto-renewal is at list price, so remember to turn it off.
surfshark-black-friday.source: Surfshark official Black Friday page + Cybernews / Security.org (2026-11)

td-bank-checking-300.title: [US] TD Bank new checking: $300 / $200 direct-deposit bonus (to 2027-01-30)
td-bank-checking-300.highlight: Open TD Beyond Checking ($25 monthly fee) and take $2,500 of salary/pension/government direct deposits within 60 days for $300; TD Complete Checking pays $200 for $500, and a savings bonus stacks on top
td-bank-checking-300.regions: [US] Only the 16 states with TD Bank branches plus DC: CT, DC, DE, FL, MA, MD, ME, NC, NH, NJ, NY, PA, RI, SC, VA, VT
td-bank-checking-300.content: TD Bank's new-customer checking bonus: open TD Beyond Checking and complete $2,500 or more of qualifying direct deposits within 60 days of opening for $300; open TD Complete Checking and complete $500 or more for $200. Bonuses are paid within 180 days of qualifying and stack with the matching savings account bonus (up to $500 in total). Only electronic direct deposits of employer salary, pension or government benefits such as Social Security count, each of at least $250; P2P such as PayPal/Venmo and bank transfers don't.
td-bank-checking-300.conditions: New customers only: no current TD personal checking account, none closed in the past 12 months and no TD checking bonus before; must open through a qualifying official entry point; residents of the 16 states and DC; Beyond Checking costs $25 a month (waived with $5,000 of monthly direct deposits, a $2,500 daily balance or $25,000 in linked balances), Complete Checking $15; closing within 6 months lets the bank claw back the bonus.
steps: From the TD Special Offers page choose Beyond ($300) or Complete ($200)
Get salary, pension or government payments to arrive as electronic direct deposits within 60 days ($2,500 for Beyond, $500 for Complete)
Keep the account in good standing and don't close it within 6 months
Wait for the bonus within 180 days of opening and file the tax form the bank sends
td-bank-checking-300.risk: Open to residents of the 16 states and DC only, so other states are declined; the $300 tier needs $2,500 of direct deposits, not the "$500 gets $300" version circulating online (that's the $200 tier); an unwaived monthly fee eats the bonus, so check the deposit or balance condition.
td-bank-checking-300.source: TD Bank official Special Offers and Checking & Savings bonus pages (offer to 2027-01-30, terms in Important Disclosures)

oracle-always-free.title: [Global] Oracle Cloud always free: 2 ARM cores + 200GB
oracle-always-free.highlight: Always-free 2 OCPU/12GB ARM or 2 small AMD instances, plus $300 for 30 days
oracle-always-free.regions: [Global] Available in commercial regions worldwide (not US Government cloud); A1 instances only in the home region, not Chuncheon, Korea
oracle-always-free.content: Oracle Cloud Always Free includes 1,500 OCPU hours and 9,000 GB hours a month (equivalent to a 2 OCPU / 12GB ARM A1 instance), up to 2 AMD micro instances, 200GB of block storage, object storage and a load balancer. New accounts also get $300 of trial credit for 30 days.
oracle-always-free.conditions: Card verification required; Always Free resources can only run in your home region; instances whose 95th-percentile CPU and network use stay below 20% for 7 days (memory too for A1) may be reclaimed; capacity shortages that block new instances are normal.
steps: Sign up for Oracle Cloud and pick a suitable home region (it sets latency and which shapes you can launch)
Create a VM.Standard.A1.Flex (2 OCPU/12GB) or a micro instance under Compute
Attach a boot volume within the 200GB of block storage
Before the trial ends, keep A1 within 2 OCPU/12GB so it isn't deleted
oracle-always-free.risk: Since 2026-07 the free ARM allowance is 2 OCPU/12GB (was 4 OCPU/24GB); older 4-core instances are stopped and deleted after 30 days, and idle instances can be reclaimed.
oracle-always-free.source: Oracle official Always Free documentation + official change notice of 2026-07-21

gcp-300-credit.title: [Global] Google Cloud $300 for new customers / 90 days
gcp-300-credit.highlight: Use it freely for 90 days without being charged, plus always-free usage on 20+ products
gcp-300-credit.regions: [Global] Needs a billing address in a supported country
gcp-300-credit.content: New customers who have never paid for Google Cloud get $300 of welcome credit that covers eligible products for 90 days without any charge, along with the monthly Free Tier (e2-micro instances, Cloud Run, BigQuery and more).
gcp-300-credit.conditions: Never a paid Google Cloud / Maps / Firebase customer; a valid card or payment method is required; during the trial GPUs, Marketplace, Windows Server images and more than 8 concurrent cores are unavailable.
steps: Sign up for Cloud with a Google account and create a billing account
Add a card and pass the temporary $0–1 verification
Create a project and deploy an instance or service
Decide within 90 days whether to upgrade to a paid account
gcp-300-credit.risk: The credit expires after 90 days; without an upgrade resources are stopped and deleted after a 30-day grace period; from 2026-11-16 new $300 credits can't be used for Gemini/Vertex AI.
gcp-300-credit.source: Google Cloud official free programme documentation (checked 2026-11)

vultr-credit.title: [Global] Vultr new-customer credit up to $300
vultr-credit.highlight: Codes FLY300VULTR / FLY200 / VULTRMATCH, use within 30 days
vultr-credit.regions: [Global] 30+ locations worldwide (credit limited to selected products)
vultr-credit.content: Vultr's official offers page has long listed three new-customer credits: FLY300VULTR for $300, FLY200 / FLYTWOHUNDRED for $200 and VULTRMATCH for a first deposit matched up to $100. The credit covers selected products, lasts up to 30 days and only one promotion can be used per account.
vultr-credit.conditions: New accounts only; add a card or PayPal after signing up (a $0 verification works); can't be combined with other offers; unused credit expires.
steps: Sign up for a new Vultr account from the offers page
Enter the code under Billing → Summary and click Apply
Deploy an instance and destroy it before the credit runs out to avoid charges
vultr-credit.risk: The credit expires and the balance isn't refunded; forgetting to destroy instances turns into real charges.

hsbc-uk-bank-account-switch-220.title: [UK] HSBC Bank Account switch bonus £220: open in the app + 2 Direct Debits + deposit £2,000 + spend £500
hsbc-uk-bank-account-switch-220.highlight: Only counts if you open the Bank Account inside the HSBC mobile app: full CASS switch within 60 days (with 2 Direct Debits), deposit £2,000 and spend £500; the bonus lands within 60 days
hsbc-uk-bank-account-switch-220.regions: [UK] UK residents; HSBC Bank Account (Basic Bank Account doesn't qualify)
hsbc-uk-bank-account-switch-220.content: HSBC UK's official £220 switch bonus from 15 June 2026: you must open the HSBC Bank Account inside the HSBC UK Mobile Banking App (web, branch or phone applications don't count), then within 60 days complete a full CASS switch bringing at least 2 Direct Debits, deposit a total of £2,000 or more and spend £500 or more on the account's HSBC debit card (Apple/Google/Samsung Pay count; cash withdrawals, fees, refunds, gambling, credit card or insurance payments and card-to-card transfers don't). Once qualified, £220 is paid in GBP within 60 days, one per person.
hsbc-uk-bank-account-switch-220.conditions: UK resident, 18+, new customer; must open in the app; within 60 days: 2 Direct Debits, £2,000 deposited and £500 spent; not eligible if you held an HSBC UK or first direct current account since 2023-01-01; the account must be open and unfrozen at payout.
steps: Download the HSBC UK app and apply for the HSBC Bank Account inside it
Within 60 days start a full CASS switch in the app, making sure 2 Direct Debits come across
Deposit a total of £2,000 into the new account within 60 days (salary, transfers or cash; you don't have to keep it there)
Spend £500 in total on the HSBC debit card within 60 days (mobile wallet payments count)
The bonus arrives within 60 days of qualifying; contact HSBC support if it doesn't
hsbc-uk-bank-account-switch-220.risk: The account must be opened in the app — web or branch accounts don't count, which is where many people come unstuck; the £500 must be genuine spending, not cash withdrawals or fees; holding an HSBC or first direct account since 2023 makes you ineligible outright; the bank can withdraw the offer at any time.
hsbc-uk-bank-account-switch-220.source: HSBC UK official switch page "Current switch offers: Get £220" + Bank Account eligibility page + official £220 T&Cs (from 2026-06-15)

first-direct-1st-account-switch-210.title: [UK] first direct 1st Account switch bonus £210 (£175 + £35 top-up, open by 12/2)
first-direct-1st-account-switch-210.highlight: Open between 2026-09-14 and 12/2 for £175 + £35: switch within 45 days (2 Direct Debits or standing orders), deposit £1,000, make 5 debit-card payments and log into online banking; paid on the 20th of the following month
first-direct-1st-account-switch-210.regions: [UK] UK residents; first direct 1st Account (no monthly fee)
first-direct-1st-account-switch-210.content: first direct's official £175 switch bonus plus a £35 top-up (for accounts opened between 2026-09-14 and 2026-12-02), £210 in total. Within 45 days of opening you must: complete a full CASS switch bringing at least 2 Direct Debits or standing orders, deposit £1,000 or more, make 5 or more debit-card payments (in store, online or via mobile wallet) and log into digital banking. The bonus is paid on the 20th of the month after all conditions are met, one per person or joint account. The account also comes with a £250 interest-free overdraft (subject to approval) and a 7.00% AER Regular Saver.
first-direct-1st-account-switch-210.conditions: UK resident, new customer who has never held any first direct product; not eligible if you opened an HSBC current account since 2018-01-01; within 45 days: switch, 2 Direct Debits or standing orders, £1,000 deposit, 5 card payments and a digital banking login; the £35 top-up only applies to accounts opened 2026-09-14 to 2026-12-02.
steps: Open a 1st Account at firstdirect.com or in the app (open before 12/2 to include the £35 top-up)
After opening, tap "switch to us" in the app, move the old account with CASS and confirm the 2 Direct Debits or standing orders come across
Within 45 days deposit £1,000, make 5 debit-card payments and log into digital banking once
Look for the £210 around the 20th of the following month; contact first direct if it's missing
first-direct-1st-account-switch-210.risk: The £35 top-up only runs until 2 December for new accounts and afterwards it is £175; anyone who has been an HSBC customer since 2018 can't apply, and it is mutually exclusive with the HSBC £220 offer (one or the other); the £1,000 is your own money — it doesn't have to stay, but it must arrive within 45 days.
first-direct-1st-account-switch-210.source: first direct official 1st Account page + official switch page (£175 and £35 top-up terms, top-up window 2026-09-14 to 2026-12-02)

club-lloyds-switch-200.title: [UK] Club Lloyds switch bonus £200: open a new account + 3 active Direct Debits (to 2027-01-08)
club-lloyds-switch-200.highlight: Open a new Club Lloyds (or Silver/Platinum/Premier) and switch in full with CASS bringing 3 active Direct Debits; no deposit needed and £200 arrives within 14 working days of the switch starting
club-lloyds-switch-200.regions: [UK] UK residents; Club Lloyds / Club Lloyds Silver / Club Lloyds Platinum / Lloyds Premier
club-lloyds-switch-200.content: Lloyds' official £200 switch bonus (offer extended to 2027-01-08): open a new Club Lloyds (£5 a month, waived with £2,000 of monthly deposits), Club Lloyds Silver (£11.50/mo), Club Lloyds Platinum (£22.50/mo) or Lloyds Premier online, in a branch or by phone between 2026-09-17 and 2027-01-08, and switch in full with CASS from another bank bringing at least 3 active Direct Debits (ones set up after the switch starts, standing orders and subscriptions don't count); no set deposit amount. Cash is paid within 14 working days of qualifying.
club-lloyds-switch-200.conditions: UK resident; must be a newly opened qualifying account (converting an existing Lloyds account doesn't count); the switch must include 3 active Direct Debits; can't switch from Halifax / Bank of Scotland; not eligible if you've had a Lloyds / BoS / Halifax switch bonus since 2023-01-01; one payout per joint account.
steps: Open Club Lloyds (or Silver/Platinum/Premier) at lloydsbank.com or in the app
Choose a full switch through the Current Account Switch Service when applying
Confirm at least 3 valid Direct Debits move across with the switch (ones set up after it starts don't count)
Check for the £200 within 14 working days of the switch completing; Club's £5 fee is refunded with £2,000 of monthly deposits
club-lloyds-switch-200.risk: You need 3 genuinely active Direct Debits — salary alone isn't enough; Club Lloyds charges £5 a month (refunded with £2,000 of deposits) and Silver/Platinum cost more; Halifax / BoS customers can't switch in; the bank can withdraw the offer early.
club-lloyds-switch-200.source: Lloyds Bank official switch page "£200 on us when you switch" (offer extended to 2027-01-08) + Club Lloyds product page + official £200 T&Cs

natwest-select-switch-200.title: [UK] NatWest Select / Reward switch bonus £200: no Direct Debits, deposit £1,250 + log into the app
natwest-select-switch-200.highlight: Switch another bank account in full to NatWest Select (no monthly fee) or Reward, deposit £1,250 within 60 days (each payment stays 24 hours) and log into the app; £200 within 30 days, with no Direct Debits required
natwest-select-switch-200.regions: [UK] UK residents; NatWest Select or Reward account
natwest-select-switch-200.content: NatWest's official £200 switch bonus: from 2026-05-06, new and existing customers qualify as long as they held no NatWest current account on 2026-05-06. Open Select (no monthly fee) or Reward and switch in full with CASS from another bank; deposit a total of £1,250 or more within 60 days of the switch (in several payments if you like, each staying in the account 24 hours) and log into the NatWest app at least once; £200 is paid within 30 days. No Direct Debits required, which makes it the lowest bar among the big UK banks.
natwest-select-switch-200.conditions: UK resident, 18+; must be a Select or Reward account opened or switched after 2026-05-06; deposit £1,250 and log into the app within 60 days; not eligible if you held a NatWest account on 2026-05-06 or have had a NatWest/RBS/Ulster switch bonus; can't switch from RBS/Ulster; the account must stay open until payout.
steps: Apply for Select (free) or Reward at natwest.com or in the app
Choose a full CASS switch from your other bank when applying
Deposit £1,250 in total within 60 days of the switch, keeping each payment in for at least 24 hours
Log into NatWest mobile banking once
£200 arrives within 30 days of qualifying — don't close the account before then
natwest-select-switch-200.risk: The £1,250 is your own money and can go in several payments, but each must stay 24 hours; anyone who has had a NatWest Group switch bonus is out; the bank can change or withdraw the offer at any time; Reward charges £2 a month.
natwest-select-switch-200.source: NatWest official Select account page "£200 switch offer" + NatWest Group official press release (2026-05-06) + official Switch Offer T&Cs

za-bank-mgm-welcome-2000.title: [HK] ZA Bank new-customer welcome: HK$2,000 voucher pack + 20% time-deposit boost + USD 30 US-stock voucher (from 11/19)
za-bank-mgm-welcome-2000.highlight: Open a ZA Bank savings account in Hong Kong with an invite code and deposit HK$1,000 in one payment within 14 days for a HK$2,000 welcome voucher pack, a 7-day 20% HKD time-deposit boost and a USD 30 Micron stock voucher if you hold shares
za-bank-mgm-welcome-2000.regions: [HK] Hong Kong residents and visitors (must open in the app while in Hong Kong); HKD and USD accounts
za-bank-mgm-welcome-2000.value: HK$2,000 voucher pack + USD 30 stock voucher
za-bank-mgm-welcome-2000.content: ZA Bank's official refer-a-friend (MGM) campaign, new period 2026-11-19 to 2027-01-13 inclusive. The referred person (a brand-new ZA Bank customer who has never held any ZA Bank product) opens a savings account in Hong Kong with the invite code and deposits at least HK$1,000 in a single payment within 14 days to meet the funding condition, unlocking: (1) a HK$2,000 welcome voucher pack (HK$1,000 stock cashback voucher, HK$800 fund-holding rebate voucher, FX instant-discount voucher, overseas remittance rebate voucher, spending rebate voucher and more, each with its own threshold); (2) a 7-day +19.9% p.a. HKD new-money time-deposit boost (about 20% with the base rate, up to HK$20,000); (3) a USD 30 Micron (MU) stock voucher if you hold at least HK$10,000 of stock assets for 14 days within 30 days. Rewards are issued within 30 working days of qualifying.
za-bank-mgm-welcome-2000.conditions: Must be a brand-new ZA Bank customer (no ZA Bank product); enter the invite code when opening; you must be in Hong Kong when opening (mainland ID plus a HK/Macau permit uses the visitor route); deposit at least HK$1,000 in one payment within 14 days; each voucher has its own threshold (e.g. the stock voucher needs a single buy of HK$1,500 or more to unlock a HK$60 voucher); the USD 30 stock voucher needs stock trading enabled and HK$10,000 of stocks held for 14 days.
steps: Open a ZA Bank account in the app while in Hong Kong, choosing the mainland ID or HK ID route and entering the invite code
Deposit at least HK$1,000 in one payment within 14 days of opening
Claim the 7-day 20% HKD time-deposit boost and the welcome voucher pack in ZA Quest
For the USD 30 Micron voucher: enable stock trading and hold HK$10,000 of stock assets for 14 days within 30 days
za-bank-mgm-welcome-2000.risk: The HK$2,000 is vouchers, not cash, and most need further stock or fund trades or remittances to use, so real value is far below face value; you must be in Hong Kong to open; the 20% deposit boost lasts 7 days and caps at HK$20,000; the referrer picks the reward plan, so terms can change.
za-bank-mgm-welcome-2000.source: ZA Bank official MGM campaign page and full terms (period 2026-11-19 to 2027-01-13, HK$2,000 welcome, 20% deposit boost, USD 30 MU stock voucher)

google-ai-student.title: [US/multi-region] Google AI student plan: 12 months free
google-ai-student.highlight: US students get AI Pro ($19.99/mo), 140+ markets get AI Plus; a card is required
google-ai-student.regions: [US/multi-region] The US gets AI Pro; 140+ markets get AI Plus (excluding the US, Canada, Hong Kong, Macau, Tunisia and others)
google-ai-student.content: Eligible university students can claim 12 months of a Google AI subscription free: AI Pro in the US ($19.99/mo of value, with higher Gemini limits, Gemini in Gmail/Docs and 5TB of storage) and AI Plus in 140+ other markets ($4.99/mo, 400GB of storage). Must be redeemed by 2026-12-31.
google-ai-student.conditions: Enrolled university student aged 18+; must pass SheerID student verification; a valid payment method is required; family-group and third-party subscription users (e.g. Google Fi) don't qualify; school-issued Workspace accounts don't qualify.
steps: Open the student offer page with a personal Google account
Verify your student status through SheerID
Add a payment method and confirm the $0 subscription
Cancel before it ends so it doesn't roll into a paid plan
google-ai-student.risk: When the trial ends it renews at list price (Pro $19.99/mo, Plus $4.99/mo) and charges you unless you cancel; student status is re-verified every year.
google-ai-student.source: Google official blog (2026-08-19) + Google One student offer terms

nationwide-flexaccount-switch-175.title: [UK] Nationwide FlexAccount switch bonus £175: 2 Direct Debits + deposit £1,000 + 1 card payment
nationwide-flexaccount-switch-175.highlight: Switch to FlexDirect / FlexAccount / FlexPlus, complete the full switch within 28 days (with 2 Direct Debits), deposit £1,000 and make one debit-card payment within 31 days — £175 in 10 days, the fastest of the lot
nationwide-flexaccount-switch-175.regions: [UK] UK residents; FlexDirect / FlexAccount / FlexPlus (new or existing accounts can be switched into)
nationwide-flexaccount-switch-175.content: Nationwide's official £175 switch bonus (from 2026-05-21 until withdrawn): switch to a new or existing FlexDirect, FlexAccount or FlexPlus with CASS from an account outside Nationwide / Virgin Money, bringing at least 2 active Direct Debits with it, and the switch must complete within 28 days of opening (or of telling the bank you'll switch into an existing account); within 31 days deposit £1,000 or more and make at least one payment with the Nationwide debit card (gambling, crypto, cash withdrawals and transfers don't count; Apple/Google Pay does). £175 is paid within 10 days of qualifying.
nationwide-flexaccount-switch-175.conditions: UK resident; must be a first-time Nationwide switch bonus recipient (none since 2021, one per person and one per joint account); the account switched into can't be Nationwide / Virgin Money; full switch with 2 active Direct Debits within 28 days; £1,000 deposit and 1 card payment within 31 days; at most 3 Nationwide current accounts.
steps: Apply for FlexAccount (or FlexDirect/FlexPlus) at nationwide.co.uk and choose to switch, agreeing to close the old account
Confirm the 2 Direct Debits on the old account move across within 28 days
Deposit £1,000 into the new account and make at least one debit-card payment within 31 days
Look for the £175 within 10 days of qualifying (it shows as Switching Offer on the statement)
nationwide-flexaccount-switch-175.risk: The full switch, including closing the old account, must complete within 28 days — partial or manual switches don't count; the 2 Direct Debits must already be active on the old account; anyone who has had a Nationwide switch bonus since 2021 can't get another; the bank can end the offer at any time.
nationwide-flexaccount-switch-175.source: Nationwide official switch page "£175 when you switch" + official £175 Current Account Switch Offer Terms (2026-05 edition, from 2026-05-21)

trading212-au-bonus-shares.title: [AU] Trading 212 invite: invest A$100 and both sides get A$20–A$200 in free shares (ends 12/8)
trading212-au-bonus-shares.highlight: Sign up for an Invest account with an existing customer's invite link (or enter their Referral ID), fund it and invest A$100 within 10 days, and both sides get a random A$20–A$200 free share; 80% land at A$20–50
trading212-au-bonus-shares.regions: [AU] Australian residents only; new customers who have never opened an Invest account with any Trading 212 entity
trading212-au-bonus-shares.content: Trading 212's Australian entity (Trading 212 AU Pty Ltd, AFSL 541122) new Invite a Friend round: 2026-11-18 00:00 to 2026-12-08 23:59 AEST. New customers sign up via an existing customer's invite link, or enter the Referral ID right after opening, complete onboarding and verification, and fund and invest at least AUD 100 within 10 calendar days of opening; both sides get a random free share. Value odds: 80% at A$20–50, 15% at A$50.01–100, 3% at A$100.01–150 and 2% at A$150.01–200; in rare cases the equivalent cash is credited instead. Rewards are issued within 3 business days of qualifying, can be sold immediately but the cash can't be withdrawn for 30 days.
trading212-au-bonus-shares.conditions: Must be an Australian resident opening for the first time with any Trading 212 group entity; never claimed another T212 promo reward; fund and invest A$100 within 10 calendar days of opening; invite links are issued to only some existing customers — without one you can use their Referral ID; can't be combined with other promo codes or links; the free share price moves with the market and is locked for 30 days.
steps: Find an existing Australian T212 customer with an invite link and sign up through it (or use their Referral ID)
Complete identity verification and onboarding
Fund the account and buy at least A$100 of shares or ETFs within 10 days
Check the random free share within 3 business days; it becomes withdrawable after 30 days
trading212-au-bonus-shares.risk: Most people get the A$20–50 tier; the A$100 you invest carries market risk; the free share can't be withdrawn for 30 days; the platform can end the campaign early.
trading212-au-bonus-shares.source: Trading 212 official help-centre campaign page (2026-11-18 to 2026-12-08) + official Invite a Friend terms PDF

github-student-pack.title: [Global] GitHub Student Developer Pack
github-student-pack.highlight: Verify as a student and get Pro, Copilot Student, a domain, cloud credits and 80+ other benefits free
github-student-pack.regions: [Global] Aged 13+, enrolled in a degree or diploma programme
github-student-pack.content: Students verified through GitHub Education get the Developer Pack: GitHub Pro, Copilot Student (unlimited completions plus AI Credits), a Codespaces Pro allowance, Azure $100, Heroku $13 a month for 24 months, a Namecheap .me domain for a year, the full JetBrains suite and 80+ partner benefits.
github-student-pack.conditions: Enrolled in a degree or diploma programme, 13+, with a personal GitHub account; a student card, class schedule or proof of enrolment is required; teachers and researchers use a separate track and aren't covered by this pack.
steps: Sign in to GitHub → Settings → Education benefits → Start an application
Upload dated proof of enrolment or use your school email
Once approved, claim each partner benefit one by one
github-student-pack.risk: Partner benefits run for different periods (months to "while enrolled") and must be claimed separately; Copilot Student re-checks student status every month.

rakuten-alliant-checking-200.title: [US] Rakuten × Alliant high-yield checking: $200 cashback (or 20,000 Amex/Bilt points)
rakuten-alliant-checking-200.highlight: Open an Alliant checking account via the Rakuten link: deposit $500, take $500 of employer/government direct deposits within 30 days and make 5 × $10 debit purchases within 45 days, with $1,000 still in the account on day 45
rakuten-alliant-checking-200.regions: [US] Alliant new members only, US residents or US persons (including RA) aged 18+; no Illinois residency needed
rakuten-alliant-checking-200.content: Rakuten has raised the Alliant Credit Union checking cashback from $100 back to $200 (its all-time high): go through Rakuten's Alliant page, open a new Alliant high-yield checking account (a high-yield savings account comes with it) and complete the steps; the $200 cashback is paid by Rakuten, not the bank, and can also be issued as 20,000 Amex Membership Rewards or Bilt points depending on your account settings. Cashback usually lands within 45 days of qualifying, though Rakuten warns it can take months.
rakuten-alliant-checking-200.conditions: Alliant new members only (not if you've held an account or closed one within 180 days), one per person; deposit $500+ when opening; within 30 days of clicking the Rakuten link, one direct deposit of $500+ from an employer or government (PayPal/Venmo/bank ACH/tax refunds don't count); 5 debit-card purchases of $10+ within 45 days; keep $1,000+ in the account on day 45 (money only in savings doesn't count); closing within 90 days costs $10.
steps: Sign up or log in to Rakuten, open the Alliant Credit Union page and click "Shop now"
Open the Alliant high-yield checking account online and deposit $500 or more
Arrange one $500+ salary or government direct deposit within 30 days
Make 5 debit-card purchases of $10+ within 45 days
Keep $1,000+ in checking on day 45 and wait for Rakuten to pay
rakuten-alliant-checking-200.risk: The real requirements are a genuine direct deposit and $1,000 still there on day 45 — if you can't do that, don't open it; the cashback relies on Rakuten tracking, so enter through its link and keep a screenshot, because missing-payment claims are painful; this is a limited-time offer with no fixed end date published.
rakuten-alliant-checking-200.source: Rakuten official Alliant offer terms ($200, was $100) + StackTheDeal's check of the bank page, 2026-11-17

deepgram-200-free-credit.title: [Global] Deepgram $200 free credit: no card, never expires (about 700 hours of transcription)
deepgram-200-free-credit.highlight: Sign up for $200 of credit with no credit card, no minimum spend and no expiry; roughly 43,000 minutes (700+ hours) of Nova-3 speech transcription
deepgram-200-free-credit.regions: [Global] Sign up on deepgram.com (an EU endpoint, api.eu.deepgram.com, is available)
deepgram-200-free-credit.content: Deepgram's Pay as you go tier gives new accounts $200 of free credit: the official terms say no credit card, no minimum spend and no expiry, which suits voice agents, meeting transcription or prototyping. Per the official FAQ, $200 is roughly 43,000 minutes (700+ hours) of Nova-3 speech transcription; TTS (Flux/Aura, billed per character) or Voice Agent (billed per connected minute) burn through it at a completely different rate.
deepgram-200-free-credit.conditions: Register a Deepgram account and create an API key; the $200 is a one-off, then usage billing applies (card required); transcription is billed per second with no rounding, streaming Nova-3 mono is $0.0048/min (promo price); Voice Agent is $0.075/min at the standard tier and burns far faster than plain transcription.
steps: Sign up at deepgram.com and open the Console
Create an API key (scoped to what you need)
Call /v1/listen with the official SDK or REST API to transcribe audio
Watch the balance in the Console and decide about adding a card before the $200 runs out
deepgram-200-free-credit.risk: The $200 is estimated against Nova-3 transcription, and TTS / Voice Agent / audio-intelligence endpoints consume it several times faster; once it's gone, a linked card is billed automatically, so prototype without one first.
deepgram-200-free-credit.source: Deepgram official pricing page, Pay as you go tier and FAQ (free $200 credit, no credit card, does not expire)

pingandb-hk-new-customer-nov2026.title: [HK] Ping An Digital Bank November new customers: 20% HKD 1-month deposit + HK$200 cash (about HK$1,515 in total)
pingandb-hk-new-customer-nov2026.highlight: Brand-new customers who open with referral code NTB2026 and place a 1-month HKD time deposit get 20% p.a. on the first HK$80,000 (about HK$1,315 of interest in month one); deposit another HK$20,000 by 30 November for an extra HK$200
pingandb-hk-new-customer-nov2026.regions: [HK] Hong Kong-licensed virtual bank; HK residents or visitors physically in Hong Kong (in person, checked by app location)
pingandb-hk-new-customer-nov2026.content: Ping An Digital Bank (formerly PAObank, Ping An OneConnect Bank) November welcome: from 2026-11-01 to 11-30, brand-new customers who enter referral code NTB2026 when opening a personal savings account and place a 1-month HKD time deposit earn 20% p.a. on the first HK$80,000 — the official example gives about HK$1,315 of interest in the first month on a full HK$80,000; deposit HK$20,000 into the savings account by 30 November for another HK$200 cash reward. The bank puts the total at about HK$1,515. Referrers get HK$300 per successful referral, with the regular referral cap raised to HK$12,000 and a HK$26,888 "referral king" prize.
pingandb-hk-new-customer-nov2026.conditions: Brand-new customers who held no account with the bank before the campaign; the referral code must be entered during the application and can't be added later; the 20% deposit is for HK$100–HK$80,000 for 1 month only and must be opened in the promotional slot under Deposit > Time Deposit in the app; the HK$200 needs HK$20,000 deposited into the personal savings account by 30 November; only HK residents or visitors physically in Hong Kong can open; limited places, first come first served.
steps: Download the Ping An Digital Bank app and choose new-customer onboarding (have your ID or passport, HK/Macau permit or visa and proof of presence in Hong Kong ready)
Enter NTB2026 in the referral code field during the application (without it there's no 20% deposit and no HK$200)
After opening, go to Deposit > Time Deposit and open a 1-month HKD time deposit of HK$100–80,000 in the promotional slot
Deposit another HK$20,000 into the personal savings account by 30 November and wait for the HK$200
When the deposit matures it rolls to the base rate — decide whether to renew or move it
pingandb-hk-new-customer-nov2026.risk: The 20% is an annual rate on a 1-month deposit, not free cash: the HK$1,315 comes from tying up HK$80,000 for a month; non-residents must travel to Hong Kong at their own cost; the code and terms are whatever the in-app page shows that day, and places are limited; the bank has no physical or virtual debit card.
pingandb-hk-new-customer-nov2026.source: Ping An Digital Bank official press release (2026-11-04, issued via Media OutReach, with NTB2026 and the 20% deposit terms) + official service-scope note (rechecked 2026-11-19: HK residents and visitors in Hong Kong only)

robinhood-uk-free-stock.title: [UK] Robinhood UK free share for new customers: deposit £1 for a $7–$175 share (96% get $7–$8)
robinhood-uk-free-stock.highlight: New UK customers open an account and deposit £1 to pick a fractional share from 26 US stocks worth $7–$175; the official odds show 96% get $7–$8
robinhood-uk-free-stock.regions: [UK] UK residents only (Robinhood U.K. Ltd); needs a UK address and bank account
robinhood-uk-free-stock.content: Robinhood UK's new-customer share reward: UK residents who have never opened a Robinhood UK brokerage account can, once approved, link a UK bank account and make a deposit, then pick one fractional share from 26 US stocks (the two largest by market cap in each S&P 500 sector) worth $7 to $175 in the app. The official terms state about 96% of participants get $7–$8, with only a 0.10% chance of $50–$175. It can be sold 60 days after claiming, and the cash value must stay in the account 60 days before it can be withdrawn freely. The reward must be claimed within 60 days or it lapses.
robinhood-uk-free-stock.conditions: UK residents who have never held a Robinhood UK account; approval, a linked bank account and a deposit required; one per person; the reward buys only the 26 listed stocks; unclaimed after 60 days it expires; all Robinhood rewards are capped at $1,500 per household per year.
steps: Sign up for Robinhood UK through the invite link and complete identity checks
Link a UK bank account and deposit at least £1
When the app notifies you, claim the reward and choose the stock within 60 days
To cash out, wait for the reward to settle and hold it 60 days before selling
robinhood-uk-free-stock.risk: Expected value is only about $8 (96% of the time), so don't open an account hoping for the big one; deposits and withdrawals are in pounds with FX costs; the fractional share can't be transferred outside Robinhood; the terms can change at any time.
robinhood-uk-free-stock.source: Robinhood UK official Fractional Stock Offer terms (read 2026-11-19)

amd-ai-developer-program-credits.title: [Global] AMD AI Developer Program: $100 cloud GPU credit + $50 Fireworks credit + free Token Lab API
amd-ai-developer-program-credits.highlight: Join the AMD AI Developer Program free for $100 of AMD Developer Cloud (MI300X) credit, $50 of Fireworks AI credit, or free API access to open models such as DeepSeek V4 / Qwen3.8 / Gemma 4 through Token Lab
amd-ai-developer-program-credits.regions: [Global] Developers with an AMD account (must give a use case and a public profile for review)
amd-ai-developer-program-credits.content: AMD's official AI Developer Program is free to join. Member benefits: (1) $100 of AMD Developer Cloud credit for MI300X and other Instinct GPU instances — submit the request form under Member Perks (affiliation, role, use case, LinkedIn/GitHub and other public profiles), reviewed in 2–3 business days, then valid for 30 days after it lands; (2) $50 of Fireworks AI hosted-inference credit, valid 90 days, on OpenAI-compatible endpoints; (3) Token Lab hosted APIs for open models such as DeepSeek V4, Qwen3.8 and Gemma 4 (base URL https://api.tokenlab.amd.com/v1), billed in credits, with the credit amount and end date unpublished.
amd-ai-developer-program-credits.conditions: Register a free AMD account and join the AI Developer Program; cloud credit requires the request form with a stated use case and AMD decides whether to grant it; the $100 cloud credit expires 30 days after activation and Fireworks' $50 after 90 days; Token Lab credit amounts and rate limits are unpublished and can change; no card needed, but service stops when credit runs out.
steps: Join the AI Developer Program at developer.amd.com/ai-developer-program/ with your AMD account
In Member Perks click "Request Cloud Credits", fill in the use case and GitHub/LinkedIn profiles and submit
Wait 2–3 business days, then follow the email to sign in to AMD Developer Cloud and activate the $100 (use it within 30 days)
For hosted models, take the $50 Fireworks AI credit or create a Token Lab API key and call open models directly
amd-ai-developer-program-credits.risk: Cloud credit is reviewed and a vague use case may be rejected; the $100 only lasts 30 days after activation, so don't activate early; Token Lab's credit amount and rate limits aren't published and can change; instances are destroyed and data lost when credit runs out.
amd-ai-developer-program-credits.source: AMD official AI Developer Program page + AMD Developer Cloud FAQ ($100 credit, valid 30 days, review process) + AMD technical article "How to Claim AMD Cloud Credits" (Fireworks $50 / 90 days)

bybit-eu-card-welcome-120.title: [EU] Bybit EU card for new customers: €120 cashback + up to €50 back on subscriptions
bybit-eu-card-welcome-120.highlight: EEA residents apply for the Bybit EU virtual card and top up €100 within 30 days: 10% cashback on eligible spending for the first 30 days (up to €120) plus 100% back on ChatGPT/Netflix/Spotify and similar subscriptions (up to €50)
bybit-eu-card-welcome-120.regions: [EU] EEA residents only, excluding Malta; needs a Bybit EU card approved after 2026-08-20 and KYC Lv.1
bybit-eu-card-welcome-120.content: Bybit EU's Bybit Card welcome offer (the EU entity runs it long-term, alongside the global 120 USDT version that ended on 11 November): EEA residents who apply and are approved for the virtual card, then top up at least €100 within 30 days (crypto or fiat), get 10% cashback on eligible spending for 30 days from when Cashback Booster appears, capped at €120 regardless of card tier; at the same time subscriptions get 100% back (ChatGPT, Netflix, Spotify, TradingView, Amazon Prime and others), capped at €50. Cashback accrues as points that Auto-Cashback converts to USDC/BTC, or you redeem manually in the rewards store.
bybit-eu-card-welcome-120.conditions: EEA residents only (excluding Malta), card approved after 2026-08-20, KYC Lv.1, and no Bybit Card held before; unlocking requires €100 topped up within 30 days; the 10% covers only selected MCCs — transport, clothing, dining, beauty, travel, airlines, hotels — and excludes e-wallets, prepaid and financial spending such as Alipay, WeChat, Revolut and Wise; transactions must settle inside the 30-day window; Bybit EU can change or cancel the offer.
steps: Apply for the virtual card in the Bybit EU app and complete KYC Lv.1 (approved after 2026-08-20)
Register for the offer on the official page
Top up €100 or more into the Funding Account within 30 days (crypto or fiat)
Wait for Cashback Booster on the card dashboard, then spend with the card during the next 30 days
Convert points to USDC/BTC under Rewards or redeem them in the store
bybit-eu-card-welcome-120.risk: Open to EEA residents only — mainland China can't take part and a VPN won't help because KYC will refuse; cashback is limited to selected MCCs and counted at settlement, so spending after the window doesn't count; €120 is a cap you won't reach at normal spending; crypto price risk is yours.
bybit-eu-card-welcome-120.source: Bybit EU official Bybit Card Welcome Offer page and promo terms (rechecked 2026-11-19; the global 120 USDT version ended 2026-11-11 10:00 UTC)

elevenlabs-black-friday-creator.title: [Global] ElevenLabs Black Friday: Creator $99 for the first year (about 55% off, to 12/1)
elevenlabs-black-friday-creator.highlight: Black Friday runs to 1 December: Creator yearly at $8.25/mo for the first year (about $99/yr, normally $18.33/mo) and Pro at $37.13/mo (normally $82.50/mo), with professional voice cloning and commercial rights
elevenlabs-black-friday-creator.regions: [Global] Subscribe on elevenlabs.io, paying by major card or PayPal (as shown at checkout)
elevenlabs-black-friday-creator.content: ElevenLabs' official Black Friday promo (banner: "Black Friday · Get up to 55% off · Ends December 1"): Creator yearly drops to $8.25/mo for the first year, about $99/yr (then $18.33/mo); Pro yearly is $37.13/mo for the first year (then $82.50/mo). Creator includes commercial rights, professional voice cloning and 121,000 credits a month; the Free tier gives 10,000 credits a month to try first. Startup Grants also offer new teams 12 months free with 33 million characters.
elevenlabs-black-friday-creator.conditions: Only yearly billing gets the Black Friday price — monthly isn't discounted; the discount covers the first year only, then it auto-renews at the restored price; a valid payment method is required; the offer ends 2026-12-01 (per the official page).
steps: Open elevenlabs.io/pricing and switch billing to "Yearly billing"
Confirm Creator at $8.25/mo for the first year (about $99/yr) before ordering
Check the discount is applied at checkout before paying
If you won't keep it, cancel or downgrade before the first year ends
elevenlabs-black-friday-creator.risk: The discount is first-year only and the second year auto-renews at $18.33/mo (Creator), so forgetting to cancel costs more than double; credits are shared across products and dubbing/music burn fast; commercial use follows the official terms.
elevenlabs-black-friday-creator.source: ElevenLabs official pricing page, Black Friday banner and Creator/Pro first-year prices (rechecked 2026-11-19, Ends December 1)

notion-education.title: [Global] Notion education plan: Plus free
notion-education.highlight: Verify with a school email and get single-member Plus, with 100 guests and 30-day history

notion-education.content: Enrolled university students and teachers who verify with a school email can upgrade a single-member workspace to the Education plan free, with the same features as Plus: bigger file uploads, 100 guests, 30 days of page history and the ability to publish sites.
notion-education.conditions: The school email must be the account's primary email and the school must be listed in WHED; one claim per school email; K-12 teachers and students don't qualify; only a free workspace can be upgraded.
steps: Change your Notion primary email to your school email
Settings → Upgrade plan → Get free education plan
Re-verify your enrolment each year when the reminder arrives

notion-education.source: Notion official help centre and pricing page (checked 2026-11)

modelscope-amd-100h-gpu.title: [CN] ModelScope × AMD developer programme: 100 hours of MI300X (192GB VRAM) free compute
modelscope-amd-100h-gpu.highlight: Register for the AMD Developer Program and link your ModelScope account for 100 hours of AMD GPU Notebook after approval: MI300X/MI308X, 192GB HBM3 per card, 23 cores / 200GB RAM, billed only while running
modelscope-amd-100h-gpu.regions: [CN] ModelScope (modelscope.cn, sign up with a +86 number and link Alibaba Cloud real-name verification before launching); AMD developer programme China site developer.amd.com.cn
modelscope-amd-100h-gpu.content: AMD and ModelScope's joint developer programme: complete AMD Developer Program (ADP) registration and authorise the ModelScope account link, and after review 100 hours of AMD GPU credit lands automatically in ModelScope's "My Notebook" with an extra "AMD GPU environment" row. The machine has 23 CPU cores, 200GB of RAM and 192GB of VRAM (MI300X or MI308X, gfx942), with ROCm 7.2.3 and PyTorch 2.12 preinstalled — enough to benchmark open models around the 27B–Qwen3.6 class. Hours stack: an original technical post in the study group adds 25 hours (max 50), a Notebook walkthrough in the inspiration feed adds 50 (max 150) and an approved Space deployment adds 700+. The global AMD Developer Program also gives new members $100 of AMD Developer Cloud credit (single-MI300X instances).
modelscope-amd-100h-gpu.conditions: Only newly registered AMD Developer Program (ADP) users — existing members don't get it again; the form needs a real name, province or city, field and a one-line use case and is reviewed (usually minutes to days); after it lands you must link an Alibaba Cloud account with real-name verification and a slider check before starting; community testing puts a single session at about 8 hours with only /mnt/workspace kept on shutdown (not an official written promise); instances and data are cleared when the entitlement expires or runs out; sign-ups close 2026-12-31 and the campaign runs to 2027-01-30.
steps: Log in to modelscope.cn with a +86 number, open My Notebook and click the AMD banner at the top
It redirects to developer.amd.com.cn, where one click authorises your ModelScope account for the AMD Developer Program
Fill in name, email, phone, individual developer, province or city, field and use case, then submit with the email and SMS codes
Back in My Notebook, confirm the "AMD GPU environment · 100 hours left" row appears
Link Alibaba Cloud with real-name verification before launching; mind the 8-hour limit and keep code and models in /mnt/workspace
modelscope-amd-100h-gpu.risk: It's an application, so the only proof is the AMD GPU environment row appearing in My Notebook; peak times can fail to start with a resource warning (no hours charged); claiming from multiple accounts can be treated as abuse; don't keep important data only on the instance.
modelscope-amd-100h-gpu.source: ModelScope official campaign page events/247 + AMD developer cloud page ($100 ADC credit) + walkthroughs published 2026-11-11 and 11-14

amazon-prime-young-adults.title: [US] Amazon Prime for Young Adults: 6 months free for 18–24s and students
amazon-prime-young-adults.highlight: 18–24s or enrolled students get 6 months of Prime for $0, with Prime Video, free delivery and exclusive discounts; $7.49/mo after
amazon-prime-young-adults.regions: [US] Amazon.com US site; aged 18–24, or enrolled at a two- or four-year college
amazon-prime-young-adults.content: Amazon's membership for younger customers: 18–24s or enrolled college students get 6 months for $0, then $7.49/mo or $69/yr (about half of regular Prime), including free delivery, Prime Video, Amazon Music Prime, Prime Gaming and unlimited photo storage, plus 5% back in some categories. Age is verified with a driving licence, passport or ID, or a .edu email for students; at 25 or after study ends it rolls into regular Prime.
amazon-prime-young-adults.conditions: New US-site members only; 18–24 or enrolled at a two- or four-year college; age or student verification required; after 6 months it charges $7.49/mo automatically, so cancel in advance if you don't want it.
steps: Open amazon.com/joinstudent (or amazon.com/youngadult)
Choose Prime for Young Adults and complete the age or .edu verification
Confirm the 6 months at $0 and add a payment method
Cancel before it ends if you don't want to continue
amazon-prime-young-adults.risk: It auto-renews at $7.49/mo after 6 months, so set a reminder to cancel; US site only, needing a US payment method and address; when student status ends it becomes regular Prime.
amazon-prime-young-adults.source: Amazon official Prime for Young Adults page and help centre

dxo-black-friday-2026.title: [Global] DxO Black Friday: up to 50% off all photo software (11/17–11/29, up to $75 off)
dxo-black-friday-2026.highlight: PhotoLab 10 $199.99 ($50 off), FilmPack 8 $74.99 ($75 off), Nik Collection 9 $149.99 ($30 off), PureRAW 6 and ViewPoint 6 $99.99 each; no code needed, Black Friday prices apply automatically
dxo-black-friday-2026.regions: [Global] dxo.com shows prices in USD/EUR/GBP/JPY/CNY by region
dxo-black-friday-2026.content: DxO's 2026 Black Friday: all five photo apps are discounted (four got new versions this year), no code needed, running from 11-17 to 11-29 (Sunday) 23:59 automatically. PhotoLab 10 drops from $249.99 to $199.99 (CNY 32,900 → 25,800); Nik Collection 9's seven plugins from $179.99 to $149.99; ViewPoint 6 geometry correction from $129.99 to $99.99; PureRAW 6 RAW preprocessing from $139.99 to $99.99; FilmPack 8 film looks from $149.99 to $74.99 ($75 off, the biggest cut). dxo-black-friday-2026.conditions: Discounts can't be combined with other offers; the promo ends 2026-11-29 23:59 local time; the perpetual licence covers that major version only and later majors cost extra (the exact update window is on each product page, to be confirmed); instalments via PayPal aren't available everywhere.
steps: Open the DxO Black Friday page and pick what you need
Confirm the Black Friday price already shows (no code needed)
Check the currency and version before checkout (there's a free 30-day trial to try first)
Register the licence key in your account after buying
dxo-black-friday-2026.risk: The perpetual licence doesn't include later major upgrades; Black Friday is the year's lowest price, but for someone who isn't editing photos right now it's just an impulse buy; prices differ noticeably by region and currency.
