wise-invite.highlight: Invited new customers choose one: a free card (saving £7) or no fees on their first transfer up to £500
wise-invite.regions: [UK/EU] Mainly the UK and EEA; other Wise markets have different perks (per the terms for the region you sign up in)
wise-invite.content: Sign up for Wise through an existing user's invite link and choose between a free physical card and no fees on a transfer of up to £500; the inviter earns £15/£25/£35 of fee credit by tier once the invitee completes a cross-border transfer of £200 or more.
wise-invite.conditions: New Wise users only; the invite link can still be attached within 30 days of signing up; the fee-free voucher must be used within 6 months and excludes taxes and same-currency top-ups.
steps: Open the invite link and sign up for Wise
Complete identity verification (ID, proof of address and a selfie)
Choose the free card or the fee-free transfer on the gift page
Use the voucher before it expires
wise-invite.risk: Perks differ by region (the UK and Europe usually get the free card or £500 fee-free while Australia gets cashback); fee credit isn't cash and can't be withdrawn.
wise-invite.source: Wise official help centre (terms for the three invite programmes)

ifast-golden-ticket-50.title: [UK] iFAST Global Bank Golden Ticket referral: deposit £1,000 and keep it 60 days for £50 each (ends 11/30)
ifast-golden-ticket-50.highlight: Open an iFAST multi-currency account through an existing customer's Golden Ticket link, deposit £1,000+ within 30 days of approval and keep it for 60 consecutive days for £50 each, paid straight into the multi-currency current account
ifast-golden-ticket-50.regions: [UK] iFAST Global Bank (UK-licensed e-bank, deposits protected by FSCS up to £85,000); mainland Chinese users can open online, though ordinary self-signup only gets the £5 standard referral
ifast-golden-ticket-50.content: iFAST Global Bank's Golden Ticket Referral Programme: during the campaign each successful referral pays the referrer and the new customer £50 each, up to 5 successful referrals per customer. The new customer must open a qualifying account (multi-currency current), deposit at least £1,000 within 30 days of approval and keep that balance for 60 consecutive calendar days (the holding period); the reward is credited to both parties' Multi-Currency Current Accounts within 1 business day after the holding period. There is also a business version (2026-10-14 to 2027-04-14: refer a business account, deposit £1,000, keep it 14 days, £50 each). Mainland users have opened accounts remotely, which suits anyone who already needs GBP/USD exchange and payments.
ifast-golden-ticket-50.conditions: Must use the existing customer's Golden Ticket link (ordinary self-signup only gets the £5 standard referral); the £1,000 must be new money held for 60 consecutive days — take it out early and it's void; at most 5 successful referrals per person during the campaign; monthly fees, minimum balances and currency conversion rules follow the official fee page and invite email (to be confirmed); referrer and referee can't be the same person.
steps: Ask an existing iFAST customer for a Golden Ticket invite link
Open the account online through the link and complete KYC with ID and proof of address
Deposit £1,000 or more (or the equivalent) within 30 days of approval
Leave the balance untouched for 60 consecutive calendar days
Within 1 business day after the holding period, £50 lands in both multi-currency current accounts
ifast-golden-ticket-50.risk: There's no public retail landing page — the offer is only reachable from the invite email or the client area, and the terms, monthly fee and whether it stacks with the £5 standard reward are marked to be confirmed; the £1,000 is locked for 60 days, so the tied-up money and FX risk are yours; the bank can change or end the campaign at any time.
ifast-golden-ticket-50.source: The iFAST Golden Ticket referral email as reposted in full by a community member on 2026-11-01 + iFAST official MGM terms page / business referral announcement (LinkedIn 2026-10-21 and 2026-11-05)

att-us-free-trial-30d.title: [US] AT&T 30-day free trial: 100GB + 25GB hotspot (eSIM, no credit card)
att-us-free-trial-30d.highlight: New customers activate a 30-day trial over eSIM in the AT&T app: 100GB of data, 25GB of personal hotspot, unlimited calls and texts across the US, Canada and Mexico and full 5G access, with no number port-in and no credit card
att-us-free-trial-30d.regions: [US] United States; needs a US number and account environment, plus an unlocked phone that supports eSIM (iPhone XR or newer, or a compatible Android)
att-us-free-trial-30d.content: AT&T's official Try AT&T free trial: new customers check phone compatibility in the app and activate a trial eSIM while keeping their existing number and service, using the AT&T network for 30 days. It includes 100GB of data, 25GB of personal hotspot, unlimited calls and texts between the US, Canada and Mexico, unlimited texts from the US to 200+ countries and full 5G access (not a downgraded experience). AT&T's blog says you can start without a credit card, and you can switch or stop at any time during the trial, including porting in.
att-us-free-trial-30d.conditions: AT&T new customers only (current customers don't qualify); the phone must be unlocked with eSIM support (iPhone XR or newer; Android also supported); one per user/device; the trial doesn't roll into a paid plan, so you'd have to port in separately; some areas and network types may be limited, as the in-app eligibility check shows. US carriers generally run eUICC EID whitelists, so a third-party card needs its IMEI and EID registered with customer service before download.
steps: Download the myAT&T app from the App Store or Google Play (or scan the code at att.com/wireless/free-trial/)
Tap "Start your trial" and confirm the phone is unlocked and eSIM-compatible
Create a simple profile and activate the trial eSIM, noting the trial number assigned
Set the AT&T line as the data and calling line in your phone settings to use the 100GB plus 25GB hotspot
Decide before the trial ends whether to port in; if not, delete the eSIM line
att-us-free-trial-30d.risk: You need a US network environment and US account details, so non-US users may fail eligibility; the eSIM needs an unlocked phone and carrier-financed handsets usually don't qualify; the trial number can't be ported out and service stops when the trial ends; AT&T can change or end the trial at any time.
att-us-free-trial-30d.source: AT&T official Try AT&T page (100GB / 25GB hotspot / 30 days, rechecked 2026-11-19) + AT&T official blog launch note of 2024-10-22 (no credit card needed)

xiaomi-india-google-ai-pro-3m.title: [IN] Xiaomi/Redmi India devices × Google AI Pro: 3 months free
xiaomi-india-google-ai-pro-3m.highlight: Buy and activate an eligible Redmi/Xiaomi device in India and claim 3 months of Google AI Pro in the Gemini or Google One app; it renews monthly at the local price if you don't cancel
xiaomi-india-google-ai-pro-3m.regions: [IN] Eligible Xiaomi/Redmi devices sold in India; 18+, an India-region Google account and a valid payment method; mainland China, Hong Kong and Macau excluded
xiaomi-india-google-ai-pro-3m.content: Xiaomi India's purchase benefit with Google: after buying and activating an eligible Xiaomi/Redmi device in India, you can claim 3 months of Google AI Pro (including Gemini Advanced capabilities) in that device's Gemini app or Google One app; when the subscription ends it renews monthly at the local price and can be cancelled at any time during the trial. The device must be bought and activated by 2027-06-12 23:59 local time, and the benefit claimed before then.
xiaomi-india-google-ai-pro-3m.conditions: Only selected models sold in India; the device must be purchased and activated within the window; claiming needs age 18+, a Google account and a valid payment method (nothing is charged during the trial); one per person/device; returning the device may cancel the subscription.
steps: Buy and activate an eligible Redmi/Xiaomi device in India
Open the Gemini app or Google One app on that device
Tap the "Try Google AI Pro at no extra cost" pop-up, or "Try Google AI Pro" in the profile menu
Tap "Start trial" and add a payment method to finish activation
Cancel manually before the trial ends to avoid the automatic charge
xiaomi-india-google-ai-pro-3m.risk: It has to be a genuine device bought and activated in India — buying an activation slot second-hand risks losing the subscription and the account; after 3 months it renews at local price (about ₹1,950/mo), so cancel during the trial if you don't want it.
xiaomi-india-google-ai-pro-3m.source: Xiaomi India official Google AI Pro Offer terms page (claim deadline 2027-06-12)

zalando-plus-spotify-duolingo.title: [EU, 17 countries] Zalando Plus free membership: Spotify Premium up to 5 months + Super Duolingo up to 4 months
zalando-plus-spotify-duolingo.highlight: Zalando Plus is free to join; then claim Spotify Premium (3–5 months by tier) and Super Duolingo (2–4 months) under "Partner-Vorteile" without buying anything
zalando-plus-spotify-duolingo.regions: [EU] 17 Plus markets including Austria, Germany, Switzerland, Italy, Spain, Luxembourg, France, Belgium, the Netherlands, Sweden, Denmark, Finland, Norway, Poland, Czechia, Croatia and Romania
zalando-plus-spotify-duolingo.value: Up to about €60 (Spotify 3 months + Duolingo from 2 months)
zalando-plus-spotify-duolingo.content: Zalando Plus has been a free membership since September 2024 (tiers Light / Shine / Star / Superstar based on points) and in 2026 added two partner benefits: Spotify Premium Individual for 3 (Light/Shine) to 5 (Superstar) months and Super Duolingo for 2 to 4 months by tier. Both are claimed by tapping the cards in the "Partner-Vorteile" carousel on the Plus home page, and Spotify's official window is 2026-07-07 to 2028-07-06. Claiming requires signing in to or creating a Spotify/Duolingo account, and Duolingo needs a payment method; when the free period ends it renews at full price.
zalando-plus-spotify-duolingo.conditions: Must be a Zalando Plus member in one of the 17 markets (free to join); the Spotify benefit is only for people who have never had Spotify Premium; Duolingo requires at least one Zalando order in the past 12 months in some markets and a payment method; each benefit can be claimed once and tier upgrades don't stack; cancel before the free period ends or it renews automatically.
steps: Register on the relevant country site (e.g. zalando.de/plus) and activate Zalando Plus free
On the Plus home page, tap the Spotify or Duolingo card in the "Partner-Vorteile" carousel
Sign in or create the matching account as prompted; Spotify activates the free months directly and Duolingo needs a payment method first
Note the end date in your calendar (the platform reminds you 7 days before) and cancel auto-renewal before then
zalando-plus-spotify-duolingo.risk: The benefits differ by country site and membership tier — Germany and Spain don't match exactly; Duolingo in some regions requires a Zalando order in the past 12 months, which means spending first; Spotify only works for accounts that have never subscribed to Premium; forgetting to cancel bills you about €11.99/mo, so set a reminder.
zalando-plus-spotify-duolingo.source: Zalando official corporate news (2026-09-28 Duolingo partnership, up to 4 months in 17 markets) + Zalando Lounge official help page (Spotify 3–5 months, running to 2028-07-06) + Zalando France promo terms (market list)

lemfi-eu-referral-50.title: [EU] LemFi invite: €50 LemFi Cash each when you sign up in Europe (first transfer must leave the euro area)
lemfi-eu-referral-50.highlight: Sign up to LemFi in Europe with a referral code for €50; once the invitee sends a first transfer of €50+ outside the euro area the inviter gets €50 too — €5 off per transfer, up to €15 a month
lemfi-eu-referral-50.regions: [EU] LemFi users registered in Europe (e.g. Germany); the UK has a £50 version, the US $50, Canada C$50 and Australia A$50
lemfi-eu-referral-50.content: LemFi's official help page (updated 2026-10-21) states the referral reward for users registered in Europe is €50, with the invitee getting €50 too, both in the local currency of the country of registration. The invitee must sign up with the referral code and complete one qualifying transfer of €50 or more; for European registrations the qualifying transfer must go outside Europe (e.g. CNY, USD, PHP — transfers within Europe don't count). The €50 is LemFi Cash credit, not cash: €5 off each transfer of €50 or more, up to €15 a month, non-withdrawable, so it takes about 3–4 months to use; the LemFi account itself is fee-free on the first transfer and about €6 per transfer after that.
lemfi-eu-referral-50.conditions: New LemFi customers only; the referral code must be entered at sign-up; the first transfer must be €50+ and outside the euro area; LemFi Cash can't be withdrawn or transferred, gives €5 off each €50+ transfer up to €15 a month; European registration needs a European phone number and passport, sometimes proof of address.
steps: Download the LemFi app and register with a European number and passport, completing KYC
Enter the referral code at sign-up and make a first transfer of €50+ to a country outside the euro area (e.g. your own Wise account or a CNY card)
See the €50 in your LemFi Cash balance; each qualifying €50+ transfer then takes €5 off
To refer others, share your own code — you get €50 once their first transfer qualifies
lemfi-eu-referral-50.risk: The €50 is credit, not cash, and you can't take it in one go; each transfer carries fees and FX spread, so real value can be far below face value; European registration needs a European number and matching IP, and proof of address depends on risk checks; don't post the code publicly (it's meant for people you know).
lemfi-eu-referral-50.source: LemFi official help centre "How much LemFi Cash do I get for a referral?" (2026-10-21) + official German help page "Wie funktioniert das Empfehlen von Personen" (European registrations must send outside Europe) + a forum walkthrough (NodeSeek 2026-11-03, payout details updated 11-19)

Your friend signs up through the link and completes KYC
They deposit, order the card and make 3 purchases
Check progress and the payout under Referrals

worldremit-quidco-uk-cashback.title: [UK] WorldRemit × Quidco cashback: £37.50–£40 back on a first transfer of £25+ plus a £10 referral voucher
worldremit-quidco-uk-cashback.highlight: Start at Quidco, click through to WorldRemit, sign up and send a first transfer of £25+: £40 back for Pakistan/Nepal/Philippines/Ghana/Zimbabwe (Premium price; £37.50 for standard members) but only £20/£18.75 for other destinations; add a referral code as a new customer for another £10 transfer voucher
worldremit-quidco-uk-cashback.regions: [UK] UK (a Quidco account plus a new UK WorldRemit customer); the cashback tier depends on the destination country
worldremit-quidco-uk-cashback.content: Quidco's WorldRemit merchant page (captured 2026-11-19) shows "Get up to £40 cashback" in two tiers: a new customer who registers and sends a first transfer of £25+ to Pakistan, Nepal, the Philippines, Ghana or Zimbabwe gets £40 (the page marks this as the Premium member rate; Cashback Wolf recorded £37.50 for standard members the same day), while a first transfer to other destinations gets only £20 (£18.75 standard). Cashback tracks within 24 hours but can take up to 6 months to become withdrawable after the merchant confirms. Adding a WorldRemit referral code in the same signup also earns a £10 transfer voucher after a first transfer of £30+ (the inviter gets a £20 voucher), and the community treats this stack as the most reliable single deal in the UK.
worldremit-quidco-uk-cashback.conditions: New WorldRemit customers only; first transfer of £25+ (or £30+ to also get the £10 referral voucher); you must start from Quidco's Get cashback link and finish signup and payment in the same browser session; the £40 tier needs Premium membership (£1 a month, charged only in months with cashback, 3 months free for new members); Quidco's terms say using external discount codes can void cashback.
steps: Register or sign in to Quidco (new members can use an invite link for an extra signup bonus); take Premium for the £40 tier (3 months free for new members)
Search WorldRemit on Quidco and click Get cashback
Complete the WorldRemit signup in the same browser and enter the referral code (for the £10 voucher)
Send a first transfer of £30+ to the destination (Philippines/Pakistan/Nepal/Ghana/Zimbabwe for the £40 tier)
Check tracking on Quidco within 24 hours, then use the £10 voucher on a second transfer
worldremit-quidco-uk-cashback.risk: Some Reddit users report WorldRemit closing accounts for the Quidco + referral code stack, and the official terms reserve the right to cancel rewards for abuse; cashback waits for merchant confirmation and may take 6 months, so don't close the account; Premium's £1 comes out of the cashback; FX spread and transfer fees eat into it (about £1.99 in fees on the Philippines route).
worldremit-quidco-uk-cashback.source: Quidco WorldRemit merchant page (captured 2026-11-19, £40 is the Premium price) + Cashback Wolf / Bank Boost same-day record (standard £37.50) + WorldRemit Refer a Friend official FAQ and terms + several r/beermoneyuk reports from 2026-10 to 11

lemfi-uk-referral-50.highlight: New UK customers get £50 LemFi Cash with a referral code, and the inviter gets £50 once the friend sends a single transfer of £50+; it can't be withdrawn — instead £5 comes off each £50+ transfer, up to 3 a month
lemfi-uk-referral-50.regions: [UK] UK-registered users (the US, Canada, Australia and EU have equivalents in local currency); transfers reach supported countries in Africa, Asia, Europe and elsewhere
lemfi-uk-referral-50.content: LemFi's official Invite and earn: a new customer who signs up with a referral code or link gets £50 LemFi Cash, and once the invitee sends a single transfer of £50 or more to any supported country the inviter gets £50 too. The official referral note (2026-10-21) states that European registrations must send outside Europe. The £50 isn't cash: the official terms give £5 off each transfer of £50 or more, up to 3 a month and non-withdrawable — at most £15 a month, used up over about 3–4 months; the account itself charges no transfer fee.
lemfi-uk-referral-50.conditions: New LemFi customers only; a single transfer of £50 or more; the referral code must be entered at signup and can't be your own referral; LemFi Cash can't be withdrawn or transferred, gives £5 off each £50+ transfer, 3 a month.
steps: Download the LemFi app, register with the referral code and complete passport/ID KYC
Fund the account and send an international transfer of £50 or more (e.g. to your own Wise euro account)
See the £50 in your LemFi Cash balance; each £50+ transfer afterwards takes £5 off
To refer others, share your code — you get £50 once their first transfer qualifies
lemfi-uk-referral-50.risk: The "£50" is credit, not cash, and you can't take it in one go; real value depends on whether you'll send more transfers. Sites such as Budgetfitter advertise code FATILPG7 for "£10 cash straight to your balance", which doesn't match the official LemFi Cash terms — trust the app; FX spread is still charged.
lemfi-uk-referral-50.source: LemFi official invite-and-earn page ($50/£50 in both currencies) + official "How does referring someone work" help page (2026-10-21) + referralplug's review of the LemFi terms (2026-11-18)

mistral-vibe-pro-lechonk-3m.title: [EU] Mistral Vibe Pro: 3 months free for European developers with code LECHONK ($45)
mistral-vibe-pro-lechonk-3m.highlight: To promote Vibe + Le Chonk (Mistral Large 4) Mistral released limited places: European developers redeem code LECHONK for 3 months of Vibe Pro, including a monthly API allowance
mistral-vibe-pro-lechonk-3m.regions: [EEA] Aimed at European developers; the redemption page expects a European IP and non-European accounts often fail risk checks
mistral-vibe-pro-lechonk-3m.content:
On 17 November Mistral AI released limited free 3-month Vibe Pro places to European developers to mark the launch of the open model Le Chonk (Mistral Large 4, 1 trillion parameters with about 52 billion active) combined with Vibe, using code LECHONK. Vibe Pro normally costs $14.99/mo before tax, so three months saves about $45 and includes higher message and web-search limits, expanded Vibe capacity, all-day CLI/IDE/web agentic coding and a monthly API allowance. Places ran out that day and Mistral said on X that more might come the next day; on 11-18 the community saw the code go from "unavailable" back to claimable after a restock, so it's issued in batches.

Re-check (2026-11-20 03:30): Mistral restocked once on 11-18 alongside the Vibe Desktop launch, but users again reported "This code is no longer available" the same day. From 11-19, AI Promo Now marks it "verified: no longer works" and mydealz lists it as ended, while users on X are still asking @MistralAI for another drop. It is archived as sold out; if codes return, it can be revived.
mistral-vibe-pro-lechonk-3m.conditions: European developers only; limited places, first come first served, and the code shows "This code is no longer available" until restocked; redeem while signed in to a Mistral account; a valid payment method is needed and community reports say zero-balance virtual cards usually pass verification (a data point, not an official promise); it renews at $14.99/mo, so cancel manually.
steps: Connect through a European node and sign in to a Mistral account (register first if needed)
Open the redemption page at admin.mistral.ai and enter code LECHONK
Confirm Vibe Pro is $0 for the first 3 months and submit
Cancel the renewal on the subscription page before it ends
mistral-vibe-pro-lechonk-3m.risk: Archived as sold out: stock can return at any time, and failing to redeem is normal. Non-European accounts or risk checks may fail outright. Anyone who already redeemed still auto-renews at $14.99/month unless cancelled.
mistral-vibe-pro-lechonk-3m.source: Mistral official campaign post on X (2026-11-17) + NodeSeek hands-on thread of 2026-11-18 (including the restock data point) + DDay.it coverage

proton-black-friday-2026.content: Proton's 2026 Black Friday (live from 10-26 to Cyber Monday 11-30): Proton Unlimited is $77.88 for the first 12 months ($6.49/mo, normally $12.99/mo, renewing at $119.88/yr); Mail Plus is $29.88/yr ($2.49/mo, renewing at $47.88/yr) with 15GB, 10 encrypted addresses and 1 custom domain; the public page also has an Unlimited first month for $1 (then $12.99/mo). proton-black-friday-2026.conditions: Pay for the whole year up front; new users come through the public Black Friday page (the checkout link carries BF2026NEW) while existing accounts claim the personal price in the account area; yearly plans renew at $119.88/yr, so cancel in advance; one refund per person within 30 days.
steps: Open proton.me/mail/black-friday (or proton.me/pricing)
Choose Unlimited yearly ($77.88 for the first year) or Mail Plus ($29.88)
Check the checkout says "renews at $119.88/year" and that the discount applied
Add a calendar reminder to cancel or renew before it ends

unicom-esim-xianxian-2026.title: [CN] China Unicom eSIM launch season 2026: activate eSIM for 100GB of data or a ¥300 roaming voucher
unicom-esim-xianxian-2026.highlight: After setting up a Unicom eSIM (new line, physical SIM to eSIM, or number port-in) claim a benefit within 30 days: carrier-supplied models can take 100GB of domestic data or overseas eSIM data and roaming vouchers; self-bought phones choose one of two
unicom-esim-xianxian-2026.regions: [CN] Mainland China (needs a Unicom number and a China-market phone that supports eSIM; apply at an own-brand store or in the Unicom app)
unicom-esim-xianxian-2026.content: China Unicom's eSIM launch season 2026: activating eSIM service (new line, physical SIM to eSIM, eSIM to eSIM, or after number port-in) lets you claim a self-selected benefit pack within 30 calendar days, once per phone. For eSIM models supplied by Unicom you pick one of three — overseas eSIM data, an international roaming voucher or domestic data — while self-bought phones that Unicom doesn't supply usually choose between overseas data and a roaming voucher. Domestic data tiers include 100GB (plus a 50GB six-month pack and 200/300/500GB annual packs), with the activation month as the first month, valid for 6 or 12 calendar months and no rollover; the roaming voucher is the ¥300 tier. Benefits can't be cancelled, renewed or given away.
unicom-esim-xianxian-2026.conditions: Must hold a Unicom number and set up eSIM (the phone must be on Unicom's compatibility list and a mainland-market model); the benefit must be claimed within 30 calendar days through the Unicom app, a store poster QR code or the card in carrier-supplied device packaging; domestic data is only for carrier-supplied models, and numbers on conflicting plans such as "Unicom Cube" or throttled plans can't claim it; an independent eSIM number counts towards the five-lines-per-ID limit, and each device supports at most 2 eSIM numbers across carriers. Third-party eUICCs (eSTK, 9eSIM) lack the Chinese carrier CI certificates, and mainland eSIM requires device-card locking with IMEI and EID registration, so they cannot be written.
steps: Check in the Unicom app under Services → eSIM zone, or at a nearby own-brand store, that your model qualifies
Set up the eSIM (new line, physical SIM to eSIM, or number port-in)
Within 30 days choose one benefit on the campaign page (domestic data, or overseas data/roaming voucher)
Use it before it expires; domestic data doesn't roll over
unicom-esim-xianxian-2026.risk: Domestic data only goes to carrier-supplied models, so self-bought phones usually get overseas data or a roaming voucher; throttled or conflicting plans make the domestic data claim void; overseas data must be installed and activated abroad within 365 days and doesn't support hotspot; in-store processing means visiting an own-brand store.
unicom-esim-xianxian-2026.source: China Unicom's official eSIM launch season 2026 campaign rules (reported by ITHome on 2026-09-09 and 09-13 and by Unicom's official Weibo; the benefit details were cross-checked by media on 2026-11-17)

verizon-free-trial-30d.title: [US] Verizon 30-day free trial: up to 100GB of 5G data (eSIM, no credit card)
verizon-free-trial-30d.highlight: Non-Verizon users can use an eSIM phone free for 30 days: unlimited calls and texts plus up to 100GB of priority 4G/5G data, no credit card, and it ends automatically
verizon-free-trial-30d.regions: [US] In the United States only; needs an unlocked, eSIM-compatible phone
verizon-free-trial-30d.content: Verizon Free Trial: sign up in the My Verizon app or on the official page and activate a 30-day trial on an unlocked eSIM phone, with unlimited calls and texts within the US, up to 100GB of priority 4G/5G data (throttled to 600Kbps after that) and 480p streaming (4K on 5G Ultra Wideband). The trial gives you a temporary Verizon number without touching your existing number or carrier service; the eSIM expires automatically at the end with nothing to cancel, and no credit card is needed at any point.
verizon-free-trial-30d.conditions: US only; the phone must support eSIM and be unlocked; current Verizon, Visible and TracFone customers can't take part; no Verizon trial in the previous 12 months; US calls only, no international; the temporary number can't be kept or ported after the trial. steps: Download the My Verizon app (or start on the official Free Trial page)
Enter your details and check the IMEI to confirm the phone is unlocked with a free eSIM slot
Receive the text and install the trial eSIM
Switch data to the Verizon line; it ends automatically after 30 days
verizon-free-trial-30d.risk: It only works inside the US; the 100GB is a priority-data cap and speeds drop after it; some Samsung models need their existing eSIM removed first; the temporary number has no international roaming.
verizon-free-trial-30d.source: Verizon official Free Trial page and support FAQ (read 2026-11-19)

paypal-uk-25-invite.regions: [UK] UK residents with UK personal PayPal accounts only; the reward is GBP checkout credit with no cash value

steps: Have a friend with a UK PayPal account send the official invite from the app
Register a new UK personal account through the link, link a bank or card and verify the phone
Within 30 days pay a GBP order of £10+ with PayPal (or send a P2P transfer of £10+)
Check Offers in the app about two weeks later for the £25

steps: Open the Airalo Black Friday Unlimited page and choose the destination and plan
Enter BLACK25 in the discount field and apply it at checkout
Check the discounted price, plan length and the 3GB/day rule before paying
Activate the eSIM at your destination — you have 365 days
airalo-black25-unlimited.risk: BLACK25 only works on Unlimited, so fixed-data plans save nothing; "unlimited" means 3GB of high speed per day then throttling; one code per order, so it doesn't stack with the 15% first-order code; the code stops working when the campaign ends.
airalo-black25-unlimited.source: Airalo official Black Friday campaign terms (2026-11-13 to 11-30) + official Unlimited plan page (BLACK25, 3GB/day high speed, 365-day activation)

airtel-postpaid-free-roaming.title: [IN] Airtel postpaid: one free international roaming pack a year (5GB / 5 days)
airtel-postpaid-free-roaming.highlight: New postpaid plans from 2026-10-08 include one free international roaming pack a year: 5GB of data, 60 minutes of calls and 25 texts, valid 5 days, activated whenever you choose
airtel-postpaid-free-roaming.regions: [IN] Indian Airtel postpaid customers; the pack covers Airtel's overseas roaming destinations
airtel-postpaid-free-roaming.content: Airtel announced on 2026-10-07 that from 8 October new postpaid plans include one free international roaming pack a year: 5GB of data, 60 minutes of calls, 25 outgoing texts, free incoming texts and 5 days of validity, activated at a time you choose when travelling; each member of a family plan gets their own. New plans or upgrades are available in the Airtel app or at a store.
airtel-postpaid-free-roaming.conditions: Must be an Indian Airtel postpaid customer (new or upgraded from prepaid); once a year; 5-day validity, self-activated in the app; each family plan member gets one; the pack only covers Airtel partner networks.
steps: Open or upgrade to a new postpaid plan in the Airtel app or at a store
Activate the free international roaming pack in the Airtel app before you travel
Choose the 5-day window so it's live when you land
airtel-postpaid-free-roaming.risk: You need an Indian postpaid number and a monthly bill first; the pack only covers partner networks, so check destinations and any speed limits on the activation page.

gigsky-visa-complimentary-data.title: [Global, by card issuer] GigSky × Visa: 1–3GB of free global data for eligible Visa cards + 7 days unlimited in selected destinations
gigsky-visa-complimentary-data.highlight: Enter your Visa card number in the GigSky app to check eligibility; eligible cards get up to 3GB of global data (175+ countries), some destinations add up to 7 days unlimited, and all plans are up to 20% off
gigsky-visa-complimentary-data.regions: [Global, by card issuer] Benefits depend on where the Visa card was issued (US, Canada, Brazil, Argentina, Japan, Hong Kong/Macau, Latin America and the Caribbean, rest of world), with extra tiers for U.S. Bank, UBS, Navy Federal, Chime, Caixa and other issuers in the US
gigsky-visa-complimentary-data.value: ≈ $25 (1–3GB global data + unlimited in selected destinations)
gigsky-visa-complimentary-data.content: GigSky's long-running partnership with Visa: download the GigSky app and verify your own Visa card for up to 3GB of global data covering 175+ countries; selected Visa destinations also get up to 7 days unlimited; all GigSky plans give Visa cardholders up to 30% off. The allowance differs by card issuer — some Visa Infinite / Signature cards get 1GB and certain US banks have 3GB or 5GB tiers — so what the app shows after verification is what counts.
gigsky-visa-complimentary-data.conditions: Must hold a Visa card (debit or credit depending on the issuer) and verify with the card number in the app; new GigSky users only; data activates automatically on connecting in a covered country and must be used within its validity; one claim per card/user; the benefit can be withdrawn if the card is closed or no longer valid; excludes your home country, cruises, in-flight and maritime networks.
steps: Download the GigSky app and register
Open the Visa benefits page and enter your Visa card number to check eligibility
Choose the free allowance tier and destination
Install the eSIM; it activates on connecting at the destination — set the GigSky line as the data line as instructed
gigsky-visa-complimentary-data.risk: The allowance depends on card type and issuer, and an ordinary card may get only 1GB or nothing; you must enter the card number in the app, which raises privacy questions; the free data has an expiry and can lapse if the eSIM is never activated; GigSky can change or end the partnership.
gigsky-visa-complimentary-data.source: GigSky official Visa Travel Benefits page (up to 3GB / 175+ countries / up to 7 days unlimited in selected destinations / up to 30% off, rechecked 2026-11-19)

unicom-cloud-free-ai-desktop.title: [CN] Unicom Cloud new customers: 1 month of AI cloud desktop for ¥0 (4 cores 8G + Qwen Office)
unicom-cloud-free-ai-desktop.highlight: Double 11 compute festival: new customers get 1 month of a 4-core 8G / 80G system-disk AI cloud desktop with Qwen Office preinstalled for ¥0; pick the "OpenClaw shell" image for a free Token Plan Lite
unicom-cloud-free-ai-desktop.regions: [CN] Unicom Cloud (cucloud.cn); real-name verification required (face scan in China, passport abroad), new customers only
unicom-cloud-free-ai-desktop.content: Unicom Cloud's 2026 Double 11 compute festival includes a ¥0 "AI cloud desktop bundle": standard 4 cores / 8G, an 80GB enhanced system disk and 1 month of use with the Qwen Office agent preinstalled, normally ¥164.67. Choosing the "OpenClaw shell" image also brings Token Plan Lite (1 month, 6 million tokens a month, normally ¥15/mo). The same page has a new-customer 11.11 CNY / 6-month 2-core 4G ECS, limited to 2 units.
unicom-cloud-free-ai-desktop.conditions: Unicom Cloud new customers only (no completed order or bill above ¥0 on the platform, and no pay-as-you-go product opened); real-name verification required; the same ID/phone/device/IP counts as one user, one order and one unit; prepaid online orders only; can't be combined with other offers; the cloud desktop doesn't include an OS licence and you must buy one to keep using it after the trial; renewals and resizes follow list price.
steps: Open www.cucloud.cn/bwnnov.html, register and complete real-name verification
Click "Try for ¥0" in the "Free · AI cloud desktop + Qwen Office + Token Plan Lite" section
Choose the "OpenClaw shell" image in the configuration to get Token Plan Lite
Confirm 4C8G / 80G / 1 month at ¥0, submit the order and pay 0
After 5–15 minutes, download the Unicom Cloud AI Desktop client as the SMS instructs and sign in
unicom-cloud-free-ai-desktop.risk: New customers only — old accounts don't see it or can't order it; limited stock (the community says 5,000 units), first come first served; the cloud desktop has no web entry, so the client is required; the Windows licence isn't included, so it's unusable after the trial without buying one.
unicom-cloud-free-ai-desktop.source: Unicom Cloud official campaign page (2026 Double 11 compute festival, marked "0-yuan trial · new customers only") + several community walkthroughs of 2026-11-11 (aipromonow / Manman Moyu / Wubianyi)

swarms-cloud-black-friday.title: [Global] Swarms Cloud Black Friday: $15 free credit + 20% extra on top-ups (to 12/2)
swarms-cloud-black-friday.highlight: Redeem code SWARMSFLASH under Credits for $15 of free credit (new accounts also get $5 signup credit) and 20% extra on every top-up; Pro is half price at $10/mo for the first 3 months, and subscribers get free tokens on Black Friday and Cyber Monday
swarms-cloud-black-friday.regions: [Global] Swarms Cloud (cloud.swarms.world); the code works on new and existing accounts, email signup required
swarms-cloud-black-friday.value: $15 free credit (about $20 with the $5 signup credit)
swarms-cloud-black-friday.content: Swarms Cloud's 2026 Black Friday has five parts: (1) code SWARMSFLASH gives $15 of free credit (once per account, until 12/2 Pacific) and new accounts get another $5 signup credit for $20 to start; (2) Free-plan accounts get half off the first 3 months of monthly Pro/Premium (Pro $19.99 → $10/mo, Premium $100 → $50/mo), including a 7-day Pro trial; (3) new annual subscriptions get a further 10% off on top of the usual 15% (Pro $183.51 for the first year); (4) every top-up gets 20% extra credit ($25 buys $30); (5) on Black Friday 11/27 and Cyber Monday 11/30, Pro/Premium subscribers get token fees waived (agents, images and search excluded). The free credit works with models such as GPT-5.6, Claude Opus 5 and Gemini 3.1 Pro, plus image workflows and agent batch endpoints.
swarms-cloud-black-friday.conditions: SWARMSFLASH is once per account, entered under Settings → Credits → Redeem a code; the half-price offer only applies to accounts without an active subscription and only for the first 3 months; the annual discount is for first-year new subscriptions only; free tokens apply only on 11/27 and 11/30 to Pro/Premium subscribers; the campaign ends 2026-12-02 Pacific time.
steps: Register or sign in at cloud.swarms.world
Go to Settings → Credits, enter SWARMSFLASH and redeem; $15 lands immediately
Top up if you need more — every top-up gets 20% extra
For longer use, take Pro on the Black Friday page ($10/mo for 3 months) and schedule batch jobs for 11/27 and 11/30
swarms-cloud-black-friday.risk: The free credit expires and burns fast on some models; subscriptions renew at full price, so cancel when you're done; agent, image and search fees at premium endpoints sit outside the free tokens.
swarms-cloud-black-friday.source: Swarms Cloud official Black Friday page (checked 2026-11-18)

taptap-send-uk-first-transfer.title: [UK] TapTap Send first-transfer reward: £5 standard, up to £20 to Turkey (code to be confirmed)
taptap-send-uk-first-transfer.highlight: New customers enter a referral code before their first transfer and get £5 off a first transfer of £25+; Budgetfitter separately lists a Turkey-specific £20 code (expires 2026-12-31). The reward is transfer credit, not cash, and lasts 90 days
taptap-send-uk-first-transfer.regions: [UK] UK (the US, Europe, Canada, Australia and the UAE can also send); there's a dedicated code for the Turkey route
taptap-send-uk-first-transfer.content: TapTap Send's official referral terms: a new customer enters a referral code on their first transfer and gets the reward after a successful transfer at or above the app's minimum, to a recipient who isn't the inviter, with the amount and minimum shown in the app (the UK standard tier is £5 on a first transfer of £25+). The reward goes into the app balance, can only be used as a whole, can't be withdrawn and expires after 90 days. Budgetfitter's brand page lists three tiers: £20 on a first transfer to Turkey (code Budgetfitter), £15 extra on a first transfer of £100+ (code Budget100) and £5 on a first transfer of £25+ with the general code FATIH2945, all dated 2026-12-31; Finder's FINDER10 gives £10 off £20+, checked in 2026-07 and to be re-confirmed.
taptap-send-uk-first-transfer.conditions: First-time users only; the first transfer must meet the app's minimum (usually £25, some codes require £100); only one code per first transfer, so a promo code rules out also using a referral code; the reward expires after 90 days; the recipient can't be the inviter.
steps: Download the TapTap Send app, register and complete KYC
Start the first transfer, enter the code under "Have a referral code?" and confirm the reward shows
Complete the transfer (you can send to your own Wise euro or Turkish lira account)
Use the reward on your next transfer within 90 days
taptap-send-uk-first-transfer.risk: Only affiliate pages advertise the "£20 to Turkey" tier — it isn't published officially or in the app and is to be confirmed, so check the app shows a discount before ordering; the reward is used as a whole and may exceed what you meant to send; only one code, so choosing the £20 means no standard referral code.
taptap-send-uk-first-transfer.source: TapTap Send official referral terms (amounts and minimums as shown in the app, 90-day expiry) + ReferMonkey (£5 / first transfer £25) + Budgetfitter brand page (2026-11: Turkey £20, Budget100, FATIH2945) + Finder UK (2026-07: FINDER10)

revolut-uk-signup-20.title: [UK] Revolut signup bonus £20: first card purchase of £1+, to 12/31
revolut-uk-signup-20.highlight: New UK customers get a personal link by phone number, open an account, verify their identity and make a first card purchase of £1+ for £20 straight into the account; the campaign ends 2026-12-31 23:59 CET
revolut-uk-signup-20.regions: [UK] Great Britain (GB-ENG / GB-SCT / GB-CYM), plus European markets AT/BE/BG/CZ/DE/DK/EE/ES/FI/FR/GR/HU/IE/LT/NL/PL/RO/SE/SK
revolut-uk-signup-20.content: Revolut's official campaign page (Sziget Festival edition): a new customer enters their phone number to get a personal download link, opens an account, verifies their identity and makes a first card purchase of at least £1 (physical or virtual card), and £20 lands in the Revolut account; the campaign runs to 2026-12-31 23:59 CET. There is also a Manchester City Women edition paying the same £20 but requiring a first purchase of £20+, on the same end date. Revolut has held a UK banking licence since 2026, so eligible deposits are FSCS-protected.
revolut-uk-signup-20.conditions: Revolut new customers aged 18+; identity verification and one qualifying card purchase (gambling, gift cards and transfers don't count); one campaign per person; campaigns roll out by region, so the app's rewards page at signup is what counts.
steps: Enter your phone number on the campaign page and get the personal download link
Open the account and verify your identity (passport or licence plus a selfie)
Order a physical card or use the virtual one for a purchase of £1+
The £20 usually lands a few business days after you complete the steps
revolut-uk-signup-20.risk: Rewards are split across campaigns and regions, and the campaign behind a link can rotate, so always check the in-app rewards page at signup; the promotion may involve withholding tax; existing Revolut customers can't take part.
revolut-uk-signup-20.source: Revolut official campaign page (Sziget edition £20 / first purchase £1+; Man City W.F.C. edition £20 / first purchase £20+, both dated 2026-12-31) + Revolut Help Centre referral conditions

remitly-first-transfer.title: [Multi-region] Remitly $20 off your first transfer
remitly-first-transfer.highlight: New customers get $20 off a first transfer of $40+, and the inviter gets $20 back each time
remitly-first-transfer.regions: [Multi-region] Sending countries such as the US, Canada, the UK, the EU and Australia, each with its own first-transfer threshold
remitly-first-transfer.content: New customers who use a referral or ambassador code, register it on the Redeem Offer page and complete a first international transfer of $40 or more get $20 off; the inviter gets $20 off their next transfer once the friend's first transfer completes. Some regions also add a rate boost and fee waiver.
remitly-first-transfer.conditions: First-time Remitly customers only, one per person; the discount only applies to the first transfer and doesn't cover the minimum send amount; the sending and receiving countries must be on the supported list.
steps: Sign up for Remitly through the referral link
Enter the promo code on the Redeem Offer page and confirm it's applied
Complete a first transfer of $40 or more
The inviter uses their credit on their next transfer
remitly-first-transfer.risk: The discount is transfer credit, not cash; rates and fees are whatever the day's quote says, so don't ignore the FX spread just because of the $20.
remitly-first-transfer.source: Remitly official referral and offer terms (2026-10)

sendwave-referral.title: [US/EU] Sendwave invite: transfer credit for both sides
sendwave-referral.highlight: Enter a referral code before your first transfer and both sides get credit (the amount varies by country and corridor)
sendwave-referral.regions: [US/EU] The US and Europe are separate entities and corridors: US → Latin America/Africa/Asia, Europe → Africa/Latin America/Asia, with credit amounts differing by corridor
sendwave-referral.content: Sendwave's referral programme is two-sided: the new user enters a referral code before their first transfer, and once the first transfer arrives both sides get the credit shown in the app (the US corridor typically shows $5, French and euro accounts have shown €20, and Brazil/Latin America about $10). Credit can be used in parts on later transfers.
sendwave-referral.conditions: Never-completed-a-transaction new users only; some corridors, minimum amounts and KYC requirements are limited; the inviter must be on the same corridor as the invitee for the reward to count.
steps: Download the app, register and pick up a code under Me → Refer a Friend, or use a friend's
Enter the referral code before the first transfer
Complete the first transfer and wait out the 24-hour reversal period
Check the credit in your balance
sendwave-referral.risk: The exact amount is to be confirmed: the official figure changes by country and promotion, so only what the app shows counts; test transfers (under $1) don't count.
sendwave-referral.source: Sendwave official referral terms (valid 12 months) + third-party app screenshots checked 2026-11

gigsky-free-esim.title: [Multi-region] GigSky free eSIM: 100MB / 7 days / 125 countries
gigsky-free-esim.highlight: 100MB with no card needed; 500MB in India; up to 5GB / 15 days with a Visa card
gigsky-free-esim.regions: [Multi-region] 125 countries for the base allowance; 500MB in India; up to 500MB in Europe; 175+ destinations for Visa cardholders; 290+ cruise ships
gigsky-free-esim.content: New GigSky users can claim one free trial eSIM: 100MB / 7 days / 125 countries with no credit card; India gets 500MB / 7 days and Europe up to 500MB; an eligible Visa card unlocks 1–5GB / 15 days or 3–7 days unlimited in selected regions.
gigsky-free-esim.conditions: One per person; an eSIM-compatible unlocked phone; the Visa tier needs a card that qualifies with its issuer; the free allowance stops when used up.
steps: Download the GigSky app and register
Enter your destination and pick the free Standard allowance
Check out at $0 and install the eSIM
Turn on data roaming when you arrive
gigsky-free-esim.risk: 100MB is only enough to check that you can connect; cruises and some countries are charged separately, so don't treat the trial as your main data.

worldremit-uk-refer-a-friend.title: [UK] WorldRemit invite: a £10 voucher for the new customer, £20 for the inviter
worldremit-uk-refer-a-friend.highlight: New customers sign up with the referral link or code and after a first transfer of £30+ both sides get transfer vouchers: £10 for the new UK customer and £20 for the inviter; the voucher only offsets the next transfer and is subject to a minimum
worldremit-uk-refer-a-friend.regions: [UK] UK ↔ most destination countries (UK → Australia, Ghana, India, Nigeria, Pakistan, the US and Bangladesh excluded)
worldremit-uk-refer-a-friend.content: WorldRemit's official Refer a Friend: a new UK customer uses the inviter's link or enters the code on the signup page and, after a transfer of £30 or more, gets a £10 transfer voucher while the inviter gets £20 (the official FAQ table: UK to destinations other than Australia, Ghana, India, Nigeria, Pakistan, the US and Bangladesh pays £20/£10; to Ghana £25/£10). The voucher appears under Discounts in the app, is used once, and has a minimum transfer amount. The inviter must have completed a transfer themselves before they get a referral code.
worldremit-uk-refer-a-friend.conditions: New customers only; the referral code must be entered at signup and can't be added later; first transfer of £30+; referring the same address and using the voucher to send back to the inviter don't count; the inviter needs a transfer history.
steps: Get the inviter's link or code (or make a transfer yourself first to become an inviter)
Enter the code on the WorldRemit signup page and complete signup and KYC
Send a first transfer of £30+ to a third party (your own Wise foreign-currency account works)
Find the £10 voucher under Discounts in the app and use it on your next transfer
worldremit-uk-refer-a-friend.risk: The voucher is transfer credit, not cash, and its real value depends on how you use it: community testing found that after the second transfer, fees and FX losses left about £7; WorldRemit reserves the right to cancel rewards and even close accounts for same-address referrals, multiple accounts or sending back to the inviter.
worldremit-uk-refer-a-friend.source: WorldRemit official Refer a Friend FAQ (UK reward table) + Refer a Friend terms + referralplug's UK referral index check (2026-11-18: new customer £10 / inviter £20 / first transfer £30)

ria-uk-refer-a-friend-20.title: [UK] Ria invite: £20 off each side on a first app transfer of £50+ (plus £4 and £6 add-ons)
ria-uk-refer-a-friend-20.highlight: New customers enter the inviter's code at signup and get £20 off a first app transfer of £50+; the inviter gets £20 too. A first transfer placed before 12/31 also earns £4 and £6 add-ons on the second and third transfers, stacking with HELLORIA's fee-free first transfer
ria-uk-refer-a-friend-20.regions: [UK] Registered in the UK and ordered in the app; the add-on excludes the Philippines and covers most other countries apart from the US, Canada, Nigeria and India
ria-uk-refer-a-friend-20.content: Ria's official UK promotional terms for Refer-a-Friend: a UK existing customer generates a personal code in the app, a UK new customer enters it at signup and completes a first international transfer of £50+ in the app (arriving in full); the new customer gets £20 off, usable only on that first transfer and void if unused, and the inviter gets £20 once the friend's transfer arrives, usable on later £50+ transfers with at most 2 vouchers (£40) per transfer. There's also "UK New Customer £4 + £6": a new customer who places their first transfer between 2026-09-14 and 12-31 gets £4 extra on a second transfer of £50+ and £6 on a third (a total of £10), with the second and third placed by 2027-03-31. The same first order can use HELLORIA for no fee (valid to 2028-01-31) and still collect the £4/£6 add-ons.
ria-uk-refer-a-friend-20.conditions: New UK customers only, through the Ria app only; first transfer of £50+; the £20 only offsets the first transfer, with at most two vouchers per transfer; the £4/£6 add-ons need second and third transfers of £50+ each with the first placed before 2026-12-31, and the add-on destination list excludes the Philippines; can't be combined with other offers on the same transfer.
steps: Get the inviter's personal Ria app code
At signup choose "I have a referral code", enter it and complete KYC (a Chinese passport works, usually without proof of address)
Send a first transfer of £50+, checking the -£20 is applied on the confirmation page before paying (HELLORIA can waive the fee on the same order)
Watch for ADD4 / ADD6 on the second and third transfers of £50+
ria-uk-refer-a-friend-20.risk: The £20 first-order codes circulating in Chinese communities in mid-October were largely shut down around 10/20 and only some inviters' codes still work — if the app shows no discount, it's gone; the £20 only applies to a qualifying first transfer; multiple accounts and sending to yourself easily trigger a freeze; the add-on list excludes the Philippines, so the Maya route doesn't get £4/£6.
ria-uk-refer-a-friend-20.source: Ria official UK Promotional Terms (Refer-a-Friend, UK New Customer £4+£6, HELLORIA, Welcome Rates, captured 2026-11) + NodeSeek hands-on report 2026-10

lg-exaone-25-free-api.title: [Global] LG K-EXAONE 2.5 API open free: 750B parameters / 512K context / OpenAI compatible
lg-exaone-25-free-api.highlight: Register on the EXAONE API Platform for a key and call K-EXAONE 2.5 free: 750B total parameters, 31B active, 512K context, an OpenAI-compatible API and no card needed
lg-exaone-25-free-api.regions: [Global] The official statement covers developers, startups, enterprises and research institutions; registration is open only in some countries, and access from mainland China is limited
lg-exaone-25-free-api.value: Free API (quota unpublished, roughly $20/mo of calls)
lg-exaone-25-free-api.content: On 2026-11-09 at NVIDIA AI Day Seoul, LG AI Research announced the K-EXAONE 2.5 API is free: a technical-preview model with 750B total parameters and 31B active, up to 524,288 tokens of context (input plus max_tokens), text only, Korean and English only, with tool calling, structured output and streaming, at an OpenAI-compatible POST /v1/chat/completions with model name k-exaone_v2.5 and base URL https://api.exaone.ai/v1. Register on the EXAONE API Platform (docs.exaone.ai) and create an API key — no card needed; over-quota returns 429, the rate limits are given in x-ratelimit-* headers, and daily limits rise if you allow your data for service improvement.
lg-exaone-25-free-api.conditions: Register an EXAONE API Platform account (only some countries, and it may need the right network); the free period, quota and rate limits are all unpublished — it's free "for now"; the model doesn't support Chinese, only Korean and English; input plus output must stay under 524,288 tokens.
steps: Open docs.exaone.ai, register and verify your email
Create an API key in the console
Point any OpenAI-compatible client at https://api.exaone.ai/v1 with model k-exaone_v2.5
Send a small request to check connectivity and limits (failures are usually region or quota; check the x-ratelimit-* headers)
lg-exaone-25-free-api.risk: "Free" comes with no promise on duration or quota, there's no price page, and it can start charging or throttling at any time; Korean and English only, so it's not for Chinese content; direct access from mainland China is limited; a technical-preview model is weaker and less stable than commercial ones, so don't put it straight into production.
lg-exaone-25-free-api.source: LG AI Research official news of 2026-11-09 "K-EXAONE 2.5 API Available for Free" + official API docs (524,288 context / OpenAI compatible, rechecked 2026-11-19)

sendwave-latam-tshirt.title: [US only] Sendwave Latin America invite: 3 friends for a limited T-shirt
sendwave-latam-tshirt.highlight: Refer 3 new Brazil or Latin America customers between 10/10 and 11/28 for a commemorative T-shirt
sendwave-latam-tshirt.regions: [US only] Residents of the 50 US states (the inviter)
sendwave-latam-tshirt.content: Sendwave's "Viva LATAM" campaign: existing US users who bring in 3 eligible new customers through their in-app invite code during the campaign (each completing a first transfer at the local referral amount) get a Hispanic Heritage commemorative T-shirt.
sendwave-latam-tshirt.conditions: The inviter must be a legal resident of the 50 US states with an account in good standing; the invitee must be brand new and send a first transfer at least equal to their market's reward (about $10 for Brazil/Latin America).
steps: Open the Sendwave app and tap the gift icon for your invite code
Share the code with new users sending to Latin America
Each successful first transfer counts as one
After 3, follow the email to give your shipping details
sendwave-latam-tshirt.risk: The reward is physical, not cash, and shipping is limited to some regions; the campaign ends 11/28 23:59 Eastern, after which qualifying referrals don't count.
sendwave-latam-tshirt.source: Sendwave official campaign terms (promotion period specified)

databasemart-black-friday-vps.title: [Global] Database Mart Black Friday VPS: from $1.25/mo (up to 75% off, to 11/28)
databasemart-black-friday-vps.highlight: Black Friday from 11/15 to 11/28 Central Time: Linux VPS from $1.25/mo, 3-year terms 60–75% off, some plans lock a lifetime price, plus a 24-hour free trial
databasemart-black-friday-vps.regions: [Global] Database Mart's site (US data centres), accepting Visa/Mastercard/Amex/PayPal
databasemart-black-friday-vps.content: Database Mart's 2026 Black Friday sale runs from 15 to 28 November Central Time: VPS from $1.25/mo (Linux VPS Lite: 1 core / 1GB / 30GB / 50Mbps), Basic Linux VPS (4 cores / 8GB / 140GB) at $5.20/mo on a 3-year term, GPU VPS from $11.60/mo and dedicated servers from $48.95/mo, up to 75% off. Some plans are "locked lifetime price" (the same on renewal), and there are limited flash sales. Eligible VPS orders can request a 24-hour free trial in the order notes; the usual limit is 3 per customer.
databasemart-black-friday-vps.conditions: The discount depends on the billing term: monthly −30%, quarterly −35%, annual −40%, 2 years −55%, 3 years −60% (per plan) — longer is cheaper but must be paid up front; new orders only and paid add-ons excluded; limited stock while it lasts; 3-unit limit; the cheap tiers are tiny (1 core, 1GB), so heavier work needs a bigger plan.
steps: Open the Database Mart Black Friday page and choose a Linux or Windows VPS
Choose the billing term at checkout and confirm the discounted monthly price and the total
For a trial, request the 24-hour one in the order notes
The machine is provisioned within 1–10 minutes of payment

skrill-uk-raf-10-off-100.title: [UK] Skrill cross-border transfer: £10 off £100 (and a Mastercard if you want one)
skrill-uk-raf-10-off-100.highlight: New UK customers register through a referral link or code and, after a first cross-border transfer of £100+, both sides get £10 of transfer credit; verify KYC with a passport plus UK proof of address, pay with a UK card, and you can also open a euro-denominated Skrill Prepaid Mastercard (virtual card instantly, works with Apple/Google Pay)
skrill-uk-raf-10-off-100.regions: [UK] UK Skrill accounts (Skrill Limited, FCA-regulated) → about 39 destination countries including Germany, Italy (euro area), the US and the Philippines (the Philippines can also receive to mobile wallets); sender and recipient must be in different countries
skrill-uk-raf-10-off-100.content: Skrill Money Transfer's Refer a Friend programme; the official terms state the UK line clearly: users registered in the United Kingdom, minimum transfer GBP 100 (or the equivalent in the send currency), referral credit GBP 10 for both the inviter and the new customer. The flow: the new customer registers through the inviter's link, or enters the code under "Got a referral code?" on the first transfer page (codes are valid for 3 months from registration), completes a cross-border transfer (sender and recipient in different countries, at least £100 excluding fees and taxes, delivered successfully), and once the recipient's funds are confirmed Skrill places £10 of credit under My Account → Refer a Friend, usable on the next qualifying transfer within 3 months, up to £50 per transfer (at most 5 credits). Registration and KYC need an ID plus proof of address (a passport plus UK proof of address is enough, with 4 days to supply it before the transaction is cancelled). Payment must be a UK-issued debit or credit card or a UK bank account — Skrill balance can't be used. The same account can apply for the Skrill Prepaid Mastercard: UK and EEA residents qualify, the virtual card works as soon as it's approved, the physical card arrives within 15 working days and it's denominated in euros. A UK user's hands-on report: paying with a UK card, transfers to Germany, the US, Italy and the Philippines arrived almost instantly, all done on the website (ordering in the app doesn't get this offer).
skrill-uk-raf-10-off-100.conditions: New Skrill customers only (no Skrill account before registering, and one account per person); must register through the inviter's link or enter the code on the first transfer, completing a qualifying transfer within 3 months of registering; the first transfer must be cross-border (different countries), at least £100 excluding fees and taxes and successfully delivered; paying with the Skrill Prepaid Mastercard, wallet top-ups or withdrawals, moving money between your own accounts with your own code, or sending back to the inviter don't count; payment only by card or bank account, never Skrill balance; KYC needs passport/ID plus UK proof of address within 4 days or the transaction is cancelled; the £10 credit is valid 3 months, up to £50 per transfer, can't be withdrawn or transferred and returns if a transfer fails.
steps: Ask an existing Skrill Money Transfer user for a referral link or code (they must have sent a transfer themselves to generate one)
Register a UK Skrill account through the link, or tap "Got a referral code?" on the first transfer page and enter it
Complete KYC: passport plus UK proof of address with matching name and address
Do everything on skrill.com: choose UK → Germany/US/Italy/Philippines, at least £100, paid with a UK debit or credit card
Once the recipient's funds are confirmed, the £10 appears under My Account → Refer a Friend
Spend the credit on a second cross-border transfer of £100+ within 3 months; for the card go to Skrill Card → Apply now — the virtual card is immediate
skrill-uk-raf-10-off-100.risk: The terms contradict themselves: 3.4 says the credit applies to "the next transfer" while 3.6 and the marketing page say new customers can use it on the first, so go by the quote at checkout and plan for a second £100+ transfer; it isn't free to run — 1% card top-up plus 3.99% FX (with Skrill's own rate mark-up) makes two £100 transfers cost about £7–8, leaving roughly £5, so it's only worth it if you meant to send money anyway; "instant" and "must use the website, not the app" are user data points, and the official promise is minutes to 2 business days; the card is euro-denominated with a €10 annual fee (some users also pay a €10 issuance fee), 1.75% at ATMs and 3.99% FX, so only open it if you'll really spend; the UK proof of address must genuinely be yours, since borrowing an address is a compliance risk that can freeze the account and make the balance hard to recover; accounts with no transactions for 12 months pay a €5/mo inactivity fee; from 2027-02-01 the UK Skrill business moves from Skrill Limited to Paysafe Financial Services Limited and the terms will change with it.
skrill-uk-raf-10-off-100.source: Skrill Money Transfer Refer a Friend terms (skrill.com/en/footer/terms-conditions/skrill-money-transfer-raf/: UK row GBP 100 → GBP 10; when the page refused crawling, cross-checked against the same page's 2027-02-01 version and the terms PDF, 2026-11-19) + Skrill official transfer-money FAQ (new customers get "£10 off their first transfer", KYC needs ID plus proof of address within 4 days) + Skrill Prepaid Mastercard page and terms (UK/EEA residents only, €10 annual fee, €10 issuance fee for some users, virtual card immediate) + Skrill UK fee notes of 2026-11-03 (1% card top-up, 3.99% FX, 1.75% withdrawal) + a UK user's hands-on data point (UK card payment, instant to Germany/US/Italy/Philippines, all on the website)
