It brings Handoff, its own cloud computer — a real browser, file system and terminal, up to six browsers at once — that signs into sites, places orders, fills forms, runs your email and calendar and builds mini apps for you.
hark-pro-free-agent.regions: [US/UK/EU] Listed free with no invite code in the US, the UK and all 27 EU countries (App Store); Memory is not available in the EEA, the UK or Switzerland; elsewhere, check whether the site and app stores offer it.
hark-pro-free-agent.content: Hark is the personal AI agent Hark Labs, founded by Brett Adcock, launched on 2026-10-06, positioned as an operating system for your life: everything happens in one long-running chat, with topic threads called Projects and a customisable Home. At its centre is Handoff — every request spins up a dedicated virtual computer with its own browser, file system and terminal, which signs into millions of sites like a person, places orders, cancels subscriptions, fills forms, files expenses, books tables and makes slides. Hark says it can juggle six browsers at once; outside the browser it connects to Google Workspace and Microsoft 365 by API and can read files, query external databases and use MCP. Memory keeps your preferences and context, and Action Buttons (pay a bill or cancel in one tap), Panels (mini apps built from a sentence), Scheduled Tasks and Specialties (multi-step routines it memorises) do the rest. Pricing: the full Hark Pro feature set is free forever with no ads, limited only by a base usage cap whose size Hark has not published; Pro² at $20/mo gives 2x the usage and Pro³ at $100/mo gives 10x, with the same features in every plan. The US App Store also lists Pro⁴ ($259.99, 10x Pro², launched 2026-11-11), and its in-app prices run above the website's. Passwords and cards sit in Secured by Hark, an encrypted vault Hark itself cannot see inside, and it checks with you before payments or orders; Hark says it never sells your data or shares it with advertisers.
hark-pro-free-agent.conditions: The free plan needs no invite code and no card; a card is needed only to upgrade to Pro² / Pro³ or switch on auto top-up, which then charges automatically within the amount and ceiling you set. Memory is unavailable in the EEA, the UK and Switzerland. The free plan has a base usage cap whose size, cost rules and reset are not published; when you hit it you need a higher tier or a top-up to continue. Signing in, paying and ordering require your authorisation and confirmation in Hark, and Handoff relies on the accounts you connect (Gmail, Google Calendar, Microsoft 365 and so on).
steps: Sign up at hark.com, or install the app from the App Store, Google Play or hark.com/mac (no card needed for the free plan)
Connect Gmail, Google Calendar, Microsoft 365 and other accounts in settings so it can read mail and see your calendar
Ask for what you need in Chat, e.g. "Book a table for two at 7 PM Friday and check parking nearby"; anything that needs the web goes to the Handoff cloud computer
Before paying, ordering or cancelling, check the confirmation card (what it will do and what it costs) and approve it
Need more usage: upgrade to Pro² ($20/mo, 2x) or Pro³ ($100/mo, 10x); the free plan keeps working without an upgrade
hark-pro-free-agent.risk: Hark has not published the free plan's usage cap, how usage is consumed, or when it resets, so "free forever" only promises that no feature is paywalled — heavy use may hit the cap quickly (marked unverified). The ≈$10/mo in the value line is an estimate derived from Pro² at $20 for 2x the usage, not an official price. Once a card is bound or auto top-up is on, it charges when credits run low — stay unbound if you only want the free tier. The EEA, the UK and Switzerland get no Memory, so the experience differs from the US. The agent makes mistakes: check the confirmation card and the result before paying, ordering or cancelling, keep passwords and card numbers in Secured by Hark and never type them into the chat. The US App Store also has Pro⁴, and its in-app prices ($26 / $129.99 / $259.99) are higher than the website's, which is the reference.
hark-pro-free-agent.source: Hark official: pricing page hark.com/pricing (Free to use, Pro² $20 / Pro³ $100), Using Hark Pro at hark.com/using-hark (what Handoff is, platforms iOS/Android/web, Pro² 2x / Pro³ 10x), launch post "Introducing Hark Pro" 2026-10-06 (all features always free), engineering post "Introducing Hark Handoff" 2026-08-05 (dedicated virtual computer with browser, file system and terminal; six browsers; logs in for you), privacy policy 2026-11-05 (no Memory in the EEA, UK or Switzerland); availability: Personal Agent Atlas 2026-11-01 and App Store lookups (US/UK/DE/FR); checked 2026-11-19.

sesame-voice-ai-free.title: [Multi-region] Sesame: lifelike voice AI with 30 free minutes a day, and phone control for Claude Code
sesame-voice-ai-free.highlight: Sesame's Maya, Miles and other characters are known for unusually lifelike real-time voices: the free plan gives 30 minutes of calls a day plus limited weekly credits, straight from iOS or Android. Sesame Link also lets one phone call walk you through your Claude Code and Codex sessions — hear each one's status, focus on a session and talk to it live, approve permissions, start new work.
sesame-voice-ai-free.regions: [Multi-region] The app is listed in 98 countries and regions, including the US, the UK, all 27 EU countries, Japan, Korea, Taiwan, Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, Vietnam, Indonesia, the Philippines, Canada, Mexico, Australia and much of the Middle East; not mainland China, Hong Kong or India, where only the web Research Preview works (also 30 minutes a day). Only English is officially supported.
sesame-voice-ai-free.content: Sesame (Sesame AI, Inc., from the co-founders of Oculus) builds voice-first personal AI. Its site lists four characters — Maya, Miles, Simone and Charlie — you call or text in the iOS and Android app, and when signed in each remembers its past conversations with you. The free plan is $0: 30 minutes of talk time a day (resets daily) and limited weekly credits for texts, tasks and higher intelligence (resets weekly), with the same features on every plan. When the allowance runs out you can keep texting, but intelligence drops and some capabilities are restricted. Plus is $20/mo for 2 hours a day (4x) and 4x the weekly credits; Pro is $100/mo for 10 hours a day (20x); add-ons are 1 hour of talk time for $5 or 5 hours for $20, and 1,000 credits for $5 or 5,000 for $20 (one-time purchases never expire and are used after the plan allowance). Plus has a free 7-day trial, and subscriptions are managed through the App Store or Google Play. Sesame Link (link.sesame.com) puts the coding agents in your terminal on your phone: install a CLI on the computer running Claude Code, Codex, Pi, Cursor, Hermes or OpenCode and sign in with the same Sesame account, then use the browser web client or simply call your Sesame character to ask "What are my sessions doing?" and hear each session's status, say "Focus on …" to talk to Claude or Codex live, approve or deny permission requests by voice, and start or end sessions. The code, tools and accounts stay on your own computer; Link only relays through Sesame's cloud.
sesame-voice-ai-free.conditions: No card is needed for the free plan. Talk time resets daily and credits weekly; calls use talk time and anything the agent goes and does uses credits, while Max intelligence uses both. When the allowance is gone you can still text, with lower intelligence and some restrictions. Sesame Link needs a Sesame account plus the CLI installed on a computer with the coding agent installed and signed in (Claude Code also needs tmux 3.4+; the desktop apps don't count), and runs on macOS and x86-64 Linux (preview) only. Claude Code is fully supported; Codex, Pi and Cursor are previews; Hermes and OpenCode are experimental. Where the app isn't listed you can only use the web Research Preview, which does less than the app. Sesame officially supports English, with early, less reliable support for Chinese, French, German, Spanish, Italian, Japanese and Korean.
steps: Install "Sesame: Personal Agents" from the App Store or Google Play (or use the web app at app.sesame.com where it isn't listed) and sign up
Pick a character (Maya, Miles, Simone or Charlie) and call or text; the free plan gives 30 minutes a day and limited weekly credits
To steer coding agents: on the Mac or Linux machine running Claude Code or Codex, run the curl install script, then sesame-link auth login and pick the default folder
Add Sesame Link to the character in the Sesame app, then call and say "What are my sessions doing?" or "Focus on …"; you can also use the web client at link.sesame.com
Out of allowance: upgrade to Plus or Pro or buy a top-up in the app's Plan screen, or wait for the daily or weekly reset
sesame-voice-ai-free.risk: Sesame hasn't published the size of the free plan's weekly credits, so how fast task use burns through them is unknown (marked unverified). The ≈$5/mo in the value line is an estimate derived from Plus at $20 for 4x the free talk time, not an official price. Sesame Link has no separate pricing page and Sesame doesn't say whether Link itself costs extra; voice control draws on Sesame's talk time and credits (marked unverified). The app isn't listed in mainland China, Hong Kong or India, where only the more limited web version works. Coding agents run on your own computer, and long plans, file contents and most MCP arguments can't be read aloud in full — confirm those in the web client or terminal. Paid plans are in-app purchases managed by the App Store or Google Play; cancel there, and don't forget after the trial.
sesame-voice-ai-free.source: Sesame official: plans page sesame.com/plans (Free $0 = 30 min/day + limited weekly credits, Plus $20 4x, Pro $100 20x, top-up prices, Plus 7-day trial), help page sesame.com/journal/getting-started (list of 98 countries, language support), Sesame Link site link.sesame.com and docs at link.sesame.com/docs (Claude Code / Codex / Pi / Cursor / Hermes / OpenCode, macOS/Linux, voice control and approvals), changelog v0.1.44 (2026-11-17); checked 2026-11-19.

call-e-free-credits.title: [US/CA] CALL-E: your AI assistant dials real phone calls (100 free credits for new users)
call-e-free-credits.highlight: Hand the "I'll have to call them" errands to ChatGPT / Claude / Muse / Claude Code: it plans the call, you confirm, it dials a real US or Canadian number, gets through phone menus and hold, then brings back a summary, the transcript and a structured result.
call-e-free-credits.regions: [US/CA] Calls go to real US and Canadian numbers; about 20 more countries are reachable on international numbers (the docs say mainly for development and testing). Sign-up availability by country is not published — check the official site.
call-e-free-credits.content: CALL-E is a phone-call agent from AI Rudder (Singapore), launched in November 2026. It only makes outbound calls. Install the official calle skill in the AI assistant you already use (ChatGPT, Claude, Muse, OpenClaw, Hermes) or in a coding agent (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor), or call it through MCP, the TypeScript and Python SDKs, the REST API or WhatsApp. Say what you need and it plans the call — who to call, when, in which language, and what counts as done. It asks for anything missing, shows you the plan, and only dials after you confirm. During the call it handles live pickup, voicemail, hold, transfers, silence and interruptions, and can navigate phone menus (IVR) with keypad input. Afterwards you get a summary, the full transcript and structured data validated against a schema you define, with quoted lines as evidence and a completion-confidence label. Calls can be scheduled or sent as a batch. Typical errands: booking a table, moving an appointment, calling around for a quote, checking stock, cancelling, reaching a human in support. New accounts get 100 credits (the site says about US$1); credits are a usage allowance, not a fixed number of calls or minutes.
call-e-free-credits.conditions: 100 credits once per new account. Billed per second: a US/CA outbound call in Goal mode is about $0.0148/10s model fee plus $0.02/min carrier fee (about $0.06 for 30 seconds); a one-shot call is about $0.0296/10s plus $0.04/min (about $0.13 for 30 seconds). Preparation can consume model credits even if the call never connects. Outbound only — it does not answer or screen incoming calls. International numbers outside the US/CA are mainly for development and testing; other destinations need your own SIP trunk.
steps: Install the official calle skill in an MCP-capable assistant or coding agent (or use the API/SDK) and sign in — a CALL-E account with 100 credits is created automatically
Ask in your own words: "Book a table for two at 7 PM Friday at Bella's Bistro and ask about parking"
It fills the gaps (who to call, the name for the booking, what counts as done) and shows you the call plan
Confirm, and it dials, presses through the phone menu and waits on hold; you can take over or add instructions mid-call
Read the summary, transcript and structured result afterwards; schedule or batch calls when you need many
call-e-free-credits.risk: 100 credits buy only a few trial calls — a real test needs a top-up. Billing combines model and carrier fees, and planning can burn credits even when no call happens. The AI tells the person on the line it is an assistant, and some businesses refuse such calls. Before letting it book, cancel or pay, read the call plan it shows you. Whether you can sign up from mainland China and similar regions is not documented — check the site or login page.
call-e-free-credits.source: CALL-E official site FAQ and llms.txt (checked 2026-11-19) plus the Product Hunt launch page (No. 3 on the 2026-11-11 daily leaderboard)

dusk-bot-free.title: [Global] dusk bot: a free open-source Grok Bot alternative that runs a crew of AI helpers on the ChatGPT / Claude plan you already pay for
dusk-bot-free.highlight: Each bot gets its own computer (browser and desktop), an editable memory and schedules, and several bots can hand work to each other in one thread. Free for personal use, no card and no new account — sign in with the ChatGPT / Claude / Gemini / Grok plan you already have.
dusk-bot-free.regions: [Global] Desktop app on your own computer (or your own server); needs an existing ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, Cursor, Copilot or DeepSeek plan, or your own API key
dusk-bot-free.value: Free (every app feature of the $20/mo Plus plan)
dusk-bot-free.content: dusk bot is a desktop app that puts a crew of AI helpers on your own computer (launched on Product Hunt 2026-11-18, described there as 100% free and open source). It does not sell models: you connect the ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, Cursor, Copilot or DeepSeek plan you already pay for, or your own API key, and each bot gets one job, one chat window and a memory you can read and edit. Bots sign in to sites and click through them on their own computer — a browser plus a desktop — which you can watch live and take the mouse back from at any time. Start with one bot and hire more as the work grows; several bots can sit in one group thread and hand work to each other, asking you before risky steps. Say a recurring job once and it becomes a routine (summarise the inbox at 8 every weekday, compare competitor prices on Mondays) that runs on a schedule or when something happens, even while you sleep. Official pricing: Free is $0 forever with every app feature, running on your own computer, no card, no account and no trial timer, but stops when the computer sleeps and has no work licence; Plus $20/mo moves bots to dusk cloud (2 vCPU, 4 GB RAM, 20 GB disk, always available); Pro $50/mo adds a bigger machine and a work licence for one person; Team $119/mo for 2 seats.
dusk-bot-free.conditions: Free is for personal use only and must run on your own computer or server (bots stop when it sleeps). Any business use needs a work licence (Pro includes one, or add one for $12/mo). Model usage still comes out of your own ChatGPT/Claude subscription, so those limits still apply.
steps: Download the desktop app from dusk.bot/download (Mac or Windows); the free plan needs no sign-up and no card
Sign in with your existing ChatGPT / Claude / Gemini / Grok account, or paste your own API key
Name the first bot and give it one job (researcher, inbox helper, code reviewer, bookkeeper, travel planner)
Describe the work in chat and watch it operate on its own computer; press "take the mouse" whenever you want control
Turn repeats into routines ("summarise my inbox every weekday at 8") and move to the $20/mo Plus cloud when you need it running with the lid shut
dusk-bot-free.risk: The free plan runs on your machine, so it stops when the computer sleeps — don't rely on it for anything time-critical. Model quota comes from your existing subscriptions and several bots burn it faster. Business or work use requires a paid licence. Product Hunt describes it as 100% free and open source, but the pricing page does not link the repository, so the open-source claim is unverified. Bots log in to sites and click for you — start with low-risk tasks and watch the first runs.
dusk-bot-free.source: dusk bot official site and pricing page (checked 2026-11-19) plus the Product Hunt launch page (2026-11-18)

scalekit-agentkit-free-tier.title: [Global] Scalekit AgentKit: an MCP gateway with a free tier of 10,000 tool calls a month
scalekit-agentkit-free-tier.highlight: One MCP gateway across 1,100+ connectors and 55,000+ tools (Salesforce, GitHub, Slack, Google Drive…), with every action run as the user who asked, inside the scopes they granted. The free tier includes 10,000 tool calls and 10,000 trigger events a month.
scalekit-agentkit-free-tier.regions: [Global] Developer and team SaaS accounts; the Free tier costs nothing, Growth is $99/mo (EU data residency is a paid add-on)
scalekit-agentkit-free-tier.content: Scalekit's AgentKit is an MCP gateway for agents headed to production (No. 6 on the Product Hunt November 2026 monthly leaderboard). It puts 1,100+ connectors and 55,000+ tools — Salesforce, GitHub, Slack, Google Drive and more — behind one gateway and handles the OAuth and integrations, so every action runs as the user who asked, within the scopes that user granted. Virtual MCP Servers give each agent only the tools its job needs; custom connectors add internal APIs; Triggers start an agent the moment an email lands; every call is logged. The official pricing page lists Free at $0/month: 10,000 tool calls, 10,000 trigger events, unlimited connected accounts, 1,100+ connectors and 55,000+ tools, bring-your-own credentials, community and email support. Growth is $99/month with 100,000 tool calls plus $0.50 per 1K after that, and 50,000 trigger events plus $3 per 1K.
scalekit-agentkit-free-tier.conditions: The free tier expects you to bring your own OAuth credentials for each service; Scalekit does not apply for them for you. Allowances reset monthly. Past the free allowance you move to Growth ($99/mo) or pay per use. SSO, SCIM, BYOK, HIPAA BAA and VPC/on-prem are Enterprise only.
steps: Sign up at scalekit.com and create an environment
Pick the connectors you need in the dashboard (GitHub, Slack, Google Drive…) and enter your own OAuth credentials
Create a Virtual MCP Server carrying only the tools this agent needs and copy its MCP address
Add the address to Claude, Cursor or your own agent and complete one authorised call end to end
Watch the 10,000-calls-a-month free allowance on the usage page before deciding to upgrade
scalekit-agentkit-free-tier.risk: The official page contradicts itself: the Free card says 10,000 tool calls a month while the comparison table below lists 5K for Free, so check your own dashboard after signing up. The free tier needs your own OAuth apps and credentials, so it is not plug-and-play. Overage is $0.50 per 1K calls, which adds up quickly on busy agents.
scalekit-agentkit-free-tier.source: Scalekit official pricing page (checked 2026-11-19) plus the Product Hunt November 2026 monthly leaderboard (No. 6)

nestdaddy-mcp-free.title: [Global] NestDaddy MCP: give your AI today's internet — 1,000 free credits a month, no card
nestdaddy-mcp-free.highlight: One MCP URL plugs into Claude / Claude Code / Cursor / VS Code / Windsurf / n8n and gives it live web search, breaking world news, full article text and papers, from its own index, on a flat monthly price rather than per search.
nestdaddy-mcp-free.regions: [Global] Any MCP-capable client (Claude, Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code, Windsurf, n8n and other MCP clients)
nestdaddy-mcp-free.content: NestDaddy is an MCP server built to give agents a live internet (launched on Product Hunt in November 2026). It runs its own search index instead of reselling another provider's results and exposes nine read-only tools: live web search, real-time breaking news from around the world, full article text and research papers. Get a key, then add https://mcp.nestdaddy.com/mcp as a Streamable HTTP server — in Claude via Settings → Connectors → Add custom connector, with claude mcp add in a terminal, or in Cursor, VS Code, Windsurf and n8n. After that, a question like "what happened in AI this week?" makes the agent search, read the sources and answer with links instead of guessing from a training cut-off. Pricing: free is 1,000 credits a month, no card, no time limit; paid plans start at $19/month on a flat monthly price with no per-search bills; the launch code PH50 takes 50% off any paid plan for three months until 2026-11-24.
nestdaddy-mcp-free.conditions: The free tier gives 1,000 credits a month with no card and no trial timer. Credits are consumed by calls and fetches, and pulling full articles costs more than a single search. PH50 works only on a key claimed at the official mcp page before 2026-11-24. Read-only: it searches, fetches and reads, but does not operate pages for you.
steps: Register at nestdaddy.com/mcp for a free key (1,000 credits a month, no card)
Add a custom MCP connector in your client: https://mcp.nestdaddy.com/mcp?key=YOUR_KEY (or an Authorization: Bearer YOUR_KEY header)
Ask directly, e.g. "what new free APIs launched in the AI news today?" or "what method does this paper use?"
If you want a paid plan, use PH50 before 11/24 for 50% off three months
Track credit use on the dashboard so full-article fetches do not drain the month in one sitting
nestdaddy-mcp-free.risk: 1,000 credits look generous until you pull full articles and poll news, which burn them fast. PH50 ends 2026-11-24. The site does not say whether unused free credits roll over or reset monthly. Results come from its own index, so obscure long-tail sites may be covered less thoroughly than Google.
nestdaddy-mcp-free.source: NestDaddy official MCP page (checked 2026-11-19), the Product Hunt launch post and the DEV launch write-up (PH50 until 11-24)

rankspot-1-credit.title: [Global] RankSpot: an SEO execution layer for agents — $1 of credit at sign-up, no subscription
rankspot-1-credit.highlight: Connect its MCP to Claude or ChatGPT and the agent does the work per action: write and publish an article $3, an AI-visibility check $0.004, a keyword update $0.15, an outreach email found $0.065. Sign-up gives $1, reading your data is free, top-ups start at $10 and roll over.
rankspot-1-credit.regions: [Global] Any MCP-capable agent (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, n8n); works on site data from Google and AI search results
rankspot-1-credit.value: $1 of starter credit + free data reads
rankspot-1-credit.content: RankSpot turns SEO into an execution layer billed per action (No. 2 on the Product Hunt 2026-11-17 daily leaderboard). Model usage stays on the Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or n8n plan you already pay for; RankSpot charges only for the actions it performs and shows the price before each one runs. An account is free, reading your own site data is free, and a one-time $1 welcome credit lets you try paid actions; top-ups start at $10, credit rolls over and nothing renews automatically. Published prices: an article researched, written, published and indexed is $3 (images add the AI cost +30%), an indexing request is $0.01, editing through MCP with your own AI is free; an AI-visibility check — one prompt in one AI, the answer, the brands it names and the pages it cites — is $0.004 and includes forum threads and link opportunities; a keyword update is $0.15, a backlink update $0.07, tracking a competitor is free; an outreach email found is $0.065 (nothing if not found), sending an email from your own mailbox is $0.025, connecting a mailbox and replies are free.
rankspot-1-credit.conditions: $1 is a one-time welcome credit and only useful once an agent is connected. Minimum top-up is $10. Model token costs are not included — they come from your own AI subscription. Writing, publishing and requesting indexing each trigger paid actions in sequence.
steps: Sign up at rankspot.ai (free, with the $1 welcome credit)
Connect its MCP to Claude or ChatGPT in about two minutes
Do the free work first: read your site data, add competitors, look at the link opportunities inside AI-visibility checks
Ask for a price before writing ($3 an article) and only then let it run; editing with your own AI is free
Top up from $10 when the credit runs out — it rolls over and never auto-renews
rankspot-1-credit.risk: $1 is a third of one $3 article, so a real run costs far more than the free credit. The Product Hunt copy mentions a free article with sign-up, but the pricing page lists only the $1 welcome credit — unverified. Publishing puts content on your live site and requests indexing, so test on a small scale first. Outreach sends from your own mailbox, so watch your sending-domain reputation.
rankspot-1-credit.source: RankSpot official pricing page (checked 2026-11-19) plus the Product Hunt launch page (No. 2 on the 2026-11-17 daily leaderboard)

gemini-tasks-free-jpkr.title: [JP/KR/US/CA/AU/IN] Gemini Tasks is now free: hand bookings, price checks and bill sorting to it in the background
gemini-tasks-free-jpkr.highlight: Flip the toggle in Gemini from Chat to Task and give it multi-step, recurring work: a morning brief across Gmail and Calendar, a trip itinerary, long-running research — it runs in the background and tells you when it's done. Free in Japan, Korea, the US, Canada, Australia and India since 2026-11-17.
gemini-tasks-free-jpkr.regions: [JP/KR/US/CA/AU/IN] Free in six markets (free tier runs Gemini 4 Hydrogen; AI Pro and Ultra run Gemini 4 Neon). Phoning businesses, Google Pay checkout and sending tasks by text or email are US-only for now (English, 18+).
gemini-tasks-free-jpkr.value: Free (previously an AI Pro feature at $19.99/mo)
gemini-tasks-free-jpkr.content: On 2026-11-17 Google renamed the Gemini Spark personal agent to Tasks in Gemini and made it free for hundreds of millions of users in the US, Japan, Korea, Canada, Australia and India — previously it required Google AI Pro or Ultra. Open the Gemini app, flip the input toggle from Chat to Task and describe the job in plain language: Gemini works across Gmail, Calendar and 60+ connected apps to run multi-step tasks (a morning brief of what matters, a trip itinerary, recurring research, tracking subscription perks), supports recurring schedules, and notifies you when results are ready; you can jump in with more instructions while it works. Each task runs in a hardware-isolated virtual machine dedicated to your account on Google Cloud's Agent Compute Engine, with prompt-injection filters and Safe Browsing limiting the links it may open, and it is designed to ask for confirmation before critical steps such as clicking Buy (you can set routine steps to "Always allow"). US-first extras: calling businesses to check quotes, stock or appointments; watching for restocks and checking out with Google Pay under a price cap you set; starting tasks by forwarding mail to gemini@google.com or texting Gemini.
gemini-tasks-free-jpkr.conditions: Needs an 18+ user, a personal Google account and Web & App Activity history turned on. Works in the Gemini app on iOS, Android and Mac and on the web. In Japan and Korea only the task-running part is live; phone calls, Google Pay checkout and text/email task entry are US-only. Tasks can still fail or miss the mark.
steps: Update the Gemini app (iOS / Android / Mac or web) and confirm you're signed in with a personal Google account, 18+, with history on
Flip the toggle above the input box from Chat to Task
Describe the job: "Every morning at 7, list the three things in my mail and calendar that can't slip" or "Plan next week's Osaka trip with transport and restaurants"
Let it run in the background and open the task to watch progress or add instructions; it pauses to ask before important steps
Check the result when it notifies you, then turn recurring jobs into scheduled tasks
gemini-tasks-free-jpkr.risk: In Japan and Korea only the task-running core is open — phone calls, Google Pay orders and text/email task entry stay US-only, so don't expect the US demo. Tasks read your mail, calendar and connected apps, so start with small jobs before granting anything that spends money. Gemini still fails and misreads instructions; confirm before it buys or books. It requires activity history, which leaves a record.
gemini-tasks-free-jpkr.source: Google official blog "Put Gemini to work for you" (2026-11-17) plus the Gemini app release notes and Japanese launch coverage (checked 2026-11-19)

iijmio-gigaplan-half-price.title: [JP] IIJmio Giga Plan half-price campaign: voice SIM or eSIM at half the monthly fee for 3 months (from ¥475)
iijmio-gigaplan-half-price.highlight: On a 5/10/15/25/35 GB voice SIM or voice eSIM the monthly fee drops by ¥475/700/800/1,000/1,200 for months 1–3; the 15 GB plan also gets 5 GB extra for 3 months, and stacked with the call-option discount that is 20 GB with unlimited 5-minute calls for about ¥800 a month.
iijmio-gigaplan-half-price.regions: [JP] Japan, ordered on the official IIJmio site (iijmio.jp) as a new line or MNP transfer; voice eSIM qualifies; orders through BIC SIM or JAL Mobile do not
iijmio-gigaplan-half-price.content: IIJ started the IIJmio Giga Plan half-price campaign on 2026-11-05 with no announced end date. It applies to the voice SIM and voice eSIM versions of the Giga Plan at 5, 10, 15, 25 and 35 GB, whether you are a new customer, transferring in with MNP, or moving from an old plan (Minimum Start, Light Start, Family Share, metered). For months 1–3 from activation the monthly fee is cut by ¥475 (5 GB), ¥700 (10 GB), ¥800 (15 GB), ¥1,000 (25 GB) or ¥1,200 (35 GB), tax included. Choosing 15 GB also adds 5 GB for up to three months, so you use 20 GB. The simultaneous call-option discount campaign makes the flat-rate call option (5-minute+, 10-minute+ and unlimited tiers) free for up to three months, so 15 GB (20 GB) plus the 20 GB unlimited-call bundle comes to about ¥800 a month (¥700 with the family discount). The first month is prorated by days, and the discount never exceeds that month's bill or rolls over.
iijmio-gigaplan-half-price.conditions: Order a 5/10/15/25/35 GB voice SIM or voice eSIM during the campaign and activate it. Keep the same data tier until the benefit ends: changing capacity, switching to a data/SMS-only SIM or cancelling ends the discount (switching between a physical SIM and eSIM keeps it). Taking this campaign on 25 GB disqualifies the separate 25 GB trial discount. Not valid through BIC SIM or JAL Mobile, and not for capacity changes by existing Giga Plan customers. In a prorated first month the discount is capped at the amount billed.
steps: On iijmio.jp pick the Giga Plan, choose voice eSIM or voice SIM, and a 5/10/15/25/35 GB tier
Order as a new line or MNP transfer (or switch from an old plan in My IIJmio) and finish identity verification and payment setup
Activate the eSIM profile; the discount starts automatically from the activation month, with no separate application
Add the flat-rate call option (Tsūwa Teigaku) while the campaign runs to get up to three months of it free
Keep the same tier through month three; after that the normal fees apply (5 GB ¥950 / 10 GB ¥1,400 / 15 GB ¥1,600 / 25 GB ¥2,000 / 35 GB ¥2,400)
iijmio-gigaplan-half-price.risk: You need a Japanese address, Japanese payment method and identity verification, so it is effectively closed to overseas users. The end date is unannounced and can come at any time. Only three months are discounted — from month four you pay full price, so work out the long-run cost. Changing capacity or SIM type voids the discount, and a prorated first month can make the discount look smaller than advertised.
iijmio-gigaplan-half-price.source: IIJ official announcement of the IIJmio Giga Plan half-price campaign (2026-11-05, iijmio.jp/info/iij/1793256547.html) and the official IIJmio Q&A (updated 2026-11-10)

ymobile-yahoo-store-benefits.title: [JP] Y!mobile via the Yahoo! store: up to ¥15,000 PayPay for switching carriers, Black Friday waives the setup fee (eSIM works)
ymobile-yahoo-store-benefits.highlight: Black Friday add-on (11/20–12/1 14:59): the online store waives the activation fee for new and switching lines; a SIM-only line (eSIM included) switching from another carrier earns ¥15,000 in PayPay on Simple 3 S, M and L (Simple 3 S is normally excluded), and an existing customer's second line on M/L rises from ¥5,000 to ¥15,000; on top, a Yahoo-only coupon returns up to 20% (capped at ¥6,000 for M/L).
ymobile-yahoo-store-benefits.regions: [JP] Japan; needs a Yahoo! JAPAN ID, and the Y!mobile service must be registered on that same ID. Switching from SoftBank, LINEMO or a SoftBank-network MVNO does not count as another carrier.
ymobile-yahoo-store-benefits.content:
These are SoftBank's Y!mobile sign-up benefits at the official Y!mobile online store on Yahoo! Shopping, with no announced end date. Two layers. First, the SIM contract benefit: order a SIM-only line (physical SIM or eSIM) from this page and join the Data Boost option (¥550/month, free for the first six months from the month after joining) and you get PayPay points worth ¥15,000 for switching from another carrier onto Simple 3 M or L, or ¥5,000 on Simple 3 S; a new M/L line gets ¥5,000, and ages 5–18 get ¥10,000 (new S lines are excluded). Points go to the Yahoo! JAPAN ID used for the service registration, at the end of the month after next. Second, the Yahoo-only coupon: claim it before ordering, and the fourth month after ordering, Yahoo! Shopping purchases get up to 20% back, capped at ¥6,000 for Simple 3 M/L and ¥500 for S.

On 2026-11-20 SoftBank started a BLACK FRIDAY SALE at the Y!mobile online store, running to 12/1 14:59. Three additions: the activation fee (normally ¥3,850) is waived for new lines and carrier switches ordered online, excluding device upgrades; for SIM/eSIM-only lines on Simple 3 S/M/L with the Data Boost option (¥550/month), switching from another carrier pays ¥15,000 in PayPay points — and Simple 3 S, normally outside the benefit, is included this time, while an existing customer's second line on M/L rises from ¥5,000 to ¥15,000; and buying a device in one payment with Simple 3 M/L puts the OPPO A5 5G or a certified refurbished iPhone SE (3rd gen) at ¥1, with a certified refurbished iPhone 14 128GB at ¥23,040. Switching from SoftBank, LINEMO or a SoftBank-network MVNO still does not count.
ymobile-yahoo-store-benefits.conditions: You must order from this page and add the Data Boost option (¥550/month) at the time of ordering — without it none of the SIM contract points are paid. SIM-only contracts must complete Y!mobile service registration by the end of the month after ordering. One line per name. Switching from SoftBank, LINEMO or a SoftBank-network MVNO is excluded. PayPay points cannot be withdrawn or transferred and need the Yahoo! JAPAN ID linked to a PayPay account. The coupon must be claimed before ordering and only applies to that fourth month's Yahoo! Shopping spend. The Black Friday tier (11/20–12/1 14:59) also requires ordering online, since stores do not qualify, and the fee waiver excludes device upgrades for existing customers; the ¥15,000 for a SIM/eSIM-only line still needs the Data Boost option, and the second-line top-up is limited to Simple 3 M/L in the existing customer's own name.
steps: Claim the Yahoo-only coupon on this page first — claiming after ordering does not count
Choose Simple 3 S / M / L, pick eSIM or a physical SIM, and tick the Data Boost option when ordering
Complete Y!mobile service registration with your Yahoo! JAPAN ID by the end of the following month
Keep the line; the PayPay points arrive at the end of the month after next; use the 20% coupon in month four
After six months the Data Boost option starts charging ¥550/month — cancel it once the points are paid if you don't need it
ymobile-yahoo-store-benefits.risk: Without the ¥550/month Data Boost option you get none of the points, and it is only free for six months. Lines activated on or after 2026-07-01 pay an ¥858 cancellation fee if cancelled within a year. The coupon must be claimed before ordering and only counts on month-four shopping, which is easy to forget. Points go to the Yahoo! JAPAN ID, so a wrong ID loses them. The end date is unannounced. The waived activation fee lasts only to 12/1 14:59 and then returns to ¥3,850; the SIM-only points are still tied to the ¥550/month Data Boost option and the Y!mobile registration, so don't skip either while racing the deadline.
ymobile-yahoo-store-benefits.source: Y!mobile official Yahoo! store pages and terms for the SIM contract benefit and the Yahoo-only coupon (checked 2026-11-19)

wooriwon-mobile-black-friday.title: [KR] Woori WON Mobile Black Friday: 11 plans at an effective ₩0 — six months of 꿀머니, ₩50,000 Naver Pay, free eSIM activation
wooriwon-mobile-black-friday.highlight: The Woori Bank MVNO pays six months of 꿀머니 (₩10,500–29,500 a month, 1꿀 = ₩1) plus a ₩5,000 membership coupon each month on nine plans, once you activate and enter the event page; three value plans add ₩50,000 of Naver Pay, the youth plans add a chicken coupon, and the ₩2,750 eSIM fee is refunded.
wooriwon-mobile-black-friday.regions: [KR] South Korea (Korean identity verification and payment method; foreigners need an Alien Registration Card); new numbers or number porting; 19 and over
wooriwon-mobile-black-friday.content: Woori Bank's MVNO brand Woori WON Mobile runs a Black Friday event from 2026-11-01 to 11-30. It covers nine plans — Youth Dream 5G 125GB+, LTE 71GB+, 5G 50GB+, 100GB+, LTE 15GB+, Membership Data Up LTE 17GB+ and 10GB+, Double Coupon LTE 71GB+ and 15GB+ (WON Celeb and Samsung Wallet Money plans have their own pages). Activate one during the event and enter on the event page, and for six months you receive 꿀머니, the Woori Financial Group point where 1꿀 = ₩1, ranging from ₩10,500 to ₩29,500 a month depending on the plan, plus a ₩5,000 membership coupon each month that you claim yourself on the membership page. New customers also get: ₩50,000 of Naver Pay on the 500MB/50-minute, Membership Data Up 10GB+ and 17GB+ plans; a bhc fried-chicken set coupon on the six Youth Dream plans; a free USIM, with the ₩2,750 eSIM download fee refunded as a bill discount; and ₩10,000 of 꿀머니 to both sides for a friend referral. Woori describes the combined points and coupons as an effective ₩0 phone bill — the invoice is still charged at the normal price.
wooriwon-mobile-black-friday.conditions: 19 or older; activate during the event (new line or port-in) and complete the entry on the event page; keep the line active on the same plan with no suspension or name change, and keep marketing and SMS consent. 꿀머니 is paid at the end of each month for six months starting January 2027, and you must be a Woori WON Members member. One line per person. Naver Pay of ₩30,000 (general plans) or ₩50,000 (500MB/50-minute, Membership Data Up 17GB+/10GB+) arrives by 2027-03-18; coupons last 60 days.
steps: Pick an event plan on the Woori WON Mobile site or in the Woori WON banking app (work out monthly fee minus 꿀머니 minus coupons first)
Choose eSIM (the ₩2,750 fee is refunded) or a free USIM and complete Korean identity verification
Enter the ★ Black Friday event on the event page and keep marketing/SMS consent on
Join Woori WON Members, claim the ₩5,000 coupon each month, and watch for 꿀머니 from January 2027
Keep the plan and line until the six months are paid out; inviting a friend earns ₩10,000 of 꿀머니 each
wooriwon-mobile-black-friday.risk: "₩0" is an effective price after points and coupons — the bill is charged at full price, so model the cash flow yourself. Cancelling, changing plan, suspending or transferring the line forfeits the remaining points and coupons. Points only work inside the Woori WON Members and Naver Pay ecosystems; they cannot be withdrawn or carried over. Foreigners need an Alien Registration Card and a Korean number. Per-plan 꿀머니 amounts come from third-party breakdowns (₩10,500–29,500); the official page only gives the range, so confirm on the activation screen.
wooriwon-mobile-black-friday.source: Woori WON Mobile official event page EVT0014805 (2026-11-01 to 11-30, checked 2026-11-19) plus Woori Bank's 2026-11-09 press release and Korean press coverage

Draw at 1, 3, 5, 7 and 9 stamps (up to five draws: ¥500 × 200, ¥10 × 20,000, ¥1 × 200,000) and finish all 10 for ¥50 PayPay, limited to the first 20,000 finishers.
yahoo-japan-agent-i-stamp-rally.regions: [JP] Japan residents with a Yahoo! JAPAN ID only; points need the Yahoo! JAPAN ID linked to a PayPay account
yahoo-japan-agent-i-stamp-rally.content: A LINE Yahoo campaign on Yahoo! Zubtoku running 2026-11-09 10:00 to 2026-12-15 23:59. Sign in with a Yahoo! JAPAN ID and work through up to ten missions, each entered by pressing the button inside the event page that takes you to the matching Agent i page (Yahoo's new AI assistant surface). Each mission earns one stamp, ten at most. At 1, 3, 5, 7 and 9 stamps you can draw once each, up to five draws per person: first prize ¥500 in PayPay points (200 winners), second ¥10 (20,000), third ¥1 (200,000). yahoo-japan-agent-i-stamp-rally.conditions: Needs a Yahoo! JAPAN ID and residence in Japan. You must enter each mission from the button inside the event page; opening the task page directly does not count. One stamp per mission, ten maximum. Draws and the completion reward must be used before the campaign ends. Points require a linked PayPay account, and unlinked points expire in 28 days. Points cannot be withdrawn or transferred.
steps: Open stamp.yahoo.co.jp/stamp/exc-agenti202611p and sign in with your Yahoo! JAPAN ID
Work through the mission list, pressing the button inside each mission to open the Agent i page, then return and check the stamp landed
Draw at 1, 3, 5, 7 and 9 stamps (up to five draws)
Finish all ten and claim the ¥50 PayPay reward — the first-20,000 cap can close it early, so do it soon
Make sure your Yahoo! JAPAN ID is linked to PayPay; unlinked points expire in 28 days
yahoo-japan-agent-i-stamp-rally.risk: The money is small: ¥50 for finishing plus ¥1–500 per draw, worth only a few yen in expectation — the real value is trying Agent i. The completion reward is capped at the first 20,000 and can close any time after 2026-11-27. Missions only count when entered from the event page buttons. Unlinked points expire in 28 days, and the ¥2,500 ceiling needs five first prizes, which will not happen.
yahoo-japan-agent-i-stamp-rally.source: Yahoo! Zubtoku official event page "AI o tanoshinde point GET! Agent i stamp rally" (checked 2026-11-19)

envato-minimax-h3-unlimited-24h.regions: [Global] Countries where Envato sign-up is open (free account only, no card needed)
envato-minimax-h3-unlimited-24h.content:
Limited Envato × MiniMax event: for 24 hours starting 8am EST on 19 November 2026, both Envato subscribers and free account holders can generate unlimited MiniMax H3 videos in Envato AI Video (the page says unlimited, subject to the Fair Use Policy). When the event starts (19 Nov 21:00 Beijing), open the Envato AI Video tool
Pick MiniMax H3 in the model dropdown, write a prompt, optionally add a reference image, and generate
Download the videos; the official licence covers personal and commercial end products

poke-devin-bots-free-credits.title: [Global] Poke × Devin Bots: pitch your idea, get a free Devin Bot + 1 month of Max ($200) + up to $10,000 in credits
poke-devin-bots-free-credits.highlight: Text Poke what you want to build and convince it how many free credits you deserve; 10,000 accounts, up to $10,000 each, plus a month of Devin Max
poke-devin-bots-free-credits.regions: [Global] Regions where Poke can be reached by iMessage/SMS and Devin can be opened (checkout says no card required; confirm in your account)
poke-devin-bots-free-credits.value: Up to $10,000 (includes 1 month of Devin Max, normally $200/mo)
poke-devin-bots-free-credits.content: Cognition launched Devin Bots on 17 November 2026: a lead agent runs several Devin sessions in parallel, each on its own cloud machine. In the same limited-time experiment you message Poke at poke.com/bots, describe the outcome you want it to own (not a single ticket) and argue for how many free credits you deserve. Cognition's Walden Yan said 10,000 accounts are available with up to $10,000 each, and participants also get one month of Devin Max ($200/month). Once you confirm, Poke sends an exclusive link; sign in to Devin and finish the Stripe checkout, no card needed.
poke-devin-bots-free-credits.conditions: Needs a phone that can receive Poke messages (iPhone Safari or Mac iMessage); the credit amount is decided by Poke per pitch, so not everyone gets a large grant; 10,000 accounts, first come first served; the offer ends 23 November 2026 at 16:00 Beijing time.
steps: Open poke.com/bots in Safari on an iPhone (or message via iMessage on a Mac)
Tell Poke the outcome you want it to own, your stack, and what you will handle yourself
Agree on an amount, confirm, and get your exclusive link
Open the link, sign in to Devin and complete the Stripe checkout (no card required) to activate the membership and credits
poke-devin-bots-free-credits.risk: Poke decides the amount, so most people will not get the maximum; this is described as a one-week experiment and can be tightened or ended at any time; Devin quotas refresh daily and weekly, so the advertised credit value is not usable all at once; a vague pitch tends to get the lowest tier.
poke-devin-bots-free-credits.source: Poke official release notes (Devin Bots, 2026-11-17) + Cognition announcement and sulat.com report (2026-11-19) + jidan.si summary

workbuddy-hy4-flash-free-nov2026.regions: [China/International] WorkBuddy (workbuddy.cn domestic, workbuddy.ai international), desktop client and account required
workbuddy-hy4-flash-free-nov2026.value: Free daily allowance (0 credits during the promo)

workbuddy-hy4-flash-free-nov2026.conditions: Download the WorkBuddy client and sign in; the free allowance only works inside the client and cannot be exported as an API key; after the daily allowance runs out you pay with credits; image/video generation is not covered.

Switch the model picker to Hy4 flash (marked limited-time free)
Chat, read documents, build slides or simple front-end code without spending credits until 23:59 Nov 30
For API access outside the client, use Tencent Cloud TokenHub or OpenCode's hy4-flash-free tier

scnet-maas-new-user-tokens.regions: [China] SCNet platform (phone sign-up plus real-name verification, brand new accounts only)
scnet-maas-new-user-tokens.content: The National Supercomputing Internet (SCNet) MaaS campaign, extended to 31 December 2026, gives users who register for the first time during the campaign a 10M-token welcome pack (officially shown as GLM-5.3-Flash with 1024K context, credited instantly, valid 30 days, one per account, while stock lasts). steps: Register and sign in at scnet.cn with a phone number (first registration during the campaign)
Open the MaaS campaign page and claim the 10M-token welcome pack
Optionally grab a ¥0.1 50M-token pack at 10:00 each day
Create an API key under Console → Model Service → API Key management (shown once)
Point your client's base_url at https://api.scnet.cn/api/llm/v1

scnet-maas-new-user-tokens.source: SCNet official MaaS campaign page and rules (ends 2026-12-31) + NodeSeek post (2026-11-14) + iGetoken review

firefox-builtin-vpn-unlimited-2027.title: [Global] Firefox built-in VPN with unlimited data, free until Jan 31, 2027
firefox-builtin-vpn-unlimited-2027.highlight: Sign in with a Mozilla account and the built-in VPN in Firefox for desktop and Android drops its 50GB monthly cap until Feb 1, 2027
firefox-builtin-vpn-unlimited-2027.regions: [Global] Regions where the built-in VPN is available (desktop and Android; iOS not yet)
firefox-builtin-vpn-unlimited-2027.content: Mozilla announced that from 10 November 2026 through 31 January 2027 the free built-in VPN in Firefox has no monthly data cap, replacing the usual 50GB. It applies automatically once you are signed in to Firefox with a Mozilla account, and the VPN panel shows unlimited usage. The built-in VPN only routes Firefox browsing traffic through an encrypted proxy to hide your IP; it does not cover other apps. The 50GB cap returns at 00:00 UTC on 1 February 2027.
firefox-builtin-vpn-unlimited-2027.conditions: Must be signed in with a Mozilla account; only in regions where the built-in VPN is available; covers Firefox traffic only, not the rest of the device; does not hide local browsing history.
steps: Update Firefox on desktop or Android
Sign in to or create a Mozilla account
Turn on the VPN icon in the toolbar (desktop) or Settings → VPN (Android)
The panel shows unlimited; you can switch among 28 locations
firefox-builtin-vpn-unlimited-2027.risk: Only Firefox traffic is protected, so downloads and other apps still use your real connection; some sites add checks or slow down behind a VPN; the 50GB cap returns automatically on 1 February 2027.
firefox-builtin-vpn-unlimited-2027.source: Mozilla official blog (2026-11-10) + Mozilla Connect staff post + Cheapies.nz and PCMag coverage

raisin-stack-welcome-bonus-1000.title: [US] Raisin STACK welcome bonus: up to $1,000 (deposit $10,000+, hold 90 days, first deposit by Nov 30)
raisin-stack-welcome-bonus-1000.highlight: Use code STACK, deposit at least $10,000 within 14 days and hold it for 90 days; tiers run from $40 to $900, plus a $10–$100 savings + CD boost
raisin-stack-welcome-bonus-1000.regions: [US] US residents (new Raisin US customers with SSN/ITIN and a US bank account)
raisin-stack-welcome-bonus-1000.content: Raisin's new-customer bonus: sign up with promo code STACK, start your first deposit by 23:59 ET on 30 November 2026, reach at least $10,000 in total deposits within 14 days and keep it for 90 days. steps: Register a Raisin US account with promo code STACK
Initiate your first deposit before 23:59 ET on 30 November
Top up to your target tier within 14 days (multiple transfers are fine)
For the boost, put $1,000+ into a second product category such as a CD
Hold for 90 days; the bonus arrives within 30 days

raisin-stack-welcome-bonus-1000.source: Raisin official STACK page and terms (ends 2026-11-30) + Motley Fool (2026-11-18) and BankingPicks checks

clearstreet-3pct-cash-match.title: [US] Clear Street 3% cash match: up to $10,000 ($5,000 minimum, funds must stay 5 years)
clearstreet-3pct-cash-match.highlight: Open and fund a brokerage account between Nov 9 and Dec 31 for a 3% match on net deposits within 14 days, up to $10,000 — but the matched money has to stay for 5 years
clearstreet-3pct-cash-match.regions: [US] US residents 18+ with a US tax ID and US street address
clearstreet-3pct-cash-match.content: Clear Street, a New York brokerage, offers new customers who open and fund an individual cash or margin account between 9 November and 31 December 2026 a 3% cash match on net deposits made in the 14 days after the first funding date, with a $5,000 minimum net deposit and a $10,000 cap; ACH, wire and ACATS transfers all count, and the match is credited in one lump sum within 30 days after the window.
