Note: a third-party report on 16 November described an older $250-for-$5,000-for-90-days version; the official page now shows the 3% match with the 5-year hold, so the official terms control.
clearstreet-3pct-cash-match.conditions: New Clear Street customers who never received a prior new-account promotion; US resident with US tax ID and address; $5,000 minimum net deposit within the 14-day window; funds kept 5 years; cannot be combined with other Clear Street promotions, though referral rewards can stack.
steps: Open a Clear Street individual brokerage account through the offer page before 31 December
Within 14 days of your first deposit, top up to your target net deposit (ACH, wire or ACATS)
The match is credited within 30 days after the window and can be used as buying power
Do not withdraw the matched funds for 5 years or you may be charged back
clearstreet-3pct-cash-match.risk: The 5-year hold is very long and ties up your money; cash under $50,000 earns 0%, so parking $5,000 for $150 of match has a real opportunity cost; early withdrawals can be clawed back; investments can lose value; terms can change.
clearstreet-3pct-cash-match.source: Clear Street official offer page and Offer Disclosure (2026-11-09 to 12-31) + US Card Forum discussion (2026-11-17) + Doctor of Credit (older $250 version delisted 11/17)

ashampoo-photo-optimizer-11-free.title: [Global] Ashampoo Photo Optimizer 11: free lifetime licence (normally $40, redeem by Nov 30)
ashampoo-photo-optimizer-11-free.highlight: Code PO11_free unlocks the full lifetime licence for one PC; a free Ashampoo account and newsletter sign-up are required
ashampoo-photo-optimizer-11-free.content: Ashampoo's November giveaway: Photo Optimizer 11, normally $40, is free from 1 to 30 November 2026 with redemption code PO11_free on the official redeem page, giving a lifetime licence for one PC. The app offers one-click auto optimisation, 45+ creative LUTs, perspective correction, manual colour temperature and tone curve tools. You need a free Ashampoo account and to subscribe to its newsletter; no card and no raffle.
ashampoo-photo-optimizer-11-free.conditions: Code PO11_free; free Ashampoo account plus newsletter sign-up; Windows 10/11 (x64, ARM); one PC, lifetime; redeem and activate before 30 November.
steps: Open the official redeem page (ashampoo.com/en-us/redeem?code=po11_free, code pre-filled)
Sign in or register a free Ashampoo account and tick the newsletter
Submit the code and confirm the full licence
Download the installer from Ashampoo's site and sign in with the same account to unlock
ashampoo-photo-optimizer-11-free.risk: You must subscribe to marketing email to claim it; Windows only; the licence is tied to one PC; the giveaway can end early; download only from the official site rather than third-party 'cracked' copies.
ashampoo-photo-optimizer-11-free.source: Ashampoo official redeem page + OzBargain / Cheapies.nz merchant posts (2026-11-14 to 11-16) + iggysoft check (2026-11-18)

uq-oyakouenwari-1100.title: [Japan] UQ mobile Parent-Child Support Discount: ¥1,100 off per month for 12 months, plus 300GB for 3 years
uq-oyakouenwari-1100.highlight: New UQ mobile lines on Komikomi Plan Value or Tokutoku Plan 2 for a household with someone aged 5–18 get ¥1,100 off monthly for a year; Komikomi also adds 300GB valid for 3 years
uq-oyakouenwari-1100.regions: [Japan] UQ mobile (requires a member aged 5–18 in the same home/family discount group)
uq-oyakouenwari-1100.content: KDDI and Okinawa Cellular began accepting applications for the UQ Parent-Child Support Discount on 19 November 2026. New UQ mobile lines on Komikomi Plan Value (¥3,828/month) or Tokutoku Plan 2 (¥4,048/month), with a member aged 5–18 in the same home-set or family-set discount group, get ¥1,100 off per month for 12 months starting the following month. Komikomi Plan Value also gets the Parent-Child Support Plan with an extra 300GB valid for three years, and the UQ Komikomi discount takes another ¥660 off for up to 13 months (from month 14 it needs an au PAY Gold Card).
uq-oyakouenwari-1100.conditions: Applications open from 19 November 2026 with no announced end date; must be a new line, MNP or plan change to an eligible plan; requires a 5–18 year old in the group; one per line; does not stack with the under-5GB discount; applications late in the month may be applied later.
steps: Confirm you have a 5–18 year old in the same home-set or family-set discount group
Order or port a UQ mobile line on Komikomi Plan Value or Tokutoku Plan 2 (SIM or eSIM)
Complete the application during the acceptance period; the ¥1,100 discount starts the next month for 12 months
For Komikomi, the 300GB arrives around the 10th of the following month and must be claimed in My UQ mobile
uq-oyakouenwari-1100.risk: You need a new line, port or plan change, which can end existing discounts; if the under-18 line leaves or the family group breaks up, the whole family's discount stops that month; the 300GB must be claimed in the app or it expires; the au PAY Gold Card costs ¥11,000 a year.
uq-oyakouenwari-1100.source: UQ mobile official campaign page and KDDI news release (announced 2026-11-18, applications from 11-19) + Yahoo! News / ITmedia coverage

bitel-peru-esim-7days-unlimited.title: [Peru] Bitel new eSIM line: 7 days of unlimited data, calls and SMS on top of 30 days of service
bitel-peru-esim-7days-unlimited.highlight: Activate a new Bitel eSIM line in the Mi Bitel app with a postpaid plan and get 7 days of unlimited local data, calls and SMS free, ahead of the normal 30-day period
bitel-peru-esim-7days-unlimited.regions: [Peru] Bitel postpaid new eSIM customers in Peru (local ID and payment method required; to be confirmed)
bitel-peru-esim-7days-unlimited.content: Bitel Peru's November eSIM promotion runs from 1 to 30 November 2026: customers who activate a new eSIM line through the Mi Bitel app with a postpaid plan get an extra 7 days of service free — unlimited local data, unlimited calls to any national operator and unlimited SMS — added on top of the plan's normal 30-day period, with no payment needed first. From day 8, the line is suspended if the plan is unpaid and resumes after payment.
bitel-peru-esim-7days-unlimited.conditions: New eSIM lines only (new customers or existing customers opening an extra line); must be done in the Mi Bitel app with a postpaid plan; once per customer, not cumulative or transferable; excludes ported lines, eSIM replacements, roaming and international calls; requires an eSIM-capable Android or iOS device.
steps: Download the Mi Bitel app and register
Choose to activate a new eSIM line and sign up for any postpaid plan
The 7 free days of unlimited local data, calls and SMS are applied automatically after activation
Pay the plan before day 8 or the line is suspended
bitel-peru-esim-7days-unlimited.risk: It is a postpaid sign-up with 7 free days, not pure free data; the line is suspended if you do not pay after day 7; only usable in Peru; the ID and payment requirements for foreign visitors are not stated officially (to be confirmed).
bitel-peru-esim-7days-unlimited.source: Bitel official promotion page and terms (valid 01/11/2026–30/11/2026)

chatgpt-pro-business-api-credits.title: [Multi-region] ChatGPT Pro / Business subscriptions now include API credits, up to $500 a month
chatgpt-pro-business-api-credits.highlight: Pro $100/$200/$500 tiers receive matching API credits monthly; Business gets $20 per Standard seat or $100 per Premium seat, capped at $500 per workspace
chatgpt-pro-business-api-credits.regions: [Multi-region] Countries and cohorts where the benefit is enabled (check whether the entry appears in your ChatGPT billing settings)
chatgpt-pro-business-api-credits.content: OpenAI's documentation: eligible paid ChatGPT Pro and Business subscriptions can claim free API credits. Pro 100/200/500 receive $100/$200/$500 of API credits per billing cycle; Business is calculated per paid seat (Standard $20, Premium $100) with a $500 monthly cap per workspace ($6,000 per annual cycle, issued upfront). Activate by linking the subscription to an API organization you own in ChatGPT Settings → Billing; credits are then granted automatically at each renewal while the benefit lasts. They cover paid API usage such as Responses, Agents, Decisions, Realtime, Images and built-in tools; Codex usage through API keys is not covered.
chatgpt-pro-business-api-credits.conditions: An active paid Pro or Business subscription at least seven days old; you must be the owner of both the subscription/workspace and the API organization, with the same email; Free, Plus, Go, free trials, Enterprise, Edu and legacy Codex seats do not qualify; credits expire at the end of each billing cycle and do not roll over; the first grant is prorated; availability depends on cohort and country.
steps: Sign in to ChatGPT with the account that owns the Pro or Business subscription
Open Settings → Billing (Pro) or the workspace billing settings (Business) and find the API credits benefit
Select the API organization to receive the credits and confirm
Check API Platform billing to see the credits, then use that organization's API keys
chatgpt-pro-business-api-credits.risk: You must pay for a $100+/month subscription first, so it is not free; unused credits vanish each cycle; the first grant may be prorated; it does not raise ChatGPT or signed-in Codex limits; accounts or countries outside the rollout will not see the option.
chatgpt-pro-business-api-credits.source: OpenAI official API docs (API credits for ChatGPT subscribers) + ChatGPT Business release notes (2026-10-28) + Korean Naver blog walkthrough (2026-10-31)

capy-free-local-agent.title: [Global] Capy: desktop coding agent with a $0 plan, 100 reviews a month and three free models
capy-free-local-agent.highlight: Runs on your own computer, plugs into the ChatGPT / Copilot / SuperGrok plan you already pay for, and the Free tier includes 100 review credits a month with unlimited members.
capy-free-local-agent.regions: [Global] The free plan runs on your own machine; bring your own ChatGPT (Codex), Copilot or SuperGrok subscription or API keys. Cloud machines and Capy-hosted models are paid.
capy-free-local-agent.content:
Capy is a desktop AI coding agent. Install the app and it opens threads on your own computer (or on its cloud machines), writes code, runs commands and reviews changes. The official pricing page puts the Free plan at $0: agents on your own computers, your own subscriptions and keys, 100 review credits a month, unlimited members and one subscription per organisation.

A review costs 1 credit at Low effort, 5 at Medium and 10 at High, so 100 credits is roughly 20 Medium reviews. Capy's launch post adds two things the pricing page does not list: Particle-1, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash and GLM 5.3 run free on any plan without a subscription, and commenting on that post gets you a month of Lite. Check the app before relying on either.

Because the free plan uses your own machine there are no machine minutes; cloud machines and Capy-hosted models are what draw on credits (Lite: 30,000 machine minutes and $20 of model usage, first week $1).
capy-free-local-agent.conditions: The free plan needs your own ChatGPT (Codex), Copilot or SuperGrok subscription or API keys. Local threads only, no cloud machine minutes. 100 review credits reset monthly and do not roll over. The three free models and the free Lite month come from the launch announcement, not the pricing page.
steps: Download the macOS / Windows / Linux app at capy.ai/download and sign in
Connect your ChatGPT (Codex), Copilot or SuperGrok subscription or API keys under Settings → Models
Pick your own computer as the machine, open a thread and hand over the task; choose Low / Medium / High when you want a review
capy-free-local-agent.risk: The free plan is local only and depends on your own model subscription, so nothing continues in the cloud. The free models and the free Lite month appear only in the launch post and can be withdrawn.
capy-free-local-agent.source: Capy official pricing page and docs.capy.ai (checked 2026-11-19) + X @okeyccronald launch post (2026-11-19)

tesseract-free-desktop-agent.title: [Global] Tesseract: a free desktop AI agent that turns one sentence into a deck, site, logo or video
tesseract-free-desktop-agent.highlight: It produces finished files rather than chat: PowerPoint, PDF, websites, brand kits, fonts and video. The app is free, and free of charge entirely if you already pay for Claude or ChatGPT.
tesseract-free-desktop-agent.regions: [Global] macOS, Windows and Linux desktop app. Free when you have a Claude, ChatGPT or similar subscription; without one it runs on a built-in free allowance.
tesseract-free-desktop-agent.value: Free app ($0 with your own AI subscription)
tesseract-free-desktop-agent.content:
Tesseract from Eightcell Labs launched on Product Hunt on 2026-11-14. It does not chat, it delivers: ask for an investor deck for a bakery and it shows a plan, does the work and hands back an editable PowerPoint or PDF. The same flow builds websites from 220+ templates and 14 themes, logos and brand kits, fonts, video, spreadsheets and sourced research reports, all saved to your computer.

Its pricing is the interesting part. There is no subscription and no credit pack; it drives the AI subscription you already have — Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, Cursor Agent, Kimi Code, Qwen Code and more — signed in with your own account. The site says that with a Claude or ChatGPT plan it costs nothing on top and never meters your usage, and it moves to the next account when one runs out. Without any AI subscription you start on a free allowance that refills, with prepaid credit from $10 for premium models.
tesseract-free-desktop-agent.conditions: Free in full only if you already hold a Claude / ChatGPT-class subscription (its own limits still apply). Without one you get the official free allowance, whose size is not published (unverified). Desktop only, no mobile app.
steps: Download the build for your OS at tesseract.dev (no credit card)
On first launch pick the agent you already use and sign in, or start on the free allowance
Pick one of the 33 guided makers or describe the job in one sentence and collect the editable files
tesseract-free-desktop-agent.risk: The free allowance size is unpublished. A desktop agent reads and writes local files, so try it in an empty folder first. Third-party agent CLIs may need their own authorisation.
tesseract-free-desktop-agent.source: Tesseract official site and launch blog (checked 2026-11-19; Product Hunt launch 2026-11-14)

pollyreach-free-credits-number.title: [Global] PollyReach: a real phone number and voice for your AI agent — 200 free credits plus a free number
pollyreach-free-credits-number.highlight: Say "book me a table for 7pm" and the agent finds the number, dials, navigates the IVR and reports back with a summary, recording and transcript. It also answers your phone 24/7.
pollyreach-free-credits-number.regions: [Global] Calls in 50+ languages; the free number is a US number and calls are billed in credits.
pollyreach-free-credits-number.content:
PollyReach gives an AI agent a real phone number and a real voice. Outbound: give it a task and it finds the number, dials, works through phone menus, holds the conversation, handles interruptions and hangs up when done, then sends you a summary, recording and transcript. Inbound: it answers 24/7, screens spam, takes messages and tags what matters.

New users start free. The Product Hunt launch post says everyone gets 200 credits plus a free phone number with no card. After the credits run out it becomes credit-based: the pricing page script lists Star at $20/month (2,000 credits, one agent, one US number), Pro at $40 (4,000 credits, two agents) and Max at $100 (10,000 credits, five agents), with annual billing around 15% off.
pollyreach-free-credits-number.conditions: The 200 free credits are a one-off; paid plans take over afterwards. The credit-to-minute conversion is not published (unverified). Daily outbound call limits apply and bulk robocalling is blocked. Complex IVR trees can still defeat it.
steps: Sign up at pollyreach.ai (no credit card) and collect the 200 credits
Claim a free number and set the agent's identity and script
Send it a task in chat, e.g. "book a table for two on Friday at 7pm", then read the summary and recording
pollyreach-free-credits-number.risk: Paid tiers are only in the page script and not fully published, so confirm charges in the app. The callee is talking to an AI and some businesses refuse. The free number is US-based, so international calls can cost the other side.
pollyreach-free-credits-number.source: PollyReach official pricing page + Product Hunt launch post (checked 2026-11-19)

instabox-free-cloud-machine.title: [Global] InstaBox free cloud computer: 4 vCPU / 8GiB with Claude Code and Codex preinstalled, no card
instabox-free-cloud-machine.highlight: One Firecracker microVM per agent, Debian 13 with a desktop and Chromium, pausing after 30 idle minutes and resuming in under a second at $0.
instabox-free-cloud-machine.regions: [Global] Machines run in the United States. The free plan allows one machine that auto-pauses after 30 idle minutes.
instabox-free-cloud-machine.content:
InstaBox gives each AI agent its own cloud Linux machine: a Firecracker microVM on Debian 13, by default 4 vCPU and 8 GiB of RAM, a 16 GiB root disk plus a 20 GiB persistent disk at /data, with Chromium, a desktop, Docker, Node.js, Python, Go, Rust and Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode already installed. Logins persist in /data/home and travel into snapshots.

The free tier is $0: one machine, five snapshots, 100 GiB egress a month, auto-pause after 30 idle minutes with state kept and no billing while paused, and runs capped at 120 minutes at first, growing to 480 with use. The pricing post says the free machine has no usage limit; it is built for bursty agent work rather than a 24/7 server.

Sign-up is GitHub or Google, and npx instabox@latest sh installs the CLI and starts a machine; the dashboard can also create one with a click and open its desktop.

Plan limits from the official Limits page (checked 21 November 2026): the free plan allows one machine and one running at a time, up to 4 vCPU and 8 GiB, a fixed 20 GiB disk, five snapshots and 100 GiB of egress a month; idle pause is fixed at 30 minutes; a run starts at 120 minutes and grows while the machine is in use up to 480 minutes; and free machines can only be created from the agent-browser, android, omarchy and ci templates.
instabox-free-cloud-machine.conditions: Free plan: 1 machine, 5 snapshots, 100 GiB egress/month, auto-pause after 30 idle minutes, 120-minute runs to start. Whether a brand-new free account needs a card is not stated (the API has a cardMissing state — unverified). US regions only.
steps: Sign in at instabox.sh with GitHub or Google and create a free machine from a template
Open the machine desktop, or connect with npx instabox@latest sh
Run Claude Code / Codex with your own model keys; let it pause when the task ends
instabox-free-cloud-machine.risk: It pauses when idle, so it is not a always-on server. GitHub, Claude and Codex logins live inside the machine and travel into snapshots. US-only nodes mean high latency from Asia.
instabox-free-cloud-machine.source: Visitor submission (Gmail 2026-11-19 19:49) + InstaBox official pricing page and docs (checked 2026-11-19)

ethena-pay-virtual-visa-4pct.title: [47 non-US countries] Ethena Pay free virtual Visa: 4% back in AVAX on the first $2,500 each month
ethena-pay-virtual-visa-4pct.highlight: Self-custody Visa Platinum issued on a Puerto Rico BIN, no account or monthly fee, free virtual card, up to $100 of AVAX cashback a month on the Standard tier.
ethena-pay-virtual-visa-4pct.regions: [47 non-US countries] Live across Latin America, the Caribbean, Asia and the Middle East, Africa and Oceania. Not available in the US or restricted jurisdictions; not in Europe yet.
ethena-pay-virtual-visa-4pct.content:
Ethena Pay is Ethena's self-custody Visa card (issued by Third National, programme managed by Rain, BIN registered in Puerto Rico). The account is free: no opening fee, no monthly fee, no minimum balance, free virtual card issuance, and it works with Apple Pay and Google Pay.

The value is the cashback. Standard tier pays 4% on the first $2,500 of card spend each month, 1% from $2,500 to $4,000 and nothing above. Pro (unlocked with 10 referrals) pays 4.5% to $8,000 and VIP (invite only) 5% to $20,000. Cashback is calculated in dollars, paid in AVAX after settlement, roughly daily, with no monthly or lifetime cap — so a Standard user tops out near $100 of AVAX a month.

The FAQ says it is live in 47 countries and open to non-US persons only. KYC accepts passports, residence permits and driving licences, with the address typed into a form and no proof of address required. It used to need an invite code; this round's submission says the whitelist is gone (unverified).
ethena-pay-virtual-visa-4pct.conditions: Non-US persons only, KYC required. Excluded spend includes cash advances, ATM withdrawals, crypto purchases, gift cards, P2P transfers, account funding, taxes and fees; transactions under $1 earn nothing; Standard earns nothing above $4,000 a month.
steps: Download the app at pay.ethena.fi and finish KYC with a passport as a resident of one of the 47 countries
Issue the free virtual Visa and add it to Apple Pay / Google Pay
Spend on the card; AVAX cashback lands a few days after each transaction settles
ethena-pay-virtual-visa-4pct.risk: Cashback is paid in AVAX, so price moves can eat the gain. Rewards are discretionary and can be cut at any time. The whitelist removal is only the submitter's word, so check before signing up. Whether mainland Chinese residency passes KYC is unverified.
ethena-pay-virtual-visa-4pct.source: Visitor submission (Gmail 2026-11-19 19:49) + Ethena Pay official pricing page and FAQ (checked 2026-11-19)

ig-uk-refer-free-share-1000.title: [UK] IG share dealing referral: a random US share worth £50-£1,000 for the friend, £100 cash for the referrer
ig-uk-refer-free-share-1000.highlight: Put in £1,000, hold it three months and submit a W-8BEN to receive a randomly allocated US share; 70% of them land at £50-£70.
ig-uk-refer-free-share-1000.regions: [UK] UK residents aged 18+, new to IG, not living at the referrer's address.
ig-uk-refer-free-share-1000.content:
IG's Share Dealing referral: the friend opens a GIA, ISA or SIPP through a unique link, makes a first investment of at least £1,000 within 30 days and keeps an average invested value of at least £1,000 for three months. They then receive one randomly allocated US-listed share worth £50-£1,000, and the referrer gets £100 cash into a GIA.

The probabilities are not even. The terms put 70% of shares at £50-£70, 20% at £70.01-£100, 7% at £100.01-£250 and the rest at £250-£1,000, so the expected value is roughly £70-£90, not the headline.

Two easy ways to lose it: the friend must submit a valid W-8BEN before the holding period ends or the share is withheld, and the reward is paid by the end of the calendar month after the three-month holding period. Referral links may only be shared privately with people you actually know.
ig-uk-refer-free-share-1000.conditions: First investment of £1,000+ within 30 days of opening; average invested value of £1,000+ for 3 months (market moves alone do not count); valid W-8BEN before the period ends; one referral per person; referrer capped at 10 active referrals a month.
steps: Open an IG Share Dealing (GIA), ISA or SIPP through the referrer's unique link
Invest at least £1,000 within 30 days and hold an average of £1,000 for 3 months
Submit the W-8BEN during the holding period; the share arrives the month after it ends
ig-uk-refer-free-share-1000.risk: 70% of shares are only worth £50-£70. The share is USD-denominated, so FX and market moves apply. £1,000 is locked for three months, which can cost more than the reward. No W-8BEN means no share.
ig-uk-refer-free-share-1000.source: IG official refer-a-friend terms and free-share probability table (checked 2026-11-19) + r/beermoneyuk discussion (the original post was removed by moderators under the posting-frequency rule and is kept only as a lead; the official terms govern)

schwab-referral-brokerage-1000.title: [US] Charles Schwab referral: $100 for a $25,000 net deposit, up to $1,000
schwab-referral-brokerage-1000.highlight: A brokerage referral rather than a checking bonus: deposit new-to-Schwab money within 45 days and the award lands about a week later.
schwab-referral-brokerage-1000.regions: [US] US residents only (including US resident aliens), excluding US territories. The account must be an eligible Schwab One brokerage account or IRA.
schwab-referral-brokerage-1000.content:
Schwab's referral award runs through brokerage accounts, not checking. A referred person opens an eligible account with an existing client's referral code and makes a qualifying net deposit within 45 days: $25,000-$49,999 earns $100, $50,000-$99,999 earns $300, $100,000-$499,999 earns $500 and $500,000 or more earns $1,000. The award is credited about a week after the 45-day window closes.

Net deposit means money new to Schwab from outside, minus anything withdrawn or transferred out; moving money between Schwab accounts does not count. In taxable accounts the net deposit (less market losses) must stay for at least a year or Schwab may claw the award back.

Do not confuse this with the Investor Checking offer of up to $1,000 that circulated on US card forums: that one required opening and funding by 2026-11-10 and holding through 2026-12-25, so it has closed, and Schwab's terms explicitly exclude Investor Checking from this referral offer.
schwab-referral-brokerage-1000.conditions: Needs a referral code from an existing Schwab client; net deposit of outside money within 45 days; keep it a year in taxable accounts; one account and one enrolment per client; cannot be combined with other offers; US residents only.
steps: Get a referral code or link from a friend who already has a Schwab account and enter it during the application
Open a Schwab One brokerage account or IRA and fund it from an outside bank within 45 days
Hold the deposit for a year in a taxable account; the award arrives about a week after day 45
schwab-referral-brokerage-1000.risk: The tiers are steep: $1,000 needs half a million dollars parked for a year, which can cost far more than the award. It must be outside money, and a US residency plus SSN/ITIN is required. Terms can be withdrawn.
schwab-referral-brokerage-1000.source: Charles Schwab official referral page and terms (checked 2026-11-19) + US card forum discussion (its Investor Checking version closed on 2026-11-10)

monzo-uk-referral-bonus.title: [UK] Monzo referral: £5-£50 each side, depending on the invite
monzo-uk-referral-bonus.highlight: Tap the link, enter your number first, open the account and make one card payment within 30 days; not every invite carries a bonus.
monzo-uk-referral-bonus.regions: [UK] UK residents aged 16+ who have never held any Monzo account, personal or business.
monzo-uk-referral-bonus.content:
Monzo's personal referral scheme: enter your phone number through an existing customer's link first, then within 30 days download the app, open a personal current account, add money and make one physical-card payment (Apple Pay and Google Pay count; ATM withdrawals, bank transfers and virtual-card payments do not). Both sides then get a bonus.

The amount is not fixed. The 4.0 personal referral terms (13 August 2026) publish £10, £20 or £50 for the first 100 referrals and £5 after that, while the 1.1 terms served from an authorised invite (29 October 2026) print no amount at all, and Monzo's help page warns that not every invite comes with an incentive. What the link and the in-app Referral hub show is what counts.

Business accounts have a separate scheme: open Monzo Business (including the free Lite plan) and make a first card payment for £50 each side, capped at three rewards a month for the referrer.
monzo-uk-referral-bonus.conditions: Open the invite link and enter your number before signing up; open the account and make one physical-card payment within 30 days; anyone who has held a Monzo account before is excluded; some invites carry no bonus.
steps: Open the friend's invite link and enter your mobile number before anything else
Within 30 days download the Monzo app, open a personal current account and top it up
Make one card payment of any amount with the Monzo card; the bonus lands straight away
monzo-uk-referral-bonus.risk: The bonus varies by invite and can be as little as £5 or nothing. Skipping the link-then-number order breaks matching. Existing Monzo customers are excluded.
monzo-uk-referral-bonus.source: Monzo official Refer a Friend page and referral terms (v4.0 / 2026-08-13, v1.1 / 2026-10-29, checked 2026-11-19) + r/beermoneyuk thread

travelgoogoo-visa-free-esim-apac.title: [APAC-issued cards] Travelgoogoo x Visa free eSIM: 4GB global + 4GB APAC and a year of unlimited messaging on Infinite
travelgoogoo-visa-free-esim-apac.highlight: Enter a 16-digit Visa card number from an Asia-Pacific issuer and get a Travelgoogoo 365 annual eSIM covering 123 countries, with messaging that does not eat data.
travelgoogoo-visa-free-esim-apac.regions: [APAC-issued cards] Visa Infinite / Signature / Platinum issued in Asia-Pacific only. Data covers 123 countries; the APAC pack covers 23.
travelgoogoo-visa-free-esim-apac.content:
A Visa perk with Travelgoogoo: enter a 16-digit card number from an eligible Asia-Pacific-issued Visa card at travelgoogoo.com/en/visa and receive a free Travelgoogoo 365 annual eSIM.

Tiers follow the card (raised from 2026-09-07): Visa Infinite gets 4GB of global data plus 4GB of APAC data and a year of unlimited messaging; Visa Signature gets 2GB global (plus an extra 1GB of APAC per some reports, check the redemption page); Visa Platinum gets 1GB global with the 365 annual plan. "Unlimited messaging" means text and photos in iMessage, WhatsApp, Telegram, LINE, WeChat, Viber and Zalo; voice and video calls still burn data.

Redemption puts a $1 authorisation on the card, later reversed. The plan runs a year from first connection, so you can redeem now and activate before a trip.
travelgoogoo-visa-free-esim-apac.conditions: Asia-Pacific-issued Visa Infinite / Signature / Platinum only; one redemption per card number and per mobile number per year, up to two in total until 2027-11-30; eSIM phone required (iPhone XS or later, flagship Androids from 2019); data-only, no local number.
steps: Open travelgoogoo.com/en/visa, tap Redeem Now and enter the 16-digit Visa number
Sign up and pass the $1 card authorisation (it is reversed)
Install the eSIM from the emailed QR code and activate it when you travel; valid for a year
travelgoogoo-visa-free-esim-apac.risk: Only APAC-issued cards qualify, so European and US cards are rejected. Signature and Platinum APAC allowances are reported inconsistently (unverified). The data is small for heavy use, and the redemption page intermittently returns 500 from mainland China.
travelgoogoo-visa-free-esim-apac.source: Travelgoogoo x Visa official redemption page + The MileLion (2026-09-13) and CardExpert hands-on (2026-04-23)

bamboosim-bfcm-45off.conditions: Enter BFCMO50 at checkout; the 50% rate needs two or more eSIMs; the free Transit eSIM is limited to past-year customers and 100 units; sale ends 2026-12-01 10:59 AEDT.

qiniu-conatus-free-100m-daily.title: [CN] Qiniu Conatus free model: 100M tokens a day after real-name verification (until Nov 30)
qiniu-conatus-free-100m-daily.highlight: A 1024 Programmer's Day promo: 100M tokens every day once you pass real-name verification, callable from the OpenAI SDK, Claude Code or Codex; when the quota runs out nothing is charged.
qiniu-conatus-free-100m-daily.regions: [CN] A Qiniu account with real-name verification; unverified accounts get no quota and cannot call the model.
qiniu-conatus-free-100m-daily.content:
Qiniu's limited-time Conatus model from its 1024 Programmer's Day event runs from 00:00 on 2026-10-24 to 23:59 on 2026-11-30 Beijing time. The model ID is `qiniu/conatus-free`; only this single fused label is exposed and it routes across several top models. A verified account gets 100M tokens a day, raised to 1B a day after any single top-up over ¥100 that has cleared (several top-ups do not add up, and buying a resource pack or subscription does not count). Usage is metered on input plus output tokens, cached input included, shared by every API key on the account, reset at 00:00 daily and not carried over.

The event is free quota only, with no pay-as-you-go: when the quota is gone requests are rejected outright, with no charge to your balance, resource pack, subscription or points, and no automatic switch to a paid model. Base URL is `https://api.qnaigc.com/v1`, compatible with both the Completions and Messages protocols, so the OpenAI SDK, Codex and Claude Code all work; 1M context, 128K max output.
qiniu-conatus-free-100m-daily.conditions: Sign in and complete real-name verification. Only a single top-up over ¥100 that has cleared raises the limit to 1B a day (earlier top-ups count, several do not add up). Accounts flagged by risk control cannot call the model. The event ends at 23:59 on 2026-11-30 and calling stops then even with quota left.
steps: Sign in to the Qiniu console and complete real-name verification
Create an API key on the models page (every key on the account shares the quota)
Point the base URL at https://api.qnaigc.com/v1, set the model to qiniu/conatus-free and call it over the OpenAI or Messages protocol
qiniu-conatus-free-100m-daily.risk: Service stops when the event ends on Nov 30 and does not move to paid; an exhausted quota is rejected; Qiniu advises against sensitive data or production use; the platform's terms govern what it does with your verification details.
qiniu-conatus-free-100m-daily.source: Qiniu Conatus Free official event page (checked 2026-11-20) + visitor submission email (2026-11-19 21:08, linking an X post)

stepfun-stepaudio3-free-preview.title: [CN/Global] StepFun StepAudio 3 voice models are free until Nov 23, 11:59 (no card)
stepfun-stepaudio3-free-preview.highlight: Realtime duplex voice, TTS with instant voice cloning, sound-effect generation, AI music and ASR all at zero cost until noon on Nov 23; no card and no prepayment.
stepfun-stepaudio3-free-preview.regions: [CN/Global] Sign up on the StepFun platform; no credit card and no prepayment. Personal accounts usually need real-name verification before using voice models.
stepfun-stepaudio3-free-preview.value: Six voice APIs at 0 (list price from ¥0.65 per session minute)
stepfun-stepaudio3-free-preview.content:
StepFun's open platform has extended the free window for its StepAudio 3 voice family to 11:59:59 Beijing time on 2026-11-23; from 12:00:00 the new prices apply and the preview builds give way to paid releases. The free `-preview` model IDs are `stepaudio-3-realtime-preview` (end-to-end duplex realtime voice with barge-in), `stepaudio-3-chat-preview` (voice understanding over Chat Completions), `stepaudio-3-gen-preview` (text to sound effects and ambience) and `stepaudio-3-music-preview` (songs and instrumentals); `stepaudio-3-tts` (emotional TTS, seconds-long cloning, text-designed voices) and `stepaudio-3-asr-max` (long-form transcription with timestamps) are described as covered too.

stepfun-stepaudio3-free-preview.conditions: Register on the platform and create an API key; personal accounts generally need real-name verification for voice models. No card, no prepayment. Billing resumes after 11:59:59 on Nov 23. Whether TTS and standalone ASR are fully inside the free window differs between sources, so check the console (unverified).
steps: Register at platform.stepfun.com, complete verification and create an API key
Call the model names carrying the -preview suffix; try voices first in the playground
Stop any scripts or background calls before 12:00 on Nov 23 so the new prices do not bite
stepfun-stepaudio3-free-preview.risk: New prices apply automatically from noon on Nov 23, so a call left running will be charged. The exact set of free models should be confirmed in the console. Verification data falls under the platform's terms.
stepfun-stepaudio3-free-preview.source: StepFun platform API pricing page (read 2026-11-20, stating StepAudio 3 free until 11:59:59 on 11-23) + extension coverage (Cyber Egg 2026-11-17, AI Promo Radar) + X daily digest (2026-11-19)

nous-portal-qwen4-max-free.title: [Global] Nous Portal: Qwen4-Max free for five days with native vision and 1M context
nous-portal-qwen4-max-free.highlight: Alibaba's Qwen4-Max is free on Nous Portal for a five-day window as qwen/qwen4-max:free, served by Inferact on vLLM.
nous-portal-qwen4-max-free.regions: [Global] Any free Nous Portal account; the free plan covers free models only, with standard rate limits and no monthly credits.
nous-portal-qwen4-max-free.value: Five days at $0 (paid route $1.43 in / $4.28 out per million tokens)
nous-portal-qwen4-max-free.content:

nous-portal-qwen4-max-free.conditions: Register a Nous Portal account (free is enough). Limits and the exact end time are unpublished; five days from the announcement lands around Nov 23 (unverified). Once the window closes or quota runs out, the paid route applies.
steps: Register and sign in at portal.nousresearch.com
Pick qwen/qwen4-max:free in the catalogue and create an API key
Run the long-document and screenshot work early; the window can close without notice
nous-portal-qwen4-max-free.risk: Neither the end time nor a quota is published, so it can be cut short; the free endpoint is rate limited; leave no automated calls behind or they land on the paid price.
nous-portal-qwen4-max-free.source: Nous Research X announcement (2026-11-18/19) + Sulat AI News and OrcaRouter coverage (2026-11-19, catalogue and paid prices checked) + visitor submission email (2026-11-19 19:49)

hpc-ai-model-apis-2-credit.title: [Global] HPC-AI Model APIs: $2 on signup, $4 with invite code HPCAI-MAPI, OpenAI-compatible
hpc-ai-model-apis-2-credit.highlight: 20+ open models such as Kimi K2.5 and MiniMax M2.5 behind one OpenAI-compatible endpoint, usable for agents at 5 requests a minute before the first deposit.
hpc-ai-model-apis-2-credit.regions: [Global] Everywhere except mainland China, which the terms exclude.
hpc-ai-model-apis-2-credit.content:
The launch gives every user $2 of free credit, and signing up with the invite code `HPCAI-MAPI` gives $4 in total (a total balance, not an add-on). Model APIs is a single OpenAI-compatible endpoint that switches between 20-plus popular open models with one key. At MiniMax 2.5 pricing, $2 is roughly 4.3M input plus 1.07M output tokens, enough for a medium project of tens of thousands of lines.

Connect with base URL `https://api.hpc-ai.com/inference/v1` from the OpenAI SDK or Codex CLI. Before a first deposit you are at L0: 5 requests a minute per account per model, with standard models also capped at 2M tokens a minute; spending alone does not promote an account to L1.
hpc-ai-model-apis-2-credit.conditions: Register and create an API key. The $2 is once per account and the invite code makes the total $4. HPC-AI says credit is limited and runs out. No expiry is published. The service is not offered in mainland China. Claude Opus 4.6 has a higher L0 token rate; DeepSeek V4 Pro has zero L0 requests per minute.
steps: Register at hpc-ai.com/models-console (enter the invite code HPCAI-MAPI during signup)
Create a key on the API key page and export HPC_AI_API_KEY
Set the base URL to https://api.hpc-ai.com/inference/v1 and use a callable model ID such as moonshotai/kimi-k2.7-code
hpc-ai-model-apis-2-credit.risk: Mainland China is excluded. Credit is limited and stops when used up, and the free tier's 5 requests a minute will not carry batch work.
hpc-ai-model-apis-2-credit.source: HPC-AI official 'Introducing Model APIs' blog plus Quickstart and Rate Limit docs (checked 2026-11-20) + awesome-free-ai-coding probe record (2026-11-19) + visitor submission email (2026-11-19 19:49)

inception-mercury-100m-free-tokens.title: [Global] Inception Mercury 3: 100M free tokens for every new account, no card, OpenAI-compatible
inception-mercury-100m-free-tokens.highlight: Sign up and get 100M tokens with no payment details, on a low-latency diffusion model; note the Mercury API shuts down on 2026-12-28.
inception-mercury-100m-free-tokens.regions: [Global] Sign up on the Inception Platform; no payment details required.
inception-mercury-100m-free-tokens.content:
Inception's docs state that every new account gets a one-time credit of 100 million free tokens, shared across all models rather than granted per model, with no payment details needed. Free-tier rate limits went up tenfold on 2026-10-19, enough for production-like comparison traffic.

Mercury 3 is a diffusion language model with a 1M context, priced at $0.10 per million input and $0.35 per million output tokens at its 50% launch discount. The API lives at platform.inceptionlabs.ai, is OpenAI-compatible, and works as soon as you create a key.

Important: a notice at the top of the docs says the Mercury API is winding down, fully available only through 2026-12-28, after which neither the service nor the data you submitted can be reached.
inception-mercury-100m-free-tokens.conditions: The grant is one-time and not per model. Register and create an API key; adding payment details is only needed once the free tokens run low. The service closes on 2026-12-28, so the credit has to be used before then.
steps: Register at platform.inceptionlabs.ai without payment details
Create a key on the API Keys page; the free credit lands automatically
Call Mercury 3 with any OpenAI-compatible SDK, and add a card under Billing only when the credit runs low
inception-mercury-100m-free-tokens.risk: The API shuts down on 2026-12-28, so do not tie long-term projects to it. The credit is one-time, and data submitted will be unreachable after the shutdown.
inception-mercury-100m-free-tokens.source: Inception official Quick Start and FAQ (checked 2026-11-20, including the shutdown notice) + official 10x free tokens post (2026-10-19) + aifree.dev recheck (2026-11-15) + X @bobolv235824 (2026-11-19)

heygen-voice-turbo-free.title: [Global] HeyGen Voice Turbo is free until Nov 30: public voices plus instant clones, no card
heygen-voice-turbo-free.highlight: The top-ranked TTS model on Artificial Analysis is free through Nov 30 when the model name is heygen-voice-1-turbo-free; public voices and instant clones both work.
heygen-voice-turbo-free.regions: [Global] A HeyGen account and API key; no credit card and no credit balance.
heygen-voice-turbo-free.content:
HeyGen's docs say HeyGen Voice Turbo Free runs at no charge through 2026-11-30. Send `model` as `heygen-voice-1-turbo-free` to use public voices and instant clones (a voice rebuilt from one recording) without spending credits, and a free request never rolls over into a paid model. This works on both the TTS and streaming speech endpoints, and on the WebSocket with the same model name.

Limits: 30 requests a minute per workspace member by default, with all free users sharing one pool of capacity, so over the limit you get a 429 (honour Retry-After when present, otherwise back off exponentially). Professional clones are excluded and need the paid `heygen-voice-1`. HeyGen explicitly guarantees no uptime, latency or time to first audio, so treat it as a way to test, prototype and produce small amounts of speech.
heygen-voice-turbo-free.conditions: The model name must be heygen-voice-1-turbo-free; the default model or paid Turbo is charged as usual. A HeyGen account and API key are needed, professional voice clones are not included, 429s are normal on shared capacity, and billing resumes after 2026-11-30.
steps: Register at developers.heygen.com and create an API key on a free account
POST to https://api.heygen.com/v3/models/audio/tts with model set to heygen-voice-1-turbo-free
Start with a public voice from the docs, then switch to your own instant clone
heygen-voice-turbo-free.risk: Free only until Nov 30, then list price applies; a wrong model name is charged; 429s are frequent at peak; do not build a production SLA on it.
heygen-voice-turbo-free.source: HeyGen official voice model docs and TTS reference (checked 2026-11-20) + official HeyGen Voice Turbo post (2026-10-21, updated 11-02) + X @bobolv235824 (2026-11-19)

jetbrains-junie-lite-free.title: [Global] JetBrains Junie Lite: a free coding agent for every JetBrains account, no card
jetbrains-junie-lite-free.highlight: Not a trial and no countdown: a free JetBrains account gets it in Air and the Junie CLI, activated on the first request with no card at all.
jetbrains-junie-lite-free.regions: [Global] Any JetBrains account (free, AI Pro or AI Ultimate) inside JetBrains Air and the Junie CLI.
jetbrains-junie-lite-free.content:
Junie Lite is a free model tier for Junie, JetBrains' coding agent. It ships with every JetBrains account, is not a trial, has no countdown, and is granted automatically on your first request with no separate signup and no card. It works in JetBrains Air inside the IDE and in the Junie CLI; in the CLI, `/model` selects it directly, otherwise Junie routes tasks itself.

The docs say the underlying model is currently OpenAI GPT-6 Luna (the launch post said Qwen 3.6 27B) and JetBrains may swap it at any time, so do not build workflows around the model name. Usage is described as virtually unlimited with no published quota: when the model's own capacity ceiling is reached, requests stop rather than falling back to another model. Inference runs only on JetBrains infrastructure, and prompts, code and output are neither shared with the model provider nor used for training.
jetbrains-junie-lite-free.conditions: Available in JetBrains Air and the Junie CLI only, not in JetBrains AI Assistant. Needs a JetBrains account but no AI licence. No quota number is published. The launch post mentions running until 2026-12-31 while the docs describe a standing free tier, so check the official page (unverified).
steps: Install a JetBrains IDE with Air, or the Junie CLI, and sign in with your JetBrains account
In Air go to Settings → AI | Air | Accounts and pick 'Junie Lite Only'; in the CLI run /model and choose Junie Lite
Hand it the mechanical work — renames, test scaffolds, changelogs — and keep frontier models for the hard parts
jetbrains-junie-lite-free.risk: The underlying model can change, the quota is unpublished and requests stop at the ceiling, and it covers JetBrains tooling only.
jetbrains-junie-lite-free.source: JetBrains official Junie Lite docs and launch post (checked 2026-11-20) + JetBrains Air authorization help (updated 2026-11-11) + tahoo.tech recheck (2026-11-13)

vercel-ai-gateway-5-monthly.title: [Global] Vercel AI Gateway: $5 of free credits every 30 days, tokens at provider list price
vercel-ai-gateway-5-monthly.highlight: Included with any Vercel account, refreshed every 30 days; switch between OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and others by changing one string. Buying credits ends the monthly free allowance.
vercel-ai-gateway-5-monthly.regions: [Global] Every Vercel team account; the free tier covers a subset of models with lower per-model rate Limits.
vercel-ai-gateway-5-monthly.content:
Vercel AI Gateway gives each team account a free tier: $5 of credits every 30 days to try models in the catalogue. The original FAQ said every model including premium ones; the current pricing docs say the free tier covers a subset with lower per-model rate limits, so check the Free Tier model list. Tokens are billed at the upstream provider's list price with no markup, including when you bring your own key.

The free credit starts with your first AI Gateway request. Once you purchase AI Gateway Credits the account moves to the paid tier and the monthly $5 free credit no longer applies. Exceeding a rate limit returns a 429 that you can retry after a short wait.
vercel-ai-gateway-5-monthly.conditions: A Vercel account is required. The free tier is a subset of models with lower rate limits, resets every 30 days and does not roll over, and it disappears for good once credits are purchased.
steps: Register a Vercel account and open AI Gateway
Make your first request to any free-tier model, which starts the $5 clock
Change the model string to switch providers without touching your SDK; buy credits only for more usage
vercel-ai-gateway-5-monthly.risk: The free model list and rate limits change; the $5 resets every 30 days and never accumulates; one credit purchase removes the free allowance permanently.
vercel-ai-gateway-5-monthly.source: Vercel AI Gateway official pricing docs and FAQ (checked 2026-11-20) + Vercel GA announcement FAQ + X daily digest (2026-11-19)

sosim-hk-33-100gb-esim.title: [HK] SoSIM new SIM at HK$33: 50GB becomes 100GB plus a free eSIM conversion (until Nov 30)
sosim-hk-33-100gb-esim.highlight: A 3HK prepaid card for HK$33, bought as an eSIM and scanned in about ten minutes, with an extra 50GB for new cards (100GB in total) and a free SIM-to-eSIM coupon.
sosim-hk-33-100gb-esim.regions: [HK] 30 days of 50GB local data plus 50GB extra for new cards and 1,500 local minutes; real-name registration is required for local use, while travel-only use does not need it; Vo-Wi-Fi works inside Hong Kong only (China, Macau, Japan, Korea, Thailand, Taiwan and 24 hotspots).
sosim-hk-33-100gb-esim.content:
SoSIM is Hutchison Telecom Hong Kong's (3HK) prepaid brand. The new-customer offer runs from 2026-09-01 to 11-30: activate a new card in the window and pick the 50GB Hong Kong package as the default, and the first 30 days give 100GB of Hong Kong data (the 50GB package plus 50GB extra), with 1,500 local minutes included. The card costs HK$33 and stays valid for 120 days; activate it within 60 days of purchase.

The eSIM can be bought online: the QR code goes to your verified email after payment and the fastest activation is about ten minutes, with no plastic. New cards also get the 'two-way privilege': a free SIM-to-eSIM conversion coupon (normally HK$28) and a HK$8 number change, delivered to Rewards > My Coupons within five working days and valid for seven days. For travel, the same HK$33 can buy five days of Asia-Pacific roaming data if you switch within 48 hours of activation. The official VoLTE and Vo-Wi-Fi guide states Vo-Wi-Fi works inside Hong Kong only, so codes in the mainland come over roaming.
sosim-hk-33-100gb-esim.conditions: Real-name registration is required for use in Hong Kong. Activate within 60 days of purchase and the card lasts 120 days from activation. The extra 50GB only applies to cards activated before Nov 30 with the 50GB Hong Kong package as default. The device must support eSIM, and travel data has to be switched within 48 hours.
steps: Buy the eSIM on the SoSIM online shop for HK$33 (Visa/Mastercard, Alipay, WeChat Pay accepted)
Scan the QR code sent to your email and activate, which takes about ten minutes
Complete real-name registration in the app and set the default package to 50GB Hong Kong data to get the extra 50GB
Collect the free conversion and number-change coupons under Rewards > My Coupons and use them within seven days
sosim-hk-33-100gb-esim.risk: This is not free: HK$33 is a real payment, local data needs real-name registration, the package must be renewed after 120 days, roaming calls and texts are expensive (HK$8 a minute to receive, HK$3.5 a text), and travel data must be switched within 48 hours.
sosim-hk-33-100gb-esim.source: SoSIM official new-joiner and local service pages + Hutchison Telecom Hong Kong press release (2026-09-24), checked 2026-11-20 + visitor submission email (2026-11-19 21:10)

bitrefill-free-1gb-esim.title: [Global] Bitrefill app: claim a free 1GB eSIM, one per account, no code needed
bitrefill-free-1gb-esim.highlight: Only inside the official app: an account with a verified email that has never bought or claimed an eSIM sees a free banner on the eSIM tab and can pick a destination.
bitrefill-free-1gb-esim.regions: [Global] The official iOS or Android app only; eligible destinations are whatever the in-app list shows and can change.
bitrefill-free-1gb-esim.content:
Bitrefill's help centre (updated 2026-11-17) says an account qualifies for a free 1GB eSIM when the email is verified, the official iOS or Android app is used (the website does not work), no eSIM has ever been bought or claimed on that account, and the chosen destination is on the in-app list. The free banner sits on the eSIM tab in the app.

It is one claim per account, not transferable and uses no coupon code; eligible accounts simply see the offer. Free eSIMs connect to the same local networks as paid packages. If no banner appears, the usual causes are the website instead of the app, an active VPN or private relay, an unverified email, a previous eSIM order, a destination outside the list, or a location where claims are unavailable.
bitrefill-free-1gb-esim.conditions: Official app only, with VPN and private relay off. One claim per account and not transferable. Destinations change with the promotion, and accounts that previously bought or claimed an eSIM cannot take part.
steps: Install the official Bitrefill app, sign in and confirm the email is verified
Open the eSIM tab and tap the 1GB free banner
Pick a destination, confirm the order and install from the email or on-screen steps
bitrefill-free-1gb-esim.risk: The destination list and stock change, the website and a VPN hide the entry point, older accounts cannot take part, and community reports mention regional limits.
bitrefill-free-1gb-esim.source: Bitrefill help centre article on the free eSIM (updated 2026-11-17) + bitrefill.com/free-esim destinations page (checked 2026-11-20)

remitly-us-global-card.title: [US] Remitly Global Card and bank account: a bonus after $300 of wages lands, no monthly fee
remitly-us-global-card.highlight: A Lead Bank Visa debit card on a Stripe account that can hold USD or USDC, with no monthly or foreign transaction fees; a first qualifying $300 payroll deposit pays a bonus about seven business days later.
remitly-us-global-card.regions: [US] United States only, card and account from Lead Bank and Stripe (funds at Fifth Third Bank); expanding to the UK and Europe.
remitly-us-global-card.value: Bonus after $300 of wages (amount shown in the app, $50 per the submission)
remitly-us-global-card.content:
Remitly launched the Global Card on 2026-07-30: a Lead Bank Visa debit card on a Stripe Payments Company account with funds at Fifth Third Bank (FDIC), holding dollars or USDC, free withdrawals at 40,000+ US ATMs, no monthly or foreign transaction fees, and Remitly's best rate when a transfer is funded from the card. Direct deposit arrived on 2026-09-29, with a switch form generated in the app or a few taps to link an employer.

The official direct-deposit promotion runs 2026-08-10 to 12-31: a first qualifying payroll, salary, pension or government-benefit ACH deposit of $300 or more earns a bonus about seven business days later, once per customer and per account. The terms only say the amount is the one shown in the app; the submission puts it at $50. A first-transfer discount sits alongside it ($10 off a $50+ send per the submission, $20 in our multi-region Remitly entry, which differs by market and channel).

The $9.99-a-month Global Card Plan (Pay Later credit, 1% rewards) is an optional upgrade and is not needed for the bonus.
remitly-us-global-card.conditions: The card is currently invitation-only for eligible US users and has a waitlist. The deposit must be recurring salary, wages or benefits sent by an employer or payroll provider over ACH; transfers, P2P, wallets, cheques, cash, wires and tax refunds do not count. The bonus is once only, and both amounts vary by market and campaign.
steps: Confirm the Global Card invitation in the Remitly app, open the card and activate it
Generate a direct deposit form in the app for your employer, or link the employer directly
Check the bonus in the app about seven business days after the first $300 deposit; send a transfer in the same session if you also want the first-transfer discount
remitly-us-global-card.risk: US only and invitation-based; Remitly alone decides what counts as a qualifying deposit, and a disguised transfer will not pay. The amount is not fixed in the terms, and the first-transfer discount may overlap with our multi-region $20 Remitly entry, so do not count both. The card is not a bank account.
remitly-us-global-card.source: Remitly Global Card official landing page and Direct Deposit Promotional Terms (2026-11 version) + official press releases (card 2026-07-30, direct deposit 2026-09-29) + visitor submission email (2026-11-19 23:28; the accompanying invite link carried a referral code, so the page links to the official landing page instead)

payangel-referral-10.title: [UK/US/CA/AU] PayAngel referrals: £10 / $10 / CAD 10 / AUD 10 per friend, no cap
payangel-referral-10.highlight: When a friend signs up through your link, passes KYC and sends a first international transfer, you are paid instantly in your own currency with no limit on referrals.
payangel-referral-10.regions: [UK/US/CA/AU] £10 in the UK, $10 in the US, CAD 10 in Canada, AUD 10 in Australia and €10 in the eurozone; destinations are mainly in Africa and South Asia (Ghana, Nigeria, Kenya, Uganda, India, Bangladesh and more).
payangel-referral-10.content:
PayAngel's help and Rewards pages explain the programme: take your personal link from the Referral Rewards page in the app or on the web, and when a friend signs up through it, completes a one-time KYC in their own name and sends a first qualifying international transfer, you receive £10, $10, €10, CAD 10 or AUD 10 instantly in your sending currency, with no cap on how many friends you refer. Referred friends get fee-free transfers on many corridors.

KYC normally needs a valid government photo ID (passport, driving licence, national ID or residence permit) plus a selfie in the app, and occasionally proof of address for higher limits. PayAngel is supervised by the FCA in the UK, FinCEN in the US, FINTRAC in Canada and AUSTRAC in Australia, with PSD2 oversight in Europe.
payangel-referral-10.conditions: The friend must register through your link or code, pass KYC and send a first qualifying transfer, whose minimum the app shows per currency. Self-referrals, duplicate accounts and shared household identities are blocked by AML checks, and rewards are paid in the sending country's currency.
steps: Register with PayAngel, pass KYC and copy your referral link from the Rewards tab
Send it to people who genuinely send money, and ask them to open the link before registering
Check the Rewards balance once their first qualifying transfer clears; the reward is immediate
payangel-referral-10.risk: The first-transfer minimum varies by currency and corridor, so check the app; self-referral and multiple accounts are blocked and can close an account; tax on rewards is the user's own affair; only sending markets in the UK, US, Canada, Australia and the EU qualify.
payangel-referral-10.source: PayAngel official Referral Rewards and Rewards pages (checked 2026-11-20) + official send-from guides (2026-11-12) + visitor submission email (2026-11-19 19:49)

starryblu-free-virtual-card.title: [Global] Starryblu free virtual Mastercard from Singapore's Wotransfer, openable with a passport (queue applies)
starryblu-free-virtual-card.highlight: A sister brand of Panda Remit with a MAS major payment institution licence and OCBC-segregated funds; the free tier issues a Singapore-BIN 228001 Mastercard that community tests use for Claude.
starryblu-free-virtual-card.regions: [Global] A mainland Chinese passport plus a domestic proof of address works in practice; the card is issued in Singapore by Wotransfer Pte Ltd (Mastercard debit, BIN 228001).
starryblu-free-virtual-card.value: Free virtual card (physical card $9.9 shipping, plans $9.99-19.99 a month)
starryblu-free-virtual-card.content:
Starryblu is a multi-currency account from Singapore's Wotransfer Pte. Ltd., a sister brand of Panda Remit holding MAS major payment institution licence PS20200501 with customer funds segregated at OCBC. It covers CNY, SGD, USD, EUR, HKD, GBP and more, with cross-border transfers and a Mastercard debit card.

The free tier issues a virtual Mastercard at no cost (Singapore BIN 228001, usable for Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and other overseas subscriptions); a physical card ships for about US$9.9. Paid plans at $9.99 and $19.99 a month and $999.99 a year add free physical cards and number choice. Funding runs over Hong Kong FPS, Singapore PayNow or a cross-border wire, and withdrawals back to Alipay or WeChat work with small losses. Since 2026-10-29 the company has been releasing cards in batches, so free-tier users who queued for months can now open one; new registrations still queue, and a whitelist or invite code moves you up.
starryblu-free-virtual-card.conditions: A passport, face check and proof of address are required (a mainland ID card works as address proof). New accounts still queue for release. The free card cannot be added to Apple or Google Wallet per community reports. An invite code must be entered at signup and cannot be added later. Physical cards and plans carry extra fees and auto-renewal.
steps: Download the app from the official site or an app store, pick your country of residence and enter an invite code if you have one
Photograph the passport photo page, complete the face check and upload proof of address
Once approved, open the card page, choose the free plan and apply for the free virtual card; order a physical card separately if needed
Fund a small amount first to test linking and spending before leaving a balance
starryblu-free-virtual-card.risk: The queue can run for months and cards are released in batches; this is a payment account, not a bank deposit, so segregated custody is not deposit insurance; Alipay and WeChat QR spending carries noticeable loss; wallet and merchant acceptance varies; watch plan auto-renewal.
starryblu-free-virtual-card.source: Starryblu official site and app walkthrough (checked 2026-11, licence and free tier) + linux.do submission thread (2026-11-19) + NodeSeek datapoint (2026-11-11: free virtual card now live, BIN and queue) + HuoKe and Carddoger guides

revolut-mobile-ireland.title: [IE] Revolut Mobile eSIM: €9.99 a month for the first 25,000 (then €12.99), with 20GB of UK and EEA roaming
revolut-mobile-ireland.highlight: Unlimited 5G in Ireland plus 20GB of UK and EEA roaming, a 1GB Messaging Pass across 120 countries and free NordVPN, activated as an eSIM in the app with no contract.
revolut-mobile-ireland.regions: [IE] Irish numbers and Irish Revolut accounts only; 5G runs on Vodafone through Gigs, with roaming across the UK and EEA.
revolut-mobile-ireland.content:
Revolut launched Revolut Mobile in Ireland on 2026-11-09: an eSIM with network capability from Gigs on Vodafone 5G, activated in seconds in the app, on a rolling monthly contract you can cancel any time. The plan includes unlimited Irish data, calls and texts under a fair use policy, 20GB of roaming in the UK and EEA, a 1GB low-speed Messaging Pass across 120+ non-EU countries, and NordVPN at no extra cost.

Pricing: €9.99 a month for the first 25,000 customers, until 2027-01-31 or while that allocation lasts, then €12.99. RevPoints can offset the bill, up to the full amount (an Ultra customer spending about €1,400 a month covers it at €9.99). You can keep your number, take a free new one or buy a VIP number for €10, and extra numbers cost from €2 a month each.
revolut-mobile-ireland.conditions: An Irish Revolut account (Revolut Bank UAB, Ireland branch) and an Irish number are required, 18+, and the €9.99 applies only to the first 25,000 or until 2027-01-31. Fair use policy limits tethering and abuse, and the device must support eSIM.
steps: In the Revolut app open RevPoints → eSIM and choose the mobile plan
Pick a number: keep yours (text PAC to 65075 and give the code to Revolut), take a free new one or buy a VIP number
Check out, install the eSIM from the QR code; porting normally completes within one working day
revolut-mobile-ireland.risk: Irish numbers and Irish Revolut accounts only; the €9.99 can end early when the allocation runs out and reverts to €12.99; unlimited data is subject to fair use; the app price is authoritative.
