barclays-uk-switch-300.title: [UK] Barclays switch offer worth up to £300: £150 to open plus £30 a month for five months
barclays-uk-switch-300.highlight: The biggest switch bonus in the UK right now: switch in with CASS and three direct debits plus a £2,000 salary to earn £150, then £30 a month for five months by spending 10 times and keeping the salary coming.
barclays-uk-switch-300.regions: [UK] UK residents 18+ opening a sole Barclays Bank Account through the Barclays app.
barclays-uk-switch-300.content:
Barclays' Current Account Switch offer (from 2026-10-01, withdrawable at any time) pays £150 when you open a sole Barclays Bank Account in the app, complete a full CASS switch from another UK bank with at least three active direct debits, request the switch within 30 days and have £2,000 of salary paid in within 30 days of opening. The £150 arrives within 28 working days of qualifying.

After that, up to five further full months each pay £30 when you make at least 10 eligible debit card purchases, receive £2,000 of salary in that month and still hold the account, for a maximum of £300. Someone qualifying in October is assessed for the first £30 in November with payment in December, and so on through March 2027 assessed and April paid.

Salary must be Bacs from an employer, a state or private pension, or a transfer from a UK business account to your personal account; transfers between personal accounts do not count. Eligible card spending excludes cash withdrawals, ATMs, gambling, refunds, P2P payments and internal transfers, and pending transactions do not count.
barclays-uk-switch-300.conditions: UK resident, 18+, opening in the app with a mobile number. You are excluded if you held any Barclays current account on or before 2026-10-01, have had a Barclays CASS bonus before, are opening a joint account or only qualify for a Basic Account. The switch must carry three active direct debits, the first £2,000 salary must land within 30 days, and the total is capped at £300.
steps: Download the Barclays app and open a sole Barclays Bank Account (finish the application within 21 days)
Complete a full CASS switch within 30 days of opening, carrying three active direct debits
Have £2,000 or more of salary paid in by Bacs within 30 days
For the next five months, make 10 eligible debit card purchases and keep the £2,000 salary arriving
barclays-uk-switch-300.risk: Barclays says the offer can be withdrawn at any time and publishes no end date. Salary must arrive by Bacs and cannot be a transfer between personal accounts. The 10 card purchases must clear within the month, and every missed month costs £30 of the £300 ceiling.
barclays-uk-switch-300.source: Barclays official switch-offer page and October 2026 terms (checked 2026-11-20) + Barclays press release (2026-10-01) + Proper Money comparison (2026-11-16) + Martin Lewis and Birmingham Live coverage (2026-11-15)

chatgpt-business-plugin-credits.title: [Multi-region] ChatGPT Business: $50 PayPal and Oracle plugin credits, $25 HubSpot, $50 Klaviyo
chatgpt-business-plugin-credits.highlight: Inside a ChatGPT Business workspace, accept the offer in the plugin directory, install and connect the plugin, then run one real workflow within 7 days and the workspace gets $25–$50 of agentic credits. PayPal and Oracle pay $50 each, HubSpot $25, Klaviyo $50, and the four caps stack independently.
chatgpt-business-plugin-credits.regions: [Multi-region] PayPal is US users only; Oracle QuickStart is global; the November HubSpot and Klaviyo grants are rolled out per workspace, so you need the banner in the plugin directory to qualify
chatgpt-business-plugin-credits.value: $25–$50 per grant, up to about $550 per workspace
chatgpt-business-plugin-credits.content:
OpenAI's help centre article "ChatGPT Business plugin credit promotions" explains that eligible ChatGPT Business workspaces see a promotional banner in the plugin directory on ChatGPT web or desktop. The order is: accept the offer, install and connect the plugin, then complete one real successful workflow with it within the stated window. After eligibility checks the credit is added to the workspace automatically, with no promo code and no separate application, and you and the workspace admins get a confirmation email.

Current offers: PayPal pays $50 per grant, US users only, one per user and up to three users per workspace ($150 cap). Oracle QuickStart pays $50 per grant worldwide, one per user and up to five per workspace ($250 cap). The November HubSpot offer pays $25 per grant (up to two per workspace, $50 cap, 8,000 grants campaign-wide). Klaviyo pays $50 per grant (up to two per workspace, $100 cap, 10,000 grants). The four caps are counted separately, so a workspace eligible for all four could stack about $550.

These are agentic credits, not API credits: they apply to workspace usage of ChatGPT Work, Codex, ChatGPT for Excel or Sheets, ChatGPT for PowerPoint and Workspace Agent. They do not change the subscription or the usage included in the plan, and November credits expire 30 days after they land. The earlier Stripe / Intuit QuickBooks / HubSpot / Gusto / Dropbox / Canva promotion ($50 each) has ended.
chatgpt-business-plugin-credits.conditions: You must be a member of a ChatGPT Business workspace (a paid seat, Standard, Premium or legacy Codex seats) with the plugin and its underlying apps enabled by an admin. You are not eligible if the plugin was already installed or explicitly connected when you accept the offer. November HubSpot and Klaviyo require a real successful run in ChatGPT Work or Codex in the same workspace within 7 days of accepting; PayPal and Oracle require it within 7 days of installing. Grants are first come, first served and accepting does not reserve one. PayPal is US-only.
steps: Sign in to a Business account on ChatGPT web or the desktop app and open the plugin directory
Open the plugin with the promo banner (PayPal, Oracle QuickStart, HubSpot or Klaviyo) and accept the offer first
Then install and connect that plugin (an admin may need to enable it for the workspace)
Run one real successful workflow with the plugin inside the window; installing alone does not count
Wait for the confirmation email and check the workspace usage or billing page; spend the credit within 30 days
chatgpt-business-plugin-credits.risk: You need a paid Business seat to be eligible, and the credit only offsets agentic usage for 30 days, so it is not cash. Banners are rolled out per user and workspace, so not seeing one means no eligibility this round. Doing it in the wrong order (installing the plugin before accepting) disqualifies you. Supplies are limited and OpenAI can change or end an offer at any time.
chatgpt-business-plugin-credits.source: OpenAI Help Centre "ChatGPT Business plugin credit promotions" (updated 2 days ago; credit table checked 2026-11-20) + NodeSeek report and DPs 2026-11-19 + VPSlu review 2026-11-19

vercel-parallel-search-free.title: [Global] Vercel AI Gateway x Parallel web search: fast mode free until 2027-01-31
vercel-parallel-search-free.highlight: Parallel web search inside AI Gateway is free through 2027-01-31 as long as you set the tool to fast mode, with no separate Parallel account. eve agents use the free fast mode by default.
vercel-parallel-search-free.regions: [Global] Any Vercel account; model tokens are still billed
vercel-parallel-search-free.content:
Vercel's 2026-11-18 changelog made Parallel web search in fast mode free on AI Gateway through 2027-01-31, and made Parallel the default search tool for eve agents. Parallel finds relevant pages and returns links with short excerpts, filterable by site or publication date, works with any AI Gateway model and needs no separate Parallel API key.

In code: pass `gateway.tools.parallelSearch({ mode: 'fast' })` in the AI SDK tools, or set `"mode": "fast"` in the `vercel:parallel_search` tool config for Chat Completions. eve needs no configuration because its default search already runs in fast mode and is free.

The regular price is $5 per 1,000 requests (up to 10 results each, with extra results at $1 per 1,000). Only a mode you set in the tool configuration is free; a model choosing fast inside its own tool call does not qualify. Free capacity is shared and can be rate limited, in which case the tool call returns a rate-limit error to the model without failing the request, and it is never retried as a billed search. Free searches are not counted as billable gatewayToolCalls, but model tokens are still charged.
vercel-parallel-search-free.conditions: Needs a Vercel account with AI Gateway enabled. Only searches with `mode: 'fast'` explicitly set in the tool configuration are free; basic, advanced and turbo modes stay at $5 per 1,000. Free capacity is shared and can be rate limited. From 2027-02-01 fast mode returns to regular pricing. Zero Data Retention is on by default; Parallel does not retain free searches or train on them.
steps: Sign in to Vercel, create or open a project and enable an AI Gateway key
Add gateway.tools.parallelSearch({ mode: 'fast' }) to your AI SDK tools (or mode: fast in the Chat Completions tool config)
Call it from any AI Gateway model; the search bills at $0
Confirm in AI Gateway logs that searches were not billed (tokens still are)
vercel-parallel-search-free.risk: Only the search call is free; model tokens are charged in full. Without an explicit fast mode you pay $5 per 1,000. The free pool is shared and rate limited at peak times, and forgetting to change the config after the deadline starts billing.
vercel-parallel-search-free.source: Vercel changelog (2026-11-18) + AI Gateway web search billing docs (checked 2026-11-20)

agnes-ai-flash-free-api.title: [Global / China site] Agnes AI Flash models at $0: free text, image and video API (OpenAI compatible)
agnes-ai-flash-free-api.highlight: Singapore's Sapiens AI lists agnes-2.5-flash, agnes-3.0-flash, three image Flash models and agnes-video-2.5-flash at $0 for input and output, with the China site also at ¥0. Sign up, no card needed.
agnes-ai-flash-free-api.regions: [Global / China site] International site bills in USD, the China site is ¥0; sign-up only, no card, rate limited
agnes-ai-flash-free-api.value: Text, image and video Flash models all $0 (list price $0.05–$0.15 per million tokens, $10 per 1,000 images)
agnes-ai-flash-free-api.content:
Agnes AI's official international pricing page, checked 2026-11-20, shows `agnes-2.5-flash` and `agnes-3.0-flash` at $0 for cached input, input and output under the Angel User Trial Price column (list prices are $0.005, $0.05 and $0.15 per million tokens). On the image side, `agnes-image-2.0-flash`, `2.1-flash` and `2.5-flash` are $0 for 1K through 4K output and for reference images from the fourth onward (list price $10–$24 per 1,000 images). On video, `agnes-video-2.5-flash` is $0 per second at 720P (list price $0.025 per second). `agnes-video-2.5` and `agnes-2.5-pro` remain paid.

The API is OpenAI compatible: register, create a key in the console and point base_url at Agnes. Text models take about 512K of context and support tool calling and image input. The FAQ says the core models are free indefinitely and only limited by RPM, with free keys and paid Token Plan keys on separate rate-limit pools. Verified limits are roughly 10–20 RPM for text, 1–20 RPM for images depending on resolution, and 1 RPM for video; the free video pricing is a limited-time promotion.
agnes-ai-flash-free-api.conditions: Register an Agnes account and create an API key; no card. The free tier is limited by requests per minute with no published daily allowance. Free video is a limited-time promotion while text and image Flash are currently listed as permanent $0. Agent Plan and Token Plan allowances do not get the model-level free pricing.
steps: Register at agnes-ai.com (the China site is also ¥0)
Create a free API key in the console and note the base_url
Call agnes-2.5-flash, agnes-3.0-flash, agnes-image-*-flash or agnes-video-2.5-flash with OpenAI-compatible requests
Watch RPM and usage in the console and wait out the minute when limited
agnes-ai-flash-free-api.risk: Free access is gated by RPM limits that the provider says may change, so do not build a production SLA on it. Free video is a limited-time promotion that can close without notice. The provider publishes no end date. Free and paid keys use separate pools.
agnes-ai-flash-free-api.source: Agnes AI official pricing page and FAQ (checked 2026-11-20) + aifree.dev free-API listing (human verified 2026-11-06, rechecked 2026-11-19) + Chinese X deal digest 2026-11-19

fireworks-glimmer-free-training.title: [Global] Fireworks Free Weights Club: train Muse Glimmer 30B free (SFT/DPO/RL through 11/30)
fireworks-glimmer-free-training.highlight: Fireworks' Free Weights Club opens with multimodal Muse Glimmer 30B: SFT, DPO and RL training are free through 2026-11-30 with no credit card, enough for your own LoRA experiments.
fireworks-glimmer-free-training.value: Free training (LoRA SFT normally $3 per million training tokens)
fireworks-glimmer-free-training.content:
Fireworks' post "Train Muse Glimmer for free" announced the first Free Weights Club offer: Muse Glimmer 30B, a multimodal 30B-class model, is free to train with supervised fine-tuning, DPO and RL through 2026-11-30, with no credit card. You can run SFT through Managed Training in the app or API, or write your own loop with the Serverless Training API. The docs and cookbook add one detail: LoRA SFT is free in the UI and the Serverless Training API for jobs started before 2026-12-01T00:00:00-08:00, and the starter script refuses to launch after that unless you pass --allow-paid.

The published experiment trains a LoRA adapter on Kalshi prediction questions in one pass and lifts accuracy on unseen topics from 53.2% (base) to 58.3%, 11.2 points ahead of the Jev comparison. Training produces a LoRA adapter you can promote to a model, but serving it still needs an on-demand deployment billed per GPU-hour.
fireworks-glimmer-free-training.conditions: Register a Fireworks account; no card. Only training is free: inference, including evaluation sampling during a training run, is billed per token. Muse Glimmer 30B left serverless inference on 2026-09-25, so serving a tuned model needs an on-demand deployment. The blog says SFT, DPO and RL are all free while the cookbook only states LoRA SFT, so check the billing note on the job screen for DPO and RL.
steps: Register a Fireworks account (no card)
In Managed Training or the Serverless Training API, pick accounts/fireworks/models/muse-glimmer-30b
Prepare chat JSONL data and start a LoRA SFT job (the muse_glimmer starter in the cookbook works)
Read the cost line the launcher prints and confirm only evaluation sampling is billed
Promote the LoRA adapter to a model; open an on-demand deployment only if you need to serve it
fireworks-glimmer-free-training.risk: Only training is free; inference and evaluation sampling are charged and a large eval run will create a bill. Serving the tuned model bills per GPU-hour. The blog and docs differ on whether DPO and RL are covered. Jobs started after 11-30 are no longer free.
fireworks-glimmer-free-training.source: Fireworks official blog (2026-10-20, updated 2026-11-17) + official cookbook and model page promotion notes (checked 2026-11-20) + that.promo and Token Thrift re-checks 2026-11-19

tabstack-free-10k-credits.title: [Global] Tabstack by Mozilla: 10,000 free credits for new accounts, no card
tabstack-free-10k-credits.highlight: Mozilla's web API for agents gives every new account 10,000 credits with no card, enough for 1,000 page-to-Markdown extractions or 40 cited fast research runs. The trial stops when the credits run out.
tabstack-free-10k-credits.value: 10,000 credits (about 1,000 Markdown extractions or 40 fast research runs)
tabstack-free-10k-credits.content:
Tabstack's pricing page states every new account includes 10,000 free credits with no credit card. Credits are spent per action: Extract to Markdown 10 credits, Extract to JSON 50, Generate 100, Automate 100, Research Fast 250, Research Balanced 350. So 10,000 credits is roughly 1,000 Markdown extractions, 40 fast research runs, or any mix.

The platform runs search, page reading, gap checking, synthesis and citation outside your model and returns a cited Markdown report. It says it is never trained on, private by default and built by Mozilla. Trial accounts have no overage billing: requests stop when the credits run out instead of converting to a paid plan. Paid tiers are Starter at $10/month (100,000 credits), Team at $99 and Pro at $499. It launched on Product Hunt on 2026-11-19 with "Start free with 10,000 credits".
tabstack-free-10k-credits.conditions: Sign up at tabstack.ai; no card. The 10,000 credits are a one-off trial allowance and do not refresh. Balanced research needs Team or above, so trial accounts only get Fast. Rate limit is 15 requests per minute.
steps: Register at tabstack.ai with no card
Create an API key in the console and confirm the balance shows 10,000 credits
Call /extract (Markdown or JSON) or /research with mode: fast
Check in the console how many credits each action spent; requests stop when they are gone
tabstack-free-10k-credits.risk: At the published overage rate the 10,000 credits are worth only about $3, so this is a trial rather than a lasting free tier. Research can chain several actions and bills each one, so use the console estimate before running it. Do not point production at a trial account.
tabstack-free-10k-credits.source: Tabstack official pricing page and docs FAQ (checked 2026-11-20) + Product Hunt launch 2026-11-19

sspace-30day-max-trial.title: [Global] S.Space by the AutoGen team: 30-day Max trial, no card
sspace-30day-max-trial.highlight: A workspace where people and their own agents share rooms, built by AutoGen's creators: every new account starts a 30-day Max trial with no card, and you plug in your own Claude Code or Codex.
sspace-30day-max-trial.regions: [Global] Sign-up only. The Sutando agent currently needs the macOS app; web and iPhone users can join rooms but cannot run a local agent
sspace-30day-max-trial.value: 30-day Max trial (Max pricing not public; pricing unconfirmed)
sspace-30day-max-trial.content:
S.Space comes from AG2ai, the company of AutoGen's creator Chi Wang and co-creator Qingyun Wu. It launched publicly on 2026-11-02 and topped Product Hunt on 11-18. The product puts people and their agents into shared rooms: each person runs an agent called Sutando on macOS whose core is a real Claude Code or Codex session on their own subscription, so there is no per-token API key. Agents from other apps (ChatGPT's Dot, Grok Bot, Muse, Claude and others) join by adding S.Space as an MCP server at https://mcp.s.space/mcp. Agents ask each other for data, outputs land in shared Commons docs and tables, and anything leaving the room needs a human approval.

Official pricing plus third-party checks on 2026-11-19: the Free plan is $0, lets you join rooms and run Sutando on your own subscription, and includes no usage credits. Every new account gets a 30-day Max trial with no credit card. Plus, Pro and Max prices are not published on the public pages and are bought inside sutando.s.space; cloud tools are charged per use (for example $5 per market map, $0.15 per qualified lead, $20 per competitor sweep), and the managed Gemini voice key needs a paid plan. Sutando itself is MIT open source.
sspace-30day-max-trial.conditions: Register for a 30-day Max trial with no card. Sutando runs only on the macOS 12+ app (Apple Silicon or Intel); Windows and Linux users can join rooms from web or iPhone and connect agents from other apps. The Free plan includes no usage credits, and cloud tools and managed voice need a paid plan or purchased credits. Rooms with agents are not end-to-end encrypted for now.
steps: Register at s.space and confirm the account is on the 30-day Max trial
On macOS, install the S.Space app and connect your Claude Code or Codex subscription
Create a room and invite teammates, or add ChatGPT / Grok / Muse agents over MCP
Work in Commons on what the agents produce, approving anything that leaves the room
Decide before the trial ends whether to move to a paid plan, and watch per-use cloud tools
sspace-30day-max-trial.risk: Max has no public price, so the value of 30 days can only be estimated from comparable $200/month tiers and is marked unverified. The free plan carries no credits. The local agent needs a Mac and draws down your own Claude or ChatGPT subscription. Cloud tools bill per use, so do not click through them carelessly during the trial.
sspace-30day-max-trial.source: S.Space official site + TechLogHub pricing check (2026-11-19) + Product Hunt leaderboard 11-18 + NewAIToolsToday board 2026-11-19

onlook-free-designer-desktop.title: [Global] Onlook (YC W25) open-source agentic design tool: free desktop app
onlook-free-designer-desktop.highlight: Design on top of your real codebase: Onlook overlays a canvas on your repo, and clicking an element and saying 'make this a card layout' drives the Claude Code or Codex you already run to produce a git diff or PR. The desktop app is free and open source.
onlook-free-designer-desktop.regions: [Global] macOS, Windows and Linux desktop; bring your own Claude Code or Codex subscription
onlook-free-designer-desktop.value: Free and open source (Apache-2.0); cloud collaboration to be paid later
onlook-free-designer-desktop.content:
Onlook (YC W25) launched on Hacker News on 2026-11-19, announcing it had rebuilt the product as an agentic design tool and open-sourced the whole thing under Apache-2.0. The desktop app is an Electron program: import a GitHub repo or a local folder and it creates a git worktree, starts the dev server and has the agent sort out dependencies. You select elements on the canvas and give instructions; changes appear as git diffs you can push as a PR or throw away, and several worktrees can run at once.

Onlook does not train its own model. It runs your existing Claude Code or Codex subscription, turns whatever the agent emits into one typed event log, and renders the UI from that. It adds design-specific tools such as arranging frames on the canvas and generating several iterations of a selection. The desktop editor is free and open source; a paid cloud product for teams is planned, along with image, vector and font generation. The project has had 25,000+ designers and developers, 100+ contributors and two stints as the world's trending #1 repo.
onlook-free-designer-desktop.conditions: Free and open source, but you need your own working Claude Code or Codex subscription because Onlook supplies no model credits. The desktop app is aimed at macOS and Windows (Linux is not officially offered yet). The imported repo needs a dev server that starts, or the canvas cannot boot.
steps: Download the desktop app from onlook.com, or build it from github.com/onlook-dev/onlook
Import a project from GitHub or a local folder and let it create the worktree and start the dev server
Select elements on the canvas and give instructions; the agent edits code through your own Claude Code or Codex
Review the diff and open a PR or discard it
onlook-free-designer-desktop.risk: The tool is free but model usage comes out of your own subscription. It is early software, so complex repos may fail to start. When cloud collaboration and image, vector or font generation ship as paid features, the free boundary may narrow.
onlook-free-designer-desktop.source: Launch HN thread (2026-11-19, founder D_R_Farrell) + official GitHub onlook-dev/onlook (Apache-2.0)

tsb-uk-25-amazon-gift-card.title: [UK] TSB Spend & Save: £25 Amazon gift card for opening an account by 12/16 and making 3 payments
tsb-uk-25-amazon-gift-card.highlight: No switch and no direct debits needed: open a TSB Spend & Save or Spend & Save Plus account through the MoneySupermarket link, make three payments of any value by 12/31, and a £25 Amazon gift card is emailed to you. It stacks with £5 a month card cashback for six months.
tsb-uk-25-amazon-gift-card.regions: [UK] UK residents 18+ opening a new Spend & Save or Spend & Save Plus current account
tsb-uk-25-amazon-gift-card.content:
TSB's £25 Amazon gift card offer with Mony Group (MoneySupermarket and MSE) runs from 16:00 on 2026-11-17 until 2026-12-16, or earlier if withdrawn. Apply for a TSB Spend & Save or Spend & Save Plus account through the MoneySupermarket listing, then make at least three debit card payments of any value on the new account by 2026-12-31 (counted when the money leaves the account), and you get a £25 Amazon.co.uk gift card.

The flow is: click the promotional link, register your email with Giftcloud, click Continue Purchase to reach TSB and open the account. Once TSB confirms the account and the three payments, Giftcloud emails the claim link by 2027-01-31 and you have 60 days to claim. The account must still be open when the card is sent. Spend & Save also pays £5 a month for the first six months when you make 20 card payments a month (up to £30), and offers a 5% regular saver taking up to £250 a month. No CASS switch, direct debits or salary are required.
tsb-uk-25-amazon-gift-card.conditions: UK resident, 18+. You must start from the MoneySupermarket promotional link so Giftcloud can track it; other entry points and Quidco do not qualify. You must not already hold a TSB Spend & Save or Spend & Save Plus account. Make three debit card payments of any value by 2026-12-31. One gift card per person. The account must be open when the card is issued. Safari or leaving the application part way can break tracking, so enable third-party cookies and finish in one session.
steps: Open the TSB Spend & Save listing on MoneySupermarket, click the offer link and register your email with Giftcloud
Click Continue Purchase to reach TSB and open a Spend & Save or Spend & Save Plus account online
Make three debit card payments of any value by 2026-12-31, counting when they clear
Wait for the Giftcloud claim email by 2027-01-31 and claim the £25 gift card within 60 days
Optionally make 20 card payments a month to collect £5 monthly cashback for six months
tsb-uk-25-amazon-gift-card.risk: Only applications arriving through the promotional link count; going straight to tsb.co.uk gets you nothing. TSB runs a hard credit search that stays on your file. Tracking failure is the most common way this offer fails, so keep the Giftcloud emails. Closing the account early forfeits the card.
tsb-uk-25-amazon-gift-card.source: TSB and Mony Group official terms (effective 2026-11-17 16:00, transcribed in full on the MSE forum) + MoneySavingExpert round-up 2026-11-19 + Daily Record report 2026-11-19

gate-convert-new-user-20usdt.title: [Global site] Gate Convert for new users: $1 in, 20 USDT out, plus 10 WLFI daily check-ins (11/19–11/26)
gate-convert-new-user-20usdt.highlight: Users who have never used Gate Convert can register and make one Convert trade of at least 1 USDT to get 20 USDT (first 500 only). Trade 20 USDT a day to check in for 10 WLFI, out of an 80,000 WLFI pool.
gate-convert-new-user-20usdt.regions: [Global site] KYC required; restricted regions excluded; rewards paid as Dual Investment trial funds and WLFI spot
gate-convert-new-user-20usdt.value: 20 USDT (first 500) plus up to 70 WLFI from check-ins
gate-convert-new-user-20usdt.content:
Gate's official announcement dated 2026-11-19 09:00 UTC runs the Convert new-user campaign until 2026-11-26 09:00 UTC. Event 1, New User Convert Gift: after registering on the event page and passing identity verification, a user who has never completed a Convert trade on Gate gets 20 USDT for their first Convert trade of at least 1 USDT. It is limited to the first 500 users, first come first served, credited automatically as Dual Investment trial funds.

Event 2, Daily Convert Check-In: a new user who trades at least 20 USDT through Convert in a UTC calendar day (00:00–23:59) counts that day as a check-in and earns 10 WLFI, from a pool of 80,000 WLFI that runs out first come first served. Up to seven days means about 70 WLFI, paid as WLFI spot. Both events can be joined together, and both require clicking Join Now on the event page and completing KYC.
gate-convert-new-user-20usdt.conditions: Click Join Now on the event page and complete KYC first. A Convert new user means no Convert trade completed before registering for the event. Event 1 is capped at the first 500 qualifying users. Event 2 counts UTC calendar days with at least 20 USDT of Convert volume, and missed days cannot be made up. Rewards are paid as Dual Investment trial funds (event 1) and WLFI spot (event 2), not withdrawable USDT.
steps: Sign in to Gate, open the event page, click Join Now and complete KYC
Make one Convert trade of at least 1 USDT to receive the 20 USDT trial funds
Trade at least 20 USDT through Convert each day to check in for 10 WLFI
Confirm WLFI in your wallet and use the trial funds under Dual Investment rules
gate-convert-new-user-20usdt.risk: The 20 USDT is Dual Investment trial funds rather than withdrawable cash. The first 500 places can run out. Check-ins follow UTC days with no catch-up. KYC is required and some regions are excluded. WLFI is volatile, so its real value is below face value.

reducto-150-free-usage.title: [Global] Reducto: $150 of free usage on the document-parsing API for new accounts
reducto-150-free-usage.highlight: A document parsing and structured-extraction API for AI agents. The Standard pay-as-you-go tier starts with $150 of free usage, then bills per page ($1 per 1,000 pages on r-1 mini).
reducto-150-free-usage.regions: [Global] No country restriction stated. Whether a card is required is shown on the signup page and in the console (community reports say it is not).
reducto-150-free-usage.value: $150 of usage on the Standard pay-as-you-go tier
reducto-150-free-usage.content: Reducto is a document platform built for agents: Parse (PDFs, images, tables, scans to structured text), Extract (schema-based field extraction), Split, Classify and Edit, with 30+ file types and no page limits. Its pricing page, read on 2026-11-20, states the Standard pay-as-you-go plan includes "Free $150 in free usage". After that, list rates apply: r-1 mini Parse $1 per 1,000 pages, r-1 Parse $10, Extract $20, Deep Extract and Deep Split $40, Classify $7.50. The same page offers a Startup Program (under $15M funding, under $3M revenue, under 50 employees) with migration credits and discounted Growth pricing.
reducto-150-free-usage.conditions: The Standard tier includes $150 of free usage at signup and then switches to metered billing rather than a fixed subscription. The pricing page states no end date. The credit's validity period and whether a card is required are not stated on the pricing page, so check the console. The Startup Program requires an application and eligibility review.
steps: Sign up at reducto.ai/pricing or app.reducto.ai
Create an API key and confirm $150 of usage is available on the Standard tier
Parse one PDF and check that pages are deducted from the balance
Decide before the balance runs out; do not add a card just to keep the trial
reducto-150-free-usage.risk: The $150 is usage credit, not cash, and deep extraction burns it quickly. No validity period or card requirement is published, so the console is the source of truth. Parsing accuracy still needs spot checks, and confidential documents raise data-retention questions.
reducto-150-free-usage.source: Reducto official pricing page (read 2026-11-20, states "Free $150 in free usage") plus the perq.sh AI credits directory, re-checked 2026-11-19 against the same page

lindy-50-free-credits.title: [Global] Lindy: $50 in free credits at signup (valid 7 days)
lindy-50-free-credits.highlight: An automation and AI-teammate platform whose Free plan starts with $50 in credits. Connect Slack, email, calendar and 3,000+ integrations and run scheduled routines; the credits expire after 7 days and nothing converts to paid on its own.
lindy-50-free-credits.regions: [Global] Email or Google sign-in. The Free plan is listed at $0 with no credit card.
lindy-50-free-credits.content: Lindy pitches itself as an AI teammate: mention it in a Slack thread and it works, with scheduled routines, meeting notes and prep, inbox management, voice-matched drafts, computer use on paid plans, 3,000+ integrations and MCP. Its pricing page, read on 2026-11-20, lists the Free plan as $0 with "$50 in credits for free" and "Free credits last 7 days". Paid Team plans start at $29.99/month for 3,000 credits, with top-ups at $10 per 1,000 credits. The FAQ says the free week is one-time per teammate and nothing is charged when it ends.
lindy-50-free-credits.conditions: A new account gets $50 in credits on the Free plan, usable within 7 days. The free week is one-time per teammate and does not reset. Actions with outside effects (sending email, updating tickets, posting messages) wait for approval by default. The Free plan is listed at $0 and the signup page does not ask for a card, though the signup flow is the final word.
steps: Open lindy.ai/pricing and choose Try for free with email or Google
Mention it in Slack or build one automation in the web app
Connect a read-only source such as a calendar and run it once
Spend the credits on a workflow you actually need before the 7 days end, and confirm no card is on file
lindy-50-free-credits.risk: The credits last only 7 days and do not roll over, so this is a one-shot trial. Tool calls and automations burn credits fast. Paid plans start at $29.99/month, so keep payment details off the account, and review approval settings before letting it touch anyone's inbox or calendar.
lindy-50-free-credits.source: Lindy official pricing page (read 2026-11-20: "$50 in credits for free", "Free credits last 7 days") plus perq.sh directory, re-checked 2026-11-19

keenable-100k-search-free.title: [Global] Keenable search API: 100,000 free requests a month, no card ($4 per 1,000 after)
keenable-100k-search-free.highlight: A realtime search and page-fetch API for AI agents with 100,000 free requests per organisation per month and no card required. Overage is $4 per 1,000 requests (about $400 a month at list price), and an official MCP server plugs into Claude Code or Codex.
keenable-100k-search-free.regions: [Global] Sign up and use the free allowance, which resets monthly per organisation. A card is only needed to buy credits or turn on auto top-up.
keenable-100k-search-free.value: 100,000 requests a month ($4 per 1,000 beyond that)
keenable-100k-search-free.content: Keenable sells search and fetch to AI agents and says version 1.0 reached first place on the Artificial Analysis Search Index. Its pricing page, read on 2026-11-20, states every organisation gets 100,000 free requests a month with no credit card: create an API key in the console and the allowance is live. After that, pay-as-you-go is $4 per 1,000 requests, and labs or inference platforms at 100+ RPS pay $1 per 1,000 on dedicated capacity. One search or fetch is one credit, with search.realtime, search.pro, fetch and fetch.live all costing one credit each, and every response reports its own usage. The MCP server at api.keenable.ai/mcp and the CLI draw on the same allowance, and keyless use runs on a shared public pool of 1,000 requests per hour per IP.
keenable-100k-search-free.conditions: The allowance is 100,000 requests a month per organisation and resets on the day the organisation was created. An API key allows 10 requests per second with no hourly cap. Past the allowance, /v1/search returns 402 until credits are bought or the allowance resets. No card is needed for the free tier; buying credits or enabling auto top-up requires one. Academic and startup programs are separate applications.
steps: Open keenable.ai/pricing, choose Get Free 100K requests and create an organisation
Create an API key in the console; no card required
Run one /v1/search call using the quickstart at docs.keenable.ai
For Claude Code or Codex, connect the MCP server at https://api.keenable.ai/mcp
keenable-100k-search-free.risk: The allowance is per organisation, does not roll over and stops service with a 402 once used up. Result quality and any affiliate or sponsored links in results need checking before an agent relies on them. The terms state no end date, so the allowance could change at any time.
keenable-100k-search-free.source: Keenable official pricing page (read 2026-11-20, including the Free 100K requests tier and FAQ) plus perq.sh directory, re-checked 2026-11-19

neevcloud-1500-sandbox-min.title: [Global] NeevCloud: 1,500 free sandbox minutes every month for verified accounts (no card)
neevcloud-1500-sandbox-min.highlight: A free tier added in the November release: every verified account gets 1,500 sandbox minutes a month, fully covering sandboxes up to 2 vCPU / 4 GB with disk included, on templates that ship Claude Code, Codex CLI, opencode and OpenClaw.
neevcloud-1500-sandbox-min.regions: [Global] Requires account verification (individual KYC). The docs state no card is required.
neevcloud-1500-sandbox-min.value: 1,500 sandbox minutes a month (2 vCPU / 4 GB covered, disk included)
neevcloud-1500-sandbox-min.content: NeevCloud's November 2026 release notes (v0.8.1 to v0.9.0) add a free tier for Agentic Studio sandboxes: 1,500 sandbox minutes free each month, renewing monthly, for every verified account, and explicitly "no credit card is needed; completing account verification is enough". It applies to existing accounts too, and the console shows the remaining balance. Minutes are weighted by sandbox size: up to 2 vCPU / 4 GB is fully covered, smaller sandboxes burn fewer minutes and larger ones proportionally more, and disk inside the free tier is free. The platform also ships templates for OpenClaw, Claude Code, Codex CLI, opencode and Hermes, plus Docker and Playwright + Chromium templates, snapshots and an MCP endpoint.
neevcloud-1500-sandbox-min.conditions: The account must be verified (individual KYC; businesses have a separate flow). The 1,500 minutes reset monthly and do not accumulate. 2 vCPU / 4 GB is the covered size, and larger sandboxes draw down proportionally more. Idle sandboxes pause automatically and wake on the first request, and usage beyond the allowance is billed.
steps: Sign up at neevcloud.com and complete account verification (no card needed)
Open Agentic Studio, then Sandboxes, and confirm the 1,500-minute monthly allowance
Create a sandbox from a template such as Playwright + Chromium or Claude Code
Watch the remaining minutes in the console before committing to paid usage
neevcloud-1500-sandbox-min.risk: Minutes are weighted by size, so large sandboxes drain them quickly. KYC means handing over identity details. The allowance resets monthly with no carry-over, and sandboxes that pause still consume minutes while awake. The platform is young, so stability and retention policies deserve a look.
neevcloud-1500-sandbox-min.source: NeevCloud official November 2026 release notes (read 2026-11-20: "1,500 free sandbox minutes every month, for every verified account, no card required") plus perq.sh directory, re-checked 2026-11-19

freebuff-free-coding-agent.title: [Global] Freebuff: an ad-funded free coding agent with 100 Freebucks a day, no card or API key
freebuff-free-coding-agent.highlight: A free coding agent from the Codebuff team, launched on 19 November: terminal, desktop, mobile and web, with no API key and no credit card. Small text ads in the terminal pay for the models, and 100 Freebucks refill at midnight Pacific time.
freebuff-free-coding-agent.regions: [Global] The full model list covers 25+ countries. Elsewhere it drops to limited mode (DeepSeek V4 Flash only, six one-hour sessions a day), and a VPN can trigger that too.
freebuff-free-coding-agent.value: Free ($0, with 100 Freebucks a day; comparable to a $20/month coding agent)
freebuff-free-coding-agent.content: Freebuff is the free tier from the Codebuff team, released on 2026-11-19. Its site, read on 2026-11-20, says "The 100% free coding agent, $0 forever, unlimited usage" and states there is no card and no credits to watch, because text ads in the terminal fund the models. It runs as a CLI (npm install -g freebuff), desktop apps for macOS, Windows and Linux, iOS and Android apps, and in the browser, with threads kept in the cloud so work continues across devices. Models include DeepSeek v4, MiMo 2.5 Pro, GLM 5.2 and MiniMax M3, with Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite for file finding, and you can bring your own Claude key. The daily allowance is 100 Freebucks, refilled at midnight Pacific time and not rolled over; each model shows an hourly rate, so strong models burn a day's allowance in a few hours.
freebuff-free-coding-agent.conditions: 100 Freebucks a day, reset at midnight Pacific and not accumulated. The full model list is limited to 25+ countries; elsewhere limited mode offers only DeepSeek V4 Flash and six one-hour sessions a day. Text ads appear between agent turns, and the launch material says messages, traces and files may feed ad targeting while some models train on data (flagged in the model picker). A one-time login is required.
steps: Install with npm install -g freebuff, or download the desktop app from freebuff.com
Log in once, then open /model and pick a model without the training note
Give it one verifiable change in a small project
Continue the same thread from mobile or the web, remembering the daily reset
freebuff-free-coding-agent.risk: The price is privacy: the launch material admits messages, traces and files may feed ad targeting and some models train on data, so keep private code on a non-training model or your own key. Region limits can hide the best models, hourly rates drain the allowance quickly, and a brand-new service has no reliability record.
freebuff-free-coding-agent.source: Freebuff official site (read 2026-11-20: $0 forever, no card, ads pay for models) plus the DEV Community launch write-up (2026-11-19, with the 100 Freebucks and region rules)

opencode-go-glm500-usage.title: [Global] OpenCode Go: $10/month covers $500 of GLM-5.3 usage (through 11/22; Go Plus doubles it)
opencode-go-glm500-usage.highlight: Operation GLM phase two: the Go plan's monthly GLM-5.3 allowance is temporarily raised to $500 (from $200) and Go Plus to $1,000, for new and existing subscribers, with the official docs stating it runs only through 2026-11-22.
opencode-go-glm500-usage.regions: [Global] Built for international users. Subscribing through the OpenCode Console needs a payment method, and requests from China require setting Regions to Global in privacy settings.
opencode-go-glm500-usage.value: $500 of GLM-5.3 monthly usage on Go ($10/month); Go Plus pays $40 for $1,000
opencode-go-glm500-usage.content: OpenCode announced Operation GLM on 2026-11-17 with a phase one offer of $100 of GLM-5.3 usage for $10 on Go, then moved to phase two about eleven hours later: the same $10 covers $500 of GLM-5.3 usage, and Go Plus at $40 covers $1,000. The official Go docs, read on 2026-11-20, state "GLM-5.3: Higher usage limits apply through November 22, 2026". The $500 is the monthly ceiling the plan covers if you use only that model, not account balance; every paid model on Go draws on the same allowance, with 20% of the monthly allowance available per 5-hour window and 50% per week, resetting Mondays at 00:00 UTC. Subscribe on the OpenCode Console, then run /connect in OpenCode, choose OpenCode Go, paste the key and pick GLM-5.3 with /models, or call https://opencode.ai/inference/go directly.
opencode-go-glm500-usage.conditions: Requires an OpenCode Go ($10/month) or Go Plus ($40/month) subscription with a payment method. The raised allowance ends 2026-11-22 and then reverts. The $500 is a usage ceiling, not withdrawable balance. Limits are 20% per 5 hours and 50% per week, shared with other paid models. Users in China must set Regions to Global under Settings › Privacy to reach GLM-5.3.
steps: Sign in at opencode.ai/console, subscribe to Go, add billing details and copy the API key
Run /connect in OpenCode, choose OpenCode Go and paste the key
Select GLM-5.3 with /models and work normally
Use the allowance before 11/22 and cancel the subscription once it reverts if you do not need it
opencode-go-glm500-usage.risk: The $500 is a usage cap, not cash, and cannot be read as a 20% discount on real money. The 5-hour and weekly limits are real and heavy users will hit them, users report 529 errors at peak times, and the allowance drops after 11/22, so do not budget against it.
opencode-go-glm500-usage.source: OpenCode official Go docs (read 2026-11-20: "Higher usage limits apply through November 22, 2026") plus the official X phase-two announcement (2026-11-18) and reports from MoZhenZhen and AI Promo Now ($500 on Go, $1,000 on Go Plus)

exa-api-40-credits-codes.title: [Global] Exa search API: two stackable $20 codes plus $10 of free credit a month
exa-api-40-credits-codes.highlight: A semantic search API for agents. Redeem EXA20FREEBUFF and then EXA20FIRESHIP under Billing for $20 each on the same account, on top of the Free plan's $10 a month and a one-time $10 onboarding bonus.
exa-api-40-credits-codes.regions: [Global] New accounts. The official Free tier needs no card, though some accounts report being asked to verify a non-prepaid card before bonus credit is usable.
exa-api-40-credits-codes.value: $40 in codes plus $10 of free credit a month (another $10 in the first month)
exa-api-40-credits-codes.content: Exa provides semantic search for AI applications through Search, Contents and Answer endpoints, with Lite search around $4 per 1,000 requests. The official Starter tier gives every team $10 of credits a month, reset on the first of each month without rollover and with no payment method required, and completing onboarding adds a one-time $10, so the first month holds $20. Two creator and partner codes circulating in the community, EXA20FREEBUFF and EXA20FIRESHIP, were tested on 2026-11-03 and stacked on one account, taking the balance from $20 to $60 with no expiry shown in the dashboard; the older EXA50API stopped working and EXA50FIRESHIP hit its redemption limit. A NodeSeek post on 6 November records the same codes with reports that EXA50API had already failed for some.
exa-api-40-credits-codes.conditions: Both codes are creator or partner promotions rather than official pricing-page offers, so they can stop working or hit a limit at any time, once per team each. Some accounts must verify a non-prepaid card before bonus credit is usable. The $10 a month does not roll over. Codes show no expiry in the dashboard, though the official terms reserve the right to change them.
steps: Sign up at dashboard.exa.ai (no card needed)
Open Billing, redeem EXA20FREEBUFF, then EXA20FIRESHIP
Reload Billing to confirm the balance, then finish onboarding for the extra $10
Make one Search or Contents call; usage beyond the credits bills at list rates
exa-api-40-credits-codes.risk: Both codes are unofficial and can be withdrawn or capped. Some accounts hit a non-prepaid card check that virtual cards fail. The credits are API usage, not cash, and usage beyond the allowance bills at $4 per 1,000 requests.
exa-api-40-credits-codes.source: NodeSeek thread (2026-11-06, with the codes and failure reports) plus tahoo.tech testing (2026-11-03, two codes taking the balance from $20 to $60) and AIdeal's re-check of the official Free tier terms (2026-11-18)

gravatar-free-domain-1y.title: [Global] Gravatar: a free top-level domain for one year (.bio, .link, .social and more, usable as a Bluesky handle)
gravatar-free-domain-1y.highlight: Claim a .bio, .link or .social domain from your Gravatar account free for the first year, wired to redirect to your Gravatar profile, and usable as a Bluesky handle or a custom email address.
gravatar-free-domain-1y.regions: [Global] Any Gravatar (WordPress.com) account. No card required.
gravatar-free-domain-1y.value: A free domain for the first year (renews at $9+ a year)
gravatar-free-domain-1y.content: Gravatar's link-in-bio page, read on 2026-11-20, says it "Includes free custom domain for one year", offering .link, .bio, .social and other popular suffixes with "First year free (then $9+ per year)" and notes "Use it for your Bluesky handle too". The claim option sits at the top of the Gravatar dashboard or in the profile editor sidebar. Claimed domains get Smart Redirects, which point the domain at your Gravatar profile with no setup. Gravatar's support docs add that the domain can back a custom address such as hello@yourname.bio that forwards to your Gravatar email, while sending from that address needs a paid account.
gravatar-free-domain-1y.conditions: Free for the first year, then $9+ a year depending on the suffix, and an unpaid domain is released. A Gravatar or WordPress.com account is required. How many domains one account can claim depends on what the dashboard offers. Free-tier custom email only forwards mail; it cannot send.
steps: Sign in at gravatar.com and open the profile editor
Choose the claim-domain option at the top or in the sidebar
Pick an available suffix (.bio, .link, .social and others) and claim it
Confirm the redirect works, then set a reminder for the one-year renewal
gravatar-free-domain-1y.risk: Only the first year is free and the second is billed at $9+ a year, so a forgotten renewal costs money. The domain is tied to your Gravatar account, free-tier mail only forwards, and Gravatar labels the offer limited time.
gravatar-free-domain-1y.source: Gravatar official link-in-bio page (read 2026-11-20: "First year free (then $9+ per year)") plus Gravatar support docs on custom domains, Bluesky handles and email forwarding, and a linux.do thread from 2026-11-19

doubao-work-30day-sub.title: [China] Doubao Work: a 30-day subscription for new users on desktop, plus 8,800 credits for 30 days of check-ins
doubao-work-30day-sub.highlight: New users of the Doubao Work desktop app get a 30-day subscription with no card. Daily check-ins pay 200 credits (double on Mondays) with milestone bonuses, adding up to 8,800 over 30 days, more than the 8,400 a standard ¥68 plan includes.
doubao-work-30day-sub.regions: [China] Doubao and Doubao Work desktop apps on Windows and macOS. The entry point does not exist on mobile.
doubao-work-30day-sub.value: A 30-day standard subscription (¥68/month tier) plus 8,800 credits from 30 days of check-ins
doubao-work-30day-sub.content: Doubao Work, the AI agent office product under Doubao, shipped a 2026-11-12 update adding Kimi K3.1 Pro, GLM 5.3 and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash with credit multipliers shown per model, and a limited-time 0.01x rate on Doubao 2.1 Lite and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash. Alongside it Doubao offers two promotions: first-time users of the Doubao or Doubao Work desktop app can claim a 30-day free subscription covering everything except video generation and Pro models, and every user can check in daily for 200 credits, doubled to 400 on Mondays, with extra bonuses of 200, 500 and 1,300 credits at 500, 2,000 and 5,000 cumulative credits, totalling 8,800 over 30 consecutive days. Gift credits last 30 days, are spent first, and cannot be used on Pro models or video generation without a paid plan.
doubao-work-30day-sub.conditions: The 30-day subscription is only for new users who first sign in on desktop, with no entry point on mobile. Check-ins happen once a day from the desktop pop-up or the avatar menu and are not made up if missed, and Mondays pay double. Gift credits expire after 30 days. Unpaid accounts cannot spend gift credits on Pro models or video generation. The 0.01x rate and discount windows are limited-time and undated.
steps: Download Doubao Work for Windows or macOS and sign in with a phone number
Confirm the 30-day free subscription shows as active on the subscription page
Check in daily from the bottom-left pop-up, remembering Monday doubles
Run everyday tasks on the 0.01x models and use the gift credits within 30 days
doubao-work-30day-sub.risk: The promotion can change or end early, so the client's own display is the source of truth. Gift credits expire in 30 days and skip Pro models and video generation. A missed day delays milestone progress. The desktop entry point is China-only, so accounts elsewhere may not see it.
doubao-work-30day-sub.source: Tencent News and The Beijing News report on 2026-10-30 (official Doubao terms for the 30-day trial and the 8,800 check-in credits) plus National Business Daily on the 2026-11-12 update and an mmmy.net hands-on post on 2026-11-13

quilter-invest-isa-100.title: [UK] Quilter Invest: open an ISA with £1,000, hold it 4 months, get £100 cashback via TopCashback (≈$130)
quilter-invest-isa-100.highlight: Go through TopCashback, open a stocks and shares ISA, fund it with £1,000 and hold that balance for the four-month validation period to collect £100, a 10% cash bonus on the deposit, with market risk attached.
quilter-invest-isa-100.regions: [UK] UK residents aged 18+, with unused ISA allowance, new to Quilter Invest only
quilter-invest-isa-100.content: Quilter Invest is the investing app of Quilter, a FTSE 250 UK wealth manager. BeerMoneyUK, read on 2026-11-20 (listed three weeks ago, updated one week ago), records the offer: click through the cashback portal to sign up, open a stocks and shares ISA in the app, fund it with at least £1,000 within 30 days, and keep at least £1,000 in the account for the four-month validation period. The £100 is paid through TopCashback, usually within a month of validation. The page also suggests joining TopCashback first to collect its new-member bonus on top.
quilter-invest-isa-100.conditions: New Quilter Invest customers only, UK residents aged 18+ with ISA allowance left. At least £1,000 must be funded within 30 days of opening and stay in the account for four months. Click through from the cashback portal in the same browser session with ad blockers off, one cashback per person, and no unlisted promo codes. Capital is at risk and platform and fund fees apply.
steps: Join TopCashback UK first to stack its new-member bonus
Click Get This Offer on the activity page to reach Quilter through the portal
Open the stocks and shares ISA in the Quilter Invest app and check the cashback tracks
Fund £1,000 within 30 days, hold it four months, and pick a lower-risk portfolio if the £100 is the point
quilter-invest-isa-100.risk: The £1,000 is invested and four months of market movement can wipe out £100, with platform and fund fees on top. It uses £1,000 of this year's ISA allowance, which only resets on 6 April. Cashback frequently fails to track, so check the tracked status before funding. UK residents only.
quilter-invest-isa-100.source: BeerMoneyUK listing (read 2026-11-20, with the funding and four-month validation terms) plus Quilter Invest's own in-app ISA process

webull-uk-5-free-shares.title: [UK] Webull UK: deposit £500 for 60 days for 5 free fractional shares (mostly about $3 each, up to $300)
webull-uk-5-free-shares.highlight: New Webull UK customers who deposit £500 in one go and hold it for 60 days can claim five US fractional shares in the Rewards centre, each worth $3 to $300, plus 12 months of Nasdaq TotalView Level 2 and a 90-day commission-free card.
webull-uk-5-free-shares.regions: [UK] New Webull UK customers only, with UK identity verification and a local bank deposit
webull-uk-5-free-shares.value: 5 fractional shares (about $15 in practice; $3-$300 each, mostly the low end)
webull-uk-5-free-shares.content: BeerMoneyUK, read on 2026-11-20 (listed three weeks ago), records Webull UK's new-customer offer. After signing up and verifying identity you must opt in manually under Menu → Promotion Centre, then make a single deposit of at least £500 (splitting it does not count, and transferring shares in does), hold it for 60 consecutive days, and claim five US fractional shares from My Rewards within 30 days. Each share is worth $3 to $300, but community reports say most people get roughly $3 Apple shares, about £11 in total. The offer also includes 12 months of free Nasdaq TotalView Level 2 data, a 90-day UK shares and ETFs commission-free card for a GIA or ISA, and, with options enabled, 90 days of commission-free contracts up to 100 plus 30 days of OPRA real-time data. The campaign asks for the deposit by 2027-03-31.
webull-uk-5-free-shares.conditions: New Webull UK customers only, and opting in under Promotion Centre is mandatory. A single deposit of at least £500 must stay for 60 consecutive days, with withdrawals allowed as long as they do not exceed what was deposited. Rewards must be claimed within 30 days of becoming available or they expire, and each share's value is random with most at the low end.
steps: Sign up through the offer page and verify identity in the Webull app
Opt in under Menu → Promotion Centre before depositing, or there is no reward
Deposit at least £500 in one go and leave it for 60 consecutive days
Claim the five shares in My Rewards within 30 days of them appearing
webull-uk-5-free-shares.risk: The five shares are random and most people get about $3 each, so do not expect anything near the $1,500 headline. Forgetting to opt in or to claim within 30 days wastes the 60-day hold. The £500 is locked for 60 days, investing carries risk, and a throwaway account brings idle-fee and tax-reporting chores.
webull-uk-5-free-shares.source: BeerMoneyUK listing (read 2026-11-20, covering the opt-in, the single £500 deposit, the 60-day hold and the $3-$300 range with most near $3) plus Webull's own new-customer terms

coop-bank-switch-200.title: [UK] Co-op Bank switch: £125 upfront plus 3×£25 (up to £200)
coop-bank-switch-200.highlight: Move a full external account into Co-op Bank's Standard Current Account or Everyday Extra with CASS, deposit £1,500, keep 2 direct debits, make 5 card payments and register for online banking within 30 days to get £125 within 7 days; keep the same activity for 3 more months for another £25 each month, up to £200
coop-bank-switch-200.regions: [UK] UK residents only; anyone who took a Co-op switching bonus since 1 Nov 2022 is excluded
coop-bank-switch-200.content: Be Clever With Your Cash and Moneyfactscompare (checked 18 Nov 2026) confirm the new Co-op Bank switch offer: new customers opening a Standard Current Account or Everyday Extra, or existing holders of a qualifying account, complete a full CASS switch and get £125 within 7 days, in time for Christmas. Then, for three more months, keep depositing at least £1,500 a month, keep at least 2 active direct debits and make at least 5 debit card payments to receive another £25 per month, capped at a further £75 and £200 in total.
coop-bank-switch-200.conditions: UK residents only; a full CASS switch (old account closed); deposit at least £1,500 within 30 days, set up 2 active direct debits, make 5+ debit card payments and register for online banking; repeat the same activity for 3 further months; not valid if you took a Co-op switching bonus since 1 Nov 2022.
steps: Apply for the Standard Current Account or Everyday Extra on Co-op Bank's site
Move your main external account across with CASS
Within 30 days deposit £1,500, set 2 direct debits, make 5 card payments, register for online banking
After £125 lands, keep the activity for 3 more months to collect £25 each month
coop-bank-switch-200.risk: The £125 pays in one go but the three £25 payments depend on keeping up the activity, so stopping the card spend or direct debits loses them; CASS closes your old account, so check salary and subscriptions move cleanly; banks may refuse serial switchers.
coop-bank-switch-200.source: Moneyfactscompare (18 Nov 2026) + Be Clever With Your Cash November switching round-up (read 18 Nov 2026)

uq-mobile-sim-debut-20000.title: [Japan] UQ mobile SIM-only switch: ¥20,000 au PAY back (≈$130)
uq-mobile-sim-debut-20000.highlight: Port in from any carrier except au or povo and take a SIM or eSIM only (no handset), choosing Komikomi Plan Value or Tokutoku Plan 2 plus the Data Increase Option II, and ¥20,000 of au PAY balance arrives in one payment the month after activation; lifted from ¥15,000 on 17 Sep 2026 with the spend requirement removed
uq-mobile-sim-debut-20000.regions: [Japan] Japanese address and ID verification required; ports from au and povo are excluded
uq-mobile-sim-debut-20000.content: UQ mobile's official SIM Debut campaign (cross-checked with Selectra, 10 Nov 2026, and Mynavi, 19 Nov 2026): since the 17 Sep 2026 revision the reward is a flat ¥20,000-equivalent (pre-tax) au PAY balance, the old requirement to spend ¥15,000 in au PAY the following month is gone, and the two-part payout became one. Conditions are an MNP port from outside au/povo, SIM or eSIM only, a qualifying plan and the Data Increase Option II added in the same order; payment arrives from late the month after activation. The online store charges a ¥3,850 admin fee, leaving about ¥16,150 (≈$105) net.
uq-mobile-sim-debut-20000.conditions: Live in Japan with ID verification; MNP port from a carrier other than au or povo; SIM or eSIM only (buying a handset disqualifies); choose Komikomi Plan Value or Tokutoku Plan 2; add the Data Increase Option II (¥550/mo, free for 7 months) in the same order; activate by the end of the month after applying; one per line, and previous au PAY cashback recipients may be excluded.
steps: Confirm your current number is not on au or povo
Order SIM-only or eSIM-only on UQ mobile's online store with Komikomi Plan Value or Tokutoku Plan 2
Tick the Data Increase Option II during checkout
Activate by the end of the month after applying
Log in to the au PAY app with that line's au ID and collect the ¥20,000 from late next month
uq-mobile-sim-debut-20000.risk: The reward is au PAY balance, not cash, so it can only be spent at au PAY merchants; the Data Increase Option II costs ¥550 a month after 7 free months, so cancel it; new lines from 1 Oct 2025 carry a ¥1,100 cancellation fee within a year and UQ states repeat short-term churn stops payouts; ¥20,000 is a maximum and missing the option pays nothing.
uq-mobile-sim-debut-20000.source: UQ mobile official SIM Debut campaign page + Selectra (read 10 Nov 2026) + Mynavi SimSim World (19 Nov 2026)

ahamo-mnp-20000-points.title: [Japan] ahamo port-in: 20,000 d points, 4,000 × 5 months (≈$130)
ahamo-mnp-20000-points.highlight: Port your number in from another carrier and take a SIM or eSIM only, entering the campaign with the same d account you apply with and activating by the end of the following month, to receive 20,000 d points (period- and use-restricted) paid as 4,000 points a month over 5 months
ahamo-mnp-20000-points.regions: [Japan] Japanese residency, a d account and ID verification; moves inside docomo or new numbers are excluded
ahamo-mnp-20000-points.content: ahamo's official port-in d-points campaign (cross-checked with Naruhayanet, 17 Nov 2026, Mynavi, 14 Nov 2026, and DX Magazine, 19 Nov 2026): MNP customers taking SIM or eSIM only, who enter the campaign first with the same d account they apply with, get 20,000 d points paid as 4,000 a month over five months, each instalment valid 94 days. ahamo-mnp-20000-points.conditions: Live in Japan with ID verification; MNP port from another carrier with SIM or eSIM only (buying a handset disqualifies); enter and apply with the same d account; enter in the month before or the month of activation and activate by the end of the month after entry; moves inside docomo, new numbers and adding the JAL Mobile option are excluded; points are restricted and you must be a d POINT CLUB member.
steps: Enter the campaign with the d account you will use for ahamo and screenshot the confirmation
Get an MNP reservation number from your current carrier (one-stop carriers need none)
Apply on ahamo.com choosing SIM-only and porting in (MNP) with the same d account
Activate by the end of the month after entry
From late the second month after activation, check d POINT CLUB for 4,000 points a month

ahamo-mnp-20000-points.source: ahamo official campaign terms + Naruhayanet (read 17 Nov 2026) + Mynavi SimSim World (14 Nov 2026) + DX Magazine (19 Nov 2026)

ymobile-parent-child-discount.regions: [Japan] Japanese residency; a 5–18 year old user and their family; ports from SoftBank, LINEMO and LINE Mobile are excluded from parts of the offer

ymobile-parent-child-discount.conditions: Japanese residency and ID verification; the user must be 5–18 years old (family members share the boost); new sign-up or MNP to Simple 3 M/L; the 12-month discount starts the month after applying and ends from month 14; the PayPay Card discount requires paying with a PayPay Card and completing PayPay KYC plus Yahoo! JAPAN ID linking; ports from SoftBank, LINEMO and LINE Mobile are excluded from the SIM cashback.
steps: Prepare ID for the 5–18 year old user and a payment method
Order Simple 3 M/L as a new line or MNP on Y!mobile's official online store or Yahoo! store
Link the PayPay Card and Yahoo! JAPAN ID as prompted
After activation confirm the bill drops by ¥1,100 with tax from the next month
Apply separately for the Hikari set discount or SIM cashback if you want them stacked

ymobile-parent-child-discount.source: SoftBank official press release (16 Nov 2026) + Mynavi SimSim World November round-up (read 19 Nov 2026)

Pull the discount code from the LINE menu
Order the Japan eSIM 1GB / 1 day plan on the site
Enter the code at checkout and confirm the total is ¥0
Receive the eSIM QR code by email and install it

codex-students-100.title: [US/Canada] Codex for Students: $100 of credits (2,500 credits, valid 12 months)

codex-students-100.regions: [US/Canada] Current students at degree-granting universities in the US or Canada, residing there at claim time; French students have a separate €50 UNiDAYS offer
codex-students-100.content: OpenAI's Help Center terms for Codex credits for Students (cross-checked with llmperks on 12 Nov 2026, TopUseAI on 3 Nov 2026 and gptx on 8 Nov 2026): the $100 appears as 2,500 credits on the usage page and is spent once the plan's own Codex allowance runs out, without upgrading the plan. One per student, non-transferable, and the official flow is SheerID verification rather than a code, so any "student promo code" is not genuine. codex-students-100.conditions: Current student at a degree-granting university in the US or Canada, living there when claiming; verify with a school email through SheerID; a ChatGPT account on Free, Go, Plus or Pro; one per student and non-transferable; credits expire 12 months after the grant; not API credits, and students outside the US and Canada (including mainland China) cannot pass verification.
steps: Sign in to your own ChatGPT account (the free plan works)
Open the Codex for University Students page and press Claim now
Complete SheerID verification with your school email
The credits are added to your personal workspace automatically
Check the Codex usage page for 2,500 credits

Claim the €50 OpenAI offer on UNiDAYS
Sign in to ChatGPT with the same email
Check the usage page to confirm the credits arrived

google-ai-studio-monthly-credits.title: [Global] Google AI Studio: monthly Cloud credits for subscribers, $10 on Pro and $40/$100 on Ultra

google-ai-studio-monthly-credits.regions: [Global] Requires a Google AI Pro or Ultra subscription (regional availability per the plan page); primary subscriber only, not shareable with family
google-ai-studio-monthly-credits.value: $120 a year on Pro ($480–$1,200 on Ultra)
google-ai-studio-monthly-credits.content: Google's official blog (13 Nov 2026) and the Google Developer Program benefits and FAQ pages (checked through duckssi, 18 Nov 2026): monthly cloud credits that used to be claimed across several sites now sit in AI Studio's left-hand menu. Grants scale with the plan ($10 on Pro, $40 on Ultra 5x, $100 on Ultra 20x), each is valid 12 months from issue and rolls over monthly, and nothing is backdated, so credits only start once a developer profile exists. google-ai-studio-monthly-credits.conditions: A Google AI Pro or Ultra subscriber with a Google Developer Program profile in AI Studio; primary subscriber only, not shareable; no backdating of earlier months; at least $5 prepaid balance to draw on the Gemini API; each grant valid 12 months, earliest expiry first; the free developer tier gets no monthly credits.
steps: Open Google AI Studio with the account holding the Pro or Ultra plan
Go to the credits page in the left menu and create or link your Developer Program profile
Link a Cloud billing account and claim the current month's credits
Prepay at least $5 before calling the Gemini API
Return each month to claim the new grant and watch the 12-month expiry order

google-ai-studio-monthly-credits.source: Google official blog (13 Nov 2026) + Google Developer Program benefits and FAQ (checked via duckssi, 18 Nov 2026)

telnyx-pretrial-25-ai.regions: [Global] Email sign-up; credits cover AI products only, voice and messaging need a full account with identity checks
telnyx-pretrial-25-ai.content: Telnyx pricing and account-upgrade docs (cross-checked with Cekura on 2 Nov 2026, AgentPhone on 18 Nov 2026 and aipromonow on 14 Nov 2026): a new account starts on the Pretrial tier with $25 of AI credits and one US local number, no card required, usable for Inference and AI Assistants. telnyx-pretrial-25-ai.conditions: Email sign-up, no card needed; AI products only, voice and messaging need an upgrade with verification; no top-ups on Pretrial and usage stops at zero; a full account replaces the $25 with $5; the credit has an expiry, shown in the console.
steps: Open telnyx.com/sign-up and register with an email or Google/Microsoft account
Click the magic login link in the email (no password needed)
Confirm $25 of AI credits and one US number in the console
Create an API key and point the base URL at https://api.telnyx.com/v2/ai/openai
Pick a model and call it; do not upgrade before the credit runs down

telnyx-pretrial-25-ai.source: Telnyx official pricing and account-upgrade docs, cross-checked with Cekura (2 Nov 2026), AgentPhone (18 Nov 2026) and aipromonow (14 Nov 2026)

infomaniak-ai-1m-credits.regions: [Switzerland/Global] Swiss-hosted; a credit card is required and regional limits follow the site

Open the AI Services getting-started guide and the AI Services console

easysim-free-1gb-esim.title: [Global] EasySIM: free 1GB eSIM for 190+ countries (one per phone number, while stocks last)
easysim-free-1gb-esim.highlight: Archived: as of 2026-11-22 the claim page at love.easysim.ai/claim still advertises the free 1GB eSIM, but pressing Claim posts to /claim/process-welcome and returns 405 Method Not Allowed, so the page only shows a generic "Network error" and the flow cannot complete; the detail page stays for reference with alternatives listed on top
easysim-free-1gb-esim.regions: [Global] 190+ countries; one claim per phone number
easysim-free-1gb-esim.content:
EasySIM's official claim page (love.easysim.ai/claim, read 20 Nov 2026) shows "Free 1GB eSIM / Travel data for 190+ countries / One claim per phone number. Offer valid while supplies last." Arabic-language coverage (khabr.news, 17 and 19 Nov 2026) describes the same path: download the app from easysim.ai and activate the free data through love.easysim.ai/claim. The validity period and the exact country list are not on the claim page and appear only inside the app.

Archive note (2026-11-22): rechecked after a visitor reported it dead, and the claim endpoint no longer works. https://love.easysim.ai/claim itself still returns 200 and still shows "Free 1GB eSIM / Travel data for 190+ countries" with the claim form, but pressing Claim sends a JSON POST to /claim/process-welcome (with the page CSRF token and Referer) and the server answers 405 Method Not Allowed (response header allow: GET, HEAD) with an HTML error page. The page script then fails to parse JSON and only shows the generic "Network error. Please try again.", so visitors never see the real cause and cannot finish the claim. Requesting the same path with GET falls back to the claim page, so the route now takes GET/HEAD only. The offer is therefore treated as dead and moved to the archive pending an official fix; neither easysim.ai nor the love.easysim.ai home page lists another claim entry point.
easysim-free-1gb-esim.conditions: [Since 2026-11-22 the claim endpoint returns 405 and the claim cannot be completed; archived] Install the EasySIM app and register with a phone number; one claim per phone number; limited quantity, ends when supplies do; the eligible countries and validity days are shown only on the in-app activation page.
steps: Download the EasySIM app from easysim.ai
Register and activate with your phone number
Open love.easysim.ai/claim
Confirm destination and validity in the app, then install the eSIM
easysim-free-1gb-esim.risk: Archived as expired: on 2026-11-22 the claim endpoint at love.easysim.ai/claim returned 405 Method Not Allowed, so submitting always ends in "Network error" and the offer is dead for now - do not bother trying. Historic risks remain: the claim page never stated validity or covered countries, "while supplies last" means it can stop at any time, and a new brand with little track record deserves minimal personal data.
easysim-free-1gb-esim.source: EasySIM official claim page (read 20 Nov 2026) + khabr.news coverage (17 and 19 Nov 2026) + our own endpoint test on 22 Nov 2026 (405 Method Not Allowed)

zcode-daily-build-cards.title: [Global/China] ZCode nightly card: 300M GLM-5.3-Flash tokens on weekdays, 500M at weekends (no card)

zcode-daily-build-cards.regions: [Global/China] BigModel login in China, Z.ai abroad; tokens work only inside the ZCode client
zcode-daily-build-cards.value: 300M tokens a night (500M at weekends), roughly $10 of compute
zcode-daily-build-cards.content: iGetoken's standing campaign page (from 12 Nov 2026) and allagent.wiki's daily free-quota posts (14 and 16 Nov) agree: ZCode turned GLOBAL BUILD into a daily card on 27 Oct, claimed from the client's lower-left corner from 19:00, active at 23:00 and zeroed at 09:00 (weekend cards carry 500M and last to Monday 09:00), with no accumulation and no stacking between cards. After claiming you must switch the channel to Global Building (Start Plan) and keep the model on GLM-5.3-Flash, or your paid plan quota is charged instead. ZCode's official docs also list a new-user Free Trial Quota: five days after linking BigModel with 3M GLM-5.3 and 5M GLM-5.3-Flash tokens a day. zcode-daily-build-cards.conditions: Install the ZCode client (official notes say versions below 3.10 have no claim entry); any signed-in user, including free accounts, with no card; cards appear at 19:00, activate at 23:00 and expire at 09:00; switch to the Global Building channel and GLM-5.3-Flash after claiming; tokens cannot be exported as API; concurrency is capped at 3 tasks.
steps: Download and update ZCode from zcode.z.ai
Sign in and claim the day's GLOBAL BUILD card in the lower-left corner
Wait for the tokens to land at 23:00
Switch the model channel to Global Building and pick GLM-5.3-Flash
Confirm in Settings > Usage stats that usage is not hitting the paid plan

kiro-students-year-1000.regions: [Global] Universities on the official list (expanded to 133 schools across 16+ countries on 28 Oct 2026); students 18 or older, checked one school at a time from the dropdown
kiro-students-year-1000.content:
Kiro, AWS's agentic IDE, has run Kiro for Students since March 2026 and added another 41 schools on 28 October 2026, bringing the list to 133 universities (ASU, CMU and several Cal State campuses in the US, City of Glasgow College in the UK, Binus in Indonesia, plus new schools in Australia, India and Europe). The tier matches the paid plans: premium models, Kiro Web and Kiro Crew, not just the five open-weight models on the free tier. kiro-students-year-1000.conditions: Enrolled at a school on the official dropdown and 18 or older; SheerID asks for name, date of birth and university email, and may request a student ID or enrolment letter; verification can only be done once, so enter the details correctly; credits do not roll over and add-on credits cannot be bought; the account downgrades to Kiro Free after a year.
steps: Sign in at kiro.dev with Google, GitHub or AWS Builder ID (not the organization option)
Open Settings > Students, pick your university and press verify
Complete SheerID with your name, date of birth and university email, uploading a student ID if asked
Once the tier shows Kiro Students, this month's 1,000 credits are available

google-flow-daily-50-credits.title: [Global] Google Flow gives 50 free credits a day: five 8-second Veo 3.1 Lite videos without a subscription
google-flow-daily-50-credits.highlight: Google's own help centre states every account gets 50 Flow credits a day with or without a subscription; Veo 3.1 Lite costs 10 credits for an 8-second 720p clip, so that is five clips and about 40 seconds of footage a day, plus Nano Banana storyboard images, with no card
google-flow-daily-50-credits.regions: [Global] 18+ in a region on the Google Flow support list (Japan and the US are included; mainland China is not, so a working network path is needed)
google-flow-daily-50-credits.content:
Google Flow is the AI film-making tool inside Gemini. The official help page "Manage your Google Flow credits" (updated November 2026) states that every account receives 50 Google Flow credits a day whether or not it has a subscription, refreshed by the first generation of the day, with unused credits not carried over.

What the free tier can run: Veo 3.1 Lite (4, 6 or 8 seconds at 720p, 10 credits each) and Omni Flash 1.2 (1 credit per second at 360p, 3 per second at 720p, up to 10 seconds), plus image generation and the Flow agent. That makes the daily 50 worth five 8-second Lite clips, or one 720p 10-second Omni Flash clip (30 credits) plus extras. Free users may be blocked from video generation during the 14:00-17:00 UTC peak; images keep working.

Workspace Business Starter/Standard/Plus and Education Standard/Plus plans also include 50 credits a day at no extra charge.
google-flow-daily-50-credits.conditions: Age-verified 18+; the account must be in a supported region; the 50 credits reset daily and unused ones are lost; video generation can be throttled for free users at peak while images are unaffected; extra AI credits cannot be bought in Japan and some other regions.
steps: Open Google Flow (labs.google/flow) with a Google account
In the prompt box settings confirm the model is Veo 3.1 Lite or Omni Flash 1.2 and check its credit cost
Generate storyboard images first and pick the good frames before spending credits on video
Spend the day's credits before midnight since they do not carry over
google-flow-daily-50-credits.risk: 50 credits a day go fast on serious work; Veo 3.1 Fast, Veo 3.1 Quality and Omni Flash 1.1 retire on 5 December 2026, so older tutorials pick models that will be gone; free users are throttled during the 22:00-01:00 Beijing peak.
