yepapi-5-free-credit.title: [Global] YepAPI: $5 of credit on sign-up with no card, one key for 190 data endpoints and 139 LLMs
yepapi-5-free-credit.highlight: Sign up with Google or GitHub and $5 lands immediately with no card; one API key reaches 184-190 endpoints across SERP, scraping, YouTube, TikTok, Reddit and X data from $0.01 a call, failed calls are free and the balance never expires
yepapi-5-free-credit.regions: [Global] English site, sign-up with Google or GitHub; the AI model endpoints unlock after your first top-up
yepapi-5-free-credit.content:
YepAPI is a unified pay-per-call API: one x-api-key covers 184-190 data endpoints (Google SERP, keywords, backlinks, scraping, Amazon, Walmart, Reddit, X, TikTok and YouTube data) plus 139 chat models and 147 image, video and audio models. Pricing is per call — $0.01 per 10 SERP results, keyword research from $0.03 — with no monthly fee, no minimum and no charge for failed requests.

Sign-up includes $5 of credit (stated in both the FAQ and the docs, no card needed); model endpoints open only after a first top-up, so the $5 mainly covers the data APIs. An @yepapi/mcp server and llms.txt let it plug into Claude Code or Cursor as an MCP tool.
yepapi-5-free-credit.conditions: One $5 credit per account and no recurring free tier; model endpoints require a top-up first; the balance never expires but cannot be withdrawn; bulk multi-account sign-ups may be flagged as abuse.
steps: Sign in at app.yepapi.com with Google or GitHub
Check the balance shows $5.00 and copy the key from Dashboard > API Keys
Call a /v1 endpoint with x-api-key or Bearer, starting with a $0.01 SERP or scrape call
Top up later if you want the LLM and media models
yepapi-5-free-credit.risk: The $5 is one-off and pay-per-call burns faster than a subscription; data endpoint quality and anti-bot stability vary by target; model endpoints need real money first, so $5 will not run a frontier LLM.
yepapi-5-free-credit.source: Visitor submission (Gmail 2026-11-20 09:01) + YepAPI official site and docs (Authentication, llms.txt) read 2026-11-20 + aifree.dev verification page (2026-11-15)

hellomobile-foreigner-180k-naverpay.highlight: The foreigner-only "data worry-free USIM 7GB" is 22,900 won a month, and self-activating at a direct store pays 180,000 won of Naver Pay (30,000 a month for 6 months), with another 90,000 won from a friend's referral — up to 270,000 won (about $186) — and both USIM and eSIM activation fees waived

hellomobile-foreigner-180k-naverpay.value: 180,000 won Naver Pay (about $124) plus 15 GB a month
hellomobile-foreigner-180k-naverpay.content:
LG HelloVision's Hello Mobile launched a foreigner-only plan on 18 November 2026 with self-activation at direct stores and no phone call to an agent. The headline plan, "data worry-free USIM 7GB", is 22,900 won a month (7 GB at full speed then unlimited at 3 Mbps), and the store promotion adds 15 GB a month (10 GB for activation plus 5 GB for the friend referral).

Direct-store promotion: self-activate any plan of 15,900 won or more with the promo code and everyone gets 180,000 won of Naver Pay (30,000 a month for six months); joining through a friend's referral link adds 90,000 won (15,000 a month for six months), for up to 270,000 won. hellomobile-foreigner-180k-naverpay.conditions: An Alien Registration Card with 30+ days of stay, a Korean card in your own name and the simple-auth app are required; the promo code must be entered during self-activation and cannot be added later; Naver Pay is paid over six months and may stop if you cancel early; the 90,000 won referral requires joining through the referral link.
steps: Buy a Hello Mobile USIM or eSIM at a direct store, convenience store or Coupang
Go to direct.lghellovision.net, pick a plan of 15,900 won or more and enter the promo code
Pass simple authentication, the Alien Registration Card check and your own-name card check
Register for the payout after activation so Naver Pay arrives monthly
Join through a friend's referral link to add another 90,000 won
hellomobile-foreigner-180k-naverpay.risk: An Alien Registration Card is mandatory, so short-stay tourists cannot use it; Naver Pay is split over six months and later instalments may be lost on early cancellation; the unlimited part is throttled to 3 Mbps; using someone else's Korean card breaches the terms.

paypay-super-matsuri-scratch-2026.title: [Japan] Super PayPay Festival 2026: scratch cards up to a full refund (20 Nov - 27 Dec), better odds with PayPay Credit, guaranteed wins with tap-to-pay
paypay-super-matsuri-scratch-2026.highlight: Live today: pay 200 yen or more in one go with PayPay and a scratch card appears — first prize refunds the whole amount, second 5%, third 0.5%; balance payments win one time in four, PayPay Credit or PayPay Card one in two, and PayPay Card through Apple Pay or Google Pay tap-to-pay always wins; referrals pay 500 points each
paypay-super-matsuri-scratch-2026.regions: [Japan] Domestic stores and online merchants; requires completed PayPay eKYC, and PayPay Card needs PayPay Credit set up; overseas physical stores use the separate overseas scratch card
paypay-super-matsuri-scratch-2026.value: Up to a 100% refund (capped at 100,000 points per payment and per period)
paypay-super-matsuri-scratch-2026.content:
PayPay's official release of 12 November 2026 confirms the Super PayPay Festival starts on 20 November, with PayPay Scratch Cards running to 27 December 23:59. Pay 200 yen or more including tax at a participating store with PayPay or PayPay Card and a scratch card appears in the app: first prize refunds 100% of the payment, second 5%, third 0.5%, capped at 100,000 points per payment and across the whole period.

Odds depend on the payment method: PayPay balance (including the balance card and point part-payments) wins one time in four; PayPay Credit or PayPay Card one in two; PayPay balance with PayPay Bank's balance link set up also rises to one in two; and PayPay Card through Apple Pay or Google Pay tap-to-pay at a store always wins (the plastic card's tap does not count). Scratch cards expire 30 days after issue.

The festival also distributes PayPay Coupons and runs a PayPay Credit referral programme: the referred person opens a PayPay Card, sets up PayPay Credit and pays once during the period, and both sides get 500 points (referrers up to 10 people, 5,000 points).
paypay-super-matsuri-scratch-2026.conditions: Completed PayPay eKYC; PayPay Card payments require PayPay Credit to be set up first; payments must be 200 yen or more including tax, points-only payments do not count, and PayPay gift vouchers, PayPay Debit and other-card vouchers are excluded; wins are capped at 100,000 points per payment and per period; unused scratch cards expire after 30 days.
steps: Complete PayPay eKYC in the app (a My Number card is fastest, often same day)
Set up PayPay Credit, or add your PayPay Card to Apple Pay or Google Pay in the app
Pay 200 yen or more in one go at a store with the campaign poster and scratch the card on the spot
Use the points within 30 days before they expire
paypay-super-matsuri-scratch-2026.risk: The draw is not guaranteed and odds apply per scratch; raising your odds means opening a card and setting up credit, so do not spend more just to scratch; points cannot be withdrawn or transferred; overseas physical stores are excluded from this card.
paypay-super-matsuri-scratch-2026.source: PayPay official press release (2026-11-12) + PayPay Scratch Card campaign page (read 2026-11-20, campaign starts 20 Nov 00:00) + Kupomiru and nocash.news round-ups (2026-11-16)

Choose a location at checkout (Los Angeles DC03, San Jose and others) and confirm $15.98 a year
Log in with the root password from the email and run a system update first
Open a ticket to ask for doubled bandwidth, as NodeSeek reports
racknerd-black-friday-2026.risk: Cheap annual boxes are oversold, so neighbours can slow heavy workloads; international routing is unstable at peak, so anyone needing CN2 should look elsewhere; stock sells out between batches, so confirm the location and spec before paying.

altare-always-free-container.title: [Global] Altare Always Free: 6 GB RAM, 1.5 cores and 10 GB disk per team forever, up to 4 containers
altare-always-free-container.highlight: The help centre states the Always Free plan has no trial, no expiry and no card: 6 GB RAM, 1.5 cores, 10 GB disk and up to 4 servers, plus 10 GB of U3 object storage and 1 GB of KV; servers do not sleep when idle and can run Node, Bun, Python or Docker images
altare-always-free-container.regions: [Global] English site, email sign-up; mainland China connections sometimes hit 522 or registration errors, per NodeSeek reports
altare-always-free-container.value: 6 GB RAM / 150% CPU / 10 GB disk ($0, no expiry)
altare-always-free-container.content:
Altare hosts game servers, bots and small apps. Its help centre and Chinese site both state that every team starts on Always Free: 6 GB (6,144 MiB) of RAM, 150% CPU (1.5 cores), 10 GB of disk and 4 server slots, shared as one pool you split as you like, plus 10 GB of U3 object storage (5 buckets, 10 keys) and 1 GB of KV (3 million reads and 300,000 writes a month).

There is no trial, no expiry and no payment details, and servers do not sleep when nobody is online. Templates cover Minecraft (Paper, Forge, Vanilla, Sponge, BungeeCord), Rust, CS:GO, TF2 and ARK, plus Node.js, Bun and Python runtimes for bots and apps. More resources can be bought with bolts earned from daily rewards, AFK time and referrals, which is optional.
altare-always-free-container.conditions: One 6 GB/10 GB pool per team and multi-accounting is not allowed (each user can join at most 2 teams); long-running probes or mining have been banned in reported cases; containers only, so host mounts, privileged images and some port mappings are off-limits.
steps: Sign up at console.altare.gg with an email (no card needed)
Link Discord to collect bolts and daily rewards
Create one server and give it the full 6 GB and 10 GB, which is steadier than splitting
Pick a Node, Python or Minecraft template and avoid privileged containers
altare-always-free-container.risk: The host's disk is tight and free containers can be reclaimed; running probes or staying at full load has led to bans; it is not a full VPS, so privileged images and host mounts fail; registration sometimes returns 522 and needs retrying later.
altare-always-free-container.source: NodeSeek thread (2026-11-19, including "cannot register / 522" and probe-ban reports) + Altare official help on the Always Free plan and account creation (updated 2026-11-10, read 2026-11-20) + aijp/jizhiku hands-on test

uupay-new-user-1usdt-card.highlight: A virtual card costs 1 USDT to open and the system refunds the 1 USDT immediately, so the card is free; USDT top-ups on TRC-20, BEP-20 and ERC-20 all carry 0% fees, there is no monthly or annual fee, and referrals pay up to 50% (a limited-time offer with no stated end date)
uupay-new-user-1usdt-card.regions: [Global] uupay.com; tiered KYC accepting passport, ID card or driving licence, with Hong Kong, Macau, Taiwan and mainland Chinese documents on the supported list by platform risk checks; mainland ID KYC works but merchant compatibility is uneven
uupay-new-user-1usdt-card.value: 1 USDT opening fee refunded plus 0% top-up fees
uupay-new-user-1usdt-card.content:
UUPAY is a Hong Kong-registered crypto payment platform (Enterprise Square Three, Kowloon Bay) issuing USDT-funded Visa and Mastercard virtual and physical cards. Its official blog and promotions page describe the current offer: a new user opens a virtual card for 1 USDT and the system returns 1 USDT, making the card free; top-up fees are waived (TRC-20 in about a minute, BEP-20 in about 30 seconds, ERC-20 in 3-5 minutes) and the currency conversion fee is waived during the promotion; referring friends pays up to 50% commission.

U Card Radar (updated 2026-09-20) rates it tier D with a risk score of 40-49: virtual card 1 USDT with 1 USDT back and no monthly fee; physical card a 100 USDT issuance fee; transaction fees 0.9%-3%; ATM withdrawals 2.50 euros for sterling and 3 euros plus 1.5% for other currencies.
uupay-new-user-1usdt-card.conditions: Tiered KYC with an ID card, passport or driving licence and sometimes proof of address; the 1 USDT refund is once per new user; 0% top-up fees are a promotional policy with no published end date; whether the virtual card binds to Apple or Google Wallet and which merchants accept it depends on platform risk checks; the 100 USDT physical card does not qualify for the refund.
steps: Register with an email or phone number and complete KYC
Apply for the virtual card on the card page and pay the 1 USDT opening fee
Confirm the 1 USDT came back, then make a small USDT top-up to test
Bind a subscription you know is accepted, confirm it charges, and only then keep a balance
uupay-new-user-1usdt-card.risk: Crypto card platforms carry high risk (tier D on U Card Radar), so do not park large balances; funding depends on exchanges and chain congestion; KYC and merchant risk checks can tighten at any time; the "Black Friday" framing comes from the submission while the official page only says limited time, so the end date is unverified.
uupay-new-user-1usdt-card.source: Visitor submission (Gmail 2026-11-20 09:00, described as a Black Friday offer) + UUPAY official Chinese blog and promotions page (read 2026-11-20) + U Card Radar card page (updated 2026-09-20)

capital-one-360-checking-400.title: [US] Capital One 360 Checking: $400 bonus for two $500 direct deposits in 75 days (code MAKE400, ends Dec 9)
capital-one-360-checking-400.highlight: $400 for a new 360 Checking with code MAKE400 plus two $500+ direct deposits in 75 days; no monthly fee or minimum balance
capital-one-360-checking-400.regions: [US] US citizens or green-card holders with an address in the 50 states/DC, a US phone number and an SSN or ITIN
capital-one-360-checking-400.content: Capital One's 360 Checking sign-up bonus: open a new 360 Checking through the offer page with promo code MAKE400 by 23:59 ET on 2026-12-09, then receive two qualifying direct deposits of $500 or more each within 75 days of opening to earn $400. The account has no monthly fee, no minimum balance and no overdraft fee. A separate CHECKING250 tier ($250, no published deadline) has the same requirements and cannot be combined with MAKE400. The older GET400 landing page now shows as expired.
capital-one-360-checking-400.conditions: New customers only: you must not have held a 360 Checking, Simply Checking or Total Control Checking account (including Money Teen Checking) as a primary or secondary holder on or after 2024-01-01. The code MAKE400 must be entered at application, not added later. Qualifying direct deposits must be recurring payroll, pension or government-benefit ACH/real-time payments; internal transfers, wires and transfers started from the Capital One app do not count. The account must stay open and in good standing at payout. The offer is intended for its original recipient, so forwarded links are not guaranteed to pay.
steps: Apply online from the Capital One 360 Checking page with code MAKE400 before 23:59 ET on 2026-12-09 (US address, US phone number and SSN/ITIN required)
Link a US-licensed bank account and agree to paperless statements
Route payroll or government-benefit direct deposits there and collect two deposits of $500+ within 75 days
Watch for the bonus after the deposit window (up to 60 more days) and keep the account open until it posts

onepay-50-signup-bonus.title: [US] OnePay: $50 sign-up bonus and $100 for the referrer ($500 direct deposit or $5,000 month-end balance)
onepay-50-signup-bonus.highlight: $50 for opening OnePay through a referral and unlocking Cash+ in 45 days with $500 of direct deposits or a $5,000 balance; referrer gets $100
onepay-50-signup-bonus.regions: [US] Nationwide, online only (OnePay is a fintech; deposit services by Coastal Community Bank / Lead Bank, FDIC members); SSN or ITIN, US phone number and address required
onepay-50-signup-bonus.content: OnePay (formerly One Finance) pays new customers $50 cash for opening a deposit account through an existing customer's referral link (or the in-app offer entry) and unlocking Cash+ within 45 days. There are two ways to unlock: receive $500 or more in qualifying direct deposits in a calendar month, or end a calendar month with a total account balance of $5,000 or more. Rewards are paid as OnePay Points (5,000 points = $50) and usually post within five days of qualifying. The referrer earns $100 per successful referral (down from $200), up to 10 referrals. The account has no monthly fee and pays 3.35% APY on savings.
onepay-50-signup-bonus.conditions: New customers only, and you must open through a referral link or the in-app invite screen. Referrals made on or after 2026-10-01 qualify only through the $500-per-month direct deposit route; the $5,000 balance route applies only to earlier referrals. Qualifying direct deposits are automated payroll, gig-platform, retirement or government-benefit payments; P2P apps (Venmo, PayPal, Cash App), cash deposits, mobile check deposits, wires, OnePay-to-OnePay transfers and ACH or debit funding started from the OnePay app do not count. Rewards arrive as points that must be redeemed for cash in the app.
steps: Get a referral link from an existing OnePay customer (or use Discover then Invite Friends in the app)
Open the OnePay deposit account and complete identity verification
Within 45 days, either take $500+ of direct deposits in one calendar month or close a month with a $5,000 balance
Check OnePay Points in the app within five days and redeem them for cash; the referrer gets $100 for the same referral
onepay-50-signup-bonus.risk: The direct deposit definition is strict and funding from the OnePay app or P2P transfers will not count, which is where most people fail; rewards are points rather than cash; the referrer amount moves with campaigns (it fell from $200 to $100), so check the app; OnePay skips ChexSystems, but unusual funding patterns can get a reward clawed back.
onepay-50-signup-bonus.source: OnePay official Refer-a-Friend help article (read in November 2026, including the 2026-10-01 threshold change) plus The Money Ninja (2026-08-23) and Miles to Memories (2026-09-10) term-by-term checks

xiaomi-mimo-tts-free-api.highlight: Three MiMo-V2.5-TTS speech models are free for a limited time and skip Token Plan credits, at RPM 100 and TPM 10M per model
xiaomi-mimo-tts-free-api.regions: [Global/CN] Xiaomi MiMo open platform (mimo.mi.com, with separate domestic and overseas sites and billing); sign-up and an API key required, and the domestic site needs a mainland phone number
xiaomi-mimo-tts-free-api.content: The Xiaomi MiMo open platform lists all three MiMo-V2.5-TTS models as free for a limited time: mimo-v2.5-tts synthesises with preset premium voices (singing mode supported), mimo-v2.5-tts-voicedesign creates a brand-new voice from a text description, and mimo-v2.5-tts-voiceclone clones a target voice from a few audio samples. The official API pricing page, updated 2026-11-18, still marks the whole TTS series as free for a limited time, and the usage-and-quota FAQ (2026-11-19) states that TTS models do not draw on Token Plan credits. Each model lists an 8K-token context, 8K max output, RPM 100 and TPM 10M. The API is OpenAI-SDK compatible with base_url https://api.xiaomimimo.com/v1: put the text to speak in a role=assistant message, and use a role=user message for style instructions such as pace, emotion or character acting.
xiaomi-mimo-tts-free-api.conditions: Requires a Xiaomi MiMo account and an API key; the free period is set and can be ended by Xiaomi at any time and has no announced end date; voice cloning and voice design must not be used on other people's voices without permission; commercial use and content compliance are the caller's responsibility under the platform agreement; streaming requests should specify pcm16 audio so chunks can be joined.
steps: Register on mimo.mi.com and create an API key
Point the OpenAI SDK at base_url https://api.xiaomimimo.com/v1 with model mimo-v2.5-tts (or -voicedesign / -voiceclone)
Put the text in role=assistant and style instructions in role=user, and set format and voice under audio
Check the console billing detail to confirm usage still bills at zero, i.e. the promotion is still live
xiaomi-mimo-tts-free-api.risk: The free period can end or switch to per-use billing at any time with no committed end date, so check the pricing page before building on it; RPM 100 limits concurrency and long texts queue; voice cloning raises consent issues and may face extra review; the domestic site needs a mainland phone number and the overseas site bills in USD with separate quotas.
xiaomi-mimo-tts-free-api.source: Xiaomi MiMo official model page, API pricing page (updated 2026-11-18: TTS series free for a limited time, RPM 100 / TPM 10M) and the usage-and-quota FAQ (2026-11-19: TTS does not consume plan credits)

netlify-server-free-early-access.title: [Global] Netlify Server is free during Early Access: long-lived Node servers, WebSockets, in-memory state and long-running AI agents
netlify-server-free-early-access.highlight: Free during Early Access: long-lived Node servers with WebSockets, in-memory state and long-running agent loops; one instance on the free plan
netlify-server-free-early-access.regions: [Global] Netlify (credit-based Free, Personal and Pro plans plus Enterprise with credits); Netlify CLI 27.17.0+ for local work; no credit card needed
netlify-server-free-early-access.content: Netlify launched Netlify Server in Early Access on 2026-11-10: it runs your backend as a long-lived Node.js process that can hold WebSocket and Server-Sent Events connections, keep connection pools and caches in memory, and serve many concurrent requests from one instance. When nothing is using it the server scales to zero after five minutes and wakes on the next request. Netlify states that Netlify Server is free to use during Early Access. Credit-based Free and Personal plans allow one instance, while paid plans and Enterprise with credits allow three. It fits AI workloads well: an agent loop can run for a long time in one process, keep working state in memory and stream progress to the page over a WebSocket, and existing Express, Hono, Fastify or Koa apps deploy unchanged.
netlify-server-free-early-access.conditions: The free period lasts only for Early Access; at general availability billing switches to reserved memory (GB-hours) plus active CPU time (vCPU-hours). One instance on Free and Personal, three elsewhere. Servers scale to zero when idle, so the first request waits for a cold start. Bandwidth, function calls and web requests bill as usual on the same project. APIs and behaviour may change during Early Access. Netlify CLI 27.17.0+ is required locally, or run netlify init inside a coding agent.
steps: Create or open a project on Netlify and confirm it is on a credit-based plan
Upgrade to Netlify CLI 27.17.0 or later and run netlify init in the project to pull the latest agent skills
Write the server entry as a long-lived Node process (an existing Express, Hono, Fastify or Koa app works as-is) and deploy it with the project
Verify long connections and idle scale-down over WebSocket or SSE, and watch instance, memory and CPU usage on the project's Server page
netlify-server-free-early-access.risk: Free has a hard end: after GA you pay for resident memory and CPU, and an always-on backend can generate a bill quickly; the free plan has one instance and scales to zero after five idle minutes, so first requests wait on a cold start; state must live in Netlify Database or Blobs or it is lost when an instance is replaced; APIs and limits can change during Early Access.
netlify-server-free-early-access.source: Netlify's official Introducing Netlify Server post, the 2026-11-10 Early Access changelog and the docs.netlify.com/build/server pricing and limits sections (read 2026-11-20; all state it is free during Early Access)

upsolve-free-1000-credits.title: [Global] Upsolve free plan: 1,000 one-time credits (about 500 analytics questions, ≈$100), no card, with MCP and CLI
upsolve-free-1000-credits.highlight: Sign up for the $0 Free plan and get 1,000 one-time credits (worth about $100 at the $0.10 overage rate) with no credit card; its CLI and remote MCP server plug straight into Claude, Cursor or Codex
upsolve-free-1000-credits.regions: [Global] English site at upsolve.ai; sign up with Google, GitHub or email; you need your own database (Postgres, Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift and similar)
upsolve-free-1000-credits.content:
Upsolve (YC W24) builds an analytics agent for your data warehouse: ask in plain English why revenue dropped last quarter and it writes the SQL, draws the charts and writes up the answer, and it can save results into Notion or open a Linear ticket. The official pricing page lists a Free plan at $0 with 1,000 one-time credits (roughly 500 analytical questions), no credit card, then $0.10 per credit, or the Team plan at $160/month billed annually with 5,000 credits a month.

Credit costs vary by work: a clarification is under 1 credit, a basic data lookup 0.5–1, a full analytical question 1–3, and building dashboards or data apps 10–50 — so the allowance goes much further on questions than on dashboards. The Free plan still includes the AI analyst, agentic dashboards and presentations, the data model, skills and knowledge base, the playground, the CLI and the remote MCP server (https://mcp.upsolve.ai/mcp), and bring-your-own-key through Upsolve Local. Row-level security, embedding and team features are Team-only. The CLI runs with npx @upsolve-labs/analytics.
upsolve-free-1000-credits.conditions: Register an account (18+). The 1,000 Free credits are one-time, not monthly. You need to connect your own data source for it to do anything useful. Row-level security/RBAC, embedding and multi-tenant features are Team-only. Data is processed in the US and UK, so do not upload regulated or confidential data. When the credits run out you pay $0.10 per credit or upgrade.
steps: Open upsolve.ai/pricing and press Get started on the Free plan — no card needed
Connect a data source (Postgres, Snowflake, BigQuery or Redshift), or try Upsolve Local with your own key first
Ask a real question such as which channel lost the most customers this month, and watch it write SQL, chart the answer and write it up
To use it inside Claude, Cursor or Codex, add the remote MCP server https://mcp.upsolve.ai/mcp under Settings → Connectors and sign in with the same account
upsolve-free-1000-credits.risk: The 1,000 credits are one-time, not a monthly gift, and chatting or experimenting burns them. Row-level security and embedding are not in the free tier. Analysis means connecting real company data, so check compliance. Dashboards are expensive in credits at 10–50 each.
upsolve-free-1000-credits.source: Upsolve official pricing page (Free $0, 1,000 one-time credits, no credit card) read 2026-11-20 + official MCP server docs + a verification thread on X by @okeyccronald (2026-11-20)

celesto-5-trial-credit.title: [Global] Celesto: $5 cloud-computer credit without a card (AI agent sandboxes, ≈333 Micro hours; CI runners nearly 90% cheaper than GitHub's)
celesto-5-trial-credit.highlight: Sign up for $5 of Micro runtime with no credit card, valid 30 days: Micro is 1 vCPU / 2 GB / 20 GB at $0.015 an hour, so about 333 hours, with up to two retained sandboxes
celesto-5-trial-credit.regions: [Global] English site at celesto.ai; email sign-up, no card; sandbox availability depends on host capacity
celesto-5-trial-credit.content:
Celesto sells cloud computers and CI runners for AI agents. Each sandbox runs in its own microVM: you create one, SSH in, run commands, and it keeps files, browser logins and workspace state between sessions. For GitHub Actions you swap the runs-on label for a Celesto runner label, which it advertises as nearly 90% cheaper per minute than GitHub's standard runner on the same hardware.

Billing is runtime only, with no monthly platform fee: Micro (1 vCPU / 2 GB / 20 GB) at $0.015 an hour, Small $0.020, Standard $0.030, Memory $0.040, Large $0.080 and XL $0.160. A stopped computer keeps its root disk free for 30 days. New accounts get a one-time $5 Micro runtime credit without a card; it expires 30 days after activation and the trial allows two retained Micro sandboxes, stopped ones included. Larger sizes need a top-up from $2.01.
celesto-5-trial-credit.conditions: One-time $5, Micro size only, expires 30 days after activation. The trial keeps at most two sandboxes, and stopped or failed ones still count. Larger sizes require prepaid credit. Creation depends on host capacity. Trial credit cannot be withdrawn or transferred.
steps: Sign up at celesto.ai and claim the $5 Micro trial credit (no card) under Settings → Billing
Install the CLI and run celesto computer create --cloud --size micro
Run celesto computer exec <ID> --cloud -- uname -a to test it, or use the coding-agent template when you need common coding tools
Stop rather than delete a computer to keep its files; stopped root disks are free for 30 days
celesto-5-trial-credit.risk: $5 covers only 333 Micro hours and expires after 30 days. Stopped sandboxes still use the two-slot trial limit, so repeatedly creating and deleting can get you throttled. Runtime billing means a forgotten machine keeps spending. It is a young service, so check its stability and data-retention terms yourself.
celesto-5-trial-credit.source: Celesto official pricing page and docs ($5 card-free Micro trial, 30 days, two retained sandboxes) read 2026-11-20 + Toolify 'Just launched' listing (2026-11-20)

apple-card-double-daily-cash.title: [US] Apple Card double Daily Cash: up to 6% back in year one, up to $1,000 in bonus cash (apply through the promo link by 12/10)
apple-card-double-daily-cash.highlight: Open a new Apple Card through the promo link by 12/10 and your first 12 months earn double: 6% at Apple and select merchants, 4% with Apple Pay, 2% on the physical card, for up to $1,000 in extra Daily Cash in total
apple-card-double-daily-cash.regions: [US] US applicants only (needs a US credit history and SSN/ITIN), and you must apply through the promo link; Apple Card is issued in the US only
apple-card-double-daily-cash.value: Up to $1,000 in bonus cash back
apple-card-double-daily-cash.content:
Apple's limited-time new-cardholder offer runs from 2026-11-03 to 12-10. Anyone who applies through the promo link (apple.co/cardoffer110326a) and opens a new Apple Card inside that window earns double the standard Daily Cash for the first 365 days: 6% at Apple and at bonus merchants when paying with Apple Pay (normally 3%), 4% on other Apple Pay purchases (normally 2%), and 2% on the titanium card or virtual card number (normally 1%). The extra half is Bonus Daily Cash, capped at $1,000 in total across the purchase period; after that the standard 1/2/3% rates resume.

MacRumors notes that reaching the full $1,000 would take about $33,333 of spending at 6%, $50,000 at 4% or $100,000 at 2%, so most people will earn well below the cap. Apple Card itself has no annual fee, no foreign transaction fee and no late fees, and Daily Cash can go into a Savings account or Apple Cash.
apple-card-double-daily-cash.conditions: New cardholders only: anyone who has had an Apple Card before, or who has a pending or approved application, is ineligible. You must apply in the offer period from the promo link and click Apply now there; applications elsewhere do not qualify. Credit approval required. Purchases by Apple Card Family co-owners or participants do not earn the bonus rate. Returns reduce Daily Cash already paid. Apple may void the bonus for abuse.
steps: On your iPhone open learn.applecard.apple/double-your-daily-cash-promo and confirm the page shows the 2X / 6% offer
Apply from the Apply now button on that page — not the usual Wallet entry point, which does not qualify
Once approved, add the card to Apple Pay and choose whether Daily Cash goes to Savings or Apple Cash
Put everyday spending on Apple Pay during the first year, use Apple and bonus merchants such as Nike or Walgreens for the 6% tier, and watch the $1,000 cap
apple-card-double-daily-cash.risk: This is spend-more-to-earn-more, not free money: the full $1,000 needs over $33,000 of spending, and a normal spender may see only tens or a hundred-odd dollars. Applying is a hard credit pull. Spending extra just to earn the cash back is a net loss. It is effectively unavailable outside the US. Applying outside the promo link earns nothing, and Slickdeals reports several YMMV cases.
apple-card-double-daily-cash.source: Apple's official Double Your Daily Cash terms page (11/03–12/10, $1,000 bonus cap) read 2026-11-20 + MacRumors (2026-11-18) + 9to5Mac and Slickdeals discussion (2026-11-19, data points that the double rate requires the promo link)

dedirock-black-friday-2026.title: [Global] DediRock Black Friday VPS: from $9.88 a year (1C1G/10G/1TB), 2TB storage box at $27.68
dedirock-black-friday-2026.highlight: Nine US KVM annual plans on the Black Friday page: in both Los Angeles and New York, $9.88 (1 core, 1GB, 10GB SSD, 1TB), $17.68 (1 core, 2GB, 20GB, 2TB) and $27.68 (2 cores, 3GB, 40GB, 3TB), plus storage boxes from $11.88 with a 256GB disk; all on 1Gbps with a dedicated IPv4 and the Virtualizor panel
dedirock-black-friday-2026.regions: [Global] Los Angeles and New York data centres in the US, chosen at checkout; cards and PayPal, with a forum article reporting Alipay (confirm at checkout)
dedirock-black-friday-2026.content:
DediRock's (Atlas Cloud LLC) 2026 Black Friday page, read live on 2026-11-20 23:02, lists nine annual plans at the same price in Los Angeles and New York: Promo VPS Saver at $9.88 a year (1 vCore, 1GB, 10GB SSD, 1TB, 1Gbps), Economy at $17.68 (1 vCore, 2GB, 20GB, 2TB) and Value at $27.68 (2 vCores, 3GB, 40GB, 3TB); the storage line starts at $11.88 for 256GB of disk with 512MB RAM and 1TB of traffic, then $17.68 for 1TB of disk and $27.68 for 2TB. Every plan has one dedicated IPv4, a 1Gbps port and the Virtualizor panel, and the page states that all prices are yearly.

The company sits in the cheap annual big-disk corner of the market, hosted at ColoCrossing, with no China-optimised routing. NodeSeek traders noted on 2026-11-13 that last year's $6.45–6.5 two-gigabyte plan is not coming back this Black Friday, so $9.88 is this year's floor; several users in the same thread said every box had been rebooted at once, while long-time customers said the provider once called a runaway train has kept running.
dedirock-black-friday-2026.conditions: Paid yearly up front, not monthly; stock is limited and restocked in batches; Los Angeles and New York are priced the same but stocked separately; the $9.88 tier has only one core and 1GB, fine for a light site, a probe or backups; snapshots and backups are not included; check the refund policy before paying.
steps: Open dedirock.com/black-friday/ and pick a tier under the Los Angeles, New York or Storage tab
Confirm the annual price and the specs (1GB at $9.88, 2GB at $17.68, 3GB at $27.68)
Order and pay, Alipay included, then ping the IP from your own network
For China traffic, build your own relay rather than expecting direct optimised routing
dedirock-black-friday-2026.risk: Very cheap annual boxes are oversold, so performance swings when neighbours compete and NodeSeek has reported whole batches being rebooted; the servers are in the US on ordinary international routing, so evening latency from Asia varies; reselling costs a $5 push fee, so second-hand liquidity is poor; a small host carries long-term business risk, so keep production elsewhere; stock can sell out or the price can rise.
dedirock-black-friday-2026.source: DediRock official Black Friday page (read live 2026-11-20 23:02, nine plans and prices) + NodeSeek trade thread reports (2026-11-13: 5 USD push fee, no $6.5 plan this year, batch reboots)

raksmart-black-friday-2026-vps.value: Flash sale from $2.99 a month; annual from $49.90
raksmart-black-friday-2026-vps.content:
RakSmart's official promotion page, read live on 2026-11-20 23:02 with roughly 960 hours left on its countdown, splits the 2026 Black Friday sale into four parts.

First, a limited monthly flash sale marked same-price on renewal: TY-VPS 2C/2G/50G on Global BGP with a 1Gbps port and 3TB at $2.99/mo (was $8.81); SV-VPS 2C/4G/50G on China Optimized VIP 5G 5TB and on Enterprise CN2 1TB, both $4.99/mo (was $15.25 and $14.99); HK-VPS 2C/2G/50G on BGP 3TB at $8.81/mo.

Second, annual plans: SV 2C/4G/50G NVMe at 25,000 IOPS on China Optimized VIP 5G 3TB for $49.90 a year (was $129.10), the same box on Enterprise CN2 1TB for $59.90 (was $174.90), and HK 2C/4G/50G NVMe on BGP 3TB for $59.90.

Third, a one-click coupon pack: $3 off $10, $30 off $100 and $60 off $200, plus four product coupons for 30% off Enterprise CN2, high bandwidth, VPS and Dual ISP DIA, with the stacking rules on the page's own Rules link.

Fourth, 30% off the new Dual ISP DIA line, where a 1C2G box with 50G HDD and 5G/1TB drops to $3.87 a month.

A round-up on the sb.sb forum (2026-11-18) matches the official page and adds affiliate entry links.
raksmart-black-friday-2026-vps.conditions: Flash-sale tiers are monthly and released in limited stock, and same-price renewal is only stated on the campaign page, so confirm at checkout; the spend-and-save coupons apply per order at $10, $100 and $200, and whether the 30% VPS coupon stacks with them follows the Rules section; CN2 tiers carry a 50G HDD at 5,000 IOPS, so NVMe means the annual plan; locations and routes are chosen at checkout and not every tier is in stock everywhere; normal RakSmart risk checks and payment methods apply.
steps: Open the RakSmart campaign page and claim the $3, $30 and $60 coupons plus the 30% off VPS coupon
Pick a location and spec under Massive Markdowns and confirm the flash monthly price
For longer use, look at Annual Plan Perks (2C4G NVMe at $49.90 a year)
At checkout check that the coupon applied, plus the renewal price and the route, before paying
raksmart-black-friday-2026-vps.risk: Flash tiers are monthly and only sold while stock lasts, with popular locations gone in minutes; CN2 and China VIP are shared 1Gbps ports with terabyte-level traffic, so peak performance still depends on your carrier; cheap tiers are oversold as usual; coupon stacking is fiddly and the checkout price is the real one; smaller hosts have changed routes before, so test monthly first for anything important.
raksmart-black-friday-2026-vps.source: RakSmart official 2026 Black Friday page (read live 2026-11-20 23:02: flash prices, annual prices, coupons and countdown) + sb.sb forum round-up (2026-11-18)

nodeseek-dedirock-1c2g-2t-secondhand.title: [US] NodeSeek second-hand: DediRock 1C2G/2TB Los Angeles annual box at $6.5, asking ¥20 (plus $5 push fee)
nodeseek-dedirock-1c2g-2t-secondhand.highlight: Last year's Black Friday $6.5-a-year plan: 1 core, 2GB, 2TB of traffic in a Los Angeles data centre, with the seller measuring about 160ms to China Unicom and Telecom and about 200ms to Mobile; fixed price ¥20 per box, renewal due at the end of the month at $6.5, and DediRock charges a one-off 5 USD push fee to transfer
nodeseek-dedirock-1c2g-2t-secondhand.regions: [US] Los Angeles data centre (DediRock, ColoCrossing facility); the seller posts on the NodeSeek trade board, so no US identity is needed
nodeseek-dedirock-1c2g-2t-secondhand.value: ¥20 plus a $5 push fee (renews at $6.5 a year)
nodeseek-dedirock-1c2g-2t-secondhand.content:
A NodeSeek trade thread posted on 2026-11-16 and still active at 23:03 on 2026-11-20 offers a DediRock box bought in last year's Black Friday sale at $6.5 a year: 1 core and 1 thread, 2GB of RAM, 2TB of traffic, in a Los Angeles data centre. The seller measured about 160ms from China Unicom and Telecom and about 200ms from Mobile, and attached a NodeQuality benchmark. The post states a fixed price of ¥20 per box, notes that it expires at the end of the month and that the platform charges a one-off 5 USD transfer fee, and asks how to use an escrow.

Comments add the details that matter: one user says the provider does not allow changing the account email, so only an official push works; another recalls that the forum once called this a runaway train, yet it has run steadily since; someone asks about doubling traffic. The seller is a level-0 new account who asked buyers to message on Telegram, and a reply called that out as an off-platform approach from a level-0 account, after which the seller asked how escrow works. As of 23:03 there is no sold marker, and the newest reply says they want one.

Split the price apart: the box is ¥20 (about $3), the push to your own account costs another $5, and the renewal at the end of the month is $6.5, so the first month actually costs roughly ¥20 + ¥36 + ¥46, about ¥100.
nodeseek-dedirock-1c2g-2t-secondhand.conditions: Use NodeSeek's official escrow, especially with a level-0 seller, and never transfer off the platform; the 5 USD push fee is on the buyer, who also pays the ¥20 for the box; the box expires at the end of the month, so renew at $6.5 a year immediately or lose it; the DediRock account email cannot be changed, so the transfer is a push to your own account; the specs and latency are the seller's own measurements, not independently checked.
steps: Reply in the NodeSeek thread or message the seller to confirm the box is still available and who pays the push fee
Ask for NodeSeek official escrow and pay through it
After paying, have the seller submit the DediRock push and confirm the box lands in your account by email
Renew at $6.5 before the end of the month, then change the root password and reinstall
nodeseek-dedirock-1c2g-2t-secondhand.risk: The seller is a level-0 account who first pushed for Telegram contact and the thread already warns about scams, so escrow is essential; the $5 push fee is two and a half times the price of the box, so the real cost is far above ¥20; the box is reclaimed if not renewed at the end of the month; cheap annual boxes are oversold and can be rebooted in batches; DediRock boxes are hard to resell because the email cannot be changed and only a push works.
nodeseek-dedirock-1c2g-2t-secondhand.source: NodeSeek trade thread (posted 2026-11-16, checked 2026-11-20 23:03 for status and comments)

nodeseek-matrixidc-4837-1c2g-secondhand.title: [China] NodeSeek second-hand: MatrixIDC 4837 lite 1C2G/1.5T, ¥176.57 (remaining value ¥186.57 less ¥10)
nodeseek-matrixidc-4837-1c2g-secondhand.highlight: 4837 lite plan with 1 core, 2GB and 1.5TB, renewing quarterly at ¥43.20 and already paid through 2027-12-17 (393 days left); VPS.ss values the remainder at ¥186.57 and the seller cut ¥10 to ¥176.57, handing over the NodeSeek mailbox with the box
nodeseek-matrixidc-4837-1c2g-secondhand.regions: [China] Domestic 4837 route (China Telecom's 163 backbone; Unicom and Mobile leave via international gateways); the seller posts on the NodeSeek trade board
nodeseek-matrixidc-4837-1c2g-secondhand.content:
A NodeSeek trade thread posted on 2026-11-19 and checked again at 23:03 on 2026-11-20 offers a MatrixIDC 4837 lite box: 1 core, 2GB, 1.5TB of traffic, renewed quarterly at ¥43.20, traded on 2026-11-19 and paid through 2027-12-17, leaving 393 days. The VPS.ss remaining-value calculator puts it at ¥186.57, and the seller then posted a ¥10 discount, making it ¥176.57, with a NodeQuality benchmark link added 20 hours before the check.

The transfer method is stated as handing over the NodeSeek mailbox with a fixed-password deal: the box is registered on NodeSeek's own mail service, so the buyer receives that mailbox and with it full control, with no provider push needed. The thread has only two replies, one a bump and one saying that boxes priced at remaining value are hard to move, which fits the fact that it has sat for over a day. As of 23:03 there is no sold marker.

Against the list price, this is a long-remainder box already paid to 2027-12-17, working out at about ¥0.45 a day or ¥13.6 a month, slightly under the ¥14.4 a month implied by the quarterly ¥43.20, so the real saving is mostly the ¥10 cut.
nodeseek-matrixidc-4837-1c2g-secondhand.conditions: The transfer hands over the NodeSeek mailbox that the box is registered on, which means full account control, so change the password and unbind anything personal immediately; it is a fixed-password deal and escrow is advisable; the price is ¥176.57 with no push fee involved; the remaining days and value are the seller's VPS.ss figures and not independently checked; 4837 route quality depends on your carrier and region.
steps: Open the thread and confirm the box is still available at ¥176.57
Ask for NodeSeek escrow or at least a password-held deal, and check the box before paying
Once you have the mailbox, change its password and add your own two-factor authentication
Log into the panel to confirm the 2027-12-17 expiry and the 1C2G/1.5T spec, then run a speed test
nodeseek-matrixidc-4837-1c2g-secondhand.risk: The thread itself says remaining-value boxes are hard to sell and it has gone over a day without a buyer, so this is not a bargain; handing over the NodeSeek mailbox gives away the whole account, and an original owner who keeps a recovery route is a real risk; 4837 peak-hour performance and benchmarks are not guaranteed, so test latency from your own network first; a box that renews at ¥43.20 a quarter is small and not meant for heavy workloads.
nodeseek-matrixidc-4837-1c2g-secondhand.source: NodeSeek trade thread (posted 2026-11-19, checked 2026-11-20 23:03 for price, remaining value and comments)

nodeseek-legend-sg-2c2g-secondhand.highlight: SG-Evo-2-2G: 2 cores, 2GB, 20GB, KVM and a native Singapore IP (IP2Location 3, Scamalytics 0, AbuseIPDB 0), 614 days remaining, ¥400 fixed, fixed-password deal, with the full hardware and IP quality benchmarks in the post
nodeseek-legend-sg-2c2g-secondhand.regions: [Singapore] Singapore data centre (AS209699 Coaxial Cable LLC) with a native Singapore IP
nodeseek-legend-sg-2c2g-secondhand.content:
A NodeSeek trade thread posted on 2026-11-17 and checked at 23:03 on 2026-11-20 offers Legend VPS's SG-Evo-2-2G: 2 cores on an AMD EPYC 7K62, 2GB of RAM, a 20GB disk, KVM and a native Singapore IP, with 614 days remaining at a fixed ¥400 through a password-held deal and Telegram contact. The comments are the useful part: several regulars joke that the family is leaving and that the family will take over the box, one says it is about to become the family's box and wonders why the seller does not just refund since it could sell at full price, another says they dare not buy now that the family has arrived, and the seller replies that everything is being handed to the family at the end of the year, which is what everyone fears. nodeseek-legend-sg-2c2g-secondhand.conditions: ¥400 fixed through a password-held deal, with NodeSeek escrow advisable; the 614 days are the seller's own count, running to roughly mid-2028; the transfer is an account and password handover rather than an official push, so weigh the original owner's recovery risk yourself; a native Singapore IP does not guarantee every streaming service, so test what you need.
steps: Confirm in the thread that the box is still available and whether ¥400 is negotiable
Ask for NodeSeek escrow and check the panel expiry and spec before paying
After handover change the password, rebind two-factor authentication and reinstall
Watch whether the provider behaves normally for a month before committing long term
nodeseek-legend-sg-2c2g-secondhand.risk: The provider is the main risk: several long-time users in the thread say Legend is being handed to the family at year end and fear a purge that returns boxes to their original accounts, and at least one has already refunded; the longer the 614-day remainder, the more a collapse costs; a password handover is not an official push, so the original owner may recover the box; IPQS rates the IP 79, so some platforms may block it.
nodeseek-legend-sg-2c2g-secondhand.source: NodeSeek trade thread (posted 2026-11-17, checked 2026-11-20 23:03 for specs, remaining days and purge rumours in the comments)

kast-5pct-fiat-funding-nov2026.title: [Global] KAST 5% back on fiat funding: transfers of $50 or more, up to $15 per person (11/18–12/9)
kast-5pct-fiat-funding-nov2026.highlight: From 00:00 UTC on 2026-11-18 to 23:59 UTC on 2026-12-09, new users or invited existing ones who fund KAST by fiat get 5% back on the total, one reward per person capped at $15 (BRL Pix, COP Bre-B and ARS are capped at $10); the pool is $50,000 and ends early when it runs out
kast-5pct-fiat-funding-nov2026.regions: [Global] KAST-supported countries and funding routes: EUR over SEPA, GBP over Faster Payments, USD over ACH/FedNow/Fedwire from a US bank, BRL Pix, COP Bre-B and ARS local transfer; MXN is excluded from this campaign
kast-5pct-fiat-funding-nov2026.content:
KAST's official blog post of 2026-11-18 and its campaign terms say that between 18 November and 9 December 2026 (UTC) eligible users who send fiat into KAST and convert it to their USD spending balance receive a 5% promotional reward on the total, paid once per person up to $15 overall, with per-route caps: $10 for BRL Pix, COP Bre-B and ARS, and $15 for EUR over SEPA, GBP over Faster Payments, and USD over ACH, FedNow, Fedwire or SWIFT. The reward is calculated after fees, the pool is $50,000 and is paid out in the order transfers complete, and rewards arrive in the KAST Reward Balance within 14 days after the campaign ends with no claim needed.

SEPA and Faster Payments or ACH are the sensible routes: SEPA has 0% FX and no fixed fee, so a $300 transfer earns the full $15; Faster Payments and ACH charge $2; Fedwire charges a flat $15 and SWIFT a flat $30, which eats the reward. Do not use those two.

Eligibility: users who sign up during the campaign, or existing users selected and invited by KAST who have never funded by fiat or last did so at least 45 days before the start, with selection confirmed by email or in the app; KYC is required; each qualifying transfer must be at least $50 equivalent; card and Apple Pay top-ups, crypto transfers, KAST Tag receipts, refunded and reversed transfers do not count.
kast-5pct-fiat-funding-nov2026.conditions: KYC and a healthy account are required; new users or invited existing ones, since meeting the funding criteria does not select existing users; each transfer must be at least $50 equivalent and must land during the campaign; one reward per person, capped at $15 (lower on some routes); card, crypto, Tag and MXN transfers are excluded; the offer cannot stack with another offer on the same transfer; the reward is promotional, not interest, and does not refund fees.
steps: Sign up for KAST with a supported country and complete KYC
Fund by SEPA in EUR or by ACH/Faster Payments, avoiding Fedwire and SWIFT fixed fees
Send at least $50 equivalent and confirm it lands as USD spending balance during the campaign
Look for the reward in the KAST Reward Balance within 14 days after 12/9
kast-5pct-fiat-funding-nov2026.risk: Fees can exceed the reward, since Fedwire charges a flat $15 and SWIFT $30; the reward is promotional credit, not interest; the pool is only $50,000, so popular routes may exhaust it early; fiat funding runs through licensed third-party partners with country-specific currencies and limits; money held in KAST is a stablecoin balance and is not deposit-insured.
kast-5pct-fiat-funding-nov2026.source: KAST official campaign blog and terms (published 2026-11-18, Active status checked 2026-11-20) + visitor submission email (2026-11-20 21:03)

ahanow-100k-credits-nov2026.regions: [Global] app.ahanow.ai, sign-up by email or Google without a card
ahanow-100k-credits-nov2026.content:
AhaNow is an AI explainer video workspace (app.ahanow.ai, read live on 2026-11-20 23:03): its video area offers a Director mode and Quick create, takes a topic, script, link or files such as documents, slides, images, subtitles and audio or video up to 12 at a time, and renders with MiniMax H3 Max Turbo at 768p into faceless explainers, whiteboard videos, Vox-style pieces, illustrated stories and product promos. A banner on the site says new registrations get 100,000 credits, with a button to claim them.

The same page shows a 50% off upgrade banner with a six-hour countdown, which is a separate paid offer and not needed to claim the free credits. A promo post by @imFarhanAi on 2026-11-20 15:00 UTC says to register before noon ET on 26 November for the 100,000 credits. The template library already holds 453 styles, including a Manus 2.0 launch look, a whiteboard explainer and a pixel RPG.

Nothing on the page states how long the credits last or what one video costs in credits, so treat the practical value as unverified until you try it.
ahanow-100k-credits-nov2026.conditions: A new account is needed, by email or Google; the 100,000 credits are a sign-up gift whose validity and per-render burn rate are not published, so check the account page; the 11/26 noon ET deadline comes only from the official promo post, while the site just says new registrations get credits; after the free credits run out the paid plans apply, so do not leave auto-renew on; commercial use follows the official terms.
steps: Open app.ahanow.ai and register with email or Google
Claim the 100,000 credits from the banner in the left panel

moomoo-us-black-friday-2026.content:
Moomoo stacked a Black Friday boost on its regular account bonus for November. The official event page, read on 21 November 2026, confirms that new clients get Anthropic stock by first cumulative net deposit: $30 for $500, $100 for $2,000, $200 for $10,000, $400 for $50,000 and $1,000 for $100,000; the 8.1% APY is a 3.6% base plus a temporary 4.5% booster for two months on up to $20,000; and a deposit of $100 or more also brings ten $10 trading coupons. ACATS transfers do not count as a deposit, though Moomoo runs a separate 3% transfer match capped at $600.

Open the account, cash and margin both if you want, and pass identity checks
Make the first deposit before 30 November, choosing $2,000 or $10,000 cumulative for the higher stock tiers

steps: Register at dstatus.sh and claim the free five-node licence first
For 10 nodes, buy the personal edition in the user centre, enter F1x and confirm the price shows 1 yuan before paying
Deploy the panel per the official docs and paste the licence key in the admin panel
Reply in the giveaway thread for a shot at the 100-node licence on 25 November

alibabacloud-intl-200-credit.title: [Global/Intl] Alibaba Cloud International: $200 instant credit for new users, apply before first purchase (60-day validity)
alibabacloud-intl-200-credit.highlight: New Alibaba Cloud International accounts registered after 2025-04-01 with no paid order can apply with a short business description before their first purchase and get $200 in credits once approved (no minimum spend, valid 60 days), plus up to 3 months of spend-based credits
alibabacloud-intl-200-credit.regions: [Global/Intl] Alibaba Cloud International (alibabacloud.com), separate from the China site aliyun.com; needs a verified phone number, registration after 2025-04-01 and a $0 payment history; resellers, channel partners and KA/KP accounts excluded
alibabacloud-intl-200-credit.content:
Alibaba Cloud International offers a $200 first-purchase credit to new users who registered after 1 April 2025 and have no paid order on the account. You must apply on the campaign page before your first purchase, giving a company or project name, business phone number, website and a business description of 100 words or less. Alibaba Cloud reviews the application manually within 3 business days and issues the $200 as a coupon. There is no minimum spend, the coupon is valid for 60 days, and it works for both prepaid and pay-as-you-go billing.

Accounts that receive the $200 within the campaign window (by credit issue date, 2026-07-01 to 2026-12-31) also get automatic monthly credits based on eligible spend for up to 3 months: 5% for $800–4,000 monthly spend (up to $200), 10% for $4,000–8,000 (up to $800), 15% for $8,000–80,000 (up to $12,000) and 20% above $80,000 (up to $50,000), paid as monthly coupons.

The credit does not cover domains, cloud communication, CDN or Alibaba Cloud Academy products, cannot be used on orders placed through third-party agents or resellers, is not refundable and cannot be transferred or cashed out. Alibaba Cloud has not published a fixed end date for the $200 credit and may change the rules, quota or amounts at any time.
alibabacloud-intl-200-credit.conditions: Alibaba Cloud International accounts only: registered after 2025-04-01, no paid order above $0, phone number verified, and not a reseller, channel partner or KA/KP customer. You must apply before your first purchase; buying anything first forfeits eligibility. The application needs genuine business or project details (company name, business phone, website, project description) and takes about 3 business days to review. Some products are excluded (domains, cloud communication, CDN, Academy). The credit expires after 60 days and cannot be refunded or transferred.
steps: Open the Alibaba Cloud International $200 campaign page and sign in or register an account (phone verification)
Click Apply for $200 Credits and fill in the company/project name, business phone, website and a short business description
Wait for the manual review, about 3 business days, and watch the phone number and email you submitted
Confirm the $200 coupon in the console (valid 60 days)
Spend it within 60 days on Model Studio (Qwen/Wan), ECS or other eligible products
alibabacloud-intl-200-credit.risk: There is a manual review: purely personal applications, inaccurate details or no visible business need get rejected. The credit is only valid for 60 days, so unused value is lost. Orders paid with the credit are not refundable. Domains, CDN, cloud communication and some other categories are excluded. Alibaba Cloud can change the rules or end the campaign at any time, and issuance depends on human approval.
alibabacloud-intl-200-credit.source: Alibaba Cloud International $200 Instant Credit campaign page and FAQ (read 2026-11-21) + taskpanel / FreeAIHub cross-checks + X lead @Jack1472004 (2026-11-19)

l53-ggff-free-domain-2y-2026.regions: [Global] L53 (operated by 1024 Ltd, UK) client area customer.l53.net; .ggff.net suffix; registering with an overseas IP and a US address is recommended
l53-ggff-free-domain-2y-2026.content:
L53's annual Black Friday offer runs from 2026-11-20 to 2026-12-03: register an account at the customer.l53.net client area, order a .ggff.net subdomain for a 2-year term and enter promo code kxu26bf8k2y at checkout to pay $0. .ggff.net is listed in the Public Suffix List, so you can change the NS records and host the domain on Cloudflare Free (with its CDN and WAF). The provider also offers other suffixes such as .filegear-sg.me. Registering with an overseas IP (US is best) and US address details, plus a Gmail or Outlook mailbox, tends to pass risk checks more easily.

l53-ggff-free-domain-2y-2026.conditions: You need an L53 client account first. The code works once per user and covers one domain. You must choose the 2-year term before entering the code or it will not apply. US address details and an overseas IP are recommended to avoid risk-control blocks. Free service has no SLA: L53 may reject or terminate a registration within 30 days of service start, and the upstream domain owner can reclaim subdomains at any time. Free renewals are not available.
steps: Open customer.l53.net and register an account (overseas IP and US address recommended)
Go to Order, then Domain Registration, and search for the .ggff.net prefix you want
Set the registration term to 2 Years
Enter kxu26bf8k2y in the Apply Promo Code field at checkout and confirm the total becomes $0.00
Place the order, then add the domain in Cloudflare and switch the NS records as instructed
l53-ggff-free-domain-2y-2026.risk: The subdomain is still owned by L53 and can be reclaimed or suspended at any time, so it is unsuitable for a main or brand site. Renewals are not free. The free-service terms let L53 show ads on or redirect promotional domains. The code is single-use and stock is limited, so it can expire early. Inaccurate details or a flagged IP can get the account removed.
