jpm-personal-investing-invest-1000-100.content: J.P. Morgan Personal Investing, the firm's UK managed-portfolio platform, pays a £100 cash reward: 'Invest at least £1,000 in one payment by 30 November 2026 and keep it invested for at least 6 months'. The sequence is to register your email on the offer page, open a JPM PI account with the same address, open one managed product (managed GIA, Stocks and Shares ISA, Lifetime ISA, Junior ISA or Personal Pension) and pay in £1,000 or more in a single payment of new money (transfers from another provider do not count), then keep net contributions at £1,000 or more for six months. Market moves do not affect eligibility, but a withdrawal that drops net contributions below £1,000 does. The £100 is paid as unallocated cash into the account within 55 days of the six-month period ending, ready to invest or withdraw. Checked on the offer page on 21 November 2026: the 30 November 2026 23:59 GMT deadline, the single £1,000 payment, the six-month hold and the 55-day payout all match.
jpm-personal-investing-invest-1000-100.conditions: UK resident who has not invested with JPM PI before (or an invited existing client); register on the offer page and open the account with the same email; invest £1,000 or more in one payment into a managed product - multiple payments, transfers from another provider and a 100% cash pot do not qualify; keep net contributions at £1,000 or more for six months; cannot be combined with another new-client offer.
steps: Register your email on the £100 offer page
Open a JPM PI account with the same email and choose a managed product: Stocks and Shares ISA, Lifetime ISA, Junior ISA, Personal Pension or managed GIA
Pay in £1,000 or more in a single payment by 23:59 GMT on 30 November 2026 and set your investment style and risk level
Hold net contributions of £1,000 or more for six months; the £100 arrives as cash within 55 days of the period ending
jpm-personal-investing-invest-1000-100.risk: Investments can fall, so the £1,000 may be worth less after six months (that does not affect eligibility, but the loss is yours); managed products carry platform and fund charges; the deadline is 30 November, so allow time for the account and the payment to clear; only one new-client offer per customer.
jpm-personal-investing-invest-1000-100.source: J.P. Morgan Personal Investing official offer page and terms (closing 30 November 2026, 23:59 GMT; checked 21 November 2026); original listing on My Side Gig

chase-uk-referral-50.title: [UK] Chase UK referral: £50 each when you enter a code in the app and deposit £1,000 within 30 days
chase-uk-referral-50.highlight: Anyone who did not apply to Chase before 3 December 2025 can enter a referral code in the app's Rewards section and deposit a total of £1,000 within 30 days, and both sides get £50
chase-uk-referral-50.regions: [UK] UK residents aged 18+, with a UK mobile number; must not have applied to Chase before 3 December 2025
chase-uk-referral-50.content: Chase UK, J.P. Morgan's British retail bank, runs a refer a friend offer: the friend downloads the app, opens a first Chase account, selects the offer in the Rewards section and enters the referrer's code, then deposits a total of at least £1,000 within 30 days of opening. Both sides receive £50 into their rewards balance, which can be moved to a Chase current or saver account and withdrawn. The terms say the friend must not have applied to Chase before 3 December 2025, the code must be used within 30 days of opening, the £1,000 can build up over several deposits (deposit £500, spend £250, deposit another £500 still counts), and neither side may close their last Chase account or deactivate rewards before the award is paid. Each code is single use and a referrer can generate up to five. Checked on the Refer a friend terms page on 21 November 2026: £50, 30 days, £1,000 and the 3 December 2025 cut-off are unchanged; no end date is published and Chase may end the offer at any time.
chase-uk-referral-50.conditions: UK resident aged 18+, with a smartphone and UK mobile number, tax resident in the UK and passing a soft credit search; must not have applied to Chase before 3 December 2025; enter the code in Rewards within 30 days of opening the first account and deposit a total of £1,000 within those 30 days; do not close the account or deactivate rewards before the award is paid; JPMorgan Group staff and their clients cannot refer each other.
steps: Open your first Chase current account in the app using a friend's referral code
Within 30 days, open Rewards in the app, choose refer a friend and enter the code to link to the referrer
Deposit a total of £1,000 into the Chase account within 30 days, in one or several payments
Move the £50 from your rewards balance to a current or saver account and withdraw it before closing anything
chase-uk-referral-50.risk: Chase rolls the referral entry out to customers in batches, so no entry in the app means you were not picked this time; the reward sits in a rewards balance that must be transferred out before leaving Chase; opening an account involves a soft search and Chase offers no overdraft.
chase-uk-referral-50.source: Chase UK official Refer a friend terms page (£50, 30 days, £1,000, 3 December 2025 cut-off; checked 21 November 2026); original listing on My Side Gig

chip-uk-referral-50.title: [UK] Chip referral: £50 each when you deposit £1,000 and hold it 90 days, all within 120 days
chip-uk-referral-50.highlight: A referred new customer who puts £1,000 into any eligible Chip account and holds it for 90 days triggers £50 for both sides, with everything done within 120 days of the referral
chip-uk-referral-50.regions: [UK] UK residents aged 18+, UK tax residents; Chip must be a new customer (never held a Chip account)
chip-uk-referral-50.content: Chip, the UK savings and investing app, pays £50 to both sides of a referral: the friend must be new to Chip, sign up through the referral link, deposit at least £1,000 into any eligible Chip account and keep the balance there for 90 calendar days, all within 120 calendar days of being referred. Eligible accounts are the Smart Cash ISA, Instant Access, Prize Savings, Everyday Saver, General Investment Account and Stocks and Shares ISA; the Chip Pension does not count. The £1,000 can be split across eligible accounts but the total must stay at or above £1,000 for the 90 days. The bonus is paid into an Instant Access or Prize Savings account on both sides, and withdrawing to a linked bank account takes up to five working days. Checked on the Refer a friend terms page at getchip.uk on 21 November 2026: £50, £1,000, 90 days, the 120-day window and the account list are unchanged.
chip-uk-referral-50.conditions: UK resident aged 18+, UK tax resident, new to Chip (never held a Chip account); sign up through the referral link on app version 4.56.0 or later; deposit £1,000 in total into eligible Chip accounts and hold it 90 days; meet every condition within 120 days of the referral; the Chip Pension does not count.
steps: Sign up to Chip through a friend's referral link and pass identity checks
Put £1,000 into eligible accounts such as Instant Access, Cash ISA or Prize Savings (it can be split)
Keep the balance at £1,000 or more for 90 days
Once all conditions are met inside the 120-day window, £50 lands in your Instant Access or Prize Savings account
chip-uk-referral-50.risk: Withdrawing during the 90 days drops the balance below £1,000 and loses the bonus; the bonus can only be paid into an Instant Access or Prize Savings account; the 120-day clock starts on the day you are referred.
chip-uk-referral-50.source: Chip official Refer a friend terms page (£50 / £1,000 / 90 days / 120 days; checked 21 November 2026); original listing on My Side Gig

wealthify-referral-50.title: [UK] Wealthify referral: £50 each when you invest £1,000 in an ISA, or £5,000 in a GIA or SIPP, for 6 + 6 months
wealthify-referral-50.highlight: Open through a referral link, invest £1,000 in a Stocks and Shares or Junior ISA (or £5,000 in a GIA or SIPP), then keep that balance another six months, and both sides get £50
wealthify-referral-50.regions: [UK] UK residents aged 18+; new Wealthify customers who pass the risk questionnaire and identity checks
wealthify-referral-50.content: Wealthify, the Aviva-owned robo-investor, pays £50 to both sides: the friend opens an account through the referral link, makes a first investment within six months of opening - at least £1,000 into a Stocks and Shares ISA or Junior ISA, or at least £5,000 into a General Investment Account or SIPP - and then keeps that balance for a further six months. The £50 is paid straight into both investment plans rather than as cash. A referrer can share one code as often as they like, up to 50 successful referrals, and the link is the only way the referral is tracked. Checked on the Refer a Friend page at wealthify.com on 21 November 2026: £50, the £1,000 and £5,000 thresholds and the six-plus-six-month holding requirement are unchanged.
wealthify-referral-50.conditions: UK resident aged 18+, new to Wealthify; must arrive through the referral link; invest at least £1,000 in a Stocks and Shares ISA or Junior ISA, or at least £5,000 in a GIA or SIPP; keep that balance for six months after the first investment; the reward is paid as invested money, not cash.
steps: Register through a friend's Wealthify referral link and complete the risk questionnaire and identity checks
Within six months of opening, invest £1,000 in an ISA (or £5,000 in a GIA or SIPP)
Keep at least that amount invested for a further six months
The £50 is added to your plan automatically, with nothing to claim
wealthify-referral-50.risk: The reward is invested money, so it must be sold and settled before it can be taken out; investments can fall; the 6 + 6 months ties money up for about a year and early withdrawals lose the bonus.
wealthify-referral-50.source: Wealthify official Refer a Friend page (£50, ISA £1,000 / GIA and SIPP £5,000; checked 21 November 2026); original listing on My Side Gig

freetrade-free-share-10-100.title: [UK] Freetrade free share: £10-£100 random share for funding £50, cash out after 180 days
freetrade-free-share-10-100.highlight: UK tax residents who open through a referral link, finish W-8BEN and fund £50 net get a random share worth £10-£100 within 30 days, usually at the £10 end
freetrade-free-share-10-100.regions: [UK] UK tax residents only; new Freetrade customers; US nationals and dual US-UK nationals are excluded
freetrade-free-share-10-100.content: Freetrade, the UK commission-free broker, awards a free share to both sides of a referral. The new customer signs up through the referral link, passes onboarding and the W-8BEN form, and brings the account to a net cash balance of at least £50 within 30 calendar days; the free share is then issued, with the terms stating that each share is worth between £10 and £100 at the time of award and that pricier shares are rarer. Shares are usually issued within 28 business days, and the sale proceeds can only be withdrawn 180 calendar days after the award date. The referrer must also hold at least £50 net, can receive up to ten free shares a month, and may only share links with family and friends - not on public social media or forums. Checked against the Freetrade Free Share Terms (v7) and the /free-share page on 21 November 2026: the £10-£100 range, the £50 funding requirement and the 180-day withdrawal lock are unchanged.
freetrade-free-share-10-100.conditions: UK tax resident aged 18+, new to Freetrade (existing or previous accounts do not qualify); sign up through a referral link and complete KYC and W-8BEN; reach £50 net cash within 30 days; US nationals and dual US-UK nationals resident in the UK are excluded; referral links must not be posted publicly.
steps: Sign up through a friend's Freetrade referral link and complete identity checks and W-8BEN
Bring the account's net cash to £50 or more within 30 days
Wait for the share to be issued, usually within 28 business days, and find it in your portfolio
Sell whenever you like, but proceeds unlock for withdrawal 180 days after the award
freetrade-free-share-10-100.risk: Most recipients get the £10 end despite the £100 headline; share values move with the market; sale proceeds are locked for 180 days; this is an investment account with KYC and market risk.
freetrade-free-share-10-100.source: Freetrade official Free Share terms v7 and /free-share offer page (checked 21 November 2026); original listing on My Side Gig

investengine-referral-20-200.title: [UK] InvestEngine referral: invest £100, get a random £20-£200 bonus (75% at £20-£24), hold 12 months
investengine-referral-20-200.highlight: A new customer who registers through a referral link and invests £100 gets a random bonus for both sides: 75% get £20-£24, 15% £28-£34, 5% £42-£56, 3% £75-£100 and 2% £150-£200
investengine-referral-20-200.regions: [UK] UK residents only; new InvestEngine customers who pass identity checks (business accounts also need an LEI)
investengine-referral-20-200.content: InvestEngine, the FCA-regulated ETF portfolio platform, pays a random referral bonus to both sides: the new customer registers through a referral link, opens an ISA, GIA or SIPP, and invests at least £100, and the amount is revealed when claimed, straight into the portfolio. The official terms (V1.4, effective 16 March 2026) publish the weighting: £20-£24 at 75%, £28-£34 at 15%, £42-£56 at 5%, £75-£100 at 3% and £150-£200 at 2%, with business accounts on £100-£400. After the bonus is claimed, both sides must stay invested for 12 months with at least £100 plus the bonus as net funding, or InvestEngine reclaims it. The referrer needs £100 of their own invested before generating a link and can make up to 25 valid referrals. Checked on the Term Incentives page on 21 November 2026: the weighting table and the 12-month requirement are unchanged.
investengine-referral-20-200.conditions: UK resident, new to InvestEngine (never registered); must arrive through a referral link; invest at least £100 in an ISA, GIA or SIPP; keep both sides invested for 12 months with net funding of at least £100 plus the bonus; self-referrals are not accepted.
steps: Register through a friend's InvestEngine referral link and open an ISA, GIA or SIPP
Invest at least £100 into a portfolio (cash sitting idle does not count)
Claim the bonus in the platform; the amount is generated at that moment and cannot be changed
Stay invested for 12 months with net funding of at least £100 plus the bonus, or the money is reclaimed
investengine-referral-20-200.risk: The bonus is invested money that must stay for 12 months or be reclaimed; investments can fall; the advertised £200 has a 2% chance and most people get £20-£24.
investengine-referral-20-200.source: InvestEngine official Term Incentives page (Referral Program V1.4 with the weighting table and 12-month rule; checked 21 November 2026); original listing on My Side Gig

oaknorth-referral-30.title: [UK] OakNorth referral: £30 each for saving £2,000 for 30 days, plus £10 each for a second account
oaknorth-referral-30.highlight: A referred new customer opens an OakNorth personal savings account, funds it with £2,000 within 14 days and holds it 30 days, and both sides get £30 within 60 days
oaknorth-referral-30.regions: [UK] UK residents only (England, Scotland, Wales, Northern Ireland), aged 18+; new OakNorth personal savings customers
oaknorth-referral-30.value: £30 (≈$39), plus £10 each for a second account
oaknorth-referral-30.content: OakNorth, the UK digital bank with FSCS protection, runs the Better Together referral programme: the friend submits a referral form naming the referrer and their registered email, opens a new personal savings account, funds it with at least £2,000 within 14 days and keeps the balance for 30 calendar days, and both sides receive £30 within 60 calendar days of meeting the conditions, paid into their OakNorth account or nominated account. A second eligible account opened within 90 days earns both sides another £10. A referrer can be rewarded for up to ten successful referrals (£300), and up to 50 people linked to one referrer can receive a reward. The page says there is currently no cut-off date but the programme may be withdrawn or amended. Checked at oaknorth.co.uk on 21 November 2026: £30 / £2,000 / 30 days / 60-day payout all match.
oaknorth-referral-30.conditions: UK resident aged 18+, who has not previously applied for an OakNorth personal savings account; must be referred by an existing OakNorth customer, with the referrer's name and registered email on the form; fund the new account with £2,000 within 14 days and hold it 30 calendar days; a second account must be opened within 90 days for the extra £10; only one reward as a referred customer.
steps: Ask a friend with an OakNorth account to refer you, then submit the referral form with their name and registered email
Open a new personal savings account and fund it with at least £2,000 within 14 days
Keep at least £2,000 in it for 30 calendar days
The £30 arrives within 60 days; open a second eligible account within 90 days for another £10 each
oaknorth-referral-30.risk: You need £2,000 up front and withdrawals inside 30 days lose the bonus; savings rates move, so do not pick a weak account just for £30; the referral form has to be filled in at the start, not afterwards.
oaknorth-referral-30.source: OakNorth official Refer a Friend page (£30 / £2,000 / 30 days; checked 21 November 2026); original listing on My Side Gig

raisin-uk-refer-friend-100.title: [UK] Raisin UK referral: £100 each when your first account is a 1-year+ fixed bond of £10,000
raisin-uk-refer-friend-100.highlight: Register through a referral link, make your first savings account a fixed rate bond of 1 year or more funded with £10,000 in one go, and both sides get £100 within 28 days
raisin-uk-refer-friend-100.regions: [UK] UK residents aged 18+; new Raisin UK customers who have not registered before
raisin-uk-refer-friend-100.content: Raisin UK, which puts savings products from many banks in one account, pays £100 to both sides of a referral: the new customer registers through the referral link, makes their first savings account a fixed rate bond with a term of one year or longer, and funds it with at least £10,000; both bonuses are paid into the respective Transaction Accounts, usually within 28 days of the bond being opened and funded. The traps: the £10,000 must all go into that one fixed bond rather than being split across accounts; the bond has to be the first savings account opened (an easy access or shorter account first disqualifies you); registration to funding must happen within 365 days; and the bonus cannot be combined with other new-customer codes. Checked on the Refer a friend bonus page at raisin.com on 21 November 2026: £100, the one-year term, £10,000, the 28-day payout and those exclusions are unchanged.
raisin-uk-refer-friend-100.conditions: UK resident aged 18+, new to Raisin UK; must register through a referral link; the first savings account must be a fixed rate bond of one year or more funded with £10,000 or more in a single account (not split); register and fund within 365 days; cannot be combined with other new-customer codes.
steps: Register through a friend's Raisin UK referral link and complete full identity verification
Choose a fixed rate bond with a term of one year or longer and fund it with £10,000 or more in one go
Make sure all £10,000 sits in that one bond rather than an easy access or shorter account first
The £100 arrives in your Transaction Account within 28 days; the bond stays locked until maturity
raisin-uk-refer-friend-100.risk: The £10,000 threshold and the lock-up usually make £100 poor value on its own, so compare rates first; opening another account first or splitting the deposit loses the bonus; each partner bank keeps its own FSCS protection.
raisin-uk-refer-friend-100.source: Raisin UK official Refer a friend bonus page (£100 / 1 year / £10,000; checked 21 November 2026); original listing on My Side Gig

lloyds-uk-refer-friend-30.title: [UK] Lloyds referral: £30 for a new customer opening a current account in the app, no switch or pay-in
lloyds-uk-refer-friend-30.highlight: A customer brand new to Lloyds opens a sole current account from a referral link inside the app and keeps it open; £30 arrives as a cash credit (the in-app terms say within 35 days), with no switch, deposit or direct debits
lloyds-uk-refer-friend-30.regions: [UK] UK residents aged 18+ who are brand new to Lloyds (no Lloyds current account, savings, credit card, loan or mortgage)
lloyds-uk-refer-friend-30.content: Lloyds' Refer a Friend is a different offer from its Club Lloyds switch bonus: the £200 switch deal needs a switch plus three direct debits, while this £30 referral just needs the friend to use a referral link, download the Lloyds app, and open a new sole current account in the app - no switch, no set deposit and no direct debits - then keep the account open until the reward is paid. £30 is credited to the new account as a cash credit (the referral terms say within 35 calendar days of opening), and the referrer also gets £30. Lloyds states the offer on its joint accounts page - 'Psst, want £30? Just refer a friend ... you could both pocket £30 when you open a qualifying current account' - and the detailed terms appear in the Lloyds app: referral links are valid for 14 days from generation (an expired link still opens an account but pays nothing), the application must start from the link, only sole accounts qualify, and Under 19s, Smart Start, Student, Money Smart and Expresscash accounts are excluded. Checked on lloydsbank.com on 21 November 2026: the £30 and those points still hold.
lloyds-uk-refer-friend-30.conditions: UK resident aged 18+ with no Lloyds current account, savings account, credit card, loan or mortgage (brand new customer); arrive through a referral link and download the app to open a new current account in the app; sole account only, joint accounts excluded; keep the account open until the reward is paid; one referral reward per person; the link is valid for 14 days.
steps: Ask a friend who holds a Lloyds product for a freshly generated referral link (valid 14 days)
Open the link, download the Lloyds app and apply for a sole current account there (Classic or another eligible account)
Pass identity and credit checks and keep the account open - no set deposit and no direct debits needed
£30 arrives as a cash credit within 35 calendar days of opening
lloyds-uk-refer-friend-30.risk: To verify: the terms page on lloydsbank.com currently returns errors intermittently, so the £30 and the 'brand new customer, sole account opened in the app' rules are confirmed on Lloyds' own pages while the 35-day payout window, the 14-day link validity and the excluded account list come from the in-app terms (reported by third parties in October 2026) - check the app before applying; a link older than 14 days still opens an account but pays nothing; the account must be in your sole name; opening a current account involves a credit check; holding any Lloyds product, even a savings account, means you are not a brand new customer.
lloyds-uk-refer-friend-30.source: Lloyds Bank official joint accounts page and Refer a Friend entry (£30 confirmed, checked 21 November 2026; the dedicated terms page intermittently errors) plus the in-app referral terms (third-party review, October 2026) and the original listing on My Side Gig

fidelity-uk-refer-100-amazon.title: [UK] Fidelity referral: £100 Amazon gift card each for a £5,000 lump sum into an ISA, SIPP or investment account
fidelity-uk-refer-100-amazon.highlight: Open through a referral link and put a £5,000 lump sum into a Stocks and Shares ISA, SIPP or investment account that passes validation, and both sides get a £100 Amazon.co.uk gift card
fidelity-uk-refer-100-amazon.regions: [UK] UK residents aged 18+; new Fidelity customers without an existing investment account
fidelity-uk-refer-100-amazon.content: Fidelity, the UK fund and investment platform, pays a £100 Amazon.co.uk gift card to both sides of a referral: the friend arrives through the referral link, opens a Stocks and Shares ISA, a Self-Invested Personal Pension or an investment account, and funds it with a lump sum of £5,000 or more. Once the account is opened and validated, each side receives a £100 gift card. The page is explicit that accounts opened with less than £5,000 do not qualify and that the reward is a gift card rather than cash, with eligibility resting on the account being opened and validated. Checked on the Refer a friend page at fidelity.co.uk on 21 November 2026: £100, £5,000, the three account types and the gift card form are unchanged.
fidelity-uk-refer-100-amazon.conditions: UK resident aged 18+, new to Fidelity (no existing investment account); open the account through a referral link; fund it with a £5,000 lump sum into a Stocks and Shares ISA, SIPP or investment account; the account must pass validation.
steps: Register through a friend's Fidelity referral link
Open a Stocks and Shares ISA, SIPP or investment account and pay in a £5,000 lump sum
Complete account validation, including identity and source-of-funds checks
Both sides receive a £100 Amazon.co.uk gift card once the account is validated
fidelity-uk-refer-100-amazon.risk: The £5,000 threshold only makes sense if you were investing anyway; the reward is a gift card, not cash; investments can fall; funding below £5,000, or in several payments, may not qualify.
fidelity-uk-refer-100-amazon.source: Fidelity UK official Refer a friend page (£100 / £5,000; checked 21 November 2026); original listing on My Side Gig

currensea-referral-10.title: [UK] Currensea referral: £10 each when you spend £100 abroad, free-tier card included
currensea-referral-10.highlight: Apply for a Currensea travel debit card through a friend's link and spend £100 abroad, and both sides get £10 while the offer lasts
currensea-referral-10.regions: [UK] UK residents aged 18+ with a UK bank account that Currensea can debit directly
currensea-referral-10.content: Currensea is a travel debit card that links to a UK current account and spends at the real exchange rate without the usual foreign transaction fees. Its refer a friend offer says you'll both get £10 when you spend £100 abroad; the free Essential tier only charges a £4.95 delivery fee, while Pro and Elite are annual-fee tiers on the same referral terms. Checked on the Refer a friend page at currensea.com on 21 November 2026: the page still reads 'You'll both get £10 when you spend £100 abroad' and notes the offer runs from 12:00pm BST 29 June 2026 until withdrawn, with the full terms on the recommend-a-friend terms page. The amount is small, but it is free money if you already spend abroad.
currensea-referral-10.conditions: UK resident aged 18+ with a UK current account; apply through a referral link; spend a total of £100 abroad on the card; the offer can be withdrawn at any time, so check the page when you apply.
steps: Apply for a Currensea card through a friend's referral link - the free Essential tier is enough
Link the card to your UK current account and complete identity checks
Use the card abroad until you have spent £100 in total
£10 cashback appears in your Currensea account for both sides
currensea-referral-10.risk: Only worth it if you actually spend abroad rather than spending just to qualify; Pro and Elite tiers carry annual fees; the offer can be withdrawn at any time; the card debits your current account directly.
currensea-referral-10.source: Currensea official Refer a friend page and terms (£10 / £100 abroad; checked 21 November 2026); original listing on My Side Gig

hsbc-premier-switch-500.title: [UK] HSBC Premier switch offer: £500 for a full CASS switch with £100k income or savings
hsbc-premier-switch-500.highlight: Move a full current account into HSBC Premier with the Current Account Switch Service and meet the £100,000 salary or £100,000 savings/investments test and HSBC pays £500; the account itself has no monthly fee and the bank bills it as the biggest UK switch bonus
hsbc-premier-switch-500.regions: [UK] UK residents aged 18+; individual income of at least £100,000 paid into the Premier account, or £100,000+ in savings/investments with HSBC UK, or existing Premier status in another country
hsbc-premier-switch-500.content: HSBC states it on the Premier Bank Account page: 'Get £500 with an HSBC Premier Bank Account' - complete a full switch through the Current Account Switch Service with a £100k+ salary or transfer £100k+ in savings or investments. It is a different product from the HSBC £220 switch entry already on this site: that one runs on the standard Bank Account with two direct debits, a £2,000 deposit and £500 of card spend, while Premier doubles the money for a far higher bar. Premier has no monthly account fee, and HSBC values the bundled travel and health benefits at up to £1,500 a year; new customers get 90 days to meet the income or savings criteria. Checked on hsbc.co.uk on 21 November 2026: the £500 offer, the £100,000 thresholds and the note that new customers cannot have held an HSBC or first direct account since 1 January 2025 are all on the page, together with the caveat that the offer can be withdrawn at any time.
hsbc-premier-switch-500.conditions: UK resident aged 18+; new customer only - no HSBC or first direct account since 1 January 2025; meet one of: individual income of at least £100,000 paid into the Premier account, £100,000+ in savings or investments with HSBC UK (M&S, first direct and HSBC Expat excluded), or Premier status in another country; full switch through the Current Account Switch Service; 90 days to meet the criteria; HSBC may withdraw the offer at any time.
steps: Open the Premier page on hsbc.co.uk and start the application
Pass identity, address and residency checks and prepare proof of income or move £100,000 of savings/investments
Use the Current Account Switch Service to move the old account across, direct debits included
HSBC credits the £500 once the conditions are met; the income or savings test can be completed within 90 days
hsbc-premier-switch-500.risk: The bar is high: either £100,000 of income or £100,000 sitting with HSBC, which most people cannot meet; HSBC can withdraw the offer at any time and the payout timing follows its terms; a full switch closes the old account and moves direct debits, so check salary and bills first; the travel insurance and health benefits only apply once applied for.
hsbc-premier-switch-500.source: HSBC UK Premier Bank Account page (£500 and Current Account Switch Service conditions, checked 21 November 2026) plus the TopReferrals UK banking bonus table

tide-business-referral-100.title: [UK] Tide business account referral: £100 each after £500 of card spend in three months
tide-business-referral-100.highlight: Open a Tide business account with an existing member's referral code and spend £500 on the Tide card within three months to collect £100 each, paid within eight weeks; UK companies, sole traders and freelancers all qualify
tide-business-referral-100.regions: [UK] UK-registered companies, sole traders and freelancers; must be new to Tide (no previous account) and enter the referral code at sign-up or within seven days
tide-business-referral-100.content: Tide's Refer a Friend page says: 'Refer a friend to Tide and you'll both earn a £100 cash bonus.' The new business enters the referral code on the 'Add referral code' screen during sign-up, and the FAQ allows it within seven days of opening. Once the account is approved, the new business spends £500 on its Tide card within three months and both sides receive £100, paid into their Tide accounts within eight weeks of the spend being validated. The terms are precise: the £500 has to be card spend, so disputes and recharges do not count, and neither do subscriptions, account fees, gift cards or bill payments; both accounts must still be open when Tide pays; a member can refer five businesses a month and each business can only claim once. Third-party readings of the 2026 terms add that the referrer's side scales with their plan - £100 on Lite, £125 on Smart, £150 on Pro, £200 on Max - while the new business always gets £100. Checked on tide.co/referral-bonus on 21 November 2026: the £100, the £500 within three months and the eight-week payout are all stated on the page.
tide-business-referral-100.conditions: UK-registered business or self-employed; no previous Tide account; enter the referral code at sign-up or within seven days; spend £500 on the Tide card within three months (disputes, recharges, subscriptions, account fees, gift cards and bill payments excluded); both accounts active when the reward is paid; one reward per business and up to five referrals per member per month.
steps: Ask a friend with a Tide account for their referral code, generated in the app
Apply for the business account in the Tide app and enter the code on the 'Add referral code' screen
Pass KYC and credit checks, then start spending on the Tide card
Reach £500 of card spend within three months and both sides receive £100 within eight weeks
tide-business-referral-100.risk: Tide's paid plans (Smart, Pro, Max) carry a monthly fee and only Lite comes close to free, so check the fee before choosing; the £500 must be card spend, not transfers, bills or top-ups; business accounts need KYC and a UK-registered business; Tide can change the terms, and the referrer-side tiers come from app terms.
tide-business-referral-100.source: Tide Refer a Friend page and key terms (£100 each, £500 of card spend in three months, eight-week payout, checked 21 November 2026) plus the TopReferrals UK banking bonus table

quidco-refer-10.title: [UK] Quidco referral: £10 for a new member after £5 of confirmed cashback
quidco-refer-10.highlight: Join Quidco through a friend's personal referral link, earn £5 of confirmed cashback within 180 days and £10 lands in the account automatically; the friend's side pays £20 or £25 depending on their membership
quidco-refer-10.regions: [UK] quidco.com only; new members must sign up through a friend's personal referral link, aged 18+
quidco-refer-10.content: Quidco's official Refer a Friend page says 'Get up to £25 for you and £10 for each friend you refer': the friend registers through the personal link and, once they have earned £5 of confirmed cashback - which can come from several purchases - both referral rewards are paid into their Quidco accounts. The FAQ sets the edges: cashback earned through gift cards, Bonus Cashback promotions and no-spend routes such as free SIMs, surveys or insurance quotes does not count towards the £5; a member can be paid for up to ten successful referrals in a rolling 12 months; multiple accounts to farm bonuses are banned. It is the same kind of offer as the TopCashback UK entry on this site but with no campaign window, and Quidco says the amount advertised on the landing page when the friend signs up is the one that applies. Checked on quidco.com on 21 November 2026: the £10 for the new member, the £5 confirmed-cashback trigger and the ten-a-year cap are all on the referral page and in the help centre.
quidco-refer-10.conditions: UK new member aged 18+; must use a friend's personal referral link (finding the site yourself does not count); earn £5 of confirmed cashback within 180 days, across one or more purchases; gift cards, Bonus Cashback promotions, free SIMs, surveys and insurance quotes do not count; up to ten paid referrals per rolling 12 months; no multiple accounts.
steps: Ask a friend for their Quidco referral link and clear browser cookies before opening it
Register a new Quidco account through the link and verify the email
Click through Quidco to a retailer and shop normally until £5 of cashback is confirmed
The £10 referral reward is paid into the account once that cashback confirms
quidco-refer-10.risk: Cashback takes weeks or months to move from pending to confirmed, so the £5 is not a same-day step; sign up without the link and Quidco will not pay; the reward amount can change and the landing page on the day of signup decides; website and app amounts can differ.
quidco-refer-10.source: Quidco Refer a Friend page and help centre (£10 for the new member, £5 of confirmed cashback, ten referrals a year, checked 21 November 2026) plus the TopReferrals Quidco entry

clearpay-invite-10.title: [UK] Clearpay invite a friend: £10 off a £50+ order, valid for 90 days
clearpay-invite-10.highlight: Accept a friend's Clearpay invite as a new customer and £10 of referral credit is applied to your next £50+ Clearpay order; the credit lasts 90 days, is single use, and the friend gets £10 off too
clearpay-invite-10.regions: [UK] New Clearpay (Afterpay UK) customers with no active account and no active account in the past 12 calendar months
clearpay-invite-10.content: Clearpay's official Invite a Friend terms are explicit: a referred customer - someone who has no active Clearpay account at the time of referral and has not had one in the past 12 calendar months - who signs up through the invite receives a promotional code for £10 of referral credit towards any eligible Clearpay purchase of £50 or more. The person who referred them gets £10 off their next £50+ purchase as well. The credit expires 90 days after issue, is single use, and Clearpay can recover it if the order is returned or refunded. The terms also cap the referrer at five new customers and £50 in total, and the credit cannot be transferred, exchanged for cash or applied to a previous order. Clearpay's help centre adds that the credit is assigned automatically to the account's Promos tab and applied at checkout without typing a code. Checked on clearpay.co.uk on 21 November 2026: the £10, the £50 minimum and the 90-day validity match between the refer-terms page and the help centre.
clearpay-invite-10.conditions: UK new customer aged 18+; no active Clearpay account and none in the previous 12 calendar months; must arrive through a friend's invite link; the credit only applies to a single £50+ order, lasts 90 days and is single use; the referrer is capped at five referrals and £50.
steps: Ask a friend for their Clearpay Invite a Friend link
Open it, install the app and register with your mobile number so the code attaches to the account
Check the Promos tab in the app to confirm the £10 credit has arrived
Place an order of £50 or more and choose Clearpay at checkout; the credit applies automatically
clearpay-invite-10.risk: The credit is not cash: it only reduces the value of a Clearpay instalment order and only above £50; it dies after 90 days; returns and cancellations let Clearpay take it back; missed instalments affect UK credit files because Clearpay reports to the three agencies; smaller orders cannot use it.
clearpay-invite-10.source: Clearpay Invite a Friend terms and help centre (£10 credit, £50 minimum order, 90-day validity, checked 21 November 2026) plus the TopReferrals Clearpay entry

zilch-refer-5.title: [UK] Zilch referral: £5 in Rewards each after the friend's first Tap and Pay
zilch-refer-5.highlight: A new Zilch user joins through a friend's link, passes ID checks, gets the Zilch card and makes one Tap and Pay purchase in store, and both sides receive £5 in Rewards; Zilch sets no cap on referrals
zilch-refer-5.regions: [UK] UK residents aged 18+; the new user must pass ID checks and receive the Zilch card within 30 calendar days
zilch-refer-5.content: Zilch's referral page says 'Refer a friend and we'll give you both £5 in Rewards when they've made their first Tap and Pay purchase'. The help centre sets out the path: the friend registers through the personal invite link, completes identity verification, is issued the Zilch card, adds it to a digital wallet and makes one Tap and Pay purchase in store, after which £5 lands on both sides. Zilch also says referral amounts can vary during promotional periods and that the amount at the time the friend registers is the one that applies. Zilch is a UK buy-now-pay-later product with a virtual card, so Rewards are credit inside the app rather than cash in a bank account. The number of referrals is described as unlimited, though risk systems watch same-device and same-address sign-ups. Checked on zilch.com and help.zilch.com on 21 November 2026: the £5 and the first Tap and Pay trigger match, while TopReferrals lists it as '£5 in Rewards, no spend needed' even though a purchase is still required.
zilch-refer-5.conditions: UK resident aged 18+; must be new to Zilch; register through a friend's personal invite link and complete identity verification plus card issue within 30 calendar days; add the card to a digital wallet and make one Tap and Pay purchase in store; amounts can change in promotional periods.
steps: Ask an existing Zilch user for their referral link
Register through the link, complete ID checks and get approved for the Zilch card
Add the Zilch card to Apple Pay or Google Pay
Make one Tap and Pay purchase in store and both sides receive £5 in Rewards
zilch-refer-5.risk: Rewards can only be spent inside Zilch, not withdrawn as cash; a real in-store Tap and Pay is required, so registering without buying earns nothing; Zilch is buy-now-pay-later and credit limits affect your file, with fees for missed payments; the referral page and help centre describe the trigger slightly differently, so follow the app.
zilch-refer-5.source: Zilch Refer and earn page and Zilch help centre (£5 in Rewards, Tap and Pay trigger, 30-day window, checked 21 November 2026) plus the TopReferrals Zilch entry

rebtel-invite-10.title: [Global] Rebtel invite: $10 of call credit each after a $1+ first payment
rebtel-invite-10.highlight: A friend signs up through your Rebtel invite link and makes a first payment of at least $1, and both sides get $10 of Rebtel credit for international calls or mobile top-ups; up to 50 invites per account
rebtel-invite-10.regions: [Global] New Rebtel users who are not and have never been Rebtel customers; app or website sign-up with a number that can receive a code
rebtel-invite-10.content: Rebtel's official help centre says that when you refer a friend with your unique link and the friend signs up and makes a payment of at least USD 1, both of you receive USD 10 in Rebtel Credits, applied instantly and usable for international calls or mobile recharges. It also caps the programme at 50 friends per person and notes that credits expire after 12 months of account inactivity and cannot be transferred or cashed out. Rebtel's legal Invite bonus page words the trigger differently: the bonus is credited when the referred user has made successful payments of 5 USD or more, and free credits, deals and trials do not count. Reading both, a first top-up of $5 or more sits safely above either threshold. This fills a gap on the site: Rebtel is about international calling and topping up overseas numbers, popular with UK, European and South Asian diaspora communities, and it is the only entry in TopReferrals' Calling sector. Checked on both official Rebtel pages on 21 November 2026.
rebtel-invite-10.conditions: Must be a new Rebtel customer - not current and not a past customer; must sign up through an existing user's invite link; make a first payment of at least $1 (help centre) or $5 (legal terms); credit only works for Rebtel calls and top-ups, expires after 12 months of inactivity and cannot be transferred or withdrawn; up to 50 invites per person.
steps: Ask an existing Rebtel user for their invite link, generated in the Accounts section
Register a new account through the link and verify the phone number
Top up at least $5, which clears both the $1 and $5 wording in Rebtel's documents
Both accounts receive $10 of credit for international calls or mobile top-ups
rebtel-invite-10.risk: Rebtel's two official documents disagree on the first-payment threshold ($1 against $5), so top up $5 to be safe; credit is not cash and only works inside Rebtel, expiring after 12 months of inactivity; self-referral with several accounts is treated as abuse and the credit can be clawed back.
rebtel-invite-10.source: Rebtel help centre article on Rebtel Credits and the legal invite-bonus terms ($10 each, first-payment threshold, checked 21 November 2026) plus the TopReferrals Rebtel entry

voxi-friends-with-benefits-20.title: [UK] VOXI Friends with Benefits: up to £20 gift card each after the friend pays two months
voxi-friends-with-benefits-20.highlight: Join VOXI through a friend's Friends with Benefits link, pay two monthly bills and both sides get a tiered gift card worth £10, £15 or £20 - Amazon, Just Eat or PayPal cash - with double rewards up to £40 in promotional periods
voxi-friends-with-benefits-20.regions: [UK] UK residents; the new customer needs a £10+ plan, two consecutive payments within 60 days, and no promo code or student free code at checkout
voxi-friends-with-benefits-20.content: VOXI calls its referral scheme Friends with Benefits. The official help page states that when a friend goes on to pay for two months of their VOXI plan, both sides receive up to £20 in their choice of Amazon gift card, Just Eat gift card or cash via PayPal, and adds that double rewards of up to £40 are available during certain periods. The official terms PDF gives the tiers: a friend on a £10 or £12 plan earns £10 each, a £15 plan earns £15, and a £20 or unlimited plan earns £20; if the friend drops plan before the second payment, the lower tier applies. The gates are strict - the friend must buy a plan of £10 or more, make two consecutive payments within 60 days without pausing, and use no promotional code (including a one-month free code), otherwise the referral is void; both must hold an active plan when claiming. The claim email arrives after the second payment and the voucher has to be chosen within 90 days. One person can claim up to £2,000 of rewards a year. Checked on voxi.co.uk on 21 November 2026: the £20 ceiling, the two-month trigger and the voucher options match between the help page and the terms PDF.
voxi-friends-with-benefits-20.conditions: UK resident; new VOXI customer on a £10+ plan; two consecutive monthly payments within 60 days without pausing; no promotional code or student free code at checkout; both parties need an active plan when claiming; choose the voucher within 90 days of the claim email; annual reward cap of £2,000 per person.
steps: Ask a current VOXI customer for their Friends with Benefits link
Pick a £10+ plan through the link and complete sign-up without using a promo code
Pay two consecutive monthly bills within 60 days and keep the plan active
Choose an Amazon or Just Eat gift card, or PayPal cash, within 90 days of the email
voxi-friends-with-benefits-20.risk: The voucher only lands after two months of payments, so you pay two bills first; any promo code at checkout voids the referral; miss the 90-day claim window and it is gone; the £20 tier needs a £20+ plan, so most people get £10; VOXI runs on the Vodafone network and indoor signal varies by area.
voxi-friends-with-benefits-20.source: VOXI Friends with Benefits help page and terms PDF (£20 tiers, two-month trigger, double rewards up to £40, checked 21 November 2026) plus the TopReferrals VOXI entry

talkmobile-150gb-half-price-3m.title: [UK] Talkmobile 150GB at £5.97 for the first three months on a 12-month plan, then £11.95
talkmobile-150gb-half-price-3m.highlight: Vodafone-owned Talkmobile halves the first three months of its 12-month 150GB SIM-only plan to £5.97 with unlimited calls and texts plus EU roaming in 47 countries; the 100GB tier is £4.98 for the same period
talkmobile-150gb-half-price-3m.regions: [UK] UK address and UK bank card; new 12-month SIM-only contract with a credit check; EU roaming in 47 countries with a 5GB fair-use limit
talkmobile-150gb-half-price-3m.content: Talkmobile's SIM-only page carries a 'First 3 months half price' label on both large-data plans: 150GB on a 12-month contract at £5.97 a month for the first three months, then £11.95 from 20 February 2027, and 100GB at £4.98, then £9.95 from the same date. Both include unlimited minutes and texts, support eSIM, allow EU roaming in 47 destinations using the UK allowance under a 5GB fair-use policy, and connect to both Vodafone and Three networks automatically. It is not free money, but over the three months it saves £17.94 on the 150GB plan (£14.91 on 100GB) with no hidden extras, which suits anyone in the UK who wants a large data allowance short term. TopReferrals lists the same offer in its Mobile sector as '100GB for £4.98 a month, first 3 months'. Checked on talkmobile.co.uk/sim-only-deals on 21 November 2026: both half-price amounts, the 12-month term and the 20 February 2027 return to standard pricing are all on the page.
talkmobile-150gb-half-price-3m.conditions: UK address and UK bank card; new 12-month SIM-only contract with a credit check; half price only for the first three months, then £9.95 (100GB) or £11.95 (150GB) from 20 February 2027; early cancellation requires the remaining monthly fees; EU roaming in 47 countries with a 5GB fair-use data limit.
steps: Open the SIM-only page on talkmobile.co.uk and choose the 12-month 150GB (or 100GB) plan
Enter a UK address and payment details and pass the credit check
Activate the eSIM QR code or the physical SIM
Pay £5.97 for three months, then £11.95 from 20 February 2027
talkmobile-150gb-half-price-3m.risk: It is a 12-month contract, so leaving early means paying the remaining months; the half price only covers three months and the standard price is ordinary; a UK address, UK card and credit history are required, so overseas users cannot sign up; EU roaming data is capped at 5GB under fair use.
talkmobile-150gb-half-price-3m.source: Talkmobile SIM-only page (three months half price, 12-month term, return to standard pricing, checked 21 November 2026) plus the TopReferrals Talkmobile entry

railway-referral-20.title: [Global] Railway referral: $20 of credit once the new account upgrades to a paid plan
railway-referral-20.highlight: Sign up to Railway through an existing user's invite link and the new account can receive $20 of platform credit, equivalent to a month of Pro; Railway support confirms it is applied when the account upgrades to a paid plan
railway-referral-20.regions: [Global] New Railway accounts only, and the invite link must come before signing up
railway-referral-20.content: Railway's official docs state that any user who is referred gets $20 in Railway credits, equivalent to a free month on the Pro tier, while the referrer earns 15% commission on what the referred account pays. One account per person is enforced across email, GitHub and payment method. The timing matters: Railway support replied in its official community on 1 October 2026 that 'the $20 referral credit isn't granted at signup. It's applied when the referred account upgrades to a paid plan (Hobby or Pro)', and that the $5 a new workspace shows is the standard trial grant everyone gets. So the $20 is a discount on paying, not free cash. It is still worthwhile for small projects: $20 covers months of the Hobby plan or a month of Pro, credits carry no cash value, cannot be transferred and are non-refundable, and a card is required for usage beyond the credit. Checked on docs.railway.com and Railway's community on 21 November 2026.
railway-referral-20.conditions: New Railway account only, and the invite link must be opened before signing up; one account per person; the $20 applies when the workspace upgrades to Hobby or Pro; credits have no cash value and cannot be transferred or refunded; a card is required for usage above the credit.
steps: Ask an existing Railway user for their invite link, found on the Refer page of the dashboard
Sign up through the link and connect GitHub
Deploy a project, then upgrade the workspace to a Hobby or Pro paid plan
The $20 credit offsets the bill, roughly a free month on Pro
railway-referral-20.risk: The $20 is not granted at sign-up - it applies only after upgrading to a paid plan, which means binding a card first; signing up before opening the link forfeits it; one account per person, and duplicates get closed; the credit cannot be withdrawn.
railway-referral-20.source: Railway docs Accounts and Affiliate Program pages, plus Railway's own community reply that the credit applies on upgrading to a paid plan (1 October 2026) and the TopReferrals Railway entry

nordvpn-black-friday-2026.title: [Global] NordVPN Black Friday: 2-year Basic at $2.99/mo plus 3 extra months (save about $232)
nordvpn-black-friday-2026.highlight: Up to 78% off two-year plans plus three extra months: Basic works out at $2.99 a month, $80.73 for 27 months up front, Complete at $3.99 and Prime at $6.99, with the deal running to 9 December and a 30-day money-back guarantee
nordvpn-black-friday-2026.regions: [Global] Order on nordvpn.com; 78% off in the US, UK, France, Germany and others, 77% off in Canada, Australia, Sweden, Denmark, Switzerland and Taiwan, 79% off in Japan
nordvpn-black-friday-2026.content: NordVPN's Black Friday page states up to 78% off two-year plans plus three extra months, running from 21 October to 9 December 2026. The pricing page gives the actual bills: Basic at $2.99 a month, $80.73 for the first 27 months; Complete at $3.99 a month, $107.73; Prime at $6.99 a month, $188.73. Against the renewal price NordVPN uses as its baseline (Basic renews at $139.08 a year), the Basic deal saves about $232 over the term. Two conditions matter: the promotional price covers only the first subscription period and then auto-renews at the standard rate (Basic $139.08 a year, Complete $219.48, Prime $296.28), and the three extra months are already inside the 27 months rather than added on top. The 30-day money-back guarantee still applies. The site already covers the Surfshark and Proton Black Friday prices; NordVPN is the third major option on that shelf, cheaper up front but dearer on renewal. Checked on nordvpn.com/black-friday and /pricing on 21 November 2026: the amounts, the deadline and the renewal prices all match.
nordvpn-black-friday-2026.conditions: New NordVPN customers ordering through the Black Friday or pricing page; two-year term (27 months including the bonus) paid up front; the promotional price covers only the first term and then auto-renews at the standard rate (Basic $139.08 a year); refund within 30 days; slightly lower discounts in some regions (77% off in Canada and Australia).
steps: Open nordvpn.com/black-friday or the pricing page and switch the term to two years
Pick Basic ($2.99 a month) or Complete ($3.99 a month) and confirm the bill is for 27 months
Pay by card or PayPal, then download and sign in to the app
Ask for a full refund within 30 days if it is not for you; decide on renewal before the term ends
nordvpn-black-friday-2026.risk: Requires $80+ up front; auto-renewal is on by default and would charge $139.08 a year at the standard rate; the three extra months are already counted inside the 27; the discount only covers the first term; the refund has to be requested within 30 days.
nordvpn-black-friday-2026.source: NordVPN Black Friday and pricing pages (discounts, 27-month bill, deadline 9 December 2026, renewal prices, checked 21 November 2026) plus the TopReferrals NordVPN entry

shopify-uk-1-pound-3-months.title: [UK] Shopify: three days free then £1 a month for three months (Basic is £25 a month)
shopify-uk-1-pound-3-months.highlight: New Shopify merchants in the UK get three free days and then three months at £1 a month against the £25 Basic monthly price, saving about £72; the trial needs no card, but selling needs a paid plan
shopify-uk-1-pound-3-months.regions: [UK] New merchants on shopify.com/uk; UK business details and a card able to pay £1; standard pricing from £19 to £25 a month after three months
shopify-uk-1-pound-3-months.content: Shopify's UK pricing page currently reads 'Try 3 days free, then £1/month for 3 months': Basic is £25 a month billed monthly or £19 billed yearly, Grow £65 or £49, Advanced £344 or £259 and Plus from £1,800, and new merchants pay £1 a month for the first three months before standard pricing starts. The three-day trial needs no credit card, but a paid plan and a card are required to open the store for real. Two practical limits: during the trial the store stays in private mode with checkout switched off, so real orders only start once a plan is chosen, and promotional period fees are not refundable, which is why committing to yearly billing inside the £1 window is a bad idea. Shopify's help centre adds that trials cannot be extended and promotions are not reset. On the Basic monthly price the three months cost £3 instead of £75, a saving of £72 (about $94). Checked on shopify.com/uk/pricing and the free trial landing page on 21 November 2026.
shopify-uk-1-pound-3-months.conditions: New merchant on shopify.com/uk; the three-day trial needs no card, but selling requires a paid plan and a card; £1 a month for three months, then standard pricing (Basic £25 monthly or £19 yearly); checkout is closed during the trial; promotional period fees are not refundable and trials cannot be extended.
steps: Open the shopify.com/uk free trial page and create a store with your email, no card needed
Set up products, theme, shipping and taxes during the trial
Choose the Basic plan and add a card, billed £1 a month for three months
From month four it bills £25 a month (or £19 on yearly); cancel in Settings > Plan if you do not want it
shopify-uk-1-pound-3-months.risk: You cannot sell during the trial, and going live means binding a card; promotional fees are non-refundable so yearly billing inside the window is risky; the price jumps to £25 a month after three months; third-party payment providers add transaction fees; forgetting to cancel keeps the monthly charge running.
shopify-uk-1-pound-3-months.source: Shopify UK pricing and free-trial pages (£1 a month for three months, three-day trial, standard prices, checked 21 November 2026) plus the TopReferrals Shopify entry

names-free-co-uk-domain.title: [UK] Names.co.uk: a free .co.uk domain for a year (and a .com for £1.99)
names-free-co-uk-domain.highlight: Names.co.uk gives new customers one .co.uk domain free for a year and lets them add a .com for £1.99, both on annual registration paid online; renewal then follows the standard price
names-free-co-uk-domain.regions: [UK/Global] New Names.co.uk customers; online payment required and domains must be registered for a year; some extensions require a UK presence
names-free-co-uk-domain.content: Names.co.uk states the offer in a footnote on its homepage: 'Get a single .co.uk domain free for one year. Additionally, get a .com domain for £1.99 when registered for one year.' The same footnote lists first-year prices for other extensions - .uk, .org.uk and .me.uk at £3.99, .net £8.99, .org £7.99, .info £6.99, .biz £6.99 and so on - all on annual registration. It complements the free subdomains already on this site from Gravatar and L53: this is a real first-level .co.uk, useful for a UK-facing site, a landing page or a branded mailbox. The catch is renewal: the first year is free and the second bills at the standard rate, roughly £10 for .co.uk, so decide before the renewal date whether to keep it. Checked on names.co.uk on 21 November 2026: the footnote and the extension prices are on the homepage, and TopReferrals lists it as 'Free .co.uk domain for year one'.
names-free-co-uk-domain.conditions: New Names.co.uk customer; must pay online and register for a one-year term to get the first-year price; one free .co.uk per account; renewal at the standard price; WHOIS details must be real, and some extensions require a UK contact address.
steps: Open names.co.uk and search for the .co.uk name you want
Add it to the basket and confirm the first-year price shows as £0 on annual registration
Optionally add a .com for £1.99 at the same time
Pay online to register it, then point the DNS wherever you like, including Cloudflare
names-free-co-uk-domain.risk: Only the first year is free and the renewal bills at the standard rate, so cancel if you do not want it; most registrars require a valid payment method for first-year offers; some .co.uk registrations need a UK address; the domain alone is not hosting, so a site still needs a host or something like GitHub Pages.
names-free-co-uk-domain.source: Names.co.uk homepage promotion footnote (free .co.uk for a year, .com for £1.99, prices for other extensions, checked 21 November 2026) plus the TopReferrals Names.co.uk entry

wispr-flow-free-dictation.title: [Global] Wispr Flow free dictation on Mac, Windows and phones, with meeting notes included
wispr-flow-free-dictation.highlight: Wispr Flow's free plan covers AI dictation on Mac, Windows, iPhone and Android in 100+ languages, plus the Notetaker for meeting notes and MCP access, with no card required; only weekly limits apply and Pro is $15 a month
wispr-flow-free-dictation.regions: [Global] Mac, Windows, iPhone and Android; just an account, no card; dictation in 100+ languages
wispr-flow-free-dictation.content: Wispr Flow's pricing page says it is free on Mac, Windows, iPhone and Android: the free plan includes dictation and the Notetaker, which handles meeting notes with speaker identification, lets you ask questions about a meeting and offers MCP access so notes can flow into Claude, ChatGPT and other tools. The FAQ is explicit that you never need a credit card to start. The free limit is weekly usage: the page describes generous weekly usage, free accounts have a weekly meeting limit, the allowance resets every week without carrying over and phones get less than desktop. Pro removes the limits and keeps notes longer at $15 a month billed monthly or $12 a month billed yearly, with 50% off for students and 40% for educators. Compared with the meeting-note tools already on this site, such as Spellar and Grain, Wispr Flow's difference is system-level dictation: hold a shortcut in any text field and speak, and the text lands at the cursor, including mixed-language speech. Checked on wisprflow.ai/pricing on 21 November 2026: the free plan contents, the no-card claim and the Pro prices are all on the page.
wispr-flow-free-dictation.conditions: The free plan needs no credit card; works on Mac, Windows, iPhone and Android; free accounts have a weekly dictation allowance and a weekly meeting limit, and wait for the reset or upgrade when they run out; Pro is $15 a month or $12 a month billed yearly; 50% off for students and 40% for educators; meeting notes need microphone permission.
steps: Download the client for your platform from wisprflow.ai
Register a free account with email or Google, no card required
Grant microphone and accessibility permissions and set the dictation shortcut
Hold the shortcut in any text field and speak; the text appears at the cursor
wispr-flow-free-dictation.risk: The free plan has weekly word and meeting caps that heavy users will hit; phones get a smaller allowance than desktop; dictation needs microphone and accessibility permissions; audio is processed in the cloud, so read the privacy terms before using it on sensitive material; the exact weekly word counts are not published, so the app is the authority.
wispr-flow-free-dictation.source: Wispr Flow pricing page (free plan contents, no card required, Pro at $15 a month, checked 21 November 2026) plus the TopReferrals Wispr Flow entry

amazon-prime-uk-young-adults-6m.regions: [UK] Students at UK or Irish higher-education institutions with an institutional email or enrolment proof, or UK users aged 18-24 with a driving licence or passport for age checks
amazon-prime-uk-young-adults-6m.content: Amazon's UK help page describes Prime for Students and 18-24 year-olds: an initial six-month trial, after which the membership renews automatically at a discounted rate - for students for as long as they study or up to four years, and for 18-24 year-olds until their 25th birthday - and then at the standard Prime price. The current discounted rate shown on the Prime page is £4.49 a month, half the £8.99 standard price, and the page notes it is a six-month trial courtesy of Microsoft Surface for new members only. During the trial the benefits match a standard membership except that household members cannot be invited to share, Twitch gets a single channel subscription for one month only, and Kindle Owners' Lending Library is unavailable. Students need an institutional email or other enrolment proof, and 18-24s upload a driving licence or passport to verify age; customers can hold this discounted membership for a maximum of six years overall. At £8.99 a month the six free months are worth about £53.94 (roughly $70), with another £4.50 a month saved afterwards. Checked on amazon.co.uk on 21 November 2026: the six-month trial and the £4.49 rate are both stated.
amazon-prime-uk-young-adults-6m.conditions: UK or Irish higher-education student with an institutional email or enrolment proof, or a UK user aged 18-24 with a driving licence or passport; six-month free trial then £4.49 a month; student discount lasts up to four years, the 18-24 rate until age 25; maximum six years in total; no household sharing during the trial, one month of a single Twitch channel and no Kindle Owners' Lending Library.
steps: Open the Prime for Students and 18-24 page on amazon.co.uk
Verify as a student with an institutional email, or as an 18-24 with a driving licence or passport
Confirm the six-month free trial and add a payment method
Decide before the trial ends; turn off auto-renewal in Manage Your Prime Membership if you do not want it
amazon-prime-uk-young-adults-6m.risk: Student status or age has to verify, and a failed check cancels the discounted membership; after six months it charges £4.49 a month automatically until cancelled; there is no household sharing during the trial; the discounted rate is sponsor-funded and can change.

rime-free-50-monthly.title: [Global] Rime free tier: $50 of voice usage every month, no card needed (about 1,667 minutes of synthesis)
rime-free-50-monthly.highlight: Every account gets $50 of usage a month without a card, covering Prism speech-to-speech at $0.08 a minute, Coda v2 at $0.05, Mist v3 at $0.03 and Rime STT at $0.002, metered by audio minute, so the free tier is roughly 1,667 minutes of low-latency synthesis a month
rime-free-50-monthly.regions: [Global] Anywhere rime.ai is reachable; register at app.rime.ai. Voices are strongest in English, with multi-language TTS and STT available
rime-free-50-monthly.value: $50 a month (about 1,667 minutes of Mist v3)
rime-free-50-monthly.content:
Rime's official pricing page, read on 21 November 2026, lists the Free plan as "$50 of usage every month, renews monthly" with "No card required", covering Prism, Mist v3, Coda v2 and Rime STT; the FAQ repeats that every account starts with $50 of usage free every month across every Rime model with no card required. At list prices that is about 1,667 minutes of Mist v3 at $0.03 a minute, 1,000 minutes of Coda v2 at $0.05 or 625 minutes of Prism at $0.08; text to speech is metered by characters at roughly 1,000 characters a minute, and STT moved from free to $0.002 a minute on 20 November 2026.

The allowance resets monthly and does not roll over, and when it runs out the account simply stops rather than billing you, so continuing means upgrading to Flex with a card. It suits prototypes for voice assistants, podcast narration, IVR and phone agents: test voices and latency on the free tier, then decide whether the Scale plan at $100 a month with 20 percent off every rate is worth it.
rime-free-50-monthly.conditions: The monthly allowance resets and never rolls over; the free tier takes no card and stops at zero instead of billing; going past it requires upgrading to Flex (per minute) or Scale ($100 a month); concurrency and rate limits apply on the free tier; STT charges $0.002 a minute from the allowance since 20 November 2026; commercial use follows Rime's terms and attribution rules.
steps: Sign up at app.rime.ai with an email or Google account, no card
Create an API key in the console and pick Mist v3, Coda v2 or Prism
Send a short text or audio sample with the official quickstart to confirm usage comes off the free tier
Upgrade to Flex or Scale on the pricing page when the allowance runs out
rime-free-50-monthly.risk: The allowance cannot be resold or turned into a multi-layer proxy without getting throttled or banned; Chinese and other non-English voices are weaker than the English line-up; the $50 is measured at list price, so real minutes depend on voice, character count and concurrency; the free tier carries no SLA and Rime can change the allowance at any time
rime-free-50-monthly.source: Rime's official pricing page and FAQ, read 21 November 2026, plus a visitor submission received 21 November 2026 at 09:04 (lead from X)

deapi-5-free-credits.highlight: Signing up with no card credits $5 immediately, and one OpenAI-style key reaches 100+ open-source models such as FLUX.1 Schnell, Qwen Image, LTX 2.3, MiniMax H3, Kokoro and Whisper for images, video, TTS, transcription, OCR and embeddings, enough to wire up a whole generation pipeline first
deapi-5-free-credits.regions: [Global] Anywhere deapi.ai is reachable; the Basic tier needs no card and reaches every endpoint with more conservative rate limits
deapi-5-free-credits.content:
deAPI's pricing page and docs, read on 21 November 2026, state that every new account receives $5 in free credits at sign-up with no credit card and no commitment, landing on the Basic tier with conservative limits for testing. The quickstart and FAQ add that the bonus is valid for 30 days from account creation, that any top-up inside those 30 days keeps the remaining bonus permanently, and that disposable email addresses get no bonus.

The v2 API covers image generation, edit, OCR, background removal and upscaling; video generation, animation and audio sync; speech, music and transcription; embeddings and web search. Basic limits include 3 RPM and 100 requests a day for images, 1 RPM and 15 a day for video with MiniMax H3 capped at 3 videos a day, and 5 RPM and 300 a day for speech. $5 covers hundreds of images, several hours of transcription, or one end-to-end pipeline run before deciding whether to top up.
deapi-5-free-credits.conditions: The $5 bonus expires 30 days after sign-up unless any top-up ($10, $25 or $50) is made inside that window; disposable or temporary email addresses get no bonus; Basic limits are tight (images 3 RPM, video 1 RPM and MiniMax H3 three a day); past the bonus you must pay, and there is no free renewal.
steps: Register at deapi.ai with a regular email, not a disposable one
Create an API key in the dashboard and try a model in the playground
Call the /api/v2 endpoint from the quickstart and watch the $5 balance drop
Top up the $10 minimum within 30 days if you plan to keep using it, which locks the bonus in
deapi-5-free-credits.risk: The bonus vanishes at 30 days if forgotten; Basic rate limits are low enough to look like an outage during concurrency tests; open-source model quality varies and each licence must be checked for commercial use; a small platform, so stability and data retention need your own review
deapi-5-free-credits.source: deAPI's official pricing page and docs.deapi.ai quickstart, FAQ and limits, read 21 November 2026, plus a visitor submission received 21 November 2026 at 09:03 (lead from X)

mixroute-5-free-credits.regions: [Global] Register at console.mixroute.ai; the service is run by ELITE CLOUD in Singapore, with top-ups by card or USDT/USDC
mixroute-5-free-credits.content:
MixRoute's FAQ and pricing page, read on 21 November 2026, say a new account receives $5 of free credit: free models work right away with no card, and a top-up unlocks all 250+ models. Credits never expire, top-ups earn 2, 3 or 5 percent bonus by tier, every model is billed at the official provider price with zero markup, and new accounts get 50 RPM rising to 100 after the first top-up.

Integration is three changes: point the base URL at https://api.mixroute.ai/v1, swap in the MixRoute key, and use the model IDs from its model page, while the SDK and request body stay OpenAI-compatible, so migrating from OpenRouter or provider SDKs is nearly free. The quickstart notes the first API key is created automatically at registration and that the $5 works without any top-up.
mixroute-5-free-credits.conditions: The $5 works only on free models until you top up, after which all 250+ models unlock and the balance applies to them too; credits never expire; new accounts get 50 RPM and 100 after the first top-up; paid models need a top-up; billing follows each provider's official price and the statement's exchange rate.
steps: Register at console.mixroute.ai and copy the auto-created API key
Change the base URL to https://api.mixroute.ai/v1 and use the model IDs from the model page
Test the link with a free model before topping up
Top up from $10 when you need the paid models, noting the Growth, Pro and Scale bonus tiers
mixroute-5-free-credits.risk: Before a top-up the $5 only covers free models, which reads like the 250+ catalogue does not work; gateway reliability and rate limits ride on upstream providers and can only be routed around by the platform; official price with no markup is not cheaper than going direct, it only saves managing accounts; a small operator whose long-term survival is your own risk

sakura-ai-engine-glm-deepseek-free.highlight: GLM-5.3-Flash and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash now run on Sakura's AI Engine as public previews with 3,000 free Chat Completions requests a month, both accepting images (GLM also video) through an OpenAI-compatible call, all inside Japanese data centres

sakura-ai-engine-glm-deepseek-free.content:
Sakura Internet's announcement of 18 November 2026 and the AI Engine product page, read on 21 November 2026, add preview/GLM-5.3-Flash and preview/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 on the Chat Completions endpoint. The free plan allows 3,000 requests a month across Chat Completions as a whole rather than per model, with overage billed at 0.4 yen per 10,000 input tokens and 4.0 yen per 10,000 output tokens; the free plan also includes 10,000 embeddings calls and 50 each for transcription and speech.

Setup needs a Sakura member ID, a cloud project, phone verification and a card on file, with no charge on the free plan.

As public previews they can end or change price without notice: the previous preview model, Kimi-K2.6, was retired on 9 November 2026 and replaced by these two nine days later, so do not put production on them.
sakura-ai-engine-glm-deepseek-free.conditions: A Sakura member ID, cloud project, phone verification and a credit card are required; the 3,000 monthly requests cover Chat Completions as a whole, not each model; the free plan throttles with 429 rather than billing past the allowance; public previews carry no SLA and can stop or be repriced at any time; free plan sign-ups are capped.
steps: Apply for the free foundation-model plan at ai.sakura.ad.jp and verify by phone with a Japanese number
Register a card (not charged on the free plan), create a cloud project and enable AI Engine
Set the model to preview/GLM-5.3-Flash or preview/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 in each request
Call Chat Completions in OpenAI-compatible form and watch the 3,000 monthly total
sakura-ai-engine-glm-deepseek-free.risk: A Japanese number and card make sign-up awkward from abroad; the 3,000 requests are shared across models rather than granted per model; previews have no SLA and historically rotate fast, with Kimi-K2.6 lasting about half a year; exceeding the free plan returns 429; sign-ups are capped

lxi-be-free-hosting-5gb.title: [Global] LXI.be permanently free hosting: 5 GB, unlimited traffic, PHP and MySQL, no card
lxi-be-free-hosting-5gb.highlight: German LXI.be Free plan at EUR 0 forever: 5 GB of web space, unlimited traffic, PHP 8.3 with MariaDB, 5 .lxi.be subdomains, free SSL, no ads, plus 5,000 starter AI credits.
lxi-be-free-hosting-5gb.regions: [Global] Servers in the EU (run by a Munich, Germany company); no card and no contract; sign-up and control panel are in German, a browser translator works.
lxi-be-free-hosting-5gb.value: 5 GB and unlimited traffic (Pro tier costs EUR 9.99/month)
lxi-be-free-hosting-5gb.content:
LXI.be is run by Henley Franc UG in Munich, Germany. Its main products are an AI website builder (LXI Maker) and AI writing and translation tools (LXI Studio), but the Free plan also includes real shared hosting: 5 GB of web space, unlimited traffic, PHP 8.3, MariaDB 10.11 (MySQL compatible, with phpMyAdmin), automatically issued and renewed SSL, and up to 5 yourname.lxi.be subdomains. The official page states EUR 0 forever, no card, no contract, and no ads or links inserted into your site.

The control panel is Virtualmin with Webmin: create databases, upload files in the browser and extract ZIP archives, install WordPress, ClassicPress or phpMyAdmin in one click, make your own backups, add cron jobs. Servers are in the EU. At sign-up you pick the prefix you want (availability is checked instantly), and after the email confirmation the platform starts provisioning. The official page says the address is ready after the email confirmation, but the free8 forum reports a queue: on 11-20 one member posted the official notice that setup takes over 24 hours and is still processing, and on 11-21 another replied that the account opened after 48 hours.

The Free plan also carries AI credits: 5,000 starter credits for new accounts, then 1,000 AI credits a day and 10,000 a month, usable for building sites with LXI Maker and for writing and translation in Studio (the official note is 1 credit = 200 input tokens or 50 output tokens).

The official llms.txt (facts as of 2026-10-17) says FTP/SFTP access is not available yet and files go through the browser file manager; third-party tutorials show FTPS port 2121 and SSH/SFTP port 2222 credentials in the panel, so confirm in the panel once the account is open.
lxi-be-free-hosting-5gb.conditions: Free plan: 5 GB web space, unlimited traffic, 5 .lxi.be subdomains, PHP 8.3 with MariaDB 10.11, free SSL, no ads; EUR 0 forever, no card, no contract. Custom domains must be registered at LXI (hosting for them stays free) and domains registered elsewhere cannot be connected yet. Email confirmation is needed and hosting is not instant (the forum measured 24 to 48 hours). Sign-up and panel are in German. This entry carries no referral code or affiliate link; sign up directly on the official site.
steps: Open the LXI.be free hosting page, click Start for free and enter your name, email and the subdomain prefix you want
Click the confirmation link in the email, then follow provisioning in My area under Hosting & email
Once active, work in the Virtualmin panel: upload files, create a MariaDB database, or install WordPress in one click
For your own domain, buy it at LXI (hosting stays free); otherwise use yourname.lxi.be
lxi-be-free-hosting-5gb.risk: The platform only launched in 2026 and has no third-party reputation in English or Chinese; the terms do not say whether idle accounts are reclaimed or what happens when 5 GB or the traffic limit is exceeded, only that free services may have their own restrictions.
