The free subdomain belongs to lxi.be, so a permanent site ties its address to someone else's domain. Provisioning takes 24 to 48 hours and several forum members report slow nodes. The referral codes circulating in the thread (20,000 credits for both sides) are personal referral links and are not included here.
lxi-be-free-hosting-5gb.source: free8.net thread on the German LXI.DE 5 GB unlimited-traffic free hosting (2026-11-19, 35 replies) plus the LXI.be official free hosting page and llms.txt (checked 2026-11-21)

antideploy-free-1vcpu-1gb.title: [Global] Antideploy free 1 vCPU / 1 GB app: 1 Postgres and unlimited static sites, no card
antideploy-free-1vcpu-1gb.highlight: No card and no phone verification: one always-on app at 1 vCPU / 1 GB, one Postgres database, unlimited static sites, 30 deploys a month and 100 awake hours, waking from idle on the next visit.
antideploy-free-1vcpu-1gb.regions: [Global] Apps run on Antideploy's cloud (a third-party test saw a Singapore node); sign in with GitHub, Google or email; the free plan does not allow custom domains.
antideploy-free-1vcpu-1gb.content:
Antideploy launched in 2026 and its free plan is not a demo: unlimited static sites forever; one app with a server (1 shared vCPU and 1 GB of memory per app, sleeping when nobody visits and waking on the next request); one Postgres database and one storage bucket; 30 successful deploys a month with failed deploys free; three cron jobs per app, and pre-deploy checks, secrets, logs and deploy history all included. You can deploy from a GitHub repository, a local folder, or by letting a coding agent push it, and each app gets a username.antideploy.app address with automatic HTTPS.

A free8 forum thread from 11-08 and several hands-on write-ups agree: sign-up needs no card and no phone verification, and GitHub, Google or email (one-time link, valid 15 minutes) all work; two files went live in about two and a half to three minutes, a 1 GB app showed about 965 MB of memory, and a cold start from idle took around 5 seconds.

The hard limit on the free plan is 100 awake hours a month: the official pricing page says emails go out at 80 and 100 hours, and past the cap the app pauses until the 1st of the next month with code, files, database and address kept. The official docs also describe agent deployment: point the agent at antideploy.com/agent.md and approve its link.
antideploy-free-1vcpu-1gb.conditions: Free plan: 1 app with a server, 1 Postgres, 1 storage bucket, unlimited static sites, 30 successful deploys a month, 3 cron jobs per app, 100 awake hours a month. No custom domains (that needs the Go plan). Postgres only, no MySQL or Redis. No abuse protection, so do not keep the app awake with a script.
steps: Open antideploy.com and sign in with GitHub, Google or email (the email route sends a one-time link)
Create an app from a local folder, a GitHub repository, or by letting a coding agent follow agent.md
Use the xxx.antideploy.app address and automatic HTTPS once the deploy finishes
Create the one Postgres database, set environment variables, and add cron jobs if needed (5 minute minimum)
antideploy-free-1vcpu-1gb.risk: A new platform (paid plans are priced in rupees) whose free limits can change. The 100 awake hours a month work out to about 3 hours a day, so a keep-alive script burns them in 4 days and the app then waits for next month. Cold starts take a few seconds, custom domains are not available on the free plan, only Postgres is offered, and your data sits on someone else's machine, so keep your own backup.
antideploy-free-1vcpu-1gb.source: free8.net thread on the free 1 core / 1 GB Antideploy offer with no card (2026-11-08, 11 replies) plus the Antideploy official pricing page (checked 2026-11-21) and hands-on tests (2026-11-08 and 2026-11-14)

smarterasp-60-day-free-windows.title: [Global] SmarterASP.NET 60-day free Windows hosting: ASP.NET/.NET to Node, no card
smarterasp-60-day-free-windows.highlight: 60 days of Windows shared hosting with no credit card: ASP.NET through .NET 10, Node.js, MSSQL, MySQL and PostgreSQL, a free temporary domain with SSL, and GitHub auto-deploy.
smarterasp-60-day-free-windows.regions: [Global] US and Netherlands datacenters; sign up with email or GitHub, no card at any point.
smarterasp-60-day-free-windows.content:
SmarterASP.NET has sold Windows hosting since 1999. The trial runs 60 days with no card at any point and activates instantly: register with email or GitHub, click the verification link, pick a site type in the panel, and the platform assigns a temporary subdomain such as yourname.smarterasp.net; free SSL is enabled from the panel and takes a few minutes.

The trial handles ASP.NET and ASP.NET Core (the official page lists .NET 10), Node.js with automatic deployment, and PHP, with MSSQL (2008 through 2025), MySQL and PostgreSQL. You can connect a GitHub repository so a push builds and deploys, or upload a ZIP through the file manager. The free trial also includes 24/7 support.

Watch the discrepancy: the official trial page says unlimited space and bandwidth, while third-party hosting directories record the W60 trial as 5 GB of space, 10 GB of monthly traffic and one site, so go by what the sign-up page shows.

The hands-on feedback on NodeSeek from 10-23 was blunt: no SSH, very slow from mainland China, and short-lived. It fits a temporary .NET or Node site or a demo link, not a production site.
smarterasp-60-day-free-windows.conditions: 60-day free trial with no card; one site plus a free temporary subdomain; supports ASP.NET, .NET Core, Node.js and PHP with MSSQL, MySQL and PostgreSQL; the site stops when the trial ends, so export your data; the provider does not promise that the same person can repeat the trial; access from mainland China is slow.
steps: Open smarterasp.net/free_trial and click Free Trial, then Continue to Registration
Register with email or GitHub and activate through the verification email
Create a site in the control panel, choose ASP.NET or Node.js, and get the xxx.smarterasp.net temporary domain
Enable free SSL in the security settings, then deploy code through GitHub or the file manager
smarterasp-60-day-free-windows.risk: Windows, .NET and Node sites only, with no SSH or root. The forum measured slow access from mainland China, so it is not a proxy box. The official page says unlimited space while third-party records show 5 GB and 10 GB of monthly traffic, which may be capped. The site stops after 60 days and repeated trials risk being flagged as abuse.
smarterasp-60-day-free-windows.source: free8.net thread on SmarterASP.NET (2026-10-24) plus the official 60-day free trial page (checked 2026-11-21) and NodeSeek / NodeLoc hands-on feedback (2026-10-23)

trae-oneclick-deploy-free.title: [China] TRAE one-click deploy free period: static sites and Node apps online, 10 GB a day per site
trae-oneclick-deploy-free.highlight: TRAE's one-click deploy publishes a page or Node app to the public web, and during the free period a running site costs no credits: 10 GB a day and 100 QPS per site, on a platform subdomain with HTTPS.
trae-oneclick-deploy-free.regions: [China] TRAE China desktop client (Agent window, then My Sites), phone-number sign-up; sites sit on an assigned traesite.cn subdomain and cannot use your own domain.
trae-oneclick-deploy-free.value: 10 GB a day and 100 QPS per site (free period, $0)
trae-oneclick-deploy-free.content:
TRAE, ByteDance's AI coding IDE, builds one-click deploy into its client: tell the agent to deploy a finished web page or Node app and the platform packages, builds and publishes it, returning a traesite.cn link. You can then change the address, switch who can see it, roll back a version, and watch traffic and logs.

The official docs state that a deployed site keeps running and would normally consume credits, but during the current free period running a site costs none. An official community tutorial from 11-12 lists the specs: 10 GB of traffic per site per day, 100 QPS, static publishing capped at 99 files and 50 MB (anything larger is moved automatically to remote-built dynamic hosting), and only static artifacts or full-stack apps on Node.js 20 are accepted, with no database and no custom domain.

Sites are private by default: to let anyone open the link you must switch to visible to everyone, which is the question the community asks most often.

A free8 forum thread from 11-19 uses the feature to publish a demo site, with replies about the site address and sharing it. How many sites a free account can keep online, and when the free period ends, are not stated officially, so go by what the client shows.
trae-oneclick-deploy-free.conditions: Requires a TRAE China account (phone number). Only static pages and Node.js 20 full-stack apps are supported, with no database and no Python, Java or Go runtimes. Limits are 10 GB per site per day, 100 QPS, and 99 files or 50 MB for static publishes. Sites use an assigned traesite.cn subdomain and cannot use your own domain or ICP filing. The end of the free period is not published.
steps: Install the TRAE China desktop client, sign in with a phone number, and open My Sites in the Agent window
Click New deployment, or add the one-click deploy plugin in the conversation and point it at the artifact
Answer whether to reuse or create a site and whether it is private or public, then wait for the build and the link
In the site details switch to visible to everyone, change the URL, watch traffic, and pause the site when you are done so it does not bill credits after the free period
trae-oneclick-deploy-free.risk: The free period can end at any time, after which a running site consumes credits, and a site left running keeps spending them. Only a platform subdomain is offered, with no custom domain or ICP filing. 10 GB a day and 100 QPS per site are not enough for a real service. Projects with a database or a non-Node backend cannot be deployed. Links are private by default, so switch to public before sharing.
trae-oneclick-deploy-free.source: free8.net thread on TRAE site building and deployment (2026-11-19) plus the official TRAE deploy documentation and the official community tutorial (checked 2026-11-21)

uu-remote-vip-annual-half-2026.title: [China] NetEase UU Remote: VIP annual plan at half price, 119 yuan a year (238 normally, register before Dec 1)
uu-remote-vip-annual-half-2026.highlight: Accounts registered before Dec 1 can claim a half-price annual voucher in the app's message center: VIP drops from 238 to 119 yuan for the year (about 9.9 a month), while basic remote control stays free with no time limit
uu-remote-vip-annual-half-2026.regions: [China] NetEase UU Remote clients for Windows, macOS, iOS, Android and TV; the account must be registered before the December 1, 2026 launch, and the voucher is claimed from the message center inside the app
uu-remote-vip-annual-half-2026.value: 119 yuan saved (119 yuan for the year)
uu-remote-vip-annual-half-2026.content:
NetEase announced on November 19, 2026 that UU Remote launches VIP and SVIP tiers on December 1, and promised that basic remote control stays free with no cap on sessions or hours, no queue and no ads, at 1080p 30fps. The notice says users who registered before the December 1 launch can claim a half-price annual voucher; NetEase's own reply on V2EX put the price at 119 yuan a year, about 9.9 a month, claimed from the message center inside the client.

Paid tiers, cross-checked against the announcement and coverage by ITHome and V2EX: VIP is 238 yuan a year (30 yuan a month) and adds 4K, 144fps, up to 500Mbps, true-colour mode, HDR, a wireless second screen and multi-screen control; SVIP is 758 yuan a year (98 yuan a month) and adds global relay nodes on top of VIP.

In practice: install the client and register an account now, and the half-price annual voucher can be claimed before December 1. If you do not want to pay, do nothing and the free tier keeps working; nothing is charged automatically. Checked on November 21, 2026.
uu-remote-vip-annual-half-2026.conditions: The offer goes to accounts registered before the December 1, 2026 launch and must be claimed from the message center in the client; if the entry is missing, ask support to register it. The annual plan is paid up front and the half price applies to this first year only; renewals follow the official price. 4K, 144fps, 500Mbps and the second screen need VIP or above; the free tier stays at 1080p 30fps and roughly 8Mbps.
steps: Download the Windows or macOS client from uuyc.163.com and register with a phone number or WeChat
Update to the latest client and open the message center for the VIP launch notice and the half-price voucher
Claim it and pay 119 yuan for the VIP annual plan, or keep using the free tier
Consider SVIP at 758 yuan a year only if you need global relay nodes
uu-remote-vip-annual-half-2026.risk: The 4K and 144fps benefits only matter if you pay; the free tier already covers ordinary office remote control. The voucher lives in the in-app message center, so older clients may not show it. The annual plan is paid in full and the refund policy is not published. Only SVIP has global nodes.
uu-remote-vip-annual-half-2026.source: NetEase UU Remote official notice, November 19, 2026 (uuyc.163.com/blog/20261118-dwdsa.html), plus the official reply on V2EX confirming 119 yuan a year and the 2Libra thread of November 19, 2026

lenny-product-pass-2026.title: [Global] Lenny's Product Pass: 34 tools free for a year with a $200 annual or $400 Insider subscription (Cursor Pro and Google AI Pro are Insider only)
lenny-product-pass-2026.highlight: Subscribe to Lenny's Newsletter at $200 a year or Insider at $400 and claim a year of 34 AI and product tools; the Insider-only set alone (Cursor Pro, Google AI Pro, Supabase Pro, ElevenLabs) is worth more than $1,200
lenny-product-pass-2026.regions: [Global] Requires a paid Substack subscription (Annual $200 a year or Insider $400 a year) with an international card; most partner offers are limited to new customers of that product
lenny-product-pass-2026.value: About $1,200+ (Insider-only tools; the official page claims $40,000+)
lenny-product-pass-2026.content:
Lenny's Product Pass comes with a paid Lenny's Newsletter subscription: the official page lists 34 products and claims more than $40,000 of value, unlocked by Annual ($200 a year) or Insider ($400 a year) plans, claimed one by one from the dashboard with the subscribing email. Monthly subscribers are not eligible.

The $40,000 headline needs a discount: most of it is enterprise-scale seats such as PostHog Scale ($16,500) and Intercom Fin ($7,140) that an individual cannot use. What matters for a solo builder is the Insider-only tier: Cursor Pro (about $240 a year), Google AI Pro ($240 a year, including Gemini), Supabase Pro ($300 a year), Canva Business ($200), ElevenLabs Creator ($264 a year), Gamma, Lovable and n8n Cloud, plus 40 percent off Stripe Atlas, which together already exceed $1,200. Annual subscribers share Granola Business, Linear Business, Notion Business, Framer, Replit, Railway, Mobbin and Runway on a first-come basis, roughly 16 offers per drop.

Key limits: every product offer is for new customers only, so anything you have already paid for or trialled with an offer code does not count; codes stay valid only while the subscription is active and are revoked on cancellation, refund or chargeback; the collection rotates about every six months, so renewing in year two brings a new set rather than a second free year of the same products. Checked on November 21, 2026.
lenny-product-pass-2026.conditions: Requires the Annual ($200 a year) or Insider ($400 a year) plan; monthly plans are excluded. Claim with the subscribing email; accepting the Product Pass terms makes the subscription non-refundable. Each partner offer is claimed separately with its own deadline and eligibility, and most are for new customers of that product. Codes are revoked if the subscription lapses. Reselling, sharing or opening multiple accounts can lead to access being withdrawn.
steps: Pick Annual at $200 or Insider at $400 on lennysnewsletter.com
Sign in to lennysproductpass.com with the subscribing email and accept the terms (no refund afterwards)
Claim the codes you want from the dashboard, starting with in-demand ones like Cursor Pro and Google AI Pro
Redeem each code on the partner's site; the free year starts on the day you redeem it
lenny-product-pass-2026.risk: The $40,000 figure includes enterprise seats an individual will not use; the new-customer rule excludes tools you already pay for; the subscription fee is not refundable after accepting terms; codes die with the subscription; popular products run out; the $200 tier covers only part of the collection on a first-come basis; the collection rotates every six months.
lenny-product-pass-2026.source: Official lennysproductpass.com terms and FAQ read on November 21, 2026, plus Lenny's Newsletter launch post of July 28, 2026 (tiers, 34-product list) and the 2Libra thread of November 20, 2026

spaceship-com-3-60-com67.title: [Global] Spaceship: .com domain for $3.60 in the first year with code COM67 (about 65% off)
spaceship-com-3-60-com67.highlight: The official promo page lists .com at $3.60 for the first year with code COM67, down from $10.38 (about 65% off); one code per order, renewals go back to full price
spaceship-com-3-60-com67.regions: [Global] New .com registrations at spaceship.com (part of the Namecheap group), paid by major card or PayPal; premium domains excluded
spaceship-com-3-60-com67.content:
A 2Libra thread collected 2026 domain promo codes for Spaceship and Dynadot. Checking Spaceship's official promo page (spaceship.com/promos) on November 21, 2026, the live offer is .com for $3.60 in the first year with code COM67, marked as a limited-time 65 percent discount against a list price of $10.38; .si is also on offer at $6.48 a year with code SIREGSPS26. The COMPROS code at about $2.90 mentioned in the thread was no longer visible, so the official page at checkout time is the reference.

The official terms are narrow: first-year registrations only, renewals at the regular price, one code per order and per domain, premium domains excluded, and the final price is the one shown at checkout. It suits a personal site or project domain for a cheap first year; holding it longer means budgeting the renewal, which starts around $10.38 a year for .com.
spaceship-com-3-60-com67.conditions: New .com registrations in the first year only. At checkout, click Add promo code above the order total and enter COM67. One code per order. Premium and high-value domains are excluded. Renewals carry no discount and start at about $10.38 a year.
steps: Search for the .com you want on spaceship.com and add it to the cart
Click Add promo code above the order total and enter COM67
Confirm the total drops to $3.60 for the year before paying
Note the renewal price and budget for the regular rate
spaceship-com-3-60-com67.risk: Only the first year is cheap; renewals return to $10 or more. Older codes in the thread may have expired, so trust the official promo page at checkout. Premium domains are excluded and the offer can change at any time.
spaceship-com-3-60-com67.source: Spaceship official promo page and terms read on November 21, 2026 (.com code COM67 at $3.60 a year), plus the 2Libra 2026 Spaceship and Dynadot code thread of October 27, 2026

azure-for-students-100.title: [Global] Azure for Students: $100 credit plus 65 always-free services, no card needed
azure-for-students-100.highlight: Students verify with a school email and get $100 of credit for 12 months, 20+ popular services free for 12 months and 65 always-free services, with no credit card at sign-up
azure-for-students-100.regions: [Global] Full-time university students who can verify with a school email; one account per person; the credit must be used within 12 months
azure-for-students-100.content:
Azure for Students is Microsoft's standing student programme. The official page says no credit card is required, gives $100 of credit to use within 12 months, adds monthly free amounts on 20-plus popular services for 12 months for new Azure customers, and 65 always-free services; students can renew yearly while enrolled. Typical free allowances include 750 hours a month each of B1s, B2pts v2 and B2ats v2 virtual machines on Linux or Windows, 100,000 vCore seconds a month of serverless Azure SQL, and access to Azure OpenAI, Foundry and AI Search.

A 2Libra thread reports that student verification has been easy lately: a code to a school email is enough, and a few retries clear the temporary-unavailable message. Comments also mention failures when a school has reclaimed the email or the school is not on the list. Running out of the $100 credit does not trigger a charge; the subscription is disabled and Microsoft emails you about moving to pay-as-you-go. Checked on November 21, 2026.
azure-for-students-100.conditions: Full-time university students only, verified with a school email; one Azure for Students account per person; the $100 credit is valid for 12 months and cannot be spent on third-party Azure Marketplace offers; running out does not charge you automatically, and continuing requires upgrading to pay-as-you-go; monthly free amounts reset and do not roll over.
steps: Open azure.microsoft.com/free/students and click Activate
Sign in with a Microsoft account using the school email and complete student verification with the emailed code
Create resources in the Azure portal, preferring always-free and 12-month free tiers
When the credit is nearly gone, use the email notice to decide whether to move to pay-as-you-go
azure-for-students-100.risk: Verification fails if the school has reclaimed the email or the school is not listed; the $100 lasts 12 months only; going past the free allowances requires a paid upgrade; multiple accounts per person can trigger fraud checks.
azure-for-students-100.source: Azure for Students official page and FAQ read on November 21, 2026 ($100 credit, no card, 65 always-free services), plus the 2Libra verification thread of November 18, 2026 with comment reports

umobile-ultra5g-tourist-esim-my.title: [Malaysia] U Mobile free tourist eSIM: 100GB / 24 hours (scan at 4 airports)
umobile-ultra5g-tourist-esim-my.highlight: Foreign passport holders scan U Mobile's official QR code in the arrival halls of KLIA T1/T2, Kota Kinabalu and Langkawi, pass passport and face verification in the MyUMobile app and get a 100GB uncapped 5G eSIM for 24 hours; Malaysia local network only, no mainland China roaming
umobile-ultra5g-tourist-esim-my.regions: [Malaysia] Malaysia local U Mobile 5G/4G network only; mainland China roaming is not supported, so it will not work after you leave; you must scan the on-site QR code in the arrival area of KLIA T1/T2, Kota Kinabalu (BKI) or Langkawi (LGK) in person
umobile-ultra5g-tourist-esim-my.content:
U Mobile's official tourist eSIM for Visit Malaysia 2026: after landing, foreign passport holders scan a dedicated QR code in the arrival areas of KLIA Terminal 1, KLIA Terminal 2, Kota Kinabalu International Airport and Langkawi International Airport to claim a 100GB / 24-hour ULTRA5G tourist eSIM in the MyUMobile app - full-speed 5G/4G, uncapped, hotspot allowed. There is no physical SIM option; it is eSIM only.

The flow: connect to airport Wi-Fi, install the MyUMobile app (version 3.13.11 or newer), scan the on-site QR code to open the ULTRA5G Tourist page, accept the terms and tap Redeem, upload your passport details and complete face verification, fill in your details and tap Verify, then download and install the eSIM in the app. The eSIM details are also emailed to you.

After the 24-hour trial the line stays active for 14 days so you can still receive incoming calls for free. To keep using data, buy a high-speed pass in the app or on the website: 1GB/24h RM3, 10GB/24h RM6, 10GB/7 days RM12, 20GB/7 days RM15, all full speed with hotspot.

Note the wording: U Mobile also lists a separate "Free ULTRA5G Trial" (10GB / 7 days, for first-time Malaysian customers holding a MyKad). That is the domestic trial and is a different offer from this tourist version, which is the 100GB / 24-hour tier.
umobile-ultra5g-tourist-esim-my.conditions: Foreign passport holders only, one redemption per person for the lifetime of the offer; you must scan the official QR code at one of the four airports in person, it cannot be claimed online; passport details plus face verification required; eSIM only with no physical SIM, so your phone must support eSIM and be network unlocked; Malaysia local data only, no mainland China roaming; offer runs until 31 December 2026.
steps: After landing, find the U Mobile QR code in the arrival area of KLIA T1/T2, Kota Kinabalu or Langkawi and connect to airport Wi-Fi
Install and update the MyUMobile app to 3.13.11 or newer, then scan the code to open the ULTRA5G Tourist page
Accept the terms, tap Redeem, upload your passport, complete face verification, fill in your details and tap Verify
Download and install the eSIM in the app, set it as the data line and turn on data roaming
umobile-ultra5g-tourist-esim-my.risk: Only 24 hours, so use it on landing day; the 100GB is a trial allowance and any further data on the same eSIM must be bought; the code is only available at the airport, so you cannot get it after leaving; face verification fails if your passport details do not match; Malaysia local network only, so it does not roam, including in mainland China.
umobile-ultra5g-tourist-esim-my.source: U Mobile official 24-Hour ULTRA5G Trial page (checked 21 November 2026) + U Mobile newsroom release (12 February 2026) + Lowyat.NET, SoyaCincau and TechNave (13 February 2026)

mypal-kolet-free-1gb-esim.title: [Philippines] PAL myPAL eSIM by Kolet: free 1GB / 48 hours, works in 190 countries (mainland China roaming supported)
mypal-kolet-free-1gb-esim.highlight: Any international Philippine Airlines booking unlocks a free 1GB global eSIM for 48 hours; one Kolet eSIM covers 190 countries and Kolet's official coverage list includes mainland China on China Mobile, China Unicom and China Telecom 5G, so it can be used to roam in mainland China
mypal-kolet-free-1gb-esim.regions: [Philippines/Global] Open to all Philippine Airlines international passengers, any cabin class or destination and no Philippine nationality required; the eSIM is Kolet's global plan and mainland China is on Kolet's official coverage list, so mainland China roaming is supported; a few countries such as Iran, Lebanon and Afghanistan are not covered
mypal-kolet-free-1gb-esim.content:
Philippine Airlines put an eSIM into myPAL Travel Boost: with Kolet of France, any holder of an international PAL ticket (any cabin class, any destination) can claim a free 1GB global eSIM, valid 48 hours after activation, one per person.

There are two ways to claim. On the PAL page click Try it for Free, register with an email, install the Kolet app and sign in with the same email and the 1GB arrives immediately. Or register in the Kolet app and enter the promo code FLYPAL. The eSIM stays on your phone afterwards, so on the next trip you just top it up instead of installing a new one.

Coverage is the real value here. Kolet's official destination price list (updated 16 November 2026) lists mainland China on its own with China Mobile, China Unicom and China Telecom across LTE, 4G and 5G, and mainland China is also included in the Asia and Global regional plans. The free 1GB can therefore be used as roaming data in mainland China, or in Japan, South Korea, the US, Canada, the UAE, Australia and Singapore, which are exactly PAL's route map. Iran, Lebanon, Afghanistan and a few others are not covered.

After the free gigabyte, Kolet's paid rates start at $3.99 per GB with 30-day validity, and 20GB is around $29.99, purchasable in the app.
mypal-kolet-free-1gb-esim.conditions: Requires a valid international Philippine Airlines booking, any cabin class or destination; register with an email in Kolet, or use promo code FLYPAL; one 1GB gift per person; the eSIM must be activated within 7 days of receipt and runs 48 hours from first use; data only with no phone number; phone must support eSIM and be unlocked; mainland China roaming works, but most China-market iPhones have no eSIM support.
steps: Open the PAL myPAL eSIM page and click Try it for Free, or register in the Kolet app with promo code FLYPAL
Register with your email, install the Kolet app and sign in with the same address so the free 1GB is credited
Install the eSIM in the app as prompted (under two minutes for most people), then set it as the data line and enable data roaming on arrival
Top up in the app after the 48 hours if you need more (from $3.99 per GB)
mypal-kolet-free-1gb-esim.risk: Only 1GB for 48 hours and only once per person; an eSIM not activated within 7 days expires with no replacement; data only, no number; Kolet's help page says WhatsApp and Gmail work in mainland China on its eSIM without a VPN, which we have not tested, so keep a backup for anything important; some China-market and Hong Kong iPhone models have no eSIM, so check for an Add eSIM option in settings first.
mypal-kolet-free-1gb-esim.source: PAL official myPAL eSIM page and terms (checked 21 November 2026, terms effective 28 October 2025) + Kolet official Prices and Destinations (updated 16 November 2026, mainland China listed on China Mobile, China Unicom and China Telecom) + Kolet official Asia and Global regional plan pages

true-tat-asean-tourist-sim-8gb.title: [Thailand] True x TAT: free True 5G tourist SIM for ASEAN and India visitors, 8GB / 1 day plus THB 10,000 in coupons
true-tat-asean-tourist-sim-8gb.highlight: ASEAN and Indian passport holders register for a coupon at aseanindiashopper.com until 28 November, then collect a free True 5G SIM with 8GB for one day plus THB 10,000 of travel and shopping coupons at True dtac shops at Suvarnabhumi, Don Mueang and Phuket airports; Thailand local network only, no mainland China roaming
true-tat-asean-tourist-sim-8gb.regions: [Thailand] Thailand local True 5G network only, mainland China roaming is not supported; the SIM must be collected in person with passport registration at participating airport True dtac shops such as Suvarnabhumi, Don Mueang and Phuket; open to ASEAN and Indian passport holders
true-tat-asean-tourist-sim-8gb.value: 8GB / 1 day plus about THB 10,000 in coupons (about $2)
true-tat-asean-tourist-sim-8gb.content:
A welcome campaign from True and the Tourism Authority of Thailand: ASEAN and Indian passport holders first go to aseanindiashopper.com, choose How to Redeem, answer a short survey and register to receive an e-coupon. After landing, show the coupon at a True dtac shop at a participating airport such as Suvarnabhumi, Don Mueang or Phuket to collect a free True 5G tourist SIM with 8GB of data valid for one day, plus travel and shopping coupons worth more than THB 10,000.

Two dates matter: coupon registration closes on 28 November 2026, while collection and activation with the coupon can be done until 31 December 2026.

There are add-ons on site: buying an add-on package of THB 450 or more also gets an exclusive elephant-pattern folding fan, limited to 1,000 pieces; 5, 8, 15 and 30-day tourist packages are also discounted in the campaign, so you can extend on the spot once the free 8GB day is used.

Note the wording: this is a physical tourist SIM collected at an airport counter, not an eSIM issued online. Under Thailand's NBTC rules a tourist SIM must be registered against a passport, a maximum of three SIMs per person per brand, and a single tourist SIM is valid for at most 60 days. True 5G is Thailand only, so it does not roam and definitely does not support mainland China roaming.
true-tat-asean-tourist-sim-8gb.conditions: ASEAN member state and Indian passport holders only; register for the coupon at aseanindiashopper.com by 28 November 2026, then collect at a participating airport True dtac shop, usable until 31 December 2026; the 8GB is valid for one day only; Thailand local data with no mainland China roaming; passport registration is mandatory and capped at three SIMs per person per brand.
steps: Before flying, open aseanindiashopper.com, choose How to Redeem, answer the survey and register your email for the e-coupon
After landing, show the e-coupon at a True dtac shop at a participating airport such as Suvarnabhumi, Don Mueang or Phuket
Show your passport for NBTC registration and collect the free True 5G SIM with 8GB for one day
Buy a discounted 5, 8, 15 or 30-day package at the counter if you need more than a day
true-tat-asean-tourist-sim-8gb.risk: The 8GB lasts one day and you pay from day two; only ASEAN or Indian nationality qualifies, so a Chinese passport is not eligible; it is a physical airport counter SIM, not an eSIM, so expect a queue and passport registration; the folding fan gift is limited to the first 1,000; Thailand local network only, with no mainland China roaming.
true-tat-asean-tourist-sim-8gb.source: True official blog (26 October 2026) + official registration site aseanindiashopper.com + TechOffside, ZanZab and Post Today (26 October and 2 November 2026)

ktm-mobi-japan-esim-1plus1-zero.title: [Korea] kt M mobile mobi: Japan eSIM 3 days buy-one-get-one for KRW 0 (first purchase at the direct store)
ktm-mobi-japan-esim-1plus1-zero.highlight: kt M mobile, a KT-affiliated MVNO, sells its mobi roaming eSIM: a first purchase at the direct store gets the Japan 1GB-per-day 3-day plan buy-one-get-one for a total of KRW 0, with 1GB high speed each day then unlimited at reduced speed; Japan only, no mainland China roaming
ktm-mobi-japan-esim-1plus1-zero.regions: [Korea] Open to first-time mobi buyers of any Korean carrier, with a Korean phone number and email verification; the eSIM works in Japan only and does not support mainland China roaming
ktm-mobi-japan-esim-1plus1-zero.value: Two Japan eSIMs, 3 days at 1GB per day (about $15)
ktm-mobi-japan-esim-1plus1-zero.content:
kt M mobile is KT's MVNO and mobi is its roaming eSIM brand. This month the direct store has a first-purchase zero-won offer: the Japan 1GB-per-day 3-day plan on a buy-one-get-one basis, both for KRW 0.

What you get: 1GB of high-speed data per day, then unlimited at 384Kbps, 3GB per eSIM in total. You can use the two on separate trips or give one to whoever travels with you. The same store also discounts China, Taiwan, Hong Kong and Macau, Vietnam and Thailand destinations (for example Thailand unlimited 3 days for KRW 10,800 and China unlimited 3 days for KRW 6,910), but those are discounts, not zero.

How to get it: order at the direct store, receive a KakaoTalk notice to install the mobi app, verify with a Korean phone number and email, then register the eSIM in the app. The eSIM must be issued within 180 days of purchase and is valid 90 days from issue, so a changed itinerary is fine, and you can run an activation check inside Korea that does not consume data or days.

Note the wording: this is a Korean carrier roaming product for Korean users and needs a Korean number, so a mainland China user cannot practically join. The eSIM is for Japan only and does not support mainland China roaming.
ktm-mobi-japan-esim-1plus1-zero.conditions: First-time mobi buyers only, once per person; order at the kt M mobile direct store; Korean phone number and email verification in the mobi app required; zero won applies only to the Japan 1GB-per-day 3-day buy-one-get-one; issue within 180 days of purchase and use within 90 days of issue; Japan data only with no mainland China roaming; ends early if stock runs out.
steps: Open the kt M mobile direct store November campaign page and enter mobi's Japan zero-won buy-one-get-one product
Place the order (KRW 0) and wait for the KakaoTalk notice with the mobi app download link
Verify with your Korean phone number and email in the mobi app and register the eSIM
Run the activation check in Korea, then switch the data line to the eSIM on landing in Japan
ktm-mobi-japan-esim-1plus1-zero.risk: A Korean phone number and app verification are required, so mainland China users can barely join; zero won covers only the Japan 3-day plan and two copies, other countries are discounts only; stock can run out without notice; after 1GB a day the speed drops to 384Kbps; Japan only, with no roaming back home or in mainland China.
ktm-mobi-japan-esim-1plus1-zero.source: kt M mobile official direct store campaign page for mobi autumn zero-won offer (checked 21 November 2026, campaign 1-30 November 2026)

ymobile-sim-trial-two-months-free.title: [Japan] Y!mobile SIM / eSIM two-month free trial: 30GB per month and a waived 3,850 yen setup fee
ymobile-sim-trial-two-months-free.highlight: Apply online for Simple 3 M at 30GB per month and the base fee is zero through the second month with the 3,850 yen setup fee also waived and no cancellation penalty; from month three it is 4,378 yen per month; Japan local network only, no mainland China roaming
ymobile-sim-trial-two-months-free.regions: [Japan] A Japanese number on the Japanese network, with voice and SMS roam in China with free inbound SMS; no overseas data for four months on a new SIM-only contract; a Japanese address and identity document are required; eSIM activates online in as little as an hour and a physical SIM ships the next day
ymobile-sim-trial-two-months-free.content:
SoftBank's Y!mobile runs a two-month free trial on its official online store: from the designated page, apply for Simple 3 M at 30GB per month as a SIM-only or eSIM-only line. The 3,850 yen contract handling fee is waived entirely, the base fee is zero for two months from the billing start month, the universal service fees are discounted over the same period, and there is no cancellation penalty - even the 858 yen cancellation fee is waived if you cancel inside the two months.

From month three the normal 4,378 yen per month resumes. The first month is prorated by day, so applying late in the month means less free allowance. One line per name only, and anyone who used the older Y!mobile SIM Trial or SIM Trial 2 or this benefit before is excluded.

eSIM activates online in as little as an hour; a physical SIM arrives the next day. The offer cannot be combined with referral campaigns that pay PayPay points, so you choose between points and two free months.

Note the wording: this is a Japanese domestic number service and the eSIM runs on SoftBank and Y!mobile's Japanese network, but voice and SMS still roam (the official roaming page lists China with free inbound SMS); only overseas data is blocked for the first four months of a new SIM-only contract. Applying needs a Japanese address, an identity document and a credit card or bank transfer. The Y!mobile Yahoo Shopping store benefits and the Y!mobile parent-child discount already on this site are separate campaigns; this entry covers the free trial only.
ymobile-sim-trial-two-months-free.conditions: Apply from the designated campaign page on the online store for Simple 3 M as a SIM-only or eSIM-only line through a new subscription, MNP or number transfer; Japanese address, identity document and payment method required; one line per name; anyone who used an earlier SIM Trial or this benefit is excluded; cannot be combined with referral campaigns that pay PayPay points; automatic billing of 4,378 yen per month from month three; Japan local network only with no mainland China roaming.
steps: Open Y!mobile's official two-month free trial page and click Start the SIM trial
Photograph and upload your identity document and enter credit card or bank transfer details
Choose eSIM for activation in as little as an hour or a physical SIM, and complete activation
Decide whether to cancel before the second month ends; cancellation is penalty free
ymobile-sim-trial-two-months-free.risk: The first month is prorated, so applying late in the month shrinks the free allowance; from month three the 4,378 yen monthly fee is charged automatically unless you cancel; one line per name; a Japanese address and ID are required, so an overseas user cannot practically join; the eSIM works only on Japanese networks and does not support mainland China roaming. Japanese carriers generally run eUICC EID whitelists and most third-party cards need customer-service registration; no per-brand test was found for this one.
ymobile-sim-trial-two-months-free.source: Y!mobile official campaign page and the two-month free trial terms (checked 21 November 2026, reception from 8 October 2026 with no end date) + K-tai Watch (9 October 2026) + Kupomiru (10 November 2026)

alrajhi-gigsky-free-unlimited-esim.title: [Saudi Arabia] Al Rajhi Bank cards x GigSky: free unlimited-data eSIM for 3-7 days (valid to 13 April 2027)
alrajhi-gigsky-free-unlimited-esim.highlight: Eligible Al Rajhi credit and prepaid cardholders get a free GigSky unlimited-data eSIM: 7 days on Infinite cards and 3 days on Signature, Platinum and prepaid cards, plus 20-30% off add-on plans; whether mainland China is in the Visa Destinations list needs checking
alrajhi-gigsky-free-unlimited-esim.regions: [Saudi Arabia] Eligible Al Rajhi credit and prepaid cardholders only; destinations follow the GigSky Visa Destinations list, once every 365 days; GigSky itself covers mainland China on China Unicom, but whether this Visa Destinations tier includes mainland China needs confirmation from the official list
alrajhi-gigsky-free-unlimited-esim.content:
A Visa partnership benefit between Saudi Al Rajhi Bank and GigSky: eligible Al Rajhi credit or prepaid cardholders get a free GigSky eSIM and unlimited internet at selected destinations on arrival, with no local SIM to buy and no extra cost.

The card tier sets the duration: Infinite credit cardholders get 7 days of unlimited data plus 30% off all GigSky add-on plans; Signature and Platinum credit cardholders and prepaid cardholders get 3 days of unlimited data plus 20% off. The offer runs until 13 April 2027.

Rules: the free data starts counting when activated, and an eSIM not activated within one year of issue is activated automatically; each cardholder can use it once every 365 days; the countries available depend on Al Rajhi card and Visa terms and vary by destination.

On mainland China roaming: GigSky is a global operator whose official Asia Pacific and China plans cover mainland China on China Unicom and China Mobile, so the answer to whether GigSky works in mainland China is yes. This tier, however, is the Visa Destinations package, and which countries it includes is set by Visa's programme list, which the official page does not enumerate. Check inside the GigSky app under Regions, View Details, Countries after claiming, then decide whether to bring it to mainland China.
alrajhi-gigsky-free-unlimited-esim.conditions: Al Rajhi Bank eligible credit cards (Infinite, Signature, Platinum) and prepaid cardholders only; once every 365 days per cardholder; the free data runs from activation and is activated automatically if not used within a year; available destinations are bound to the Visa Destinations list; mainland China support must be checked in the GigSky app and is marked unverified here.
steps: Check the tier of your Al Rajhi credit or prepaid card (Infinite for 7 days, Signature, Platinum or prepaid for 3 days)
Add the card in the GigSky app and claim the free plan from the Visa Destinations section
Open Regions, View Details, Countries in the app to confirm the destination list, including whether mainland China is covered
Install and activate the eSIM on arrival, then turn on data roaming
alrajhi-gigsky-free-unlimited-esim.risk: Requires a Saudi bank account and a qualifying card, so an overseas user can barely join; once every 365 days; claiming without activating still auto-activates after a year, which burns the allowance; the destination list depends on Visa's programme and mainland China is not enumerated, so it stays unverified; unlimited data is still subject to fair use and local speeds.
alrajhi-gigsky-free-unlimited-esim.source: Al Rajhi Bank official GigSky benefit page (checked 21 November 2026, valid to 13 April 2027) + GigSky official Asia Pacific and China coverage notes (mainland China on China Unicom, 16 November 2026)

mpt-po-pyaw-po-ya-10x-data.title: [Myanmar] MPT Po Pyaw, Po Ya: ten times your call minutes back as data on local calls over five minutes
mpt-po-pyaw-po-ya-10x-data.highlight: MPT prepaid users dial *7711# once for free, and after that every pay-as-you-go local call longer than five minutes earns ten times the call duration in data from minute five on (six minutes equals 60MB, eight minutes 80MB), valid two days and stackable
mpt-po-pyaw-po-ya-10x-data.regions: [Myanmar] MPT prepaid active users (Swe Thahar) only, local Myanmar calls only, both MPT-to-MPT and MPT to other networks; mainland China roaming is not supported
mpt-po-pyaw-po-ya-10x-data.content:
MPT's Po Pyaw, Po Ya campaign from November: MPT prepaid users dial *7711# once for free to register, then every local call billed at pay-as-you-go rates that runs longer than five minutes earns ten times the call duration in data from minute five - the official examples are 60MB for six minutes and 80MB for eight minutes.

The data is valid two days, and multiple rewards merge and extend to the longest validity. You get an SMS when it lands and can check the balance with *224# or the MPT4U app. Both MPT-to-MPT and MPT-to-other-operator calls count.

One catch: if the account still holds voice package balance such as Kyite Yar Khaw or A Kyite Pyaw, the system deducts the package balance first and the call does not count towards this campaign until that balance is used up. Postpaid, CDMA, Base Tariff and inactive users are excluded. The campaign runs from 1 November 2026 to 31 January 2027.

Note the wording: this trades local calls for local data and needs an active MPT Myanmar number, so a mainland China user cannot join directly, and it does not support mainland China roaming. The same page also runs a Thadingyut lucky draw (buy any package and play Kick & Win for data and an iPhone 18 Pro until 30 November 2026); that is a draw, so this entry keeps to the deterministic campaign.
mpt-po-pyaw-po-ya-10x-data.conditions: MPT GSM/WCDMA prepaid active users only; dial *7711# once for free to register; only pay-as-you-go local calls count and only calls of five minutes or more; data valid two days and mergeable; existing voice package balance must be used up first; campaign 1 November 2026 to 31 January 2027; Myanmar local use with no mainland China roaming.
steps: Confirm you are on an active MPT prepaid number
Dial *7711# once to register for free
Make local calls at pay-as-you-go rates and keep each call above five minutes
Check the data received with *224# or in the MPT4U app and use it within two days
mpt-po-pyaw-po-ya-10x-data.risk: You need a Myanmar MPT number, so overseas users cannot join; remaining voice package balance is deducted first and delays the campaign; the data lasts only two days; calls under five minutes do not count; Myanmar local network only, with no mainland China roaming.
mpt-po-pyaw-po-ya-10x-data.source: MPT official Po Pyaw, Po Ya promotion page and FAQ (checked 21 November 2026, campaign 1 November 2026 to 31 January 2027) + MPT official November monthly promotion page

atom-flexi-friday-100gb-spin.title: [Myanmar] ATOM Flexi Friday: buy a FlexiPlan pack on Fridays for a spin worth up to 100GB
atom-flexi-friday-100gb-spin.highlight: Buy a FlexiPlan pack of 999 kyat or more in the ATOM Store app on Fridays for 1 to 10 spins depending on the amount, with every spin paying a data reward from 200MB to 100GB valid three days plus ATOM STAR points; Myanmar local use only, no mainland China roaming
atom-flexi-friday-100gb-spin.regions: [Myanmar] ATOM prepaid users only, and purchases must be made in the ATOM Store app; Fridays only; Myanmar local data with no mainland China roaming
atom-flexi-friday-100gb-spin.content:
ATOM, formerly Telenor Myanmar, runs Flexi Friday: buy a FlexiPlan pack in the ATOM Store app on any Friday and you get spins - 1 spin for 999 to 4,999 kyat, 5 spins for 5,000 to 9,990 kyat and 10 spins above 9,990 kyat. Each spin is valid for one day.

Every spin pays something: data tiers of 200MB, 500MB, 1GB, 10GB or 100GB, all valid three days, plus ATOM STAR points. Buying more earns more spins, so a full 10-spin purchase lets you spin 10 times. The campaign started on 23 October 2026 and runs until further notice, and ATOM reserves the right to change it.

Note the wording: you must recharge and buy a pack to get spins, hence the charge-required category; the odds favour small and mid rewards and the 100GB is the top prize, so do not value the offer at 100GB; only purchases in the ATOM Store app count, while USSD or offline channels do not; Myanmar local only, with no mainland China roaming.
atom-flexi-friday-100gb-spin.conditions: ATOM prepaid users only; buy a FlexiPlan pack of 999 kyat or more in the ATOM Store app on a Friday; spins expire the same day; rewards are 200MB to 100GB of data valid three days plus ATOM STAR points; campaign since 23 October 2026 with no end date; Myanmar local data with no mainland China roaming.
steps: Install the ATOM Store app, sign in with your ATOM prepaid number and keep enough balance
On a Friday buy a FlexiPlan pack of 999 kyat or more (more spend earns more spins)
Return to the spin page in the app and use all of the day's spins
Check the data credited in the app and use it within three days
atom-flexi-friday-100gb-spin.risk: You must buy a pack first, so it is a recharge-for-a-spin offer; 100GB is the top prize while 200MB to 1GB is far more common; spins expire the same day; app and Friday only; you need a Myanmar number, so overseas users cannot join; local data only with no mainland China roaming.
atom-flexi-friday-100gb-spin.source: ATOM official Flexi Friday Spin and Win page and terms (checked 21 November 2026, running since 23 October 2026) + ATOM official promotion hub

thai-aipass-free-ai-models.title: [Thailand] TH-AI Passport (AiPASS): more than 30 AI models free until 31 August 2027
thai-aipass-free-ai-models.highlight: Thailand's Ministry of Digital Economy and Society runs AiPASS: Thai citizens aged 15 and over register with ThaID and use more than 30 models for free, including DeepSeek, Meta AI, Mistral, Moonshot, MiniMax, Alibaba Cloud, Z.ai and Pathumma ThaiLLM, with the top tier for the first 30 days if you register by 30 November
thai-aipass-free-ai-models.regions: [Thailand] Thai nationals aged 15 and over only, with ThaID or Thang Rat app identity verification; 5,000,000 places; the platform runs from 31 August 2026 to 31 August 2027
thai-aipass-free-ai-models.value: 30+ models free for a full year (about $240)
thai-aipass-free-ai-models.content:
TH-AI Passport is a nationwide AI access programme run by BDE under Thailand's Ministry of Digital Economy and Society, entered through the AiPASS platform at aipass.go.th and its app. Officially the programme runs from 31 August 2026 to 31 August 2027, is free for the whole period, has 5,000,000 places, and is open to Thai nationals aged 15 or over.

Registration needs three things: the ThaID or Thang Rat identity app, a working Google, Microsoft or Apple email, and a connected device. The flow is email sign-up, accepting the terms and PDPA consent, ThaID verification, then profile details and you are in.

Which models: the official page currently lists Alibaba Cloud, DeepSeek, Meta AI, MiniMax, Mistral AI, Moonshot AI, Pathumma ThaiLLM, SpaceXAI and Z.ai. Thai media during the launch also mentioned Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity, but the official model list above is authoritative, and these models are called inside the AiPASS platform under programme quotas rather than as official paid accounts from each vendor.

Tiers: anyone registered by 30 November 2026 gets the top tier for the first 30 days from first use, with the largest quota; after that you need at least 100 learning points a month to keep the top tier, so you study as you use rather than locking in a full quota forever. Quotas reset daily, the ministry says there is no five-hour window or weekly cap, and user data is not used to train models and is protected under PDPA.
thai-aipass-free-ai-models.conditions: Thai nationals only, aged 15 or over on the registration date; ThaID or Thang Rat app verification, and registration must be done in person by the individual; 5,000,000 places; free through the programme period 31 August 2026 to 31 August 2027; the first-30-days top tier requires registering by 30 November 2026; keeping the top tier later needs 100 or more learning points a month; models are called under platform quotas, not as each vendor's official accounts.
steps: Install the ThaID or Thang Rat app on your phone and complete identity verification
Sign up at aipass.go.th or in the AiPASS app with a Google, Microsoft or Apple email
Accept the terms and PDPA consent and verify with ThaID
Fill in your profile and start using; registering by 30 November gives the top tier for the first 30 days
thai-aipass-free-ai-models.risk: Requires a Thai national ID and ThaID verification, so foreigners, tourists and Chinese nationals working in Thailand cannot join; 5,000,000 places are first come first served; the top-tier first 30 days must then be maintained with learning points; the models are platform calls rather than official vendor accounts; the official model list differs from media reports, so trust the site.
thai-aipass-free-ai-models.source: AiPASS official homepage (checked 21 November 2026: eligibility, places, programme period, model list and the top tier for registrations by 30 November) + The Standard (6 November 2026 on the Gemini Enterprise add-on) + SV News and MGR Online launch coverage

adcb-emirati-youth-ai-cashback.title: [UAE] ADCB Emirati Youth: up to AED 400 cashback on AI subscriptions plus AED 300-700 welcome bonus
adcb-emirati-youth-ai-cashback.highlight: Emirati nationals aged 16 to 30 who open a new ADCB account get up to AED 400 cashback on video streaming and up to AED 400 on AI subscriptions such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Perplexity using their ADCB card, plus a welcome bonus of AED 300 to 700, with no registration needed
adcb-emirati-youth-ai-cashback.regions: [UAE] Emirati nationals aged 16 to 30 who are new ADCB customers only; account opening and cashback run through ADCB digital channels and require a balance or salary transfer condition
adcb-emirati-youth-ai-cashback.content:
ADCB's Emirati Youth Programme is a tiered account package for Emirati nationals aged 16 to 30, and this month's most valuable part is subscription cashback: new customers earn up to AED 400 on eligible video streaming subscriptions (Netflix, Disney+, Amazon Prime Video, OSN+, Apple TV+) and up to AED 400 on AI subscriptions (ChatGPT, Claude, Google Gemini, Perplexity) paid with any ADCB debit or credit card during the month of account opening and the following three months, up to AED 800 across both categories, with no registration required. The offer is valid from 1 August to 31 December 2026.

The welcome bonus depends on the age band: AED 300 for ages 16 to 17 with AED 3,000 maintained for three months, AED 500 for ages 18 to 21 with AED 5,000 maintained for three months, and AED 700 for ages 22 to 30 with three consecutive salary transfers within 90 days of opening.

There are also draws: AED 100,000 scholarship draws every quarter for ages 16 to 17 and AED 150,000 for ages 18 to 30, plus 1 million TouchPoints every month, with entry based on a month-end total relationship balance of AED 5,000 or a monthly salary of AED 5,000.

Note the wording: this is only for Emirati nationals, so expatriates including Chinese nationals working in Dubai cannot use it; the AI cashback is a rebate after you pay with an ADCB card, not a free subscription, and you must genuinely subscribe.
adcb-emirati-youth-ai-cashback.conditions: Emirati nationals aged 16 to 30 who are new ADCB customers only; subscription cashback covers ADCB card spend in the opening month and the following three months, up to AED 400 each for video and AI; welcome bonus needs three months of AED 3,000 or AED 5,000 balance, or three salary transfers; draws need AED 5,000 month-end balance or salary; valid to 31 December 2026.
steps: Open the eligible account for your age band through ADCB digital channels
In the opening month and the following three months, pay for ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or Perplexity subscriptions with your ADCB card
Keep the balance or complete the salary transfers for your age band so the welcome bonus posts automatically
Cashback needs no registration and settles monthly; for draws keep AED 5,000 at month-end or receive a salary
adcb-emirati-youth-ai-cashback.risk: Emirati nationals only, so expatriate residents cannot join; cashback covers only the opening month and three months, then reverts to normal rewards; subscriptions must be really paid, and cancellations or refunds may be clawed back; the welcome bonus has a three-month balance or salary condition; the draws are probabilistic and are not counted in the value.
adcb-emirati-youth-ai-cashback.source: ADCB official Emirati Youth Programme page and FAQ (checked 21 November 2026: AED 400 plus AED 400 subscription cashback, offer period 1 August to 31 December 2026, welcome bonus tiers and conditions)

wio-creators-12-months-free.title: [UAE] Wio Creators plan: 12 months of business banking with no monthly fee (promo code WIOCREATE)
wio-creators-12-months-free.highlight: New customers holding a UAE freelance permit or trade licence who enter promo code WIOCREATE when applying for the Essential business account get 12 months with no monthly fee, no minimum balance, 10 free local transfers a month and multi-currency accounts including AED, USD, CNY and SAR
wio-creators-12-months-free.regions: [UAE] Requires a UAE freelance permit or trade licence for creative work and a new Wio customer relationship, with fully online onboarding within 72 hours; the account is a UAE local bank account
wio-creators-12-months-free.value: 12 months with no monthly fee plus 10 free local transfers a month (about $240)
wio-creators-12-months-free.content:
Wio is the digital bank in the First Abu Dhabi Bank ecosystem, and Wio for Creators targets freelancers, content creators, independent designers and individuals taking cross-border work: new customers who enter promo code WIOCREATE when applying and choose the Essential plan get 12 months with no monthly fee, no minimum balance, 10 free local transfers a month, low-cost SWIFT transfers and invoicing and bookkeeping tools with no subscription fee.

The account is multi-currency (AED, GBP, EUR, USD, CAD, AUD, CHF, SGD, CNY, SAR) and locks AED to USD at 3.673, which suits collecting from overseas clients, and you can issue unlimited virtual cards to separate spending by project. Onboarding is fully online, which the official page puts at 72 hours with no branch visit.

The qualification is the hard gate: you must be a new Wio customer with a valid UAE freelance permit or a creative-sector trade licence. The code must be entered before you submit the application; adding it after the account is open does not work.

Note the wording: this is not a no-strings freebie but a year of saved monthly fees for creators who already have a UAE freelance registration; after 12 months the standard price applies, so change plan or close the account then.
wio-creators-12-months-free.conditions: New Wio customers holding a valid UAE freelance permit or creative-sector trade licence; download the Wio Business app, choose the Essential plan and enter promo code WIOCREATE before submitting; 12 months with no monthly fee, no minimum balance and 10 free local transfers a month; standard pricing applies after 12 months.
steps: Download the Wio Business app
Start the application and choose the Essential plan
Enter promo code WIOCREATE before submitting
Upload your freelance permit or trade licence and finish online onboarding (officially within 72 hours)
wio-creators-12-months-free.risk: A UAE freelance permit or trade licence is required, so overseas users cannot join; the code must be entered before submitting and cannot be added later; the monthly fee returns after 12 months; credit and financing are underwritten separately; business onboarding involves compliance checks that slow down if documents are incomplete.
wio-creators-12-months-free.source: Wio official Creators plan page (checked 21 November 2026: 12 months free, no minimum balance, 10 free local transfers a month, promo code WIOCREATE)

singlife-nomad-free-1gb-esim.title: [Singapore] Singlife travel insurance x Nomad: a free 1GB global eSIM with a policy (to 31 December)
singlife-nomad-free-1gb-esim.highlight: Buy a Singlife single-trip or annual travel policy in Singapore and within 7 to 10 days of the policy start you get a redemption email for one Nomad 1GB global eSIM per policy, stackable across policies; mainland China roaming is marked unverified
singlife-nomad-free-1gb-esim.regions: [Singapore] Singlife travel insurance policyholders only (individual single-trip or annual travel, or corporate travel); the eSIM is a Nomad global plan and whether mainland China is covered is unverified
singlife-nomad-free-1gb-esim.content:
A joint promotion between Singapore insurer Singlife and global eSIM provider Nomad (Lotusflare Inc): during the promotion period, buying qualifying travel insurance in your own name - a single-trip or annual travel policy including new business and renewals, or corporate travel insurance - earns a free Nomad 1GB global eSIM.

The terms are explicit: one gift per qualifying policy, so two policies earn two gifts; the policy must still be in force and the premium paid in full at fulfilment or the redemption is delayed or cancelled; seven to ten days after the policy inception date Singlife emails a redemption link to the address on the policy, and you redeem with Nomad from there. The promotion runs from 19 June to 31 December 2026.

The only stackable discounts are any promotional code discount available to all Singlife customers and the MINDEF, MHA or POGIS group insurance discount; other travel insurance promotions are excluded.

On mainland China roaming: Nomad is a global eSIM provider covering well over a hundred destinations, but the terms only say 1GB of complimentary global eSIM data without listing countries. This entry therefore marks mainland China roaming as unverified - once the redemption email arrives, the Nomad app shows whether mainland China is selectable for the plan.
singlife-nomad-free-1gb-esim.conditions: Promotion runs 19 June to 31 December 2026; buy Singlife single-trip or annual travel insurance in your own name, or corporate travel insurance; one 1GB eSIM per policy, stackable; the policy must be in force with the premium paid in full at fulfilment; the redemption email comes 7 to 10 days after policy inception; mainland China roaming status is unverified.
steps: Buy a Singlife single-trip or annual travel policy during the promotion period, or corporate travel insurance for a company
Confirm the policy is in force and the premium is paid
Watch the policy email address for the redemption email 7 to 10 days after inception
Redeem the 1GB global eSIM from the email link and install it on an eSIM-capable phone
singlife-nomad-free-1gb-esim.risk: You must buy insurance first, so it is an add-on rather than a pure freebie; cancelling the policy or leaving the premium unpaid cancels the redemption; the redemption email takes 7 to 10 days and can miss an imminent trip; which countries the 1GB global plan covers is only visible in the app at redemption, and mainland China support is unverified; non-Singapore policies do not qualify.
singlife-nomad-free-1gb-esim.source: Singlife official Free E-SIM Promotion terms PDF (checked 21 November 2026: promotion 19 June to 31 December 2026, 1GB per policy, redemption email in 7 to 10 days, policy must stay in force)

dito-esim-cloud-number-63.title: [Philippines] DITO cloud-activated eSIM: a real +63 number for PHP 99, kept alive for about PHP 10-20 a year (receives SMS in mainland China)
dito-esim-cloud-number-63.highlight: Buy the eSIM online at DITO's eShop or in the app, receive the QR code by email, install it and register in the DITO app to get a real +63 carrier number; PHP 99 includes 9GB for 15 days and a small top-up of about PHP 10-20 a year keeps the number, with community tests receiving SMS in mainland China
dito-esim-cloud-number-63.regions: [Philippines] A +63 carrier number, opened entirely online (order at the eShop, QR code by email, registration in the app); Philippine SIM Registration Act (RA 11934) applies and passport registration is required; mainland China SMS roaming works in community tests from November 2025 to August 2026 but is not an official promise
dito-esim-cloud-number-63.content:
DITO is the Philippines' third carrier, and its prepaid eSIM is the cheapest option in the cloud-activated real-number category: order for PHP 99 in the official eShop or the DITO app, receive the eSIM QR code by email, scan it, complete registration in the DITO app and you have a +63 carrier number, not a VoIP number.

The starter pack is not thin: 9GB of all-access data, unlimited texts to all networks, unlimited DITO-to-DITO voice and video calls and 150 minutes to other networks, valid 15 days. The first-year cost is therefore PHP 99, roughly CNY 12, with the number usable the same day.

Keeping it alive works through top-ups: a Philippine prepaid card renews as long as there is a small top-up inside the validity window, and community guides budget one small load of PHP 10-20, about CNY 1.5-3, a year, through the DITO app or third-party channels. There is no official keep-alive package, so the lowest top-up tier shown in the app is the reference.

Mainland China use is the point of this card: community reports record a number opened in November 2025 still receiving SMS in mainland China in August 2026, and receiving needs no data package - turn data roaming off and leave voice roaming on. Whether a message arrives still depends on the local network and sender, so this is a test result rather than an official promise.

On verification codes and the barrier: a native carrier number passes ordinary SMS checks (WhatsApp, Telegram, cross-border e-commerce, some banks) far better than virtual numbers, though some platforms apply extra risk checks to Philippine ranges. Registration is the hard gate - the SIM Registration Act requires passport registration, foreign tourists usually also need a Philippine address and a return ticket, and a tourist SIM is legally limited to 30 days in principle. Being online longer does not erase that legal position, so do not make this the only recovery route for an important account.
dito-esim-cloud-number-63.conditions: Buy online at the DITO eShop or in the DITO app from PHP 99 including 9GB for 15 days; complete Philippine SIM registration with a passport in the DITO app; under RA 11934 foreign tourists generally need a passport, a Philippine address and a return ticket, and a tourist SIM is limited to 30 days in principle; the phone must support eSIM and be unlocked; mainland China SMS reception is a community test, not an official commitment. Physical eUICCs such as 9eSIM V3 and Xesim are tested to write DITO successfully; passport registration in the DITO app and roaming activation are still required afterwards.
steps: Choose the prepaid eSIM (PHP 99 tier) in the DITO eShop or DITO app and pay
Receive the eSIM QR code by email and add the eSIM by scanning it in your phone settings
Install the DITO app, complete passport SIM registration and activate the number
To keep the number, make one lowest-tier top-up in the app before expiry (about PHP 10-20); turn data roaming off in mainland China if you only need SMS
dito-esim-cloud-number-63.risk: Registration is mandatory and a tourist SIM is legally limited to 30 days in principle, so long-term use sits in a grey zone; there is no official keep-alive package, so the app's lowest top-up governs, and third-party small top-up channels change; mainland China SMS reception is a community test rather than an official promise; some platforms risk-check Philippine ranges, so avoid using it as the only recovery route for a bank or main email; Wi-Fi Calling is not documented.
dito-esim-cloud-number-63.source: DITO official eSIM page and blog (checked 21 November 2026: PHP 99, 9GB for 15 days, online eShop and app purchase, app registration, device list) + Gao Notes 2026 eSIM-with-number comparison (12 August 2026, including mainland China SMS tests and keep-alive costs) + Deepchain eSIM guide (31 October 2026)

sosim-hk-esim-33-number.title: [Hong Kong] 3HK SoSIM eSIM: a +852 number for HK$33 with 50GB for 30 days, kept alive by topping up
sosim-hk-esim-33-number.highlight: 3 Hong Kong's SoSIM sells a HK$33 eSIM online or in its WeChat mini programme, with a QR code by email and a +852 number live in about ten minutes; a new card gets 50GB for 30 days in Hong Kong or 5 days of Asia-Pacific roaming, the number lasts 120 days and a top-up of HK$20 or more extends it, and with Hong Kong registration the card receives SMS while roaming
sosim-hk-esim-33-number.regions: [Hong Kong] A +852 number; the online store accepts Visa and Mastercard, AlipayHK, mainland Alipay, WeChat Pay and UnionPay; registration is required to use it in Hong Kong, and a passport is accepted, while roaming-data-only use can skip it; after registration, SMS are received free abroad while the mainland data card is valid
sosim-hk-esim-33-number.content:
SoSIM is the prepaid brand of Hutchison Telecommunications Hong Kong (3HK) built around one card with two uses: new customers buy an eSIM for HK$33 on the SoSIM web store or in the WeChat mini programme, the QR code arrives at the verified email, and scanning it brings a real +852 number live in about ten minutes.

The HK$33 choice: 50GB of full-speed Hong Kong data plus 1,500 local minutes for 30 days, or five days of Asia-Pacific roaming data covering Japan, Korea, Taiwan, Singapore, Malaysia and Thailand among 24 destinations plus 3GB of extra Hong Kong data for 30 days, switched in the account within 48 hours of activation. No contract and no admin fee.

Keeping the number is the selling point: card validity, which is the number's validity, is separate from the starter package and starts at 120 days. A top-up of at least HK$20, or buying a designated service, extends it, and community guides budget about HK$60 a year. New cards also get free conversion to eSIM and an HK$8 number change as standing offers, against a normal HK$28 conversion fee.

SMS in mainland China: the official FAQ states the card works in any SoSIM roaming destination as long as there is roaming coverage, Wi-Fi is off and mobile data is on, so activation outside Hong Kong is possible. Hong Kong local service requires registration first, with a passport or a mainland travel permit and manual review of one to two hours, up to 48 hours; roaming-data-only use can skip registration. The official FAQ also states that once registered, SMS can be received free of charge abroad while the mainland data card is valid, so codes need no package.

On verification codes: the +852 native carrier range works in tests for WhatsApp, Telegram, Hong Kong banks and brokers, Apple ID and WeChat, but many AI platforms including ChatGPT and Claude apply extra risk checks to Hong Kong ranges and often refuse them, which is where this card differs from a Philippine DITO number.
sosim-hk-esim-33-number.conditions: New customers buy an eSIM at HK$33 or more on the SoSIM web store or in the WeChat mini programme; install and activate within 60 days of purchase; registration with a passport or mainland travel permit is required for Hong Kong local use, with manual review up to 48 hours, while roaming-data-only use needs none; number validity starts at 120 days and extends with a top-up of HK$20 or more or a designated purchase; SMS reception while roaming in mainland China is package-dependent and not itemised officially.
steps: Buy the HK$33 eSIM on the SoSIM web store or in the WeChat mini programme, which accepts mainland Alipay and WeChat Pay
Scan the eSIM QR code from the email, connect to the network and receive the activation SMS with your number
Install the SoSIM app and complete registration with your passport or mainland travel permit if you need Hong Kong local service
Switch to the 50GB Hong Kong or Asia-Pacific package within 48 hours of activation, and top up at least HK$20 in the app before expiry to keep the number
sosim-hk-esim-33-number.risk: Hong Kong local use requires registration, and an unregistered card gets data only with no calls or SMS; number validity starts at only 120 days and forgetting to top up loses the number and the balance with no recovery; mainland China SMS reception is not itemised officially and depends on the package; Hong Kong ranges are often refused by AI platforms such as ChatGPT and Claude; eSIM support differs between Hong Kong and China-market iPhones, and China-market phones usually need an external eSIM adapter.
sosim-hk-esim-33-number.source: SoSIM official eSIM guide, web store, FAQ and new-joiner offer pages (checked 21 November 2026: from HK$33, ten-minute activation, 50GB for 30 days or 5 days Asia-Pacific, 120-day validity, top-up extension, registration required for Hong Kong use, roaming can skip it) + Deepchain eSIM guide and Digital Nomad LC keep-alive comparison (2026 figures of about HK$60 a year)

saily-us-number-annual.title: [US] Saily US +1 number: from $11.99 a year with unlimited incoming SMS (opened in the app)
saily-us-number-annual.highlight: Saily from Nord Security adds a US +1 number inside its app: $0.99 to $1.99 a month or $11.99 a year, with incoming SMS free and unlimited so no calling pack is needed; a passport and face check are required after purchase, and keeping the number means keeping the subscription
saily-us-number-annual.regions: [US] A US +1 number that can be opened and used from anywhere in the Saily app, with no US address or US carrier needed; in-app identity verification with a passport or government ID plus a face check is required
saily-us-number-annual.content:
Saily is the travel eSIM app from Nord Security, the company behind NordVPN, and since June 2026 it has sold phone numbers inside the app: a US +1 number that receives SMS, takes and makes calls and handles 2FA codes, with no US address, US carrier contract or physical card.

Official pricing: the number subscription starts at $0.99 a month on the product page, with the official blog quoting $1.99 a month, and annual billing is $11.99. Incoming SMS is free and unlimited, so a verification-only user can skip the calling pack, while outgoing calls and texts need a call and SMS plan from $0.99 priced by the country you are in. The number carries no data; Saily's eSIM data plans are bought separately and managed in the same app.

KYC is the gate: after buying you must upload a passport or government ID and complete a face check in the app, usually approved within minutes, with no US residency requirement. Without it you do not get the number.

Keeping it means keeping the subscription: the number lasts as long as the subscription stays active, and lapses when it ends, so annual billing saves trouble.

On verification codes: Saily calls it a real US wireless number, but Saily itself and third parties warn that some services flag it as VoIP, so pass rates at banks and exchanges are unreliable. It suits AI apps such as ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini and ordinary overseas sign-ups and 2FA, while important accounts still deserve a native carrier number.
saily-us-number-annual.conditions: Buy inside the Saily app; the number subscription is $0.99 to $1.99 a month or $11.99 a year, at the price shown in the app; incoming SMS is free while outgoing texts and calls need a call and SMS pack; passport or ID plus face KYC in the app is mandatory after purchase; the number includes no data and Saily data plans are separate; the number is lost if the subscription lapses; some platforms treat it as VoIP.
steps: Download the Saily app and open Phone number to pick a US +1 number
Choose annual ($11.99) or monthly billing and skip the destination data plan, since incoming SMS needs no pack
Upload a passport or government ID and complete the face check in the app
Activate the number and connect it through a Saily eSIM data plan; keep the subscription active to keep the number
saily-us-number-annual.risk: Some platforms treat the number as VoIP, so banks and exchanges may refuse it; letting the subscription lapse loses the number and there is no keep-alive package; KYC must pass or the purchase is wasted; the number has no data and needs a separate plan; the product page and the official blog quote different monthly prices ($0.99 and $1.99), so check the app before ordering; no third-party invite or discount code is used here.
saily-us-number-annual.source: Saily official Get an eSIM with a phone number page (checked 21 November 2026: +1 number, from $0.99 a month, in-app KYC) + Saily official blog How to get a US phone number overseas (9 November 2026: $1.99 a month, call and SMS plans from $0.99, incoming texts included)

bot-hosting-net-free-panel.title: [Global] bot-hosting.net free panel host: 256MB with any runtime (Node, Python) and no card, always on
bot-hosting-net-free-panel.highlight: A free container with no credit card: 256MB RAM, 25% CPU, 512MB storage and one deployment, any runtime from Node.js and Python to Go and Rust, with a custom port, static IP and free HTTPS subdomain, and no sleep mode according to the official page
bot-hosting-net-free-panel.regions: [Global] Managed from a web panel and open to sign-ups worldwide; the free tier needs no card but must be renewed by hand in the panel every four days
bot-hosting-net-free-panel.content:
bot-hosting.net is a web-panel host for Discord and Telegram bots and small services, and its free tier is a rare mix: no card, any runtime, and no sleep timer. You get 256MB RAM, 25% CPU, 512MB storage and one deployment, and the resources are a pool you split across your own deployments.

Runtime support is broad: Node, Python, Java, PHP, Go, Rust, C++, Lua and Bun all start, with one-click static and PHP sites, Lavalink and Uptime Kuma. Deployment works from GitHub, a ZIP upload or the bh deploy CLI, and each deployment gets one port, a static IP and a free HTTPS subdomain, alongside environment variables, logs, a console and auto-restart on crash.

The free tier costs you two things: a manual renewal in the panel every four days, without which the service stops, and ads in the free panel, which paid plans remove. Official docs dated 17 November explain that the new panel partitions capacity between free and paid servers and that, because of cost, each user can now create only one free server; the legacy panel is being retired.

What fits: Discord and Telegram bots, webhook receivers, small REST APIs, scheduled scrapers and static or PHP showcase sites. Processes under 300MB are fine; do not expect it to run build steps or memory-heavy applications.
