airfrance-klm-kolet-free-1gb.content: Air France and KLM have run a Kolet partnership since 2024-11-25 and it is still on the airlines' sites in 2026-11: on the Flying Blue Kolet portal, or in the Kolet app with code FBDEAL (Air France also publishes AFKLDATA), first-time users claim 1GB of free data valid for two days across 190+ countries. All data plans are 10% off, every euro spent earns 10 Flying Blue Miles, referring a friend gives both sides 250 Miles, and members in France and the Netherlands can part-pay with Miles through Flying Blue+. Group carrier Transavia France adopted the same template in 2026-05, giving arriving passengers up to 1GB over two days.
airfrance-klm-kolet-free-1gb.conditions: Only for people who have never used Kolet; install the Kolet app or come through the KLM Flying Blue portal and register with email; link the Flying Blue number before paying to earn Miles; the free allowance is 1GB over 2 days; data-only with no number; the 10% discount excludes monthly plans and cannot be combined.
steps: Open KLM's Flying Blue Kolet page and choose Explore with Kolet, or sign up in the Kolet app
Enter FBDEAL (or AFKLDATA for Air France), add your email and claim the free 1GB
Choose the destination and travel date, then install the eSIM on stable Wi-Fi before flying
Turn the eSIM on after landing; add the Flying Blue number under Profile to earn Miles
airfrance-klm-kolet-free-1gb.risk: The free gigabyte is once per person and device, and reinstalling does not reset it; it stops after 2 days or 1GB; the airlines do not promise mainland-China roaming (the Virgin Atlantic version is reported working there, this one is untested); the discount and Miles apply to paid plans only.
airfrance-klm-kolet-free-1gb.source: KLM official Kolet partner page (checked 2026-11-21: 1GB free for 2 days, first-time users only, code FBDEAL) plus Air France corporate release (2024-11-25, AFKLDATA) and Travolution / Air Journal (2026-05-04) for Transavia France

air-india-kolet-free-1gb.title: [IN] Air India Maharaja Club x Kolet: 1GB free for 2 days, with Vietnam Airlines and Corendon on the same template
air-india-kolet-free-1gb.highlight: Maharaja Club members claim 1GB of free data for 2 days at airindia.shop.kolet.com across 190 countries; Vietnam Airlines and Corendon run the same partner page and TAAG joined in 2026-07
air-india-kolet-free-1gb.regions: [IN, plus partner airlines] Air India Maharaja Club members; Vietnam Airlines Lotusmiles, Corendon and TAAG co-branded pages cover 190+ destinations and none of them requires a ticket first
air-india-kolet-free-1gb.content: Kolet's airline template works the same way across carriers. Air India's official partner page says Maharaja Club members get 2 days of free internet, up to 1GB, at their destination, through the dedicated airindia.shop.kolet.com page, and paid plans also earn Maharaja Points (the page shows two different rates, 6 and 10 Points per INR 100, so the checkout page decides). On the same template, Vietnam Airlines Lotusmiles members claim 1GB for 2 days at vietnamairlines.shop.kolet.com and earn 10 Lotusmiles per USD, Corendon uses corendon.shop.kolet.com, and TAAG Angola launched on 2026-07-30 with pre-departure emails and SMS.
air-india-kolet-free-1gb.conditions: Join the relevant frequent flyer programme first (free) and use that airline's co-branded link or in-app entry; first-time Kolet users only; the free allowance is about 1GB over 2 days; data-only, no number; cannot be combined with other discounts.
steps: Join Maharaja Club (or Vietnam Airlines Lotusmiles) and note the membership number
Enter the airline partner page, airindia.shop.kolet.com (vietnamairlines.shop.kolet.com for Vietnam Airlines)
Pick a destination and plan; first-time users see the free 1GB and a zero total
Install the eSIM with the Kolet app, turn on data after landing, and add the membership number when buying a paid plan
air-india-kolet-free-1gb.risk: You must be a member of the airline programme to use its page; 1GB only covers light use over two days; Air India's page shows two different point rates, so do not buy a plan for the points; mainland-China roaming is not promised by any of these carriers.
air-india-kolet-free-1gb.source: Air India official Kolet partner page (checked 2026-11-21: 2 days of free internet up to 1GB) plus Kolet press release (2025-08-04, Vietnam Airlines, Corendon and KrisFlyer) and Kolet help centre entry for Vietnam Airlines (updated 2026-07); TAAG from alertify and 360 Angola (2026-07-30)

sas-travel-esim-hubby.title: [Nordics] SAS x Hubby travel eSIM: 2 days of free data with eligible bookings in 190+ countries
sas-travel-esim-hubby.highlight: An eligible SAS booking carries a free eSIM in the app's My trip, giving two days of data on arrival in 190+ countries, with no local SIM hunt
sas-travel-esim-hubby.regions: [Nordics] SAS-operated international flights, with the first rollout aimed at tickets outside the EU; coverage of 190+ countries and destinations
sas-travel-esim-hubby.content: SAS launched the SAS Travel eSIM with Dutch white-label provider Hubby on 2026-06-16. Eligible bookings get a free eSIM inside the SAS app's My trip, with two days of mobile data in 190+ countries; travellers install it on stable Wi-Fi before departure and activate it after landing, then top up in the app, where top-ups earn EuroBonus points. SAS's live page states two days but not the data volume; the launch team described 1GB, so treat the app's own screen as the final source.
sas-travel-esim-hubby.conditions: Needs a EuroBonus account and the SAS app; only eligible SAS bookings include it and SAS does not define which; the free part is two days, top-ups are paid; data-only, so the normal number stays active; installation needs Wi-Fi.
steps: Install the SAS app and sign in with EuroBonus
Open My trip for the upcoming journey and find the included eSIM
Tap Get my eSIM and install it on stable Wi-Fi, which does not start the clock
Activate after landing as the app instructs; top up in the app when the two days end
sas-travel-esim-hubby.risk: SAS has not published the 1GB figure or what counts as an eligible booking, and does not say whether two days means 48 hours; not every ticket includes it; partner-operated, award, group or charter tickets are undefined; paid top-ups may cost more than a separate travel eSIM.
sas-travel-esim-hubby.source: SAS official Travel eSIM page (checked 2026-11-21: 2 days of free mobile data, 190+ countries, EuroBonus login) plus Travolution (2026-06-16) and OpenSim review (2026-08-13, noting the missing 1GB figure and eligibility definition)

tarom-ubigi-free-1gb.title: [RO] TAROM x Ubigi: 1GB of free global eSIM for every passenger plus 30% off a first plan
tarom-ubigi-free-1gb.highlight: After booking a TAROM ticket, the confirmation page, My Booking or online check-in shows an eSIM banner that gives 1GB free across 200+ destinations; the same eSIM can be reused on later trips
tarom-ubigi-free-1gb.regions: [RO] Passengers holding a TAROM booking; Ubigi covers 200+ destinations with one profile that stays usable for future trips
tarom-ubigi-free-1gb.value: 1GB free (about USD 5) plus 30% off the first plan
tarom-ubigi-free-1gb.content: TAROM, the Romanian flag carrier in SkyTeam, launched a Ubigi (Transatel) partnership in December 2025. After a booking, each passenger finds an eSIM banner on the confirmation page, in My Booking and at online check-in, giving 1GB of free data plus 30% off a first paid data plan. Ubigi uses a single profile in 200+ destinations, activates only on arrival through Smart Start, allows tethering on all plans, and can be topped up even without Wi-Fi or credit, so the eSIM is worth keeping for the next trip.
tarom-ubigi-free-1gb.conditions: Needs a TAROM booking, since the banner only appears in the booking, My Booking and check-in flows; one free 1GB per passenger, then paid top-ups; an eSIM-compatible unlocked phone; data-only with no local number.
steps: Book on tarom.ro and stay on the confirmation page after payment
Tap the eSIM banner, or find the same entry in My Booking or online check-in
Install the Ubigi app, claim the free 1GB and install the eSIM
Smart Start activates it on arrival; buy more data in the app with the 30% first-order discount
tarom-ubigi-free-1gb.risk: Without a TAROM booking there is no entry point; TAROM does not publish the validity or country list for this gigabyte, so check it in the app after claiming; Ubigi's site is blocked inside Turkey, so install before any Turkish connection.
tarom-ubigi-free-1gb.source: TAROM official news release (2025-12-19) plus Transatel / Ubigi release (2025-12-18) and Passport News (2025-12-19)

sun-phuquoc-free-esim-5gb.title: [VN] Sun PhuQuoc Airways: free 5GB eSIM for international arrivals (24 hours on MobiFone)
sun-phuquoc-free-esim-5gb.highlight: International passengers arriving in Vietnam on Sun PhuQuoc Airways claim a free 5GB / 24-hour eSIM with a PNR, surname and email, then activate it by calling 900 after landing; the promotion runs to 2027-08-31
sun-phuquoc-free-esim-5gb.regions: [VN] Only for passengers arriving in Vietnam on a Sun PhuQuoc Airways international flight (adults and children); the 5GB runs on MobiFone inside Vietnam
sun-phuquoc-free-esim-5gb.content: Sun PhuQuoc Airways runs a zero-dong eSIM with VTC and MobiFone. At connect.sunphuquocairways.com an international passenger enters the PNR or ticket number, surname and email, completes eKYC with a passport page and a portrait photo, and receives a QR code plus an emailed copy. The 5GB starts when the traveller dials 900 free of charge after landing and lasts 24 hours, so installing early costs nothing. Passengers can register from before the flight until four days after arrival on one-way trips, or before the return departure on round trips, and top up on the same page later without repeating eKYC.
sun-phuquoc-free-esim-5gb.conditions: Must be flying the airline into Vietnam internationally; refunded, invalid or fraudulent bookings are excluded; one eSIM per passport in 30 days; eKYC needs a passport page and a selfie; the phone must be unlocked and eSIM-capable; 24 hours or 5GB, whichever comes first; extra data is paid.
steps: Open connect.sunphuquocairways.com and enter the 6-character PNR or ticket number, surname and email
Choose the passenger, accept the terms and complete MobiFone eKYC with a passport page and a portrait photo
Install the eSIM from the QR code, ideally on stable Wi-Fi before departure
After landing in Vietnam call 900 free of charge; the 5GB and the 24 hours start then
sun-phuquoc-free-esim-5gb.risk: Only genuine flights on this airline qualify and codeshare or charter handling is unpublished; 24 hours is short and day two needs a top-up; eKYC means uploading a passport and a selfie; an unactivated eSIM expires.
sun-phuquoc-free-esim-5gb.source: Sun PhuQuoc Airways official offer page (2026-09-01 to 2027-08-31) plus the connect.sunphuquocairways.com policy and user guide, and the Vietnamese terms summary on abay.vn

trip-com-member-free-esim.title: [Global] Trip.com Platinum and above: free global eSIM from 1GB/3 days up to 8x3GB
trip-com-member-free-esim.highlight: The rewards page lists a free eSIM at every high tier: Platinum gets 1GB for 3 days, Diamond 3GB for 5 days, Diamond+ two of them and Black Diamond eight; book a member-labelled eSIM in the app and pay nothing
trip-com-member-free-esim.regions: [Global] Trip.com Platinum, Diamond, Diamond+ and Black Diamond members; the free package covers 70+ countries and is app-only
trip-com-member-free-esim.value: 1GB to 24GB of free eSIM data by tier
trip-com-member-free-esim.content: Trip.com Rewards includes a Free Global eSIM Data Package, checked on the official page on 2026-11-21: Platinum 1x1GB/3 days, Diamond 1x3GB/5 days, Diamond+ 2x3GB/5 days and Black Diamond 8x3GB/5 days. Members open the reward in the Trip.com app, choose an eSIM product carrying the matching member label, apply the reward and pay zero, then receive an activation email with a QR code. The reward is not available on the website or mobile site. Tier thresholds shown on the same page: Platinum needs 8 eligible bookings and USD 1,000, Diamond USD 10,000 of spend, Diamond+ is by invitation and Black Diamond follows the published rules.
trip-com-member-free-esim.conditions: Requires the matching tier (Platinum: 8 bookings plus USD 1,000; Diamond: USD 10,000); app-only checkout with the reward applied; only member-labelled eSIM products, with allowance and destination set by the product page; a freely cancellable booking returns the quota, a non-refundable one does not; data-only with no number.
steps: Sign in to the Trip.com app and open Member Rewards for the Free Global eSIM Data Package
Tap Use Now to open a member-labelled eSIM product and check the destination and allowance
Apply the reward at checkout and confirm the total is zero
Install the eSIM from the emailed QR code and enable roaming on arrival
trip-com-member-free-esim.risk: The thresholds are high, so this is a frequent-traveller perk and not worth booking extra trips for; only 70+ countries are covered and obscure destinations may be missing; the website cannot claim it; cancelling a non-refundable eSIM burns the quota.
trip-com-member-free-esim.source: Trip.com official loyalty page (checked 2026-11-21 for each tier's allowance and threshold) plus the published terms for the Free Global eSIM Data Package

agoda-vip-diamond-free-esim.title: [Global] Agoda VIP Diamond: free 1GB / 7-day global eSIM
agoda-vip-diamond-free-esim.highlight: Agoda VIP Diamond members activate a free 1GB, 7-day eSIM inside the Agoda app for eligible destinations, so the phone is online the moment they land
agoda-vip-diamond-free-esim.regions: [Global] AgodaVIP Diamond members; the eSIM covers a set of eligible destinations shown in the app
agoda-vip-diamond-free-esim.content: Agoda announced free eSIMs for VIP Diamond members on 2026-02-11: 1GB of data valid for seven days, activated through the Agoda app on iOS or Android before departure, and usable in many eligible destinations worldwide. The point is to cover the gap before a traveller buys a local SIM. Diamond is the top AgodaVIP tier; third-party summaries put the threshold at 15 bookings and USD 1,500 of spend within 24 months, while Agoda itself does not publish the number. Hotel, flight and activity bookings all count toward the tier.
agoda-vip-diamond-free-esim.conditions: Requires AgodaVIP Diamond status; activation happens only in the Agoda app; only eligible destinations listed at booking; 1GB over 7 days, then paid top-ups; data-only with no number.
steps: Sign in to the Agoda app and confirm VIP Diamond status
Open the VIP benefits page and find the free eSIM entry
Choose a destination and activate, installing the eSIM on Wi-Fi before departure
Enable data roaming for that eSIM after landing and use it within the seven days
agoda-vip-diamond-free-esim.risk: The threshold is high and non-Diamond accounts see no entry; Agoda has not published how many eSIMs a member may claim or the full destination list; 1GB only covers light use over a week; the feature may roll out market by market.
agoda-vip-diamond-free-esim.source: Agoda press release (2026-02-11: 1GB, 7 days, activated in the app) plus Shareuhack's AgodaVIP summary (Diamond threshold of 15 bookings and USD 1,500, updated 2026-10)

omio-kolet-free-1gb.title: [Global] Omio x Kolet: free 1GB global eSIM with every transport booking
omio-kolet-free-1gb.highlight: Every completed Omio booking triggers 1GB of free Kolet data through the confirmation email or the Manage My Booking banner, and one eSIM spans a multi-country itinerary
omio-kolet-free-1gb.regions: [Global] Omio's 46 countries; the eSIM itself covers 190+ destinations, claimed per booking
omio-kolet-free-1gb.content: Omio and Kolet rolled out their partnership in October 2025. Each booking on Omio automatically triggers 1GB of free Kolet data, delivered by post-booking email or through the Manage My Booking banner in the app. Once installed, the Kolet eSIM picks the best local partner network in each country, so a multi-country trip needs only one profile. Omio sells more than 80,000 tickets a day across 46 countries, so even a cheap short-hop ticket can unlock the free gigabyte.
omio-kolet-free-1gb.conditions: Needs an Omio account and a completed booking; the free allowance is for first-time Kolet users; claim through the booking email or Manage My Booking; the 1GB follows Kolet's free-trial validity of about two days after activation; data-only with no number.
steps: Book and pay for a train, coach or flight ticket on Omio
Find the Kolet entry in the confirmation email or under Manage My Booking
Install the Kolet app, register and claim the free 1GB through that link
Install the eSIM on Wi-Fi before departure and activate it on arrival
omio-kolet-free-1gb.risk: Omio has not published how many times one person can claim or whether cancelled bookings are clawed back, so the email decides; 1GB covers only the first hours or a day; you must actually book through Omio to get it.
omio-kolet-free-1gb.source: Omio official press release (2025-10-21: each booking triggers 1GB via Kolet) plus Kolet's release, HotMinute (2026-05-23) and the eSIM Podium review (checked 2026-10-21)

jegotrip-cmlink-free-20gb-uk.title: [UK] JegoTrip (CMLink) free 20GB UK eSIM with a UK number, restocked in limited batches
jegotrip-cmlink-free-20gb-uk.highlight: Archived: the campaign is over. No restocks after July 2026, a visitor reported it dead on 2026-11-21, the official download page returns 500 and Google Play only shows generic wording; the detail page stays for reference with alternatives listed on top
jegotrip-cmlink-free-20gb-uk.regions: [UK] China Mobile International's CMLink UK card, data usable inside the UK; the app registers UK, Japanese, Thai or Singapore numbers, but only a UK number unlocks the 20GB and the UK number
jegotrip-cmlink-free-20gb-uk.value: 20GB plus a UK number (about GBP 9 / USD 12)
jegotrip-cmlink-free-20gb-uk.content:
China Mobile International keeps using its JegoTrip-CMLink app for acquisitions. A new user who signs in with a UK number can claim a CMLink UK eSIM for zero under Profile: one +44 number and 20GB of local high-speed data worth GBP 9. Batches of roughly 1,000 were released in May, June and July 2026 and sold out the same day; signing up with a Japanese, Thai or Singapore number only yields a 1GB China/Hong Kong travel pack. The number has no monthly fee and receives SMS for free but cannot make calls; activate within a year of claiming and the 20GB lasts 28 days. Activation must happen outside mainland China, on a UK or Hong Kong cell or over Wi-Fi Calling, and community reports say the Wi-Fi Calling route tightened in late 2026.

Archive note (2026-11-22): confirmed as an expired campaign and moved to the archive permanently. Recheck: the official download page returns 500, the Google Play listing (updated 2026-11-20) only shows generic "new-user perk, limited stock" wording with no 20GB mention, the last community restock posts date from 2026-07-28, and a visitor reported on 2026-11-21 that it no longer works.
jegotrip-cmlink-free-20gb-uk.conditions: A UK mobile number is required to register and claim (other numbers only get the 1GB China/Hong Kong pack); one claim per device and account; activate outside mainland China or through a working Wi-Fi Calling setup; activate within a year, then 20GB for 28 days; SMS only, no voice; limited stock, first come first served.
steps: Install JegoTrip-CMLink from the UK App Store or Google Play and register with a UK number
After signing in, open the 20GB UK data banner on the home screen or under Profile and order it for zero
Install the eSIM on an unlocked, eSIM-capable phone
Activate in the UK or Hong Kong, or through Wi-Fi Calling; the 20GB then runs for 28 days
jegotrip-cmlink-free-20gb-uk.risk: Archived as expired: no restocks since July 2026, a visitor reported it dead on 2026-11-21, the download page returns 500 and Google Play shows generic wording only. Historic risks remain: irregular limited restocks, a UK number is required, activation must happen outside mainland China, and the Wi-Fi Calling route has been unreliable since late 2026.
jegotrip-cmlink-free-20gb-uk.source: JegoTrip official download and product pages (still promoting the new-user welcome benefit in 2026-11) plus Naixi forum thread-12499 (2026-06-12), NodeSeek posts 845619 and 845273 (2026-07-28), Huoke's test (2026-05-13) and Chinese media summaries (2026-06 and 2026-10)

genixnode-kvm-nvme-14-loc.title: [Global] GenixNode KVM NVMe VPS: 4GB RAM from $2.99/mo in 14 locations (dedicated IPv4, full root with SSH, +1 week for LET)
genixnode-kvm-nvme-14-loc.highlight: 2 vCPU / 4GB / 40GB NVMe / 1Gbps / unmetered (fair use); $2.99/mo in Istanbul, $28.70/yr; KVM full root with SSH and one dedicated IPv4, 14 locations
genixnode-kvm-nvme-14-loc.regions: [Global] Istanbul (TR) $2.99/mo; Sofia, London, Limburg, Dublin, New York, Los Angeles, Miami and Canada $6.19/mo; Hong Kong and Sydney $7.63/mo; Dallas and Singapore out of stock
genixnode-kvm-nvme-14-loc.content: GenixNode is a KVM VPS provider run by GenixNode LLC, registered in Wyoming, USA, and founded in May 2026. Nova x4 is 2 vCPU / 4GB RAM / 40GB NVMe / 1Gbps shared port / unmetered traffic under a fair-use policy / one dedicated IPv4: $2.99/mo in Istanbul, $2.39/mo on annual billing ($28.70 a year); $6.19/mo in Europe, the US and Canada; $7.63/mo in Hong Kong and Sydney. Pulse x8 (8GB) and Apex x12 (12GB) sit above it. Quarterly billing takes 10% off, semi-annual 15% and annual 20%. The site lists KVM full root, VNC console, rescue mode, DDoS protection and free backups, with automated setup in 1-2 minutes; payment by card (Stripe), Alipay or crypto. Post your order number in their LowEndTalk thread for an extra free week; Black Friday specials land in that thread on 23 November.
genixnode-kvm-nvme-14-loc.conditions: $2.99 applies to Istanbul only; other regions add a location surcharge, and the cart summary is the price that counts (the button price and dropdown price do not match). Unmetered traffic is governed by a fair-use policy: a 6-hour average above 100Mbps is throttled automatically. One dedicated IPv4, not NAT or IPv6-only. KVM gives full root and SSH; the provider does not publish a port blocklist, so ask support before ordering if you need port 25. Signup needs only an email; pay by card, Alipay or crypto.
steps: Open genixnode.com/vps, pick Nova x4 and a region (Istanbul is cheapest) and check the cart summary before paying
After payment take the IP and root password from the panel and connect over SSH or the VNC console
Reply to the official LET thread with your order number for the extra free week
If the run-away risk worries you, stay monthly instead of prepaying years
genixnode-kvm-nvme-14-loc.risk: Founded in May 2026, so under a year old, with run-away risk; only a 7-day refund. No long-term community report yet, so do not put anything important on it. Several LET posters found the button, region and summary prices disagreeing; trust the summary. $2.99 is Istanbul only, and other regions cost more than double. The Black Friday specials only appear on 23 November, so buying now may not be the lowest price.
genixnode-kvm-nvme-14-loc.source: Visitor submission (2026-11-22 00:31) + LowEndTalk official offer thread (2026-11-21) + genixnode.com/vps and the Istanbul page (read 2026-11-22) + LowEndBox (2026-11-09)

razer-gold-8th-anniversary-bonus.title: [Multi-region] Razer Gold 8th anniversary: wallet payments earn tiered Bonus Gold, up to ¥3,412 / $21 (11/16-12/20)
razer-gold-8th-anniversary-bonus.highlight: Pay for games or entertainment from your Razer Gold wallet and get 9-10% back in Bonus Gold by single-transaction tier; all four tiers add up to ¥3,412
razer-gold-8th-anniversary-bonus.regions: [Multi-region] Only accounts registered in the US, Canada, Hong Kong, China, Taiwan, Japan, Korea, Thailand, Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia, the Philippines, Vietnam, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Turkey, Saudi Arabia, Egypt, Brazil or the UAE; Japan uses yen tiers, the US uses dollar tiers
razer-gold-8th-anniversary-bonus.value: Up to ¥3,412 (about $22) / $21 in Bonus Gold for the US
razer-gold-8th-anniversary-bonus.content: Razer Gold's 8th anniversary runs from 12:00 on 16 November to 24:59 on 20 December 2026 Japan time (the terms say 00:59 on 21 December). Pay from your Razer Gold wallet in a single transaction and reach a tier to get Bonus Gold back: in Japan ¥4,488 returns 448, ¥7,688 returns 688, ¥10,888 returns 988 and ¥14,088 returns 1,288, each once per user, and all four add up to ¥3,412; the US version has five tiers and returns up to $21. Bonus Gold expires two months after it lands and cannot be transferred or cashed out. Parallel campaigns cover Honor of Kings (1,200 / 4,000 tokens for treasure chests), Arena Breakout (top 15 spenders get 3,000 appearance vouchers) and iQIYI (a 7-day standard pass with 3/6/12-month plans).
razer-gold-8th-anniversary-bonus.conditions: Pay with the Razer Gold wallet; other payment methods do not qualify. Tiers are judged per single transaction, so several purchases cannot be combined. Each tier can be claimed once per user. The account must be verified. Only accounts registered in the 20 listed regions participate. Spend the Bonus Gold within two months.
steps: Sign in at gold.razer.com and confirm your account region is one of the 20 and that it is verified
Open the campaign page for your region (/promotions/8thanni-bonusgold) and check your local tiers
Pay from the wallet in a single transaction at or above a tier; Bonus Gold lands automatically
When clearing several tiers, keep the payments separate instead of merging the amounts
razer-gold-8th-anniversary-bonus.risk: The reward is Bonus Gold usable only inside the Razer Gold ecosystem, expiring after two months and not withdrawable. You have to spend first for roughly 9-10% back, so topping up extra to chase the rebate loses money. Tiers and currencies differ by account region, so do not copy someone else's screenshot. Razer can change the terms at any time, and some categories such as Steam are excluded depending on the region.
razer-gold-8th-anniversary-bonus.source: Razer Gold official campaign pages and terms (JP and US 8thanni-bonusgold, read 2026-11-22) plus the 8anni-ichiran roundup page

vodafone-samoa-ding-tuesday-data.title: [Samoa] Vodafone Samoa x Ding: top up $10+ on any Tuesday and get 5-25GB bonus data (11/10-2027-02-10)
vodafone-samoa-ding-tuesday-data.highlight: Top up a Vodafone Samoa prepaid number with $10 or more through Ding every Tuesday and get 5, 10 or 25GB added automatically; the top-up credit stays yours
vodafone-samoa-ding-tuesday-data.regions: [Samoa] Vodafone Samoa prepaid numbers only; the top-up must go through Ding (ding.com or the Ding app), other channels and other weekdays are excluded
vodafone-samoa-ding-tuesday-data.content: Vodafone Samoa and the top-up platform Ding run a Tuesday promotion from 10 November 2026 to 10 February 2027: top up a Vodafone Samoa prepaid number through Ding with $10 or more on a Tuesday (00:00-23:59) and bonus data is added automatically - $10-19 gets 5GB, $20-49 gets 10GB and $50 or more gets 25GB. vodafone-samoa-ding-tuesday-data.conditions: Must be a Vodafone Samoa prepaid customer. The top-up has to be at least $10 through Ding on a Tuesday. Other days and other channels do not count. The bonus data expires after 2 days. Vodafone Samoa can amend or withdraw the offer.
steps: Open ding.com or the Ding app, choose Samoa - Vodafone and enter the recipient's number
Place the order on a Tuesday (Samoa local time, 00:00-23:59) for $10 or more
The bonus data is added once the top-up lands; use it within 2 days
For the full 25GB, send $50 or more in one go

Ding adds its own exchange rate and fees. The terms do not state a per-number weekly limit, so treat it as once per Tuesday (to be confirmed). Vodafone can change or withdraw the promotion during the period.
vodafone-samoa-ding-tuesday-data.source: Vodafone Samoa official promotion page and terms (published 2026-11-09, read 2026-11-22) plus ding.com

norma-connect-start-esim.title: [DE] NORMA connect Start eSIM: no monthly fee, EUR 2.99 starter pack with EUR 10 credit (a real German Telekom number, passport accepted)
norma-connect-start-esim.highlight: A no-monthly-fee prepaid card on the Telekom 5G network: the Start plan charges 9 euro cents a minute or text. During Black Week the starter pack drops from EUR 9.95 to EUR 2.99 and activating Start returns EUR 10 of credit, so the pack nets about EUR 7; the eSIM arrives by email, Wi-Fi Calling works and top-up credit never expires.
norma-connect-start-esim.regions: [DE] A German +49 mobile number on the Telekom network; EU/EEA roaming at domestic rates plus the UK, Norway, Iceland and Liechtenstein; mainland China and other non-EU countries roam with received SMS reported free.
norma-connect-start-esim.value: EUR 2.99 starter pack including EUR 10 credit (about EUR 7 net), no monthly fee
norma-connect-start-esim.content:
NORMA connect is the prepaid brand run by the NORMA supermarket chain with Telekom, on Telekom's 5G network (D-Netz). Start is the base plan: EUR 0 a month, no contract, 9 euro cents a minute and per text (60/60 billing), no included data, with data packs bought in the app when needed.

During Black Week the starter pack (physical SIM or eSIM) falls from EUR 9.95 to EUR 2.99, and choosing the Start plan on activation credits EUR 10 to the prepaid balance, so the pack nets roughly EUR 7. That credit pays for calls, texts and data add-ons, and the official FAQ states top-up credit does not expire. The NORMA Plus app price is EUR 1.99 (teltarif, 30 October 2026; promotion runs to 29 November).

Activation requires a one-time identity check under German section 172 TKG (official ID plus a video or photo check run by NECT). A visitor reports a Chinese passport passing first time, and the eSIM arrives as an emailed QR code with no German address needed; the eSIM is available on every plan.

Its place is a real German number with minimal upkeep: no monthly fee, a +49 mobile number, working inbound SMS, Wi-Fi Calling (per comparison sites and user reports), free inbound SMS while roaming in mainland China (reported), and EU, UK, Norway, Iceland and Liechtenstein roaming at domestic rates.
norma-connect-start-esim.conditions: Activation needs a section 172 TKG identity check (passport works in current reports); the EUR 2.99 Black Week price runs to 29 November 2026, then returns to EUR 9.95 (EUR 1.99 in the NORMA Plus app); no monthly fee but calls and texts cost 9 euro cents each and no data is included; the phone must support eSIM (check for an EID with *#06#); the EUR 10 credit is call credit and cannot be withdrawn; calls and data outside the EU are charged at roaming rates.
steps: Order a starter pack (physical SIM or eSIM) at norma-connect.de at the EUR 2.99 Black Week price
Complete the NECT identity check from the email (passport photo page plus a face check) and install the eSIM QR code
Choose the Start plan on activation and confirm the EUR 10 credit lands in the prepaid balance
Top up EUR 5 every 12-15 months to keep the line active (official terms say credit never expires; this is the community habit)
norma-connect-start-esim.risk: An identity check is mandatory and there is no public list of accepted passport types, with only one or two Chinese-passport reports so far; the EUR 10 is call credit that cannot be withdrawn or transferred; EUR 2.99 is a Black Week price and returns to EUR 9.95 after 29 November; a zero-fee card includes no data, so overseas data is a separate purchase; changing phones means requesting the eSIM again; German fraud checks occasionally decline foreign payment methods.
norma-connect-start-esim.source: Official Start plan page, FAQ and price notes (read 22 November 2026) + teltarif Black Week report (30 October 2026) + sim.gratis comparison page (data as of 22 November 2026) + visitor submission (22 November 2026 01:02) + X reports from @nmyx888 and @Lovislexus (22 November 2026)

dtcpay-esim-5gb-6m.title: [Singapore] dtcpay eSIM: 5GB a month for 6 months free after signup (97 countries, Singapore residential IP, passport plus overseas address)
dtcpay-esim-5gb-6m.highlight: dtcpay, a MAS-licensed Singapore payment institution, hands out a free eSIM in its app after KYC: community reports put it at 5GB a month for six months across 97 countries with a Singapore residential IP exit, and the same account also opens a free Visa Platinum virtual card. The eSIM itself lasts about ten years and is data-only.
dtcpay-esim-5gb-6m.regions: [Singapore] The account sits in Singapore; the eSIM works in 97 countries and regions including mainland China, exiting through a Singapore Singtel residential IP.
dtcpay-esim-5gb-6m.value: Six months at 5GB a month of global data (about 30GB, 97 countries) with an eSIM valid about ten years
dtcpay-esim-5gb-6m.content:
dtcpay is a Singapore-licensed payment institution (MAS Major Payment Institution, plus a Luxembourg EMI licence) whose app opens a multi-currency account and a Visa Platinum card (virtual and physical, both free), and throws in a data-only eSIM.

How the benefit works: after KYC the app's eSIM section shows free data packs. Community reports through 2026 put it at 5GB a month for six consecutive months across 97 countries, exiting through a Singapore Singtel residential IP with a reputation score of 97, cleaner than a datacentre proxy, which suits services that only accept a Singapore IP. One October 2026 report got only two one-off packs of 1GB and 5GB instead, so the rules shift month to month and the app is the source of truth.

The eSIM costs nothing and stays valid about ten years. It has no number, cannot receive SMS and is data-only; it can be written to a physical eUICC such as 9eSIM or Xesim for phones without eSIM support, and a new phone re-enables it in the app rather than claiming again.

The bar is higher than most card accounts: a passport, an overseas address proof from the last 3-6 months (a statement) and a non-+86 phone number, with the address country matching the residence you pick. Machine review rejects address proofs often, and the community workaround is to resubmit the same photo once before switching documents. Review takes one to three business days.
dtcpay-esim-5gb-6m.conditions: KYC needs a passport, an overseas address proof (a statement from the last 3-6 months whose country matches the residence selected) and a non-+86 phone number; the eSIM is data-only with no number and no SMS; the size and length of the free packs vary by account and campaign (5GB for six months, or a one-off 1GB plus 5GB); the same account also opens a free Visa virtual card funded with USDT, USDC or foreign currency.
steps: Download dtcpay from a non-China app store, register with an email and open the emailed link on the same phone
Prepare a passport, an overseas address proof and a non-+86 number, pick the country on the address proof as residence and finish KYC
Once approved, open the eSIM section, claim the free data packs and install them or scan the code into a physical eUICC
Before travelling, check the pack's validity and volume, and optionally open the free Visa virtual card from the card section
dtcpay-esim-5gb-6m.risk: The address proof is the main obstacle and machine review often rejects it, with mainland China statements basically never passing; reports disagree on the free data (six months of 5GB versus a one-off 1GB plus 5GB), so do not pay anything for this data; the eSIM has no number and cannot receive verification codes; the account is held with a Singapore institution and incomplete documents or risk checks can close it; it is data-only, so emergency calls do not work.
dtcpay-esim-5gb-6m.source: Official dtcpay.com site and terms of business (read 22 November 2026) + NodeSeek report on a completed signup (12 June 2026) + macin.top walkthrough (2 September 2026, updated 30 October) + Digital Residents forum (8 August 2026) + visitor submission (22 November 2026 09:03)

zcode-new-user-5day-8m.title: [Global] ZCode new-user trial: 8 million GLM tokens a day for 5 days (3M GLM-5.3 plus 5M Flash, no card)
zcode-new-user-5day-8m.highlight: Zhipu's official coding client ZCode gives new users 8 million tokens a day for five days from first use after connecting a BigModel (China) or Z.ai (rest of world) account: 3 million GLM-5.3 plus 5 million GLM-5.3-Flash a day, refreshed daily and expiring after five days, with no payment or card required.
zcode-new-user-5day-8m.regions: [Global] BigModel accounts for China, Z.ai accounts elsewhere; the quota only works inside the ZCode client on Mac, Windows or Linux.
zcode-new-user-5day-8m.value: About 40 million tokens over five days (8 million a day) at no cost
zcode-new-user-5day-8m.content:
ZCode is Zhipu's coding client for GLM-5.3, and its documentation spells out the free trial: a new user downloads the client and connects a BigModel account, which grants a trial plan that provides 8 million tokens a day for the five days from first use, split into two independent quotas, 3 million GLM-5.3 and 5 million GLM-5.3-Flash. Each refreshes daily and cannot be pooled, for roughly 40 million tokens in total.

Overseas users connecting a Z.ai account get a daily flagship-model trial quota on the same terms. The documentation states no payment is required, with no card and no identity check mentioned.

It is separate from the nightly card giveaway, which hands out 300 million Flash tokens on weekdays and 500 million at weekends; this entry is the five-day new-user trial. The provider page shows each model's balance and usage for the day, which makes it a cheap way to try a real project before deciding on a GLM Coding subscription.
zcode-new-user-5day-8m.conditions: New users only, within five days of first connecting an account; daily quotas refresh and cannot be used in one go; the quota only works inside the ZCode client, so a personal API key does not qualify; everything expires after five days with no automatic charge; the documentation gives no overall end date for the offer.
steps: Download the ZCode client from zcode.z.ai (Mac, Windows or Linux) and sign in
On the first-run welcome page connect BigModel in China or Z.ai elsewhere and authorise
Start using it to enter the five-day trial and watch today's balance and usage on the provider page
Finish the tasks you want to try within five days, then decide about a coding subscription
zcode-new-user-5day-8m.risk: Five days is short and setting up a project can eat half of it; the documentation gives no end date, so the offer can change at any time; the quota cannot leave the client or be used with other tools; do not confuse it with the nightly token giveaway.
zcode-new-user-5day-8m.source: ZCode official documentation on the free trial quota and the welcome page (read 22 November 2026) + Cyber Eggs (11 November 2026) + AI Deals Radar community vote, 75% still valid (9 November 2026) + visitor submission (22 November 2026 09:04)

tencent-lightvela-free-month.title: [China] Tencent LightVela cloud AI assistant: first month free, 2 vCPU / 8GB with 4,500 AI credits a month (5 bots)
tencent-lightvela-free-month.highlight: LightVela from Tencent's Lighthouse cloud team is an always-on cloud AI assistant built on Hermes Agent that plugs into WeChat, QQ, WeCom, Feishu and DingTalk. A new user's first Launch AI plan is free for one month: 2 vCPU, 8GB RAM, 50GB storage, 4,500 AI credits a month and 5 bots, with no automatic charge at the end.
tencent-lightvela-free-month.regions: [China] The China site requires mainland ID verification; the international site's free trial page lists the same LightVela trial.
tencent-lightvela-free-month.value: First month free (normally CNY 68 a month): 2 vCPU / 8GB / 50GB cloud host plus 4,500 AI credits and 5 bots
tencent-lightvela-free-month.content:
LightVela is the cloud AI assistant from Tencent's Lighthouse cloud team, running the open-source Hermes Agent, sold as an assistant that stays online around the clock and keeps working while you are away. Each account gets an independent Ubuntu cloud machine with long-term memory, installable skills and scheduled tasks (notification and script tasks are billed at zero tokens), connecting to WeChat, QQ, WeCom, DingTalk and Feishu, with WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord and Slack on the international site.

The offer comes from Tencent Cloud's official free trial page, which lists the LightVela trial as a 2 vCPU and 8GB dedicated cloud environment with 4,500 AI credits. That maps to the Launch AI plan at CNY 68 a month with 5 bots, 2 vCPU, 8GB RAM, 50GB storage and 4,500 credits monthly; the first order is free for one month, counted as 30 days from activation, with no automatic charge afterwards. A Cruise AI plan is 40% off the first month at CNY 94.80 with 10,000 credits, 10 bots, 4 vCPU and 16GB.

It is not a bare VPS: there is no self-service SSH login, published port list or dedicated IPv4 to configure, so it works as a managed agent (create an assistant, connect a channel, hand it tasks). Anyone wanting a box to host a site or run a proxy should look elsewhere; treat it as a trial of an AI assistant that happens to include a cloud machine.
tencent-lightvela-free-month.conditions: First order only for new users; complete a one-time mainland ID verification before activation; the free period is 30 days from activation and Tencent publishes no overall end date; after that the subscription renews at list price (Launch AI, CNY 68 a month), so turn off auto-renewal; being active on 3 days within 30 days earns an extra extension card.
steps: Open the LightVela China site, sign in with WeChat or QQ and complete the one-time ID verification
Pick Launch AI on the subscription page, activate at the free first-order price shown and confirm 4,500 credits
Create an assistant, connect WeChat or QQ and hand it the work you want done
Note the date 30 days out and decide whether to renew or switch off auto-renewal
tencent-lightvela-free-month.risk: Free only for the first order and first month; it renews at CNY 68 a month afterwards and forgetting auto-renewal means a charge; mainland ID verification is mandatory, so overseas users can only use the international site; Tencent publishes no end date, so the offer can be pulled or reworded; it is not a bare cloud host, with no self-service SSH, ports or dedicated IP, so it cannot host a site or a proxy; credits are tied to the 30-day plan and expire with it.

databricks-free-edition.title: [Global] Databricks Free Edition: a perpetually free data and AI platform (notebooks, assistant, agents, model serving)
databricks-free-edition.highlight: Databricks Free Edition is free to sign up for and covers notebooks, the in-product AI assistant, agent building, model training and API serving, ETL pipelines, Genie natural-language BI and the Academy courses. The official FAQ calls it free for all users and perpetually free, restricted to personal, non-commercial use.
databricks-free-edition.regions: [Global] A hosted workspace available on signup; personal and non-commercial use only, with smaller compute and warehouse sizes under fair-use limits.
databricks-free-edition.value: Perpetually free for personal learning: notebooks, AI assistant, agents, ETL, model serving and Academy courses
databricks-free-edition.content:
Databricks Free Edition is the vendor's free data and AI platform, expanded from the old Community Edition. One workspace covers notebooks in Python and SQL with the built-in Databricks Assistant writing and fixing code, LLM agents and knowledge-base question answering, classical machine-learning training with deployment as API endpoints, ETL pipelines with schema-drift and data-quality handling, and Genie for asking your own data questions in plain language plus dashboards.

The FAQ is explicit: free for all users, perpetually free. The trade-off is smaller compute and warehouse sizes under fair-use limits, and no production or commercial use, personal learning only. Existing Community Edition users keep access for the rest of this year before moving to Free Edition, and Databricks Academy training is free.

It is not an SSH-able cloud host and has no dedicated IP or port concept, being a managed workspace. That makes it a poor fit as a VPS but a good place to practise data engineering, machine learning and agent building.
databricks-free-edition.conditions: Personal and non-commercial use only, with commercial use against the terms; compute and warehouse sizes are small with fair-use limits; legacy Community Edition keeps working for the rest of the year before migrating; the workspace is managed, not an SSH-able host, with no dedicated IP or ports.
steps: Open databricks.com/learn/free-edition and start free
Sign up with an email, create a workspace and run a first Python or SQL notebook
To try agents, build a knowledge-base Q&A or a model serving endpoint in the workspace
Take the free Databricks Academy courses; limits follow what the workspace shows
databricks-free-edition.risk: Commercial use is not allowed and can get the account suspended; clusters are small and quota-bound, so large model training queues or gets cut off; the vendor can adjust limits and terms at any time; it is not a general cloud host, so proxies and VPNs are out.
databricks-free-edition.source: Databricks official Free Edition page and FAQ (read 22 November 2026) + visitor submission (22 November 2026 09:04)

esimgg-estonia-372-number.title: [Global] eSIM.GG: an Estonian +372 number for EUR 2.99, no monthly fee, stays alive with one use a year
esimgg-estonia-372-number.highlight: EUR 2.99 buys an eSIM with a +372 Estonian number, no monthly fee and a balance that never expires; one qualifying use within 365 days renews it. In mainland China it roams on China Unicom: EUR 4.7 per GB and free incoming SMS, but no voice calls there
esimgg-estonia-372-number.regions: [Global] A +372 Estonian number the vendor lists in 154+ countries; mainland China roams on China Unicom (EUR 4.7 per GB, incoming SMS free, outgoing EUR 0.24, voice unavailable there); no identity verification at all
esimgg-estonia-372-number.content:
eSIM.GG (known in Chinese communities as the turtle card) sells a prepaid eSIM with an Estonian +372 number. It is not a data-only travel plan: once installed it receives SMS, can call and take calls, and data can be bought per use. The number costs EUR 2.99 on the official site, there is no monthly fee, and the account balance does not expire.

The keep-alive rule follows the official FAQ: any qualifying activity within 365 days, such as a little data, one SMS, one call, a top-up or a successful registration on a local network, restarts the 365-day window. After a full year without activity the number may be recycled. The vendor has announced a switch to a balance-change rule; until it lands, follow the site.

Rates from the official coverage page updated 2026-11-21: data from EUR 0.88 per GB in most of Europe and Asia; a 10GB pack usable in 42 countries for EUR 9, covering China, the US, the UK, the EU, Malaysia and Thailand. In mainland China data is EUR 4.7 per GB, incoming SMS is free, outgoing SMS is EUR 0.24 and voice is unavailable. The site also states that ChatGPT and TikTok work normally, which matters when traffic needs a foreign exit.

Community tests in October 2026: total opening cost around CNY 30 (number plus a first balance), installed on an eSTK external card, and after about 24 hours the number received a WhatsApp verification code; Telegram codes also arrived on some number ranges (5405, 5406, 5311, 57, 59, 8103). Receiving SMS does not mean every platform accepts the number: the vendor explicitly does not guarantee third-party codes, and a new line needs about 24 hours of technical provisioning, so silence right after installation is not a setup error.

Who it suits: people who want a low-cost foreign number that receives codes for years without a subscription. Who it does not: anyone who needs voice calls inside mainland China, or whose only requirement is one specific platform that must accept the number.
esimgg-estonia-372-number.conditions: Buy online at esim.gg; the number starts at EUR 2.99 (some numbers also need a first balance); no monthly fee and no identity check; the install code is issued right after payment. Keep it alive with any qualifying activity within 365 days (data, SMS, call, top-up or a successful network registration). The phone must be unlocked and eSIM-capable, or paired with an eSTK or eSIM.me card. Third-party verification codes are not guaranteed.
steps: Open esim.gg and pick a +372 number; numbers marked in red need 24 hours to 3 days before SMS works
After payment take the install code and write it to the phone's native eSIM or an external eUICC
Wait about 24 hours for provisioning, then send a test SMS from the line's diagnostics page
Put the expiry date in a calendar and do one qualifying activity a month early each year
esimgg-estonia-372-number.risk: The EUR 2.99 does not include a first balance, so real opening cost is about CNY 30, and every year needs a small paid activity. The vendor has announced moving from activity-based to balance-based keep-alive, so the yearly cost must be recalculated once that lands. Third-party codes are not guaranteed and one working platform proves nothing for others. New lines need 24 hours to 3 days of provisioning. Voice is unavailable in mainland China and outgoing SMS costs EUR 0.24. The upstream operator can raise prices or shut the service down, with 90 days' notice at best.
esimgg-estonia-372-number.source: eSIM.GG official home page and world coverage and rate pages (updated 2026-11-21: EUR 2.99 number, data from 0.88 per GB, 10GB for 42 countries at EUR 9, China data EUR 4.7 per GB with free incoming SMS and EUR 0.24 outgoing, 145 countries covered) plus the official FAQ and terms (365-day qualifying activity, clause 8 on upstream operator changes) plus nbvil blog purchase test on 2026-10-16 (EUR 2.99, WhatsApp code after about 24 hours, eSTKme Plus+ works) plus WithGoddess test on 2026-10-15 (Telegram codes on listed number ranges, about CNY 30 to open)

clubsim-hk-prepaid-number.title: [Hong Kong] Club SIM: a +852 number with no monthly fee, kept alive by a HKD 15 pass each year (free incoming SMS in the mainland)
clubsim-hk-prepaid-number.highlight: csl's build-your-own prepaid card: no monthly fee and a free eSIM ordered online, with a +852 number once the first order reaches HKD 50; after that one HKD 15 Asia pass within 365 days adds another year, and mainland China receives SMS free
clubsim-hk-prepaid-number.regions: [Hong Kong] A +852 number on csl (HKT) up to 4.5G at 42Mbps; receiving SMS is free worldwide, mainland China can receive SMS but cannot call or send SMS; Hong Kong law requires registration with a passport or a mainland travel permit, and mainland ID cards are not accepted
clubsim-hk-prepaid-number.content:
Club SIM is csl's build-your-own prepaid card from HKT, not a travel eSIM shop: choose an eSIM online and the number follows Hong Kong prepaid rules. Its reputation comes from the keep-alive cost, with no monthly fee and a simple rule that buying any service pack within 365 days of the last one extends the number by another 365 days.

The 2026 change matters: the old HKD 6 SMS pack was withdrawn on 2026-06-30 and support has confirmed there is no plan to bring it back, so the cheapest renewal is now the HKD 15 Asia 24-hour data pass. Keeping a number therefore costs HKD 15 a year, about CNY 13.

A new card has a threshold: the first order must total HKD 50, with the eSIM itself free. The usual combination is the mainland and Macao 1GB pack at HKD 38 (90 days) plus the HKD 15 Asia pass for HKD 53 in total; both packs must be added to the same card, or a second eSIM is created by mistake. Others simply buy the HKD 58 local data and voice pack.

In the mainland it behaves as a receiver: receiving SMS is free worldwide and works without roaming data, so Hong Kong bank codes, App Store verifications and platform sign-ups arrive anywhere. It cannot call or send SMS there, and data needs a separate roaming pack (mainland and Macao 1GB for HKD 38 or 3GB for HKD 88, both 90 days, with social apps advertised as working).

Registration is mandatory: Hong Kong law requires it, unregistered cards get suspended, and only a passport or mainland travel permit is accepted, not a mainland ID. It is done by photo in the app, and later spot checks can ask for documents again. eSIM and physical SIM can be swapped in the app, with a HKD 40 fee for more than one eSIM change a year.

Community test on 2026-11-19 (NodeSeek): bought the HKD 38 and HKD 15 packs, wrote the QR code into a third-party blank card with EasyEUICC, registered with a passport, received an eight-digit +852 number, saw the app show validity to 2027-11-17, and got a Club SIM SMS the same evening, confirming the receive path works.
clubsim-hk-prepaid-number.conditions: Order an eSIM online with a first order of at least HKD 50 (the eSIM is free). Hong Kong local service needs registration first, by passport or mainland travel permit rather than a mainland ID, and unregistered cards cannot call or send SMS. Keeping the number requires buying any service pack within 365 days, currently at least the HKD 15 Asia pass. Packs have their own validity, such as 90 days, separate from the number's validity. The grace period after expiry is short and the number can be lost for good.
steps: On clubsim.com.hk choose an eSIM and packs totalling at least HKD 50, for example mainland and Macao 1GB at HKD 38 plus the HKD 15 Asia pass
Install the QR code from the confirmation email on a native eSIM phone or an external eUICC
Open the Club SIM app and register with a passport or mainland travel permit, then wait for approval
Note the last pack date plus 365 days in a calendar and buy a HKD 15 pass before it comes round
clubsim-hk-prepaid-number.risk: Forgetting the yearly renewal loses the number for good, and every bank or platform tied to it must be changed. The HKD 6 era is over and the yearly cost is now HKD 15. In the mainland it only receives SMS, with no calls or outgoing messages, and data is a separate purchase. Registration is mandatory and a mainland ID is not accepted, so without a passport or travel permit the card is out of reach, and spot checks can follow. Hong Kong numbers have a poor record on AI platforms such as ChatGPT. Packs are non-refundable once ordered.
clubsim-hk-prepaid-number.source: Club SIM official site (clubsim.com.hk checked 2026-11-22: build-your-own prepaid, HKD 15 Asia 24-hour pass, mainland and Macao roaming HKD 38 for 1GB and HKD 88 for 3GB, both 90 days, free eSIM) plus SimDirs Club Sim review (rechecked 2026-11-12: keep-alive rule, HKD 50 first order, registration required for Hong Kong service) plus NomadInit Club SIM guide (2026-08-14: HKD 6 SMS pack withdrawn on 2026-06-30) plus NodeSeek post-1064567 (2026-11-19: HKD 53 order, blank-card install, mainland SMS test) plus the Naixi forum thread 12923 (2026-06-30 withdrawal discussion)

hahasim-hk-prepaid-number.title: [Hong Kong] haha SIM: HKD 50 card with HKD 50 credit, no monthly fee, kept alive by a HKD 10 top-up a year (physical SIM)
hahasim-hk-prepaid-number.highlight: A 3HK prepaid card sold by Fortress: HKD 50 for the card with HKD 50 of credit inside, no monthly fee, and free incoming SMS in the mainland; one HKD 10 top-up a year in the app keeps the +852 number for another 365 days, and only Hong Kong local service needs registration
hahasim-hk-prepaid-number.regions: [Hong Kong] A +852 number on the 3HK network, physical SIM only (no eSIM); valid 365 days from activation and extended a year by any top-up of at least HKD 10; mainland roaming receives SMS free, sends at HKD 3.5, incoming calls HKD 8 a minute; only Hong Kong local service requires registration
hahasim-hk-prepaid-number.content:
haha SIM is the recyclable travel prepaid card from Hutchison (3HK) sold with Fortress, and it is the usual alternative to Club SIM: same +852 number and same no monthly fee, cheaper because the card arrives loaded, more awkward because there is no eSIM.

The card costs about HKD 50 at Fortress and carries HKD 50 of credit, so the SIM itself is effectively free. The box prints a last activation date and the card is void after it. Once activated the balance reads about HKD 50, though a charge of about HKD 3.5 for an SMS can appear first.

Keep-alive follows the Fortress terms: the number is valid 365 days from activation, and one top-up of at least HKD 10 in the haha TRAVEL app every 12 months extends it another 365 days from the top-up date. Two traps: buying a data pack does not count, only a top-up does, and the app's lowest top-up is often HKD 20, so an exact HKD 10 top-up goes through the 3HK prepaid top-up page, which accepts WeChat Pay and Alipay from the mainland. A card expired by less than 14 days can be restored on request without guarantee and needs registration again; later than that the number is gone.

In the mainland it is a receiver: incoming SMS is free, while outgoing SMS costs HKD 3.5, incoming calls HKD 8 a minute, calls to Hong Kong HKD 8 a minute and calls to the mainland HKD 6 a minute. Data comes from day passes bought in the app, commonly HKD 10 a day with about 500MB at full speed. Registration is only compulsory for Hong Kong local service, so a card used purely for roaming codes can stay unregistered; the community also reports that buying one mainland day pass on a new card makes third-party codes arrive more reliably, which the vendor does not state.

Community reports from September to November 2026: numbers are assigned at random and cannot be chosen or changed; the vendor sells no eSIM, and forcing a conversion on iPhone leaves haha TRAVEL unable to log in, so topping up and buying data stop working. WeChat and WhatsApp codes usually arrive, while Telegram and Google have many recent failures, which is a number-range and platform risk-control matter.
hahasim-hk-prepaid-number.conditions: Buy the physical card at Fortress or through 3HK for about HKD 50 with the same credit inside, and activate it before the last activation date printed on the box. Keep the number by topping up at least HKD 10 in the haha TRAVEL app or on the 3HK prepaid page every 12 months; buying data packs does not count. Only Hong Kong local service needs registration, and mainland roaming does not. No eSIM is offered, so the phone needs an unlocked physical SIM slot.
steps: Buy a haha SIM from Fortress and check the last activation date on the box
Turn Wi-Fi off, insert the card in slot one with automatic network selection, and read the +852 number in the activation SMS
Log into haha TRAVEL with the number and ICCID, then screenshot the balance and expiry date
Top up at least HKD 10 before the expiry date each year, using the 3HK page for an exact HKD 10, and confirm the new date
hahasim-hk-prepaid-number.risk: Physical SIM only, with no eSIM, and the last activation date on the box is easy to miss. Keeping the number depends on a top-up, data packs do not count, and the app often starts at HKD 20, so overpaying is common. After 14 days past expiry the number cannot be recovered. In the mainland everything runs on roaming and calls and SMS are expensive. Numbers are random and cannot be chosen, and platforms such as Telegram and Google reject them often. Hong Kong local service needs registration, so an unregistered card is roaming-only.
hahasim-hk-prepaid-number.source: Fortress haha SIM product page and 3HK prepaid terms (checked 2026-11: HKD 50 with HKD 50 credit, 365 days from activation, top-up of at least HKD 10 extends it, data packs do not, registration only for Hong Kong service) plus the UGO EARN hahaSIM guide (2026-09-26, checked against the Fortress site: top-up rather than data pack, HKD 10 mainland day pass, code tests) plus the Linnainai guide (2026-11-01: 14-day limit, unregistered scope) plus the hokada guide (2026-11-10) plus Shuziyoumin hahaSIM introduction (updated 2026-06-18: app minimum HKD 20, official page allows HKD 10)

aws-quick-free-plus-trial.title: [Global] AWS Quick: $0 free plan forever, plus an automatic 30-day Plus trial (no AWS account, no card)
aws-quick-free-plus-trial.highlight: Sign up at aws.amazon.com/quick with any personal email or a Google / Apple / GitHub / Amazon account and you get the $0 single-user Free plan right away: 1GB index storage, AI chat, Research reports, Spaces, custom agents, Flows and one-prompt web apps, with Slack / M365 / Google / QuickBooks connectors. Every new signup also starts a 30-day Plus trial ($25 a month normally) — no AWS account and no credit card at any point.
aws-quick-free-plus-trial.regions: [Global] Sign up directly at aws.amazon.com/quick (aws.com/quick) with an email address or a Google / Apple / GitHub / Amazon account; no AWS account and no credit card. The Enterprise 30-day trial opened from the AWS Console is a different offer (needs an AWS account and turns into paid Enterprise billing), so individuals should skip it.
aws-quick-free-plus-trial.content:
AWS Quick is AWS's AI workspace for work. Since 2026-04-28 it has two plans you can sign up for directly. At aws.amazon.com/quick choose Sign up for free and register with any email or a Google / Apple / GitHub / Amazon account: enter the email, take the 6-digit code, set a password (8+ characters with upper and lower case, a number and a symbol) and the account provisions in about a minute — an AWS account is created behind the scenes and you never touch it, and no card is asked for. After that you can download the macOS desktop app or continue on the web, then pick or skip a work focus and start chatting.

Free plan ($0/month, ongoing): single user (1 maximum), 1GB index storage, and it includes AI chat, Quick Research with cited reports, Spaces, custom chat agents, Quick Flows automation and one-prompt production-ready web apps, plus connectors for Slack, Microsoft 365, Google, QuickBooks and more. AWS's official FAQ states that no Quick plan, free or paid, uses your data to train models.

The 30-day Plus trial starts automatically with the account — nothing to claim and no card: during it you get all Plus features, including shared team Spaces, the browser and Microsoft 365 extensions, user management and centralized billing, 10GB storage per seat, and you can invite up to 10 team members. Plus normally costs $25 per user per month ($20 when billed annually). AWS says that after the trial you choose whether to continue with Plus or move to Free; moving back keeps your data and settings but only the account owner retains access.

Two things not to mix up: Free and Plus exclude Quick Sight BI, Quick Automate and API access, which need the Enterprise plans through the AWS Console. The Enterprise 30-day trial (up to 25 users, subscription and the $250 monthly infrastructure fee waived) is a separate offer that requires an AWS account and starts billing as Enterprise afterwards, so individuals do not need it.
aws-quick-free-plus-trial.conditions: The 30-day Plus trial comes only with a newly created aws.amazon.com/quick account (AWS Console accounts are a different offer). Signing up and the trial need no card; upgrading to Plus requires contact details, a 4-digit SMS phone verification and a credit card, then renews monthly. The Free plan is single-user with 1GB of index storage, and the site lists overage at $5/GB/month. No plan trains models on your data. AWS states only that you choose Plus or Free when the trial ends; it does not say what happens if you do nothing.
steps: Open aws.amazon.com/quick and choose Sign up for free
Register with an email (or Google / Apple / GitHub / Amazon), enter the 6-digit email code and set a password that meets the rules
The account provisions in about a minute; download the macOS desktop app or continue on the web, then skip or pick a work focus
During the trial, go to your avatar → Manage account → Plan and billing to see the current plan, days remaining and estimated charges
To keep the free plan, choose Manage plan → Free within the 30 days; continuing on Plus is the only step that needs details, phone verification and a card
aws-quick-free-plus-trial.risk: No card is taken at signup, so an untouched account cannot be charged; upgrading to Plus is what requires a card, then $25 per user per month renews automatically ($20 on annual billing, which cannot be cancelled mid-term). The billing settings let you enable overages, which start charging beyond your monthly agent hours and 1GB of index storage ($5/GB/month) — leave them off. Two official pages disagree, so check Manage plan after signing in: the pricing comparison marks the desktop app as available on Free, while the FAQ says the desktop app is for Plus, Professional and Enterprise (including the trial); the browser and Microsoft 365 extensions are likewise blank for Free in the table but listed as included in the FAQ. Neither page publishes the monthly agent-hour allowance for Free or Plus (only Enterprise gets 1 / 8 / 18 hours), so heavy use may hit a cap quickly — marked unverified. AWS does not say whether signing up again can bring the trial back, so it is understood as one trial per new account (marked unverified).
aws-quick-free-plus-trial.source: AWS Quick site and pricing page (fetched 2026-11-22), the official Quick FAQ (original wording on the free plan and trial), AWS docs "Signing up at aws.com/quick" and "Plan and billing for AWS Quick Free, Plus, and Max accounts", and the AWS what's-new post of 2026-04-28 announcing the Free and Plus plans
